author: BuffaloSteve
title: 5 Star Service, Location & Hospitality
text:
5-Star: 
Excellent Location, Outstanding Service, and True Marriott Hospitality

My wife and I recently spent a few days at the Element Times Square West during our visit to New York City, and the experience exceeded our expectations.

The location is hard to beat—just a short walk to Times Square, Madison Square Garden, Broadway theaters, restaurants, and multiple subway lines. It made exploring NYC incredibly easy without needing a taxi.

What truly stood out, however, was the service. Anjelita at the front desk was exceptional throughout our stay. We interacted with her several times, and she was consistently friendly, professional, knowledgeable, and eager to help. She made us feel genuinely welcome and was one of the highlights of our stay.

I would also like to recognize Brianna, the General Manager, for her outstanding hospitality. She took the time to assist us personally and arranged a thoughtful room upgrade that made our visit even more special. The communication and attention to guest satisfaction were evident throughout our stay and reflected positively on the entire team.

I should also note, John E in the breakfast area was exceptionally friendly and helpful. He even surprised my wife with hash browns that were not out that day and she mentioned she wanted some in passing… John E showed up at the table with some minutes later. Wow! Salamat, John! 

As a Lifetime Titanium Elite member with more than 2,000 nights at Marriott properties worldwide, I have stayed in many hotels over the years. What keeps me loyal to Marriott is the people, and the team at Element Times Square West exemplifies the hospitality that has made the brand successful.

Thank you to Anjelita, Brianna, and the entire staff for helping make our New York City trip such a memorable experience. We would gladly stay here again on a future visit.

One bonus tip for fellow travelers: If you’re a pizza lover, don’t miss the pizza shop directly across the street called Square Pizza. During our trip I sampled pizza from several well-known NYC locations, and surprisingly, my favorite slice was right there across from the hotel. The classic cheese slice was outstanding, and the garlic knots were the best I’ve ever had. We enjoyed it so much that we went back twice!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

author: Mirlou
title: 3 day New York break
text: Lovely hotel, clean and tidy. Staff were very helpful and polite. Bathrooms were spacious and clean. Bedrooms were ideal size with very comfortable bed. Room had a hob cooker , full size fridge and dishwasher. Rooms were cleaned everyday. Breakfast was a buffet style with pancakes ,omelette ,scrambled eggs which Was lush , sausages and muffins to tea coffee and juices. Hotel is located close to Times Square probably about a 10 minute walk . I would definitely stay at this hotel again

author: Yabrinya T
title: GREAT LOCATION, PRICE AND VIEW!
text:
The location was perfect, short walk to Broadway/Times Square.  The price was reasonable and the view was AMAZING!  Extended stay with small kitchenete, full fridge, stovetop, microwave - save money on meals!  Higher floor (35) no noise and great view of the skyline.  Great HOT breakfast and evening Happy Hour (Beer/wine).  I never had any problem with the slow elevator.
Con - no drawers for my clothes, terrible lighting in the bathroom, no vanity or ledge in the shower to hold my stuff.
Overall, I would stay here again for the price and location, nothing fancy but more than suitable for a Broadway weekend!

author: kevinvalue
title: I'll definitely stay here again!

text:

The staff was amazing!Special shoutout to Cristi that helped us find the nearest landmarks and told us all the details we needed to know!
The locatiob was perfect,near The British Museum and Covent Garden.It is also a few stations away from City Center.The price was amazing for the high quality of the room and you don't have to pay for the bed the kid sleeps in.The halls were empty and everything was quiet.The cleaners would come every day to clean our room,iron our sheets and make our bed.You could not see any dust in this room.There were nicely scented body and hair products.Breakfast was also delicious.

author: ck201292
title: A gem of a hotel in NYC!
text:
What a gem of a hotel! We were originally staying at a larger chain hotel closer to Times Square and made a last minute change to Pestana, and my goodness are we glad we did this!! From arrival, we were greeted with smiles and our flight came in early so we thought we’d have a long wait to check-in, but the lovely Ricardo got us in a room ready for us to start our trip asap. The rooms are spacious, I can’t compare to others in NYC as it was our first visit but it was already better than what we had planned! The sink was in the room which was different but it actually worked nicely! Aircon was fab as it was hot when we stayed, the only slight issue is it kept switching on and off the first night and we realised it was set to auto so after changing it was perfect!!

The hotel was in walking distance to so much and grand central is a 5min walk which was just incredible! With Bryant park also so close, it was the perfect location to see so many sights but be away from the chaos!

We will absolutely stay here again if we return to the city and highly recommend it! Also, the smell as you walk in the hotel was gorgeous!! They provide complimentary breakfast snacks like bagels and fruit which are first come first served. All the staff greeted us with smiles every time we left and returned to the hotel. We didn’t use it, but there’s also a terraced area to sit out and relax if needed. A must stay if you’re in NYC!!

author: Fasantos
title: Great location in NYC
text: I stayed at Pestana Park Avenue for a week in July 2026. The hotel's location is excellent; it's on 39th Street, between Madison and Park Ave, a quarter from 5th Ave and two blocks from NYC Public Library, Bryant Park and Metro Station. My room was the Classic Room, works well for one or two people, but only for two bags. Room with comfortable bed. Bathroom with good shower. Good TV. Air conditioning. Dryer. Amenities such as shampoo, conditioner and liquid soap. The hotel offers a paid service in which you have access to a table area with a kitchen where, daily there are bread and croissants, coffee machine, water, microwave, teas, butter, jelly, milk, fruit (in my stay, it was mandarins). Simple but functional. Do not expect a big breakfast, the menu did not change throughout the week. The staff are very attentive and kind. I found my stay excellent!!!

The Jewel is cosy & friendly, if you like a big lobby entrance this isn’t the place e for you! Everyone we met was friendly, welcoming, helpful, some excellent suggestions for restaurants!
We had a room with a balcony which was so worth it, great to have some outside space & stunning views from the balcony, Radio City Music Hall just across the street.
Room was decent size by NYC standards, spotlessly clean. 
Would stay again in a heartbeat, thoroughly recommend.

author: Debra M
title: Nice hotel.

The hotel is nice and our room was clean. There was only 1 elevator working and the one elevator that did work seemed to have a problem stopping at floor 4. author: ianlowe1970
title: Great Location, very poor hotel
text:
Like some of the previous comments, I wish I’d have checked TripAdvisor before booking this hotel.
No air conditioning, 1 lift out of 2 working, no food or amenities (and there’s a sign strictly forbidding taking food to your room)

SAVE YOUR MONEY AND GO ELSEWHERE

author: Stuart P
title: Not great!
text:
This is a pretty ropey hotel. I just wish I had looked at trip advisor first before booking.
The location is great I have to say, some nice places to eat literally just outside the hotel, including a great coffee house. Tube station a 2 or 3 min walk and the high St less than that. That's where the good points end unfortunately. There is no breakfast or food available in the hotel (I was told this on arrival) so a lot of the stuff you see on booking websites is false. The hotel is really run down, loads of repair work needed, everywhere you look there are bodged repairs. My room was like a furnace as there is no AC. Impossible to sleep in the current summer heat. Lots of homeless people sleeping rough near the hotel and plenty of shady people walking around. To be honest London is getting worse week by week, its a proper grotty city these days and reminds me a lot of the the big US city's where poverty is hidden just a street or two back from the main tourist areas and business districts. 
The staff are friendly enough and the rooms were clean so I cant really blame them for the hotels main misgivings.
Massively overpriced for the a three star hotel. Even based on the location £80 a night would be a fair price to pay.

author: Vera S
title: Unsafe
text: We stayed two nights at this hotel. We had checked into our room on the ground floor and then went straight into town. In the evening we came back. When I pulled up the curtain there was a homeless man AGAINST our window doing drugs. There were also five other people next to our window, who made a lot of noise. We did not feel safe as it is a very thin wooden window that anyone can open with a little effort from the outside. After reporting it to the staff there was no refund possible as they offered us a new room. The new room was fine but very noisy and not well cleaned. I do not recommend this hotel unless you have little to spend.

author: GrandTour66900328188
title: Misleading Photos, Poor Service, and an Extremely Disappointing StayA
text:
Our experience at Cheshire Hotel was extremely disappointing from start to finish.

The hotel bears very little resemblance to the photos used to advertise it. The rooms we received were of a much lower standard than expected, outdated, poorly maintained, and completely different from what was shown online. We chose this hotel based on the advertised images, and the reality was nowhere close.

The customer service made the situation even worse. The reception staff were dismissive, unhelpful, and unwilling to understand or address our concerns. Rather than trying to resolve the issue, they insisted that we pay extra for an "upgrade." The upgraded room was nothing special—a small room with a basic double bed—yet we were charged a total of **£470**, which was completely unreasonable for what was offered.

The payment process for the upgrade was also highly concerning. Instead of providing a secure payment link or accepting a bank transfer, we were asked to provide our credit card details over the phone. This felt unprofessional and did not inspire confidence.

Throughout our stay, the staff were rude, dismissive, and made us feel like our concerns did not matter. Instead of acknowledging that the rooms did not match the advertised standard, they simply refused to help.

This was one of the worst hotel experiences we have had. We would not recommend this hotel to anyone and strongly advise future guests to look elsewhere.

author: Mr C
title: Please consider another hotel
text:
I booked a room with a kitchenette (Studio) on check in I was handed a piece of papers which said cooking was not allowed in the room. Despite it having the microwave and freezer there were no plates or cutlery. They also asked to scan my ID, this is not permitted for UK residents in a UK hotel. 

Once in the room I found evidence of bed bugs in the mattress. I was then moved to another room where the extractor was so loud and again no way to cook or eat in the kitchenette. I was then moved to a third smaller room where the wall paper and the door frame had been tapped up. The door was also already open as we approached.

The receptionist knocked the door again, offering a room change. This would have been the fourth change.

I contacted the hotel with my concerns who responded with. Cooking is not allowed due to fire risks, this suggests the rooms are not fit for purpose and are a fire risk and that the photos do not match their room and appear to be old. 

This means that they were selling rooms that could not be used as their intended purpose a breach of the customer rights act 2015 "A kitchen that cannot be used for cooking is a facility that is "unfit for purpose." 

As well as Consumer Protection from Unfair Trading Regulations 2008 which prohibits "Misleading Actions" and "Bait and Switch" tactics.

Advertising a room with a "kitchenette" implies it is a facility you can use to prepare food. By banning cooking after you paid, they misled you into a contract under false pretences. 

There also also signs staying that if you do not request a safe of give valuables to a manager then items (in rooms) are left at own risk as well as signs with hand sanitizer for covid - 19

These concerns have now been passed on to the council and health and safety for investigation

author: Catherine S
title: Southwark Classic! Luxury and Service brings comfort!
text: My husband and I stayed at The London Bridge Hotel from June 24th through June 27th, 2026. This was during a huge heatwave in London and we were very glad to have the air conditioning in our room and great service provided by the hotel. There is not air conditioning in some of the main areas of the hotel, as is to be expected for London and older buildings. As most people will not be here during a heat wave, this will not matter to most people. The location of this hotel is a key attraction, as you are just a short walk from the London Bridge Tube and Train station, as well as Borough Market, The Shard (it towers over you at the end of the street), Southwark Cathedral, HMS Belfast, Hay's Galleria, and Southbank. It is a slightly longer, but not by too much, walk to London Bridge, All Hallows by the Tower Church, The Tower, The Monument, and all the wonders of the City of London and the Thames in this historic original part of London. Staying where the Romans first set up Londinium, but with all the luxuries a posh 21st century hotel can offer, is quite something. We had reserved afternoon tea for our first day which could not have been more perfect. Coming from the US on an overnight flight, we were graciously allowed to check into our room early, got to take a brief nap and then came down to afternoon tea for our first meal in London. The hotel bar where you are served this is quite lovely! Breakfast is served in the basement restaurant and is delicious and plentiful. Mere steps away from the hotel are many restaurants and cafes, and of course the world famous Borough Market. The staff could not have been more friendly and accomodating. Our room was cozy but full of nice things like a fridge (hidden in a credenza), some fresh fruit and water, and an attentive front desk staff to bring anything else your heart could desire. I could not recommend this hotel any more highly. It is an oasis of luxury in one of the best locations for historic London lovers to stay.

author: Костя Л
title: The worst hotels I've ever had in London.
text:
Booked and paid for Standard Room, 19 m2. In fact, at the time of settlement got a 10 m2 kamorka category Single, half of what he paid for. When I pointed it out at the reception, I started openly claiming that I was wrong, that this was the number that was declared, until I showed the pictures with the real dimensions.

After that, I was "transferred" first to a room on the ground floor with windows that do not open at all and do not know where, then to another room, which turned out to be only 15 m2. I mean, I've been moved in three times and never given what I actually paid for.

And now for the condition of the rooms themselves: no air conditioning, no fan, the fridge covered in chips and scratches, like I've been in an accident, the drawers of nightstands and chests of drawers falling off or completely broken, the walls stained with black divorces and scratched, and at the end they gave me torn towels - as if that were normal.

Breakfast, which in a Booking.com photo looked varied, in reality turned out to be a couple of scarce hot dishes, one kind of sausage, one kind of cheese, three kinds of fruit and cereal with milk. OK.

As if that weren't enough - the floor is undergoing a full renovation: drill, hammer, workers constantly walking down the hall. There was no mention of this on the hotel's website, Booking.com or check-in.

I approached the front desk with each problem separately, repeatedly, and each time I got a denial - even when I showed the photos as direct evidence. No one was solving anything or helping.

For that kind of money and the four stars you're claiming, it's a real horror. Don't believe the photos on the site, the reality turned out to be completely different.

author: Jane H
title: Fire safety risk and very expensive for poor quality room
text: As with many of the other reviews this hotel was outrageously over priced for a Saturday night in July and in poor condition. We were on the 4th floor up very steep narrow stairs so completely inappropriate for anyone with lots of luggage and unfit; thankfully we weren’t.  There was no fire safety information in the rooms and it was abundantly clear we wouldn’t have stood a chance in a fire, nor know where to go other than down the main staircase.  Very unsafe.  My mattress was ancient with springs sticking through into my back and stains on it.  We checked them for signs of beds bugs given previous reviews, which thankfully did seem to be absent and the linen was clean.  The room was very hot and had old fashioned halogen lights which made it even hotter.  We were able to fully open windows after standing on chairs and had a fan, which helped.  No bedside tables or lamps and very poor room security with key lock boxes outside each room that could easily be broken into and door locks with no secondary locking mechanism.  I felt like I was in a hostel not a hotel room that cost us £250!  Should have been more like £50!  No safe for valuables . These are old buildings with the limitations that come with them which includes poor room to room insulation.  The new manager, who was helpful,  certainly has a job on his hands to upgrade this hotel which I understand was closed earlier in the year due to complaints.  I am surprised the authorities allowed it to be reopened on fire safety grounds alone.

author: Steve P
title: Not a delightful stay, but a useful location.
text:
We frequently have short stays in London for concerts, and are aware that you either have to stay a long way from the centre or pay a lot of money to get decent accommodation. Accommodation in London is very expensive. For a one night stay we accept that we will pay £100 plus for very limited, scruffy, tired, and cramped accommodation. So it is important to have realistic expectations when booking accommodation in a popular central location well served with transport and a range of restaurants and eateries. There are plenty of negatives about the Amsterdam Hotel, but there are positives as well.
It is a good location - Earls Court station just around the corner, plenty of buses, and a varied choice of eateries. It is a quiet and attractive street. The men who are paid to sit in the lobby and greet guests are very friendly and helpful. The TV has a good range of channels. And the free WiFi is strong and stable. We paid less than £200 for three people for two nights over the Easter weekend.

Though we are used to tired and scruffy accommodation, the Amsterdam Hotel did surprise us by how run down and scruffy it is. There appears to be little effort in keeping the place smart. The tired stair carpet has clearly not been hoovered for days. There are broken doors, rubbish, and general clutter left in corners and alcoves. It's not a good look. And it wouldn't take much to make it look better. Fix the doors or put curtains over the alcoves. Hire staff to hoover the carpet every day.
We had a room on the fourth floor. The building has high floors, so in reality it is more like climbing six floors. To be fair, it is quite common for accommodation in London (same as in Paris) not to have lifts. But if you have trouble climbing stairs, be aware that it's a long haul to the top!
The room was very tired and basic, and has no view to speak of, as the window looks out onto the balustrade. So you see the concreate balustrade and some sky. Beds had little support, so not good for someone with a bad back. The table is insecure and unreliable to support a kettle with boiling water. Take care. The room is generally tired and scruffy, but not dirty or smelly or damp. The toilet and shower are usable, although the space is quite cramped. The switch for the extractor fan is on the right above the door and light switch.
There were no toiletries when we arrived, and only two cups in the room; but, on being told, the chap downstairs brought us up a third cup and a bottle of shower gel.

author: Daydream49764408592
title: Toxic Work Environment
text:
I wouldn’t recommend working for Travelodge based on my experience. The managers often seemed to be on power trips and set unrealistic expectations, particularly when it came to the number of rooms you were expected to clean between 10am and 2pm. Being expected to clean 17 rooms within that timeframe felt unreasonable, especially when management would simply tell you to “hurry up” multiple times and “clean faster” rather than offering any support.

There was also an instance where a staff member was expected to work both a morning and a night shift on the same day, which I found concerning and would question whether it was appropriate and even legal. There needs to be an investigation that goes on in that place. Another issue was the way staff were treated when making small mistakes. Something as minor as putting a cup in the wrong position or forgetting to replace a coffee could result in staff being made to feel demoralised rather than being given constructive feedback.

Communication with reception was another major problem. On numerous occasions, staff would try to call reception to report that they were unable to attend a shift, but the phone often wouldn’t be answered. Despite this, managers would tell staff to keep calling, even when there was clearly nobody answering. Also would put in the work groupchat a indirect message about to call the reception instead of messaging the number.

Overall, I found the management style stressful and unsupportive, with unrealistic workloads and poor communication. Based on my experience, I would think carefully before considering a job with Travelodge.

author: someguyonthego
title: budget prices AND budget experience
text:

author: Charlie T
title: Excellent stay + Value for Money
text:
Stayed just the one night at this hotel. Not entirely sure why it has such a low score, as we had an excellent stay. We had a late arrival and immediately the staff welcomed us and offered some water whilst checking in. The rooms are indeed dated, but they are exactly like the photos and are more than adequate and the premium rooms are an option where they have been renovated. There unfortunately was no gold upgrades as the hotel was busy, but the staff did check for this. The only pain was there was no plug sockets by the end which was a shame. No outside noise as we were on the 8th floor and also at the back of the hotel (most rooms face the back of the hotel).
However, the breakfast was exceptional, possible one of the best I have had across the Hilton group. The staff were super attentive, the offering was excellent, across both the hot and cold options.
Overall, for what is one of the cheapest Hilton’s consistently across London (often far cheaper than nearby Premier inn and travelodge), it has excellent service and a good night sleep. Would recommend.

author: Viscount Philip
title: Thank you so much
text:
Simply the best Hilton Hotel in London - As a Hilton Diamond Honors Member I have stayed at this hotel many times over the last few years. It offers excellent value for money; the rooms are clean and spacious; the breakfast is best of class; the staff friendly and welcoming. A few special mentions - Francesca (charming and lovely), the reception team (fantastic and helpful); the breakfast team (amazing and efficient - including the lovely waiter who gets my second cup of coffee); the bar team (very hard working and well looked after during the Diamond Happy Hours). Let’s hope that when the hotel does get a refurb none of its fine charm is lost.

Thank you for always looking after me.

author: Rory D
title: Excellent Staff
text: Currently staying at the Hilton Olympia. I would like to say a big thank you for the excellent and friendly service provided by Bedillia, Natasha, Theo and the rest of the bar team. I always look forward to coming to this hotel as they really make the difference between a faceless service and an enjoyable experience.

author: cb
title: Just an ok hotel
text: Our room was clean, the lobby and restaurants were nice. The first two floors of the hotel felt tired, like they needed a good upgrade. The breakfast was the same each morning, after seven days, it would have been nice to have something a little different. Overall it was ok.

author: Dominic S
title: Good hotel with good people
text:
I checked-in today and the very helpful Ama assisted me magnificently.

A spot of promotion is well-deserved for this young lady I think!

author: Dominic S
title: Great hotel with great people!
text:
I checked in at the Tara Hitel and a lovely lady Ama was very helpful in assisting me.

Well-deserving of promotion I think.

author: Patricia P
title: Top
text: Celebrating my bday, Riya’s attention was excellent

author: Shivrajk1
title: Yet another most satisfactory stay at the Copthorne Tara Kensington
text: I regularly stay at the Copthorne Tara as I am sort of the rewards programme. The location, is perfect, parking is easy and very reasonable for the area and the friendly and professional staff  are always a pleasure to deal with especially on this occasion Dina and Giselle.

author: dtengineering
title: Friendly, Helpful Reception and a Great Location!
text:
We recently stayed at the Cura as part of a longer trip to the UK. The front desk staff were very helpful and attentive to our needs as we arrived early and (after a few lovely days) had a late flight out.

The location was fabulous... just a short walk to the Earl's Court Underground station and walking distance to many of the major department stores and museums. We were close enough to the touristy bits that we could get there easily, but just far enough out that there were local folks at the pubs and restaurants in the neighbourhood, too.

A special thank you to the hotel for the nice little treat that appeared in our room on our Wedding Anniversary evening!

author: Dream65620232932
title: A Comfortable Base for Exploring London
text:
We had a good stay at Cura Hotel Kensington and found it to be a convenient and comfortable option for visiting London.

The location was a definite highlight — it’s within walking distance of the Tube station, making it easy to get around the city and reach the major sights without much hassle. There are also plenty of shops, restaurants, and cafés in the surrounding area.

Our room was clean, charming, and comfortable, with everything we needed for our stay. The hotel has a nice character to it, and it was a pleasant place to come back to after a busy day exploring London.

The staff were helpful and friendly, and we appreciated how accommodating they were whenever we needed assistance.

Overall, it was a solid stay with a convenient location, clean rooms, and helpful service. A good option if you’re looking for somewhere comfortable and well-connected while visiting London.

author: Karla J
title: Possibly our new go-to hotel in London!
text: I love this hotel! The staff couldn't have been kinder and even placed a birthday treat in the room. While the hotel is a little out of the center of things, it was nice to come back to a quieter neighborhood after the bustle of the theater district. The gym is very good; the breakfast excellent and the room was a decent size for London and reasonably priced. It's near the tube and an easy walk to Hyde Park.

author: Marcus Choi
title: Cozy and Close to the Tube
text: Cura Kensington was a convenient home base for our stay in London. Its location was excellent—just a short walk from the Underground, making it easy to explore the city, and surrounded by plenty of great local cafés, pubs, and restaurants. Our room was cozy and comfortable, though the hotel does show its age. The plumbing was a bit noisy during showers, which was noticeable, but it didn’t take away from the overall experience. If you’re looking for a well-located hotel with easy access to transportation and neighborhood dining, Cura Kensington is a solid choice.

author: David S
title: Friendly staff, good location and recently renovated so clean and newish
text:
The Cura has very nice decor having been recently renovated.
It is in a good location with friendly staff.  
There was a comfortable bed albeit the rooms are smallish/cosy (which is common in London) but there is a big screen TV.
The lack of a nespresso machine and fridge was a let down.  
breakfast limited - continental with a couple of pre-cooked extras

author: Sue B
title: Lovely little gem of a hotel .
text: Lovely hotel although we had a ground floor room which was a tad clausophobic. But bed was comfy staff lovely and air con was bliss . Great location  and free bag drop before and after stay was very helpful .

author: Timtom124
title: Nice place, noisy underground
text:
Attended 13th through to the 15th July place is not bad, staff are good and rooms are clean and certainly decent for getting your head down. Only downside it is a bit noisy from the underground 
Didn’t try the breakfast so cannot comment

author: margery H
title: The most gracious and helpful staff
text: I became ill while staying at this well situated hotel very close to Victoria bus station and Victoria station. They were most supportive with advice and luggage and provided laundry service at a reasonable price.

author: Steph
title: Best place to stay for me
text: Excellent location for me. Spotlessly clean with wonderful kind and friendly staff. Will definitely stay there again

author: holidayheaven
title: Perfect for us .
text:
Had the most comfortable and welcoming stay here at the Portico....great location, quiet, well equipped and tastefully decorated rooms.
Staff were helpful and charming.
We stayed 2 nights whilst visiting the Chelsea Flower Show and would happily return without hesitation.

author: Joe B
title: A nice hotel in a nice area staff all make an effort to make you feel welcome .
text: A lovely hotel who are making great efforts to improve and the addition of a swimming pool has made the difference.The barman Zaheen is a great asset for the hotel as he remembered that we visited the hotel 6 years previous

author: Adam W
title: Calm place to stay with very helpful staff
text:
Hitel provides a calm and peaceful place to stay when visiting Rome. The pool is great for cooling down after a day of walking and sight seeing. 

Staff are great, cheerful and alway happy to help. Variety and quality of Breakfast was very good. 

We opted for two family rooms with joining door. Both the rooms and bathrooms were spacious and kept very clean each day by staff which was great. 

The hotel is a 10min bus ride from the city centre and there are bus stops right outside the hotel making travel easy. Taxis can be booked using the 'free now' app and always arrived very quickly as well.

author: Santi V
title: Very good hotel with very attentive staff!
text:
A great hotel that met all the necessary requirements. We were very comfortable and the staff's treatment was exceptional.
We took away a great impression of the hotel and we especially appreciate the great attention from María Cristina and Roberta. Thank you!

author: 44Kate
title: Fantastic hotel highly recommend
text:
Just returned from a 5 night stay , can  not fault this hotel at all . Staff were amazing hotel was excellent.  We booked through on the beach . I emailed the hotel direct a few weeks prior to see if they they offered airport transfer and they did , Maria was absolutely brilliant on the email arranging this , we had private transfer and Maurizto messaged me to say he was waiting outside and was brilliant. Only took about 30 mins and cost euro 65 . Hotel also arranged from transfer  back too . ( if you are on early flight they will also do you a breakfast bag to go which was brilliant too ) 
Our room
Was lovely king size bed and large sofa bed converted into bed ( teenager said bed was very comfy ) there is a fridge in room which was great and coffee machine , there is also a safe , steam
Iron and in our room couple of the sockets had usb ports , air con 
Shower  lovely and had shampoo and shower gel , we had email from hotel checking how we were settling in and just asking on feedback to which I just said could of done with more coffee pods and coat handles the next day knockOn door with all
Of this ! How amazing service !
Breakfast lovely served 7am -10am and lovely can’t fault it . Swimming pool absolutely brilliant and so happy to booked hotel with pool as was 40deg so was lovely to come back and co
Off , also had a pool day and chilled round the pool and had light snacks and drinks . They serve snack food until 9pm in hotel and drink until 11pm nice seating and lighting outside  
About 15 min walk to metro ( turn left outside hotel up to top of road and turn left all way down there ( just passed mc Donald’s ) also some other shop up there to to get your bus pass ( one with t outside) bus tickets includes metro too eur 150 for 100 min ( remember if on bus you must tap it to validate it ) bus conductors do get on we had one on ours ) there is bus stop outside takes you to city and we also went to trastervere  too ( took 2 stops)  
. We also walked to Vatican took approx 40 mins not ideal in heat but did it early morning . Metro is by far east but if you don’t fancy walk you have bus option outside . 
Lovely restaurant just 3mins down road called Ristorante Arturo turn right outside hotel ( shut on Mondays ) , it’s just before Crown  plaza hotel which is also has a restaurant you can go to too. We also walked past crown plaza to end of road At lights  then turned right and about another 5 min walk and found little sushi bar called nana sushi we had take out and took it back to room ( caught the bus back ) few other little restaurants there and then carry on walking up there is a little fair little ones on right hand side ( just past pharmacy)
We booked a lot of our trips with get your guide and never had any issues . 
Hope this of help . ( dont forgot water bottles to  fill up as lots of water fountains in the city. )

author: Ladydizzydi
title: Lovely stay and good value for money
text: Had a lovely 2 night stay. Added bonus having the pool in the very hot heat. Nice to be able to chill by a pool after a long day of sight seeing. Friendly staff

author: Steph S
title: Great!
text: The hotel is in an ideal location, there's transport to everywhere in London. There was plenty of choice of restaurants very near to the hotel. The room was lovely and clean and came with a fan to help keep us cool in the warm weather. We had everything we would need as we didnt spend much time in our room. Staff were all friendly and helpful. We did have a lot of stairs to get to our room, however, we were aware of this possibility when we booked and we were prepared for it. Would absolutely stay here again.

author: Marco
title: Some things need to be reviewed
text:
The area is wonderful, Paddington 
The hotel is nice but has no elevator, so for those who have difficulty, it is a significant effort
The tap water is currently not drinkable, we did not understand why

Clean

author: Yvonne S
title: I liked it
text:
Just a good choice 🙂
Close to everything...Paddington station, Hydepark & pubs

author: Thorsten K
title: Top hotel at a low price.
text: Impeccable and very clean. Small cozy room. Great service and excellent breakfast. Staff friendly and helpful. Hopefully back there next year.

author: Franky F
title: Okay for 1-2 nights.
text:
Close to Paddington Station. Noisy due to other guests and you can feel the subway passing underneath.
The breakfast is hot and cold and tastes quite good, only the coffee does not taste good.

author: Kath R
title: Thanks to the staff at The Bloomsbury Thistle
text: Great place to stay, central and very easy to get to subway. Staff at front desk Genevieve very helpful with directions and ensuring we were comfortable whilst Liudmyla was always smiling and cheerful  at breakfast. Thanks for a lovely stay.

author: francescovesco1960
title: Stay in London
text: I booked a double room. The room is not very big but well-structured with the bare essentials. It doesn't have air conditioning but a fan that would be sufficient if the windows could be opened more than 20 cm in height (in fact, one of the windows wouldn't stay open and you had to put something to hold it up). The breakfast is excellent and varied for both sweet and savory. Overall it was a pleasant stay.

author: cat20142014
title: Excellent stay
text: Located close to amenities and the tube, staff were always happy and cheerful, breakfast lovely and room spotless

author: Susan S
title: Great stay

It was a great price as we got hotel and train fares together. Genevieve needs a special mention. She was helpful, friendly always smiling and easy to talk to.  Thank you for a lovely stay. Would definitely return x

author: Mobile65276010865

Bloomsbury is a lovely area and the hotel in the centre of it. I was glad I upgraded to a deluxe room which had air con and much nicer. Breakfast was spot on.

author: estrela burga
title: Good location very poor conditions and dirty

The only cute thing is the street facade (all the entrances to these hotels are the same) no air conditioning, a fan that is useless, from the balcony you can enter the adjacent room if the window is open (so it could be dangerous) the mattresses are horribly old, the springs hurt, the carpet is super dirty and old, the shower is smaller than in a cruise ship cabin, about 50 cm on each side, the bedding looks old and don't even get me started on the terribly old pillows, the hotel in general looks old and dirty everywhere, plus expensive for what it is. author: K H
title: Seriously avoid- ignorant and dismissive to guests
text: The location is the only good thing. About 2 hours after we checked in a stream of water poured into our room’s from the top of the window. We checked it had been fully closed when this happened, then went to report it to the front desk. The staff member they sent down with us to check it repeatedly dismissed us saying it wasn’t inside, while mopping the puddle up from the window sill- something my partner tried to explain multiple times but was just ignored and dismissed every time. Considering that treatment, the fact you have to hand in your own room key any time you want to go outside and the clear uncleanliness and lack of security of the place, we quickly booked a different hotel and left. Since then our complaint has been completely ignored- clearly a trend considering their lack of responses to complaints on Booking.com

author: Loobie-loo76
title: You get what you pay for….
text: Staff very friendly and helpful. Property was  in a fabulous location. However, our room and bathroom were pretty dire…you get what you pay for! One night was ok, but that was enough! And breakfast…free or not was awful…

author: Ale S
title: If you know them you avoid them. A nightmare.
text:
I swear if I could put zero stars on this "place," because it doesn't deserve to be called a hotel, I would put them on. Upon our arrival it seemed to me to have entered a nightmare, the room was in a basement, the stairs to go down were all covered with plastic, until you get to room n. 25 in which we were placed: the floor at our entrance was dirty, full of dust and hair (something reported and for which no solution was found), the walls of the room peeled and with moisture seepage, the bathroom sink is smaller than a goldfish tank, the shower dirty and malfunctioning (hot water practically absent). We refused to try breakfast the next morning because the hygiene and health regulations of this place are non-existent! Really sucks, having spent about 120 euros for such a room
STAY AWAY IF YOU CAN from this place.

author: Nadeem A
title: Overall, we had a good family stay
text:
Overall, we had a good family stay and would like to thank Rahul, Waqas, Maria, and the housekeeping team for their kindness and assistance. The housekeeping lady was polite.
However, as an Accor Gold member, I was disappointed that no room upgrade was offered or even discussed during our 11-night stay. I would have expected my loyalty status to be recognized.
I would also like to highlight the following concerns:
Cleanliness: The room and ceiling areas were dusty. The area underneath the minibar/fridge was extremely dusty. I informed a team member and showed a photo, but it was never cleaned. Some bed linen was also old and had visible marks.
7th-floor ice machine: The ice machine was out of order throughout our stay, which was inconvenient.
Restaurant service: We had dinner at the all-day dining restaurant on our first night and paid cash. Service was not very attentive, and one pregnant staff member was particularly rude.
Bar service: The Mirror Bar staff were friendly, but some appeared to be trainees and lacked sufficient product/service knowledge.

Drink vouchers: Because we accepted alternate-day housekeeping, complimentary drink vouchers were offered. However, cocktails were refused when requested, and my son was also refused a milkshake. The voucher conditions should have been explained clearly.

Overall experience: I understand that service standards may differ between London and Dubai/UAE, but the cleanliness, maintenance, service, and attention to detail did not consistently reflect what I would expect from a four-star Accor hotel. At times, the experience felt closer to basic/student accommodation, with the hospitality element missing.

The hotel is large and has great potential, and we did meet some excellent staff. I am sharing this feedback constructively and hope management will take these points seriously and use them to improve the guest experience and better recognise loyal Accor members.

regards 

Nadeem Ahmad

author: John W
title: A positive, comfortable stay in a conveniently located hotel
text: As I had paid extra for early check in , the process was seamy! I still don’t agree with being charged£50 per night holding fee even though the room had been paid for. Reception area is spacious with friendly staff .the room was also spacious with a comfortable bed, which had a convenient plug point by the bed. Both room and bathroom were clean with a/c available. Coffee/tea provided as well as water in the mini fridge. The safe however did not work. There was also an iron and hairdryer and Rituals shower gel, shampoo and body lotion. Ample towels were provided however the bath/shower lacked a bath mat which made it slippery to have a shower. The hotel is convenient to public transport and shops!

author: Roberto B
title: Excellent accommodation
text: Modern hotel located in an excellent position. Comfortable rooms and bathroom and good cleanliness. Very satisfactory welcome with check-in carried out by Maria. Breakfast enjoyed only one day, satisfactory in the quality and quantity of the food, but the room used for it was a bit too chaotic.

author: Aventuraviajero
title: They take deposits and you struggle to get it back
text:
This hotel took a deposit of £50 for each day I stayed, This was on top of charging me for the room on checking in. That was money I needed for my trip. It was in my budget. Why take this deposit? They assured me the deposit would be returned to my account a few days ago. They have not returned it despite my messages asking for it. Now I could end up in a dispute with them. I don't remember other hotels taking a deposit from me.

And, BTW, the room was not very good. It was getting shabby and I do not think they give it maintenance. I do not see this hotel as 4 star but 3 star.

author: Özgür TUNCAY
title: Comfortable Stay with Excellent Transport Links
text:
Comfortable Stay with Excellent Transport Links

We had a very comfortable stay at Novotel London West. One of the biggest advantages of the hotel is its location. Hammersmith Underground Station is just a short walk away, and the Piccadilly Line provides a direct and convenient connection to central London, making it very easy to explore the city.

The Hammersmith area itself is also a great place to stay. There are plenty of pubs, bars, restaurants and cafés nearby, so even after returning from a busy day of sightseeing, there are many places within walking distance to enjoy the evening.

The hotel was comfortable, clean and relaxing, and our room provided a very pleasant place to rest after long days exploring London.

Overall, Novotel London West offers a very good combination of comfort, location and easy access to public transport. Being able to reach central London so easily while staying in the lively Hammersmith area was a real advantage. I would happily stay here again on my next visit to London.

author: rh14n
title: Good location and lovely hotel
text:
Location of this hotel is excellent. Close to Tower of London, Tower Bridge, The Shard and Bishopsgate. Also a 2 minute walk from Tower Hill tube station which is takes you on the district and the circle line. The rooms were lovely and spacious and clean. Stocked with hand wash shampoo, shower gel, fresh towels daily. Also had tea and coffee making facilities in the room, a mini fridge, a hairdryer and an iron.
We opted for breakfast at the Hotel one morning and it was very good with everything you could possibly want for full cooked breakfast and continental options. We also ate at the Natural Kitchen,  the restaurant in the hotel and their staff were lovely and the food was wonderful.
Not in a noisy or extremely street or part of London. 
Very good value for money for location and convenience and great staff.

author: J O B
title: Amazing service by Basit
text: We went to the hotel for a couple of days during July to visit some friends in London, we were mostly served by a gentleman called Basit, he was really kind and helped us out with our multitude of questions while providing great service. The hotel was amazing and the roof garden is really nice.

author: Caner Kocamaz
title: Central location and comfortable room
text: Had a fantastic stay at the end of July. Great location with Circle and District Tube lines in walking distance, and clean and comfortable room, bigger than most at the same price range. Hideki at the front desk was exceptional.

author: Younes S
title: Amazing customer service from Sehar
text:
We had such a lovely experience at the DoubleTree by Hilton Tower Hill, and a huge part of that was thanks to Sehar. She was absolutely amazing from start to finish, so friendly, welcoming and genuinely went above and beyond to look after us.

You can really tell when someone genuinely enjoys looking after their guests, and Sehar was a perfect example of that.

Thank you so much, Sehar, for being so lovely and making our stay even more enjoyable. The hotel is lucky to have you!

author: Daryl
title: Not a great review
text:
Checkin was very good, room clean and suitable. Houskeeping need to ensure that they clean the cups in the room, had to request that these were changed. The ececutive lounge was understaffed snd not greeted warmly, the drinks were limited to larger and wine with usual soft drinks and food very average.
Dont expect to get a relaxing morning. We were woken by the refuse collection at 0615 and he noise from the road below didnt stop till we finaly gave on and got up, we were on the 6th floor. Would i stay again, as a Diamond honours member this did not live up to the experiance that normally comes with that tier and would look for another hotel for the reasons above.

author: Jennifer
title: Not as good as it used to be.
text:
My sister and I have been coming to this Best Western in Swiss Cottage every year since 2017.  The hotel location is very convenient - in a nice residential area, steps from the Tube station (and therefore everything you might want to see in London). 

Sadly, the previous owner passed away last year, and the new owners seem to have a different focus. In the past, we have been greeted like family - with hugs and people genuinely happy to see us.  This year, we found that some of the long-term staff were leaving, and/or reducing shifts due to the changes. The new staff don't seem to understand what working in hospitality means, and some of them were dismissive, and one was downright rude. I feel sorry for the first-time guests, for whom this was their only experience of this hotel, because I can't imagine they'll be returning. We have decided to return once more in 2027, to see if any positive changes have been made with the feedback that we and others have given them.  If we don't see any improvements, our 10th stay will be our last.

author: Jo R
title: Lovely Hotel, Friendly Staff
text:
Lovely hotel, A bit dated but was spotless and the staff were lovely, No aircon so it was hot, they did provide fans but they only circulated hot air. 
Didn't have the breakfast so cannot comment on that. 
We found it very quiet not noise from other rooms or heavy feet upstairs.
Would come back but not when its this hot.

author: ARK66
title: Great Location
text:
Great staff & location! The neighborhood was quiet, yet near a lot of activity. The farmer’s market & food stalls next door was a pleasant surprise!
Staff was great.
Right next to an Underground station as well!

author: Desiree H
title: Disappointed!
text: Well located & clean & 2 staff members were helpful. Hotel branded as a 3 star hotel, when in reality it's probably closer to a 2 star hotel. Booked a 9 night stay. One would think that I would have been given a decent room with an air conditioner given the length of stay. This is by far my worst stay I have have ever had during my travels in my lifetime. My room temperature was probably between 40 and 45 degrees every day and night - no Air Conditioner provided, despite my length of stay. I was told the hotel has 4 rooms which have Air Conditioners - well I was not allocated one, despite staying for 9 nights and being unwell during my stay. I did request a room with an Air Conditioner during my stay, given my condition, but this was not provided nor was a plan made to get me a portable Air Conditioner. Needless to say, I was unable to sleep at night due to the level of heat in my room and I never recovered from my illness whilst I stayed at the hotel - in fact I went backwards, due to having to deal with the intense heat. There was also a 3 day event held at the hotel whilst I was there and it was very disruptive, as attendees took over the lounge and bar area every day and evening and other guests were unable to use those facilities as there was no where to sit. Attendees also congregated outside my room and made a noise one afternoon when I was trying to get some rest, given that I was unwell. On Trip Advisor it says the hotel has a Newspaper, provides bottled water and has a safe. Well this is not the case - the rooms have no safe, bottled water is not provided and a newspaper is not provided or made available for guests. The rooms also do not have a bar fridge where guests can keep soft drinks cool during their stay. I would not recommend this hotel - it's outdated, does not have the amenities it says it has and it's not 3 stars!

author: Louise C
title: Very Poor All Round
text: Great location but that's where the great ended.  Very shabby hotel in need of decoration.  Room was like a sauna, bathroom dirty, stained towels, no shower gel, handle on furniture missing or broken and tiny twin beds.  Bar not open to the times advertised.  Breakfast was good but very slow.

author: Marsha M
title: Great help from Norman! Bell assistant
text: Norman the Bellman was very helpful! He assisted in places to Eat. We ate at bakery and deli next door! It was very good. He recommended the hotel restaurant Shanghai Me! It was really amazing food and excellent service!

author: Sightseer12224700220

author: FarAway50613459243
title: My stay at Hilton London

The room was comfortable, clean, and well maintained, and the staff were friendly, welcoming, and helpful throughout my stay. Overall, it was a pleasant and relaxing experience, and I would happily recommend this hotel to anyone visiting London.

author: Wander65221855798

author: Jay R
title: Digital check in

author: FarAway309329

text:
We spent 14 nights with the family (5) and we had two connecting rooms and additional.The hotel Consciege and front desk were very helpful it’s very close to underground stations with a bus stop by the hotel and a big shopping mall Westfield.

Very good breakfast to start the day and Mihaela Sandu and her team were very exceptional.Thank you

author: Flyer56949473145
title: VASI

author: Avgoustini S
title: Really nice place to stay in London
text:
Our staying at the Hilton Kensington hotel was great! The rooms were clean, modern and comfortable, the receptionists and the concierge always polite, smiling and helpful and the breakfast was amazing, fresh, hot and with an enormous variety of dishes. Michaela there was really nice!

author: Caroline Moore
title: Pleasant stay
text: Pleasantly suprised after reading previous reviews. Yes the hotel could do with some updating. But rooms clean, beds comfortable and air con just about adequate in the heatwave. Stayed for 2 nights. Bus stops right outside the hotel, which was great. The hotel staff were all very welcoming. Had breakfast the day we left and it was of a good standard. It was very busy, but we got seated very quicly. I'd defintely be happy to stay here again.

author: Naomi <3
title: Book book book!!! :)
text: Had a lovely stay here, rooms were super clean, The hotel was so accommodating, had pleasant interactions with housekeeping staff and also breakfast staff especially Samir who was so kind and helpful!!! Tbh all the staff were quite friendly from the ones who helped us to store our bags and everyone working breakfast A1 service and professionalism!!!. No hand soap in the bathroom but clearly just an oversight lol :) they were quite busy when we checked in. Honestly sad we couldn’t stay longer, Booked through love holidays so great value for money, great place to stay and would definitely come back again! Thank you so much

author: Clara B
title: Great hotel
text: Perfect experience! The hotel is well located, very nice, clean and the staff is really nice! Thanks to Zain especially 😊

author: missHamm21
title: It's OK here
text: Ok stay, no major complaints.  The room is basic and could have been cleaned better (found previous occupants documents under the bed).  Room was 231 right opposite the lifts so a little noisy at times.  However, we all slept perfectly well.  Hotel bar and restaurant just ok.  Breakfast also just ok.  So all round everything is OK at this hotel.  Wouldn't pay above £250 for it though.

author: Albino F
title: Good temporary house in London
text: Great location, about a 10-minute walk from the train and metro station. The staff was very polite and helpful—special thanks to Abu at reception for being so welcoming! Comfortable rooms and a generous breakfast.

author: James T
title: Great experience
text: I have regularly stayed at Crown Plaza kings cross and have always had a great time. Aneta has always taken great care of us!

author: Dayne o
title: Excellent
text:
I went to London for a weekend with my 8- and 6-year-old children. We loved the hotel, which is truly "family friendly." 
At breakfast, Shine was adorable with the children and made sure we didn't lack for anything. Thanks to him. 
We will come back for sure.

author: JohnHart_13
title: One night stay for Hyde Park concert
text:
The hotel is about 7 or 8 minutes from Lancaster Gate tube and about 3 or 4 minutes from the nearest entrance to Hyde Park so it very convenient for that part of London.

The rooms are clean but quite small and the bathroon looks a little bit dated but the there was a large comfy bed. Reception staff were friendly but there was no breakfast option as their breakfast room was still being refurbished, finishing in Auguest ?

author: Fred P
title: Disappointed deceived experience!!
text:
Very disappointed experience. Everything we were expecting, according to their website, was a lie. The only thing that made us stay longer was the good attitude and willingness of the front desk ladies and the manager. Unfortunately we couldn’t keep up with the amount of problems we faced. Smelly rooms, broken shower in the bath room. Additionally the safe box didn’t work and when was changed the tool guy left sharp pointed screws on the floor and my daughter almost had an accident with them. 
The building is old and supposedly in renovation. Anyone can describe it as tasteless facelift. I don’t understand why they are in business deceiving guests with fake fotos of something far away from the reality. Don’t get near the place your money is very welcome somewhere else. We finally decided to move to another much better hotel almost for the same amount of money.

author: Katrine
title: A great London-hotel
text: Clean, charming rooms with comfortable beds. Nice breakfast! Friendly and service minded staff. Easy to find and a central location!

author: Amy T
title: Exceptional kindness and outstanding customer service
text:
Exceptional kindness and outstanding customer service

Although I was unfortunately unable to stay due to a family medical emergency, I felt compelled to leave a review because of the exceptional kindness and compassion shown by the hotel team.

When I explained that my mother had become seriously ill, Simona Mihalache, the Front Office and Reservations Manager, responded with genuine empathy and immediately cancelled my reservation free of charge as a gesture of goodwill. During an incredibly stressful time, this act of understanding meant so much to me and my family.

It’s easy to review a hotel after a stay, but I believe the true measure of hospitality is how people treat you when unexpected circumstances arise. The professionalism, warmth, and compassion I experienced have left a lasting impression.

Thank you again to Simona and the entire team for your kindness. I sincerely hope to visit in the future under much happier circumstances, and I would not hesitate to recommend this hotel based on the outstanding customer care I received.

author: Shirley S
title: Loved the location and front staff
text:
Staff were amazing- the location was fine and a nice neighbourhood
The rooms are small and the restaurant was closed sadly as they are renovating. We asked for soap, maps and ice and they were gracious - Dianna and Beverly  especially .
Reliable hot water was a problem

author: Weam
title: A Lovely Stay with Exceptional Service
text: My friend and I had a lovely stay at La Suite West. The hotel is in a great location, and we felt very welcome throughout our visit. A special thank-you to Abdul and Carolina, who were incredibly kind, friendly, and professional. They were always happy to help and made our stay even more enjoyable. Their excellent service truly stood out. We would happily stay here again!

author: Jennifer B
title: Our 'go-to' hotel in London
text:
We have now stayed at this hotel six times, and it is the only hotel we consider for our regular trips to London.

The location is superb, decor is elegant, staff friendly and polite, and rooms spotless.

Breakfasts are basic but healthy and plentiful.

author: carolynryan888
title: Great hotel in a great location
text:
Very comfortable modern hotel in a great location. So close to Bayswater tube and Kensington gardens. Good restaurants in the area too.  Friendly reception staff and spacious modern rooms. Marble bathrooms were lovely and very clean. 
The breakfast was pretty basic but was included in the room rate. Would definitely recommend.

author: Saud A
title: A wonderful and unique stay
text: Jahan was incredibly helpful; she made our booking much smoother and arranged for the rooms to be closer to us since we're a family. The room was clean and nice, and Abdul was also very helpful; we left our bags with him in safe hands. Thank you! The apartment is close to a train station and very close to Hyde Park, and the neighborhood is very safe.

author: Souka S
title: Amazing Hotel & Excellent Service ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Amazing hotel and one of the best I’ve stayed at in London! The hotel is very clean, comfortable, and conveniently located close to everything.

A special thank you to Jiha at the reception. She was very kind, welcoming, and helpful throughout our stay. Her great attitude and excellent service really made our experience even better.

Thank you so much for everything! I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend this hotel. ❤️

author: Michele Falconieri
title: Couple trip
text: Very close to the metro and in a very safe and residential area of London. Everything clean and hearty breakfast. Great value for money, super helpful and welcoming staff. Bathroom a little small but for the price paid is fine, super recommended!!

author: Leslie H
title: Nice Hotel
text: A nice hotel, very conveniently situated five minutes walk from the Earl's Court Tube Station.  We had a very good sized room, very clean and with a comfortable bed.  The breakfast offered plenty of selection.  The staff were friendly and helpful.

author: labrador777
title: Recommended
text:
Very comfortable hotel in a strategic place of London, metro stop a few meters, residential and quiet neighborhood. Our room was large enough and comfortable, the shower large but the spaces in the bathroom small, there are few footholds. 
Cleanliness in my opinion great, very courteous staff, good breakfast, we asked for an extra jug of milk and were given it without problems. 
In the lobby you will find some fruit, water and juice available, working wifi, there are no USB sockets so you need to bring the adapter. 
The hotel is perhaps a bit dated but I found it comfortable and comfortable, comfortable bed and especially there were not those suffocating temperatures that you sometimes find in certain hotels.

author: KChampalimaud
title: Dont care about client because only money talks
text: Unfortunately I had to Anticipate my trip in one day for this reason requested reimbursment of the day but tis one was refused. old man ate reception informed that the hotel didnt provide any reimbursment after been paid.

author: Sanni L
title: Excellent value for the price
text: Payed less than £500 for four nights, and got great value for that money. I have never had this spacious room in London. The room was clean and functional. The bathroom in our room had been renovated, and worked perfectly. Breakfast is included. It's quite basic but for this price it's okay. Location is great, just next to Earl's court station where you can pick up either Piccadilly or District line to central London. Would definitely recommend this hotel even though the property is old and could use some more renovation.

author: Aziz A
title: Holiday inn revieuw
text: It was an amazing experience, very clean and very comfortable. Srvice with cleaning and at the reception is brilliant. Swapnil and santhosh are from the reception and they was very helpfull. 10/10 hotel experience!

title: Good place to stay in London

Great location, very near Hyde Park, tube and shopping 
Clean hotel, comfortable room

Great breakfast 
Nice atmosphere

title: Good, kind
text: Thanks u so much to abi for his hospitality

author: Carroll N
title: So very Welcoming:)
text: The receptionist Valeria was friendly and so very welcoming. Lovely start to my stay following a very busy and hectic day travelling and at work. Thank you

author: Livia R
title: Good hotel
text: It was a nice hotel, nice staff and it looks cozy

author: Julie G
title: Avoid if you want a goodnights sleep
text: If you want to be cooked alive, well ‘‘tis hotel is definitely for you ! There are to fans in the room, so at least you’ll be cooked evenly ! We spent two nights here and neither of us had a good nights sleep due to the room temperature. There is a small top window, which was open, but any fresh air which manages to enter the room is very soon elevated. The food was the worst that I ever been offered. The bathroom which looks ok, absolutely stinks, and definitely needs the drains throughly clean . The only positive thing I can say is that it is near Camden market.

author: World Traveller
title: Good value budget break in Leafy North London
text:
We went on a Caledonian bus trip for 4 nights.
Have to say we expected very little and were pleasantly surprised.
Clean, good shower, bed OK, food good and plenty of it.
Yes, it was unprecedented heat and the rooms were uncomfortably warm but the fans and keeping curtains closed helped.
Great location for tube, buses, Uber and TESCO Expresd - for the bus trip price was excellent value. No complaints from us.

author: Keith
title: Good value budget hotel.
text:
This hotel is situated in a very affluent part of London, near to Primrose Hill. There is an underground station about 15 minutes walk away, and it’s a 15 minute ride into town.
Price wise it is a budget hotel, and we paid around £120 a night each for single rooms. Included in the price was the coach journey to and from Glasgow, as well as all you can eat breakfast and evening meal buffets.
The food was of a perfectly reasonable standard bearing in mind the price, and there was a good choice of dishes. Breakfast displayed a comprehensive variety of English and continental breakfasts. Unfortunately the one criticism of breakfast was that all the fried eggs were overcooked until rubbery. Please note that a lot of British consumers like fried eggs more runny than those provided.
The room was spacious, the bed comfortable and the shower excellent.
The weather was remarkably hot, and although there was no air conditioning fans were provided, which, when well positioned, kept the room at a bearable temperature throughout the night.
The staff were pleasant and helpful.
Considering that many Airbnbs in the area advertise rooms with no private bathroom or dining for at least £100 a night, this hotel is definitely good value.

author: Linda B
title: Please ignore the negative reviewers!
text:
Have just returned from a four night stay with Caledonian Travel. This short break was extremely good value and included dinner, bed and breakfast with inclusive coach travel from Glasgow.
Having read the many negative reviews, we were somewhat apprehensive but, on arrival, we were pleasantly surprised by the very pleasant reception and lounge bar area. Our rooms had obviously been recently refurbished (there is currently scaffolding at the front of the hotel which suggests that the whole hotel is currently undergoing an upgrade). We had good sized rooms with a pleasant modern  en-suite shower room with plenty of hot water, very comfortable bed and pillows, a good powerful hair dryer and tea/coffee making facilities. Although the windows in the rooms could not open, a fan was provided which provided adequate air movement and room cooling…..even in the middle of a 33 degree heatwave!
The food, for a budget-priced hotel,  was buffet-style at both breakfast and evening dinner. Breakfast was particularly comprehensive, offering mixed cereal ,fruit,  and a variety of cooked dishes. There was always something to be found at the evening meal with a choice of main course and  potatoes/chips along with nice a soup and fresh salad, hot pudding (which I didn’t try),  fresh fruit, and cheese and biscuits.
This hotel is located in a very residential area of London and is within easy walking of Chalk Road underground station, Primrose Hill, Camden Lock and Market and Camden Town itself,

author: Barry W
title: Puzzling reviews
text: Stayed on a coach trip , 1st room television was broke so the room was changed to a room with a fantastic view of London,  hotel was clean , the food was excellent,  lovely tea and breakfast I'd say it was the best organised service out of all the coach trips we've done , a big credit due to all the restaurant staff , the hotel is having work done so there is all scaffolding up on main street side .Yes the rooms are warm but the fan did its job , The only downside is no draft beer but there's a pub just up the rd

author: Chris L
title: Perfect 40th anniversary stay at Le Patio Bastille
text: Lovely hotel in the quieter part of Paris with easy metro links to all popular areas and attractions. We were 2 couples travelling to Paris to both celebrating our 40th wedding anniversaries and stayed at Le Patio Bastille for 3 nights from 20th August. The Hotel is very deceptive as it has a small front entrance that opens up to the large hotel hidden behind the main facade. Lovely well maintained hotel with very helpful reception staff, clean spacious air conditioned rooms with a small kitchenette, large very comfy beds and nice clean bathrooms with hot showers. We had breakfast included in our stay making starting each day easier and it was fresh produce every day with fruit, breads, meats and cheeses, yogurts, cereals, fruit juices, tea and coffee, cooked breakfast items, pastries and jams all very nice. Reception staff get bonus points for being lovely, very patient and very helpful especially showing us how to us the RAPT app on our phones to buy metro tickets and getting around. Hotel is well situated for a good nights sleep as its in the quieter 11th Arrondissement but an easy 5 minute walk to a wide range of bars, cafes, bakeries, shops etc. We all highly recommend this hotel for a relaxing stay in a quieter area whilst maintaining easy access to all parts of the city whilst guaranteeing a restful nights sleep to recharge and a good breakfast to set you up for each days activities.

author: lore_at06
title: Really nice hotel
text:
It has really comfy beds.
It is located a little far from city center, but well communicated with metro stations and bus stops nearby

author: seankirkby31
title: An Ideally Located and Pleasant Hotel With Exceptional Staff
text:
I've now stayed at Le Patio Bastille on two seperate occassions and each time the staff have made sure that everything went well.
On my first trip there were some issues with the booking - I did that through a third party and it was in no way the fault of the hotel - but the reception staff were able to resolve that for me.
For my 2nd trip I booked directly with the hotel and it was so much easier with the ability to complete some parts of check-in before I arrived. During my visit, i received a couple of WhatsApp messages just making sure that I knew they were there to help - a nice little touch I thought.
The hotel is ideally situated with 3 metro stations within a 5 minute walk - this gives you 5 different metro lines to choose from, meaning most attractions are within easy reach.
Within the grounds of the hotel are areas where you can sit out and finish the day off enjoying a nice glass of wine.

author: Paul M
title: Clean And Tidy
text: Staff friendly and helpful. Establishment clean tidy, rooms clean & presentable. Check in & check out easy no issues, cleanliness of the whole site makes the difference. Getting to hotel from airport was easier wee thought easy to find.  Easy to to and from places plenty of restaurants Bars food places in surrounding areas

author: Livia A
title: Very well-connected hotel that offers very good service.
text:
It is a hotel that offers more than its category indicates. Very good air conditioning, excellent service, very clean, and it features a kitchenette in the rooms.
It is very close to the Nation transport hub and is also next to the city bus stop.
The staff is very attentive and professional.

author: Luc
title: Parisian stopover
text: Good location for reaching Notre Dame in the Marais district and a few steps from the Bastille. A beautiful interior garden equipped with small tables and corners for a break. Our garden-view room was spacious and had all the comforts. We did not test the breakfast because we preferred the Parisian boulangeries.

author: Joanne D
title: Enjoyable with amenities within walking distance.
text: My husband and I were on a short get away. The front desk and restaurant staff were attentive and friendly. The room was perfect and housekeeping was great. The hotel is close to shops including a pharmacy and a grocery store, very handy. Strongly recommend.

author: Wibbs
title: Anniversary stay
text:
We booked a 4 night break to celebrate our 30th wedding anniversary and we had a fantastic stay from start to finish.
The check in was very smooth and quick and we were very impressed with our room overlooking the courtyard.
The beds were a great size and very comfy.
We went for breakfast the first morning and was really impressed with the decor of the breakfast room and the food offering.
The hotel is very close to some great bars and restaurants and also close to the metro to visit all the landmarks.
I would recommend this as a great place to stay to visit all the Paris Landmarks.

author: Alexandra A
title: Our stay was a big disappointment, poor service, inadequate organization, an unkempt and outdat
text:
This hotel was a big disappointment.
Even before our arrival, we had reserved a table for dinner, but never received a response. Upon our arrival, we discovered that the hotel restaurant was closed. The parking space reserved for us was also already occupied by another vehicle.
The elevator in the building where our room was located seemed to have been out of service for weeks. So we had to walk the way to the 4th floor every time in the intense heat. Manage the floor via a very unattractive staircase. The employee dragged and hauled our suitcases up the stairs. Given the way they were dragged over the steps, one almost got the impression that the staircase was being intentionally wiped down at the same time. 
The room was old, worn out, and in poor condition.
The low point, however, was the breakfast: In the breakfast room in the basement, the same rags used to wipe the tables were subsequently used for the floor as well. That seemed extremely unhygienic and unappetizing.
How this hotel got its four stars remains a mystery to me. Unfortunately, we cannot recommend this hotel.

author: Aisling C
title: Perfect hotel in perfect location
text:
Wow! Perfect hotel. For some reason we walked from the train station ( via everywhere) a good 60 minute walk. Supermarket 1 minute walk from the hotel.
The reception was having work done but no bother to is. The courtyard was stunning as we walked to the room. 
Oh my what an amazing room!!
Kitchenette, fridge, bath, and such a comfortable bed!!
Clean and perfect. Staff were amazing and helpful. 
Great location. Quite in your room with bustling bars and cafes surrounding. 
Highly recommend. .

author: simone Francalanci
title: Paris is always worth a mass
text: Clean hotel and logistically well-placed, near the Seine, with the subway very close. Room up to Ibis standards, but super comfortable bed complete with a topper. The policy of only one large towel per person does not satisfy us much, but by now we have gotten used to it. If we really want to find a flaw, the luggage storage service pre-check-in or post-check-out is for a fee via automatic lockers.

author: Sabrina B
title: Perfect stay.
text: Excellent location, small room but functional for two people. Perfect breakfast with plenty of choices between sweet and savory. The hotel lobby is very welcoming, fast check-in. Possibility to leave luggage after check-out.

author: CaronIan
title: Two night stay
text: We had a fantastic 2 night stay here while in Paris. The hotel is just a short walk from the metro stations with good connections to the airport and central Paris. We arrived quite early but there was a room ready so we were able to check in earlier than we should have. There are 300 rooms at this hotel! The room had aircon which was adequate. A small bathroom which was ok and the room was very clean. Staff here were so helpful and friendly. There are chargeable lockers if you need to store luggage and there are safe deposit boxes that are free to use all in a seperate location behind the check in desks. Breafast was a great experience all the standard cheese ham etc. The bar was very resonable with the prices and they have an happy hour. Nice coaktails too. Our room was on the top floor with a great view of the Bastille column. A pefect stay.

author: Gia
title: Excellent experience.
text: Very well served by public transport. Small room and small bathroom. Good breakfast. Super kind staff.

author: CJ
title: Great stay for 2 weeks
text:
I was a bit concerned having read previous reviews, but I would absolutely stay here again! I stayed for two weeks for a business trip. The location is absolutely outstanding - close to so many different eateries, grocery stores, pharmacies, metro stations etc. A great market is just down the street each Thursday and Sunday. 

I stayed on the 7th (top) floor. The room was impeccably clean and the air conditioning was great! Comfy bed and ample space to hang clothing, unpack, and a good sized desk/chair to work from if necessary. Lots of outlets and lighting options too. I do agree that the bathroom is an odd layout/quite small, but for a solo stay it was not a problem at all. 

It does seem like there are some rooms right next to the elevators, so I'd ask for one away from these. The breakfast is repetitive, but if it is included in your rate I'm not sure I would pay extra to have the breakfast when there are so many other options in the area. Note that they do not have irons/ironing boards in the rooms - they instead have an ironing room on the fourth floor which is not suitable (iron was dirty, board needs replaced, not a pleasant smell in the ironing room). This needs to be improved.

Other than that, great location and I'll stay here again next time I'm in Paris.

author: KGav67
title: My first choice
text: Grand Hotel Français is my first choice when visiting Paris. This is a quality hotel which is quiet, clean and comfortable and well-situated for local commerce and for transport to all areas of Paris. The staff are professional and helpful and you are made to feel welcome. Any issues are resolved immediately. Special thanks to Assia and Bryan for their professional and friendly service and to the manager for his generosity. I look forward to my next visit.

author: Παναγιωτα Χ
title: EXCELLENT
text: We had a very pleasant stay at this hotel. Everything was great, very clean, the staff was very friendly and polite and always willing to help. Also, metro is very close and it was very convenient for us.

author: Odyssey28147835271
