author: Gabriele A
title: Excellent
text:
We return often and gladly to this quiet hotel in Parioli.
Excellent location in a quiet area but close to the center, which can be reached with a nice walk through Villa Borghese.
Excellent quiet and comfortable rooms.
Free gym, very rich breakfast, and fair prices.

author: GenaVazquez73
title: Hilton Garden Inn Claridge, Rome — 2 stars, generously
text:
I wanted to love this place. I really did. But apparently "Diamond" status here just means the elevator remembers your floor.

Every Hilton on the planet manages two bottles of water a day for Diamond members. Not this one. I guess management decided Rome's 600 public fountains were a suitable substitute. Nothing says luxury hospitality like directing guests to hydrate at the same spouts tourists have been drinking from since the Trevi crowds discovered TikTok.

The room was small enough to negotiate the furniture placement personally. No upgrade offered, despite status that apparently exists only in theory at this property. Breakfast was the kind of mediocre that makes you grateful for gelato two blocks away.

To be fair, the neighborhood is genuinely lovely. Which is the nicest thing I can say about a stay where the hotel did the absolute minimum and I did the walking, the water fetching, and apparently the room upgrading myself.

author: Sergio Parra Sarmiento
title: Uncomfortable experience
text: I recently had a very uncomfortable experience during my stay at the hotel. At check-out, the receptionist asked me for a “voluntary” tip of 25 euros. Although they said it was optional, I felt very pressured. This had never happened to me in any hotel before. As a Hilton Silver member, I expected better treatment. I would not recommend this hotel to future travelers. I hope this practice is reviewed.

author: shimself
title: pretty decent
text:
I was there at someone else's expense, for a 20 person meeting
The room, yes pretty good, great bed, all very 4*.  I wish the curtain would shut fully, I would have liked a fridge.  The staff were nice
What I didn't like.  No stairs to the ground floor, and with 2 tiny lifts (4 people max) it was a pain.
It's a few km from town and the ruins and churches etc, walkable or buses/trams
And when I asked for directions to the bus for the railway station I was told go up the road, turn right, it's on the other side of the road.  NO, it's SECOND right.  This left me hurrying to catch my flight

author: marieanddon
title: Nice hotel
text:
Stayed 4 night.  Small reception  on 1st floor, staff very welcoming. 10-15 mins walk from train station or $17 taxi. Free good WiFi. Breakfast good, 730-10am with good selection of croissants, cold meals, plenty of choice breads, cheeses and yogarts. Eggs, pancakes, fresh fruit, juice and coffee. 
Room was large and very clean and equipped with fridge. Coffee making. TV. 1 comfortable bed very clean. Bathroom is ensuite and clean with toiletries. Would stay again if price right Great hotel and location.

author: Izabela G
title: Exceptional hotel!!
text: Charming hotel, excellent service, perfect breakfast, well located and very clean!!

author: ryan
title: First room terrible. Second room very nice. Rest of hotel nice.
text: I am extremely divided about this place. It started as 1 star and finished as 4 star. Rest of hotel is 3 star. This is because when I came to Rome for a 4 day city break with my dad, we booked this hotel because it is slap bang in the centre. I was expecting it at first to be worth it. I actually loved the service, super friendly, and the breakfast was super nice. However, the room, a whole different story (at first). When I opened the door. I literally explodrd. It was claustrophobic as heck, and all there was was a bathroom, a tv, 2 beds and a step you could easily trip on and/or fall from. The shower slightly lightened things up, but overall, it felt like a hobbit house (literally). I literally was going to go home because of how (at the time) disappointed and betrayed I felt. So my dad, the next day (while at the Colusseum) told the staff about it. I was at first terrified of going back into the hotel, but I nearly cried of happiness when I saw our new room (although further from reception and restauraunt). There was a shower and bath shared, but that didn't let me down. My claustrophobes IMMEDIATELY disappeared and there was a locker and a tv and, even better, a whole view of the hotel (albeit with a step). This immediately removed me from the ptsd I was going to get from the other room. And even if we barely even stayed here, i was relieved. Thank you so much staff for saving me from never going back to Rome, the Vatican and Italy ever again! 3/5 (1/5 1st day, 4/5 2nd, 3rd and 4th day).

author: Norma F
title: A great place in Rome to get to know the city
text:
It’s very well located, just a short walk from Termini railway station but in a very good neighborhood. Also at a 5-10-minute walk from the Trevi Fountain and the Colosseum.
Buffet breakfast , spacious rooms, and lots of places to eat nearby

author: Maria Magdalena
title: Construction work on site
text: Drill and construction work every morning, you cannot sleep! Be aware of that before you book

author: Katiuscia i
title: Rome
text:
We stayed at this property
For a few days.,
From the moment of arrival, the staff proved to be very welcoming and professional. The room was modern, beautiful, and clean, in a quiet area.
A note of merit also for the breakfast, rich in fresh products, both sweet and savory.
The hotel's location is excellent, near Termini station, a few steps from the Metro. You can also reach important destinations on foot, 
Like...
Trevi Fountain
Altar of the Fatherland
Colosseum.
We will definitely return.

author: Darione O
title: Very good hotel for the cost charged, close to everything...
text: Very good hotel, renovated and was beautiful... The good rooms, etc...

author: Urlauberin1981
title: Short stay in Rome
text:
We stayed at Hotel Patria for 2 nights. The location is great for Termini but a bit further on foot to the sights. So if you come to Rome in midsummer, you absolutely have to take that into account.
All employees were very nice and helpful.
We had booked superior and received a super nice, large room. The only drawback is that the storage space in the bathroom is very small, but otherwise we were very satisfied with the room. Also with the air conditioning.
The breakfast was absolutely okay, mega by Italian standards - there was even fried bacon and scrambled eggs.
All in all, I can definitely recommend this hotel and will book it again for our next stay in Rome.
Price-performance ratio is top!

author: willemvd15
title: Average hotel
text:
Excellent hotel. For 3 stars it is at the price. Room was not really clean. Hair on the floor in the room and bathroom. Undefined splashes on the wall in the bathroom behind the sink that have not been removed the entire stay. Noisy rooms. Beds reasonable. Breakfast was good. Coffee facility in the room, but you had to buy coffee because you only got coffee for once. Never experienced it before. 
Location is ok.

author: Mimily-R
title: Good value for money.
text: Very clean hotels, room cleaned every day, no breakfast, close to the subway, however the bed is a bit firm and you will hear the subway passing by.

author: Kelly L
title: Lovely hotel, perfectly placed
text: What a lovely, quiet hotel, the staff are so friendly and helpful. The rooms are exactly what you need for a city break and reasonably sized. Cleaned daily with fresh towels and bedding. I think it is good value for money. Located about a 20 minute walk from the Trevi fountain and only about 10 mins from a big bus hop on hop off bus stop for all other sightseeing opportunities. Would definitely recommend to others.

author: redphonedeb
title: Excellent hotel.
text:
It is a lovely hotel in an old historic building, very quirky layout. Lovely rooms, spotlessly clean and the staff were very friendly. 
Unfortunately we had an incident on the last day of our holiday.  The management and staff of the hotel were amazing, kind and caring, they looked after us so well.

I would recommend this lovely hotel to anyone.

author: ulrich1961
title: Well located
text:
The hotel is located a bit outside the city center,
Check-in went well. The rooms are not very large, especially the bathroom is a bit small. Overall, somewhat worn and noisy.
Room service is very good and takes place daily.
The bar is well stocked but has high prices.

author: Serena
title: Great stay in the heart of Rome
text: I recently stayed at Hotel Oxford for a couple of days during a business trip, and it was an excellent experience. The location is absolutely perfect. It's within easy walking distance of major attractions, transportation hubs and great local restaurants. The room was spotlessly clean, very quiet, with a very comfortable bed that ensured a great night's sleep.. The staff was incredibly welcoming and helpful throughout my entire stay. The complimentary breakfast buffet offered a wide selection of fresh fruit, pastries, and hot options. I highly recommend Hotel Oxford and I will definitely choose to stay here again on my next trip.

author: Ian B
title: Birthday trip to historic Rome
text:
The hotel is in a quiet location but within easy walking distance to the centre and attractions. 
Excellent friendly staff, good breakfast. 
Being a city hotel it's of course quite compact but everything is there that you need.
Happily use it again.

author: Isadora
title: A great option away from the rush of the city centre.
text:
Summary: We loved the modern layout of the rooms and the entire building. Our stay was pleasant and we thoroughly enjoyed the gym facilities, the breakfast and the lounge. We will highly consider this hotel in future trips to Rome when we want to stay away from the crowds and rush of the city centre.

Detailed review:

Rooms: Spacious, clean and modern. Basic toiletries, robe and slippers are supplied.
There's complimentary water daily and extra bottles for Hilton Honors members (silver and up).
The shower area is not fully private as there is a section with no door and people can see you while showering. We are a couple so we didn't mind but for families and friends it should be taken into consideration so people refrain from walking near the shower area when someone is using it.
Noise was manageable, we only heard footsteps at night coming from the rooftop bar (we stayed at the 14th floor) but they were quite muted. If you are a light sleeper,
do not stay near the rooftop bar.

Things to improve: we had a bad experience at The Blade rooftop bar (lack of customer service) and some of the elevators where out of service (2 out of 6). Elevator waiting times for us ranged from 1 to 4 minutes.

Breakfast: Varied and fresh. More suitable for non-vegetarians with only one vegetarian hot option that changes every now and then.
We loved some of the daily special stations but some were disappointing, like the virgin mojito or the pancakes. The fresh juice bar should be a regular feature, it was the highlight of that day.

Lounge: Quiet and relaxing. Good internet speed and enough outlets to charge laptops and work gear. Soft drinks and snacks are available all day long until 9PM and a light breakfast and light evening meal are served at specific times. They're very strict with those times and special drinks and food will be removed on the dot.

Getting to the city centre: 15 to 30 minutes by car depending on traffic, taxi/uber costs around 26€ from or to Trevi fountain
A Bus with AC to via del corso and Trevi fountain stops one street away from the hotel. The journey takes roughly 30 minutes and it costs 1.50€ one way. We used this method when going to the city centre as the ride was comfortable and full of sights.
The metro station is a few minutes away by walk. We never used the metro but other guests said it was quite convenient and the fastest way to reach the centre.
Location: Away from the city centre, so not crowded at all. Not many restaurant immediately outside of the hotel but there are lots of sight-seeing opportunities around this area. There is a shopping mall nearby, mostly accessible by car. There is a gorgeous park with waterfalls just a few minutes away by walk. The streets felt safe both day and night.

author: Francois B
title: Modern hotel but a major elevator problem
text:
The hotel is located near a subway station, which makes it easy to reach the main tourist attractions as well as Termini. The rooms are large, modern, and well-equipped. The breakfast buffet is abundant and the staff is attentive.

Two significant drawbacks:

Between three and four elevators were out of service during our three-night stay, which made the wait interminable.

The executive lounge was disappointing: limited food selection, not very varied, and often out of stock.

author: МОТ К
title: Good hotel, everything is clean, but the service is very bad
text: The hotel is good, everything is clean, the rooms are clean, but there are downsides. The restaurant, I ordered pasta with lobster, they promised 100g of lobster and 100g of pasta, meaning 200g total, but they brought 150g and a little lobster, and it's unclear if they brought shrimp with lobster or something else. We also ordered a steak, a medium rare steak, but they brought a rare one, so we were deceived. Service 0.

author: M Lu
title: Kindness and comfort even in an unexpected situation
text:
We stayed at the Hilton Hotel due to a flight delay that caused us to miss our connection, and the airline therefore put us up in this hotel.

It was a pleasant surprise. The staff was truly very kind and helpful, always ready to meet our needs. The hotel is very spacious and well-maintained, while the room was very clean, comfortable, and equipped with everything necessary. The bathroom was also very clean and functional.

A gesture we particularly appreciated was their attention to our situation: not having our suitcase yet, they provided us with a personal hygiene kit with a toothbrush and toothpaste, slippers, and a comb, which we were really pleased with.

A short stay, due to an unforeseen situation, but certainly made much more pleasant by the courtesy and professionalism of all the staff. Compliments and thank you!

author: Louaie H
title: Great hotel in Rome
text: Staff was amazing. They greeted us with candy and were very helpful. Hotel was beautiful and clean. Location was great as long as you take train to sites. Train station is a block away

author: CB880
title: A good address
text: A bet on a week. Very pretty but a bit noisy because of the old window; impeccable room, decent breakfast, efficient and attentive staff, good advice. Proximity to public transport, convenience stores, and restaurants

author: Prity Shah
title: BEST HOTEL IN ROME FOR SHORT STAY - GOOD LOCATION, CLEAN AND REASONABLE
text: Best Western Hotel Astrid Rome is superb for short stay of 3 nights. Great location, easy reach from centre - quiet neighbourhood. Has 2 bus connections to Termini. Very clean and great staff.  Just spent 3 nights in last week of July. Only negative is poor lighting in room, however very big room.

author: Michele
title: Average
text: Fairly welcoming property inside a historic Roman building. Reception service very sterile; I personally found a tidy room with a truly small bathroom, bidet almost inaccessible as it was wedged in a corner, and a small shower; unfortunately, the shower tray flooded while showering, because it was probably clogged. The breakfast is absolutely not worth the hotel's name, few products, and above all, it is unacceptable that inside such a hotel there is a broken espresso machine and they do not provide a backup or an immediate replacement.

author: castmar90
title: Nice and clean
text: Nice and clean hotel near the center of Rome. Friendly and welcoming staff. Breakfast 8/10

author: Elisabetta G
title: Very beautiful place
text:
Extremely easy to reach both from the Roma Termini station and to get to the center with 4 bus stops.
The girls at the reception were very kind and provided us with directions to our many questions and also gave us a map of the city.
Quiet and residential area... also for going out in the evening... the breakfast on the top floor is great from where I admire the beauty of the city.
We will return next year ♥️

author: Davidson B
title: DO NOT book directly with this hotel!
text:
DO NOT book directly with this hotel! Use a reliable agent like Booking.com. 
Having stayed at Holiday Inn Gare de Lyon 6 times with our dog - which had all been very good experiences which we had relayed to all our friends traveling to/through Paris with dogs  - I tried booking DIRECTLY on their web site AS REQUESTED BY THEIR STAFF. As I was completing my reservation, I noticed that the dates had changed from July 16-18 to TODAY (July 11). I tried to Abort hitting Back space and Escape but the site grabbed my info and processed it anyway. I IMMEDIATELY contacted their Customer Service which turned out to be a contractor. After explaining I receivced an email saying that the reservation HAD been cancelled but that the Manager (Maxime) had refused to refund the charge of $394. BAD!!!!!

author: pace_ripley
title: Solid functional stay at the center of Paris
text:
The hotel is located close to the Gare de Lyon station, but not too close. Overall, this central placement make it comfortable for you to access all form of transportation. As you should expect, a Holiday Inn is not a palace, but the hotel is clean and well organized. The rooms are spacious (I had the king bed room) and well organized. There is a desk, small closets and very importantly, a safe and a small fridge. The bathroom is nice and has modern fixtures and decent soaps. I stayed on the third floor and there was little to no noise from the street. A little bit seeped from the next door rooms. The restaurant - especially for breakfast - was overpriced. 
Most importantly, the air conditioning was GREAT. You have a modern thermostat too and can control it very well.
In short - it's a very functional, comfortable say at the center of Paris . I with they would  let you get into the room earlier in the morning after an overnight flight, but I understand that's not always possible.

author: ev b
title: Excellent stay!
text:
The hotel enjoys an ideal location, easily accessible and well-served.
Very warm welcome from the staff and the quality of the breakfast is exceptional.
I highly recommend this establishment for a pleasant and comfortable stay!

author: Lisa Ann W
title: Towels are important.
text:
The hotel was very clean. Modern, good breakfast. 
My reason for the three? It was 1,000$ a night. The towels were crusty wash rags. For 1,000$ a night, the towels should be large and fluffy.

author: Extensive-Traveller
title: Excellent, well connected, Main station and many restaurants very close.
text:
Apx £35 by Uber/Bolt taxi from Charles De Galle Airport (June 26), takes an hour.
Excellent hotel in a great location, clean, comfortable, great service.
2 min walk to Gare De Lyon Station (Subway/Trains/Metro), provides easy access to Paris attractions.
Buy a travel card.
1 min walk to great pastry shops/Cafes, restaurants, kebab shops, night life etc.

author: mas r
title: Reservation cancelled after confirmation: inadmissible
text: Reservation confirmed and then cancelled under the pretext of “pricing error”. The problem is their own system. Very disappointing and absolutely unprofessional. No consideration for the customer.

author: emiliea555
title: Well without more ... 3 stars but not4
text: Very well placed the neighborhood is quiet nice the means of transport easily accessible. The breakfast is very good staff also but the room is not worth a 4 star due to its cramped bed does not make the 160 the cramped bathroom the bar is empty there is no iron... the elevator is really too small and aging pity!!

author: InaFee02
title: Nice location
text:
It’s a very clean and central hotel in Paris.
We were very happy with it.
The breakfast was good and the service very polite.
The shower at the bathroom was a bit difficult for us but over all the room was clean and nice.

author: Wabbiba
title: All right.
text:
The hotel is full of charm and modernity. It is very well located, close to many shops and restaurants, and 5 minutes from the metro.
The room is well equipped and warm, as is the welcome by the staff who remain available and pleasant.
In use, however, I find, that we hear a lot of street noises in the neighborhood that is very lively. The renewal of the insulation by a recent and high-performance glazing deserves to be reassessed to gain comfort in the bedroom.

author: Hiya071
title: Adorable hotel
text: Appreciated how quiet the neighborhood was.  Safe and walkable. The bus wasn't far and uber was convenient. Great view from balcony too.

author: 4567QBC
title: Huge disappointment in Paris
text:
I know that Paris is an old city and some buildings have awkward layouts which is why I requested a room with a view. I asked them a month in advance and we were very disappointed with our room that has a window to a shared public walkway and no view. You can’t keep the window open because someone can crawl inside which presents a safety and comfort issue. 
I’m sorry to say that this is by far the worst hotel room I have ever stayed in my many trips to Paris. The front desk did not honor my wish to have a view, even they have many rooms available with views. The room also smelled like sewage/mildew. 
I’m sure if we were given a room in the main block or looking on the Main Street as we requested, we would have had a better experience. Too bad because location is great. But for 300 a night it’s a disappointment.

author: Carla D
title: A stone's throw from the Louvre
text:
Centrally located hotel, very close to the Louvre. 
Friendly and helpful staff, they also speak Italian.
Small room, tiny bathroom. Carpet everywhere...
Daily cleaning with towel change.
Comfortable beds. Our room was overlooking inner courtyard (other windows very close) very quiet.
Breakfast average, positive note the juice of real oranges (not fake juice).
For a short stay I would recommend it.

author: Mary B
title: Ideal hotel in Paris
text: Stayed here twice now when visiting Paris, for the price I can not fault it. Great lication, clean,  lovely breakfast, cand friendly staff. Will stop here again.

author: Constance
title: Great location
text:
Great location. Actually just next to Louvre museum
5min walk from the nearest metro (line 1, where you can get to most of the tourist spots)
10min walk from the RER station, where you get on the train to airport / disney/outlet 
also many buses around 
many restaurants /bakery nearby, including chinese , japanese, French etc
there are some hair left in the Bathroom or the room 
no bottled water is provided in the room but there are supermarkets on the next street 
can store the luggage for free 
highly recommend

author: Sean M
title: You can't beat the location of this cute budget hotel!
text:
The staff at Timhotel were very kind and helpful with recommendations. You can't beat the location being so close to the Louvre and also not far from Notre Dame and the Marais. We traveled with my 89 year old mother and she really liked the breakfast.

The breakfast was modest IMHO but certainly adequate to start the day. The room and especially the bathroom were tight. I've never stayed somewhere with such a small bathroom! But it served its purpose and being in Paris is not about lounging in your hotel room when there's so much to do outside!

author: Valeria S
title: A stone's throw from Times Square, but with several aspects to review
text:
The hotel is in an excellent location: Times Square can be reached comfortably in about 5 minutes on foot. Furthermore, in the immediate vicinity there are several subway and public transport stops, as well as supermarkets, restaurants and everything necessary to make the stay very comfortable.

I was also lucky to have a room with a beautiful view of the New York skyscrapers, a detail that made the stay even more pleasant.

My room was clean and tidy, however there were several aspects that made the experience less satisfactory. For three consecutive days the soap was not restocked, despite the fact that I had requested it several times from the staff.

Furthermore, I was surprised by the fact that the room was not equipped with a mini-fridge and that, upon our arrival, not even a simple complimentary bottle of water had been left, a courtesy that many hotels now offer their guests.

Another morning I kindly asked if it was possible to have a simple teaspoon, but I was told that I would have to buy it from the vending machine at a cost of €3.50. I found this response truly unprofessional and not very attentive to the customer: after having spent about €2,000 for the stay, I would have expected a minimum of availability for such a simple request.

Finally, although my room was clean, in the hallway on my floor the carpet gave off a strong odor, similar to that of cheese, as if it had been washed without being dried correctly or had not been cleaned thoroughly. It is a detail that gives a bad impression of the common areas and that should be improved.

Overall, the hotel's location is undoubtedly its strong point, as is the view from my room. However, the service and attention to some details were not up to the price paid and deserve more attention.

author: BENJAMIN M
title: Minimal rooms
text: The photos of the rooms are taken with a wide-angle lens and they look bigger than they are. These are minimal and the bed is a Murphy bed because if you open it, there is no room in the room. A shame

author: Ricardo
title: They SCAM customers with rooms that do not match reality.
text:
Our experience at this hotel was extremely negative and, unfortunately, it is the first time we have been forced to leave a property due to the condition in which the room was handed over to us.

We had booked a corner room with a view, equipped with a modern bathroom with a glass shower, exactly as represented in the photos and the room type selected at the time of booking. Upon our arrival, however, we were assigned a completely different room: neglected, in poor condition, with numerous stains, obvious signs of wear, and damaged in several places. The bathroom was also a handicap-accessible bathroom, with the floor full of stains and a shower equipped with a simple curtain, absolutely not corresponding to the room we had booked and the images published.

What is even more serious is that, by consulting the reviews published in the previous months, we found that other guests had already reported the exact same problem, namely the discrepancy between the rooms shown in the photographs and those actually assigned to guests. This shows that the issue had already been brought to the attention of the property for some time and that, despite this, nothing seems to have been done to resolve it or to correctly inform customers before booking.

We immediately went to the reception, asking with the utmost politeness to be able to use the room actually booked. We were told that the rooms of that type were being renovated and that no alternatives were available (the same excuse already used previously with other guests, see reviews on Booking).

At this point we tried to find a solution together with the reception, but the behavior of the staff was, in our opinion, absolutely inadequate and unprofessional. We did not receive any concrete assistance or willingness to find a solution. On the contrary, while we were trying to explain the situation and resolve the problem, some members of the staff continued to be on the phone texting, even going so far as to laugh in our faces in front of our requests and our evident discomfort.

The only solution we managed to find was to contact Booking support on our own. Support immediately took charge of our case and initiated the refund request for the total nights not used. Unfortunately, even in this case, the hotel refused to meet our request.

The following day we were contacted again by Booking and were informed that the property was not willing to find a solution or to meet us halfway and that, consequently, it had opposed the refund.

We lost more than half a day trying to resolve a situation that we had not created and, in the end, we were forced to find an alternative solution on our own, without receiving any real support from the hotel.

It was an extremely disappointing experience from every point of view: room not in accordance with the booking, unacceptable conditions of the property, terrible customer service, total lack of professionalism and helpfulness on the part of the staff and no willingness to resolve the problem, despite it being a situation already reported by other customers in the previous months.

In many years of traveling, it is the first time that we have found ourselves in a similar situation and that we have been forced to leave a hotel due to the conditions of the room and the total absence of cooperation on the part of the property.

We strongly advise against this hotel. We believe that the relationship between what was promised at the time of booking and what was actually offered was absolutely unacceptable and that the behavior held by the property towards a customer who had simply requested what was regularly booked was extremely disappointing.

author: Xin S
title: Never got refund
text: I booked a penthouse room for my birthday but they gave me a regular small room said the penthouse was flooded at last minute. But they would offer a refund. It’s almost two weeks later I never got refund and they never answer my phone call anymore. I emailed Marcelino who handled my issue at the time and he never responded either.

author: B&B Del Corso
title: Traumatizing experience
text:
Traumatizing experience: Unsafe environment and negligent security
​I am writing to share a deeply distressing experience I had while staying here alone for work.
​20 minutes after check-in, two men under the influence of drugs began pounding on my door, claiming to be hotel staff bringing "bread." When I refused to open, they became aggressive, yelling insults and trying to force their way in with other keys.
​When I reported this to hotel security, they dismissed me, claiming I was "overreacting" and that it was likely a misunderstanding. Even after the police arrived and instructed them to move me to a different room, the security staff continued to minimize the incident in front of the officers.
​I am left traumatized by this. The hotel’s long hallways have no video surveillance, and I shudder to think what could have happened had I stepped out of my room alone. The hotel clearly prioritizes its image over guest safety. I felt completely abandoned and vulnerable. I strongly advise solo travelers to avoid this property, as the management's lack of concern for guest security is unacceptable.

author: esot
title: Enchanting stay at the Tophams hotel :)
text: I rarely-almost never - write a review, feeling that I should not bias people based on our experience..However since our return from London, I have felt the urgent need to set the record straight about the Tophams hotel and the rating/reviews it has received. I had looked it up and made the booking despite the multiple unfavorable reviews, sighting quite a few advantages and feeling that somehow I had to give it a chance. And I must confess that we were not disappointed in the least! :) First of all its location is absolutely fabulous..Convenient, safe, charming! :) The room was not big but for us it was sufficiently spacious, comfy and had everything we needed! I understand that the hotel has smaller rooms, but you better check it at the time of reservation, depending on the traveler group size and requirements. Their breakfast was both qualitative and diverse, a great start of the day! And last but not least, their staff was genuinely welcoming and friendly, making us feel that we were home away from home for the week we stayed with them! Thank you very much Tophams for a truly enchanting stay! :)

author: Rolyat46
title: Great hotel
text:
The location is good.  We chose to stay here as our son was running in the London Marathon and it was close to the finish.  It was also close to tube stations and parks.  We enjoyed the continental breakfast and there was sufficient choices for both meat eaters and vegetarians.  A lovely touch were the cakes on offer by the Reception and they were delicious.

A downside was the shower which kept changing temperature from normal to cold and very hot.

author: Les W
title: Basic but good location.
text:
Small hotel tiny bed and bedroom 2stars ???
Clean tidy , reception friendly. Lift not working half our stay. Ok when we left. Breakfast room very tight tables crammed in.  
No eggs , waiting for delivery but no sorry !!! Continental buffet limited and staff not very happy. I’d look elsewhere next time and if you do go book room only and eat out where you get service and what you want. ( oh coffee was good ).

author: David Jones
title: A stay of 2 days was enough
text: The hotel is extremely dark,and accessibility to rooms difficult if the lift is not working, I feel we didn't get the room we booked. Breakfast is ample the staff quite surly,nicely positioned to see London

author: DAVID D
title: A beautiful moment
text:
The hotel is ideally positioned for a London discovery.
Staff at the top thank you Rafaela for her help, and kindness. 
A simple breakfast that speaks a bit of an English touch for tourists like us. But very hearty. Perfect room, very good cleaning. 

Thank you to the whole team for allowing us to discover London with a perfect place to rest from our long visits.

author: Danny J
title: A great stay at Hilton Paddington
text: Great service, especially by the gentlemen checking us in Suvisna. He was very patient when we were sorting our ID out and very welcoming. The room was lovely and the bed was so comfortable. The breakfast was excellent with lots of choices and perfect location by Paddington station for our train home. Overall a great experience.

author: Ilham A
title: Amazing
text: Great hotel and amazing staff! As soon as I walked in I was greeted by Ratish, and he helped with the check in process and made it very smooth for me. He’s very warm, welcoming and efficient!

author: Matthew S
title: Excellent Service from Darius
text: We had a business lunch at the hotel, and Darius in particular gave us wonderful service in the restaurant. Plus I love that my father would stay at the hotel when the railway owned it.

author: MOTASEMAG
title: Disappointing Communication and Lack of Compassion
text:
I had planned to stay at this hotel for seven nights, but unfortunately, I couldn't travel because my visa was refused. 

Although the hotel has a good location and meets the standards expected of a Hilton property, my customer service experience was extremely disappointing. Before my scheduled arrival, I sent several emails requesting information about airport transportation but received no response. When I called the hotel, I was given the email address of the person in charge; however, my follow-up email was ignored as well.

After my visa was refused, I politely requested a refund or some form of consideration, as the circumstances were beyond my control. Unfortunately, this request was denied. I even tried to contact the General Manager directly, but I received a response from the Reservations Assistant Manager, who made no meaningful attempt to find a reasonable solution.

I understand that booking conditions are important, and my booking was non-refundable. However, this was during the busiest season of the year, and the hotel could likely have resold the room. I did not stay at the hotel or use any of its services, yet I was charged for all seven nights.

Overall, the experience left me feeling that the hotel prioritized commercial considerations over communication, flexibility, and compassion. While guests may expect the Hilton name and facilities, my experience suggests that they should not necessarily expect the same standard of customer care.

author: Pioneer11406304178
title: Appreciate all the staff members were so kind n nice
text: I had a really nice stay, and I especially want to thank the  Daniela da Silva who helped me during my stay. She was very kind, helpful, and professional, and she made my experience much better. I truly appreciate her help and positive attitude. Thank you so much! 😊

author: Carneddau
title: Great family stay
text:
This is a perfect base for exploring London. It’s close to Waterloo station, which itself is easy to reach from Euston. 
Rooms are clean, have a great shower and comfy bed.  I’ve come away  from my stay reflecting on how great the staff are there . They really do go above and beyond to make you feel welcome. Thanks

author: Ian L
title: Great Hotel
text: Great hotel in a perfect location, stayed many times always very good. The staff are very professional and helpful, always having time to help.

author: mary m

text: Excellent hotel and staff, the staff are pleasant and very willing to help very clean with Excellent food package, Excellent showers and bedrooms. fantastic position so close to many of the sites

author: silvia m
title: Recommend
text: Amazing location, outstanding staff🔆

author: Darren
title: Good, and Bad
text:
The hotel is in a great location, right next to the London Eye and Waterloo station.
The rooms are big, but dated. We were at the front, it was very noisy most night, to the early hours. Sounded like a motor bike race each night and one night 2.20am a football match. So lacked on sleep.
The bar are is great and not busy, with a good view to people watch.
Staff were very good especially Fay, helpful, chatty and friendly.

author: Melanie D
title: Lovely staff
text: Nice 2 night stay with my daughter, the receptionist Goolabee was really helpful and was able to check us in early which was fab.

author: peapod19
title: Lovely staff & central location
text:
Conveniently located hotel with great staff; Wilkey at front of house was so helpful & friendly. 
We will be back.

author: IRINA BABCHENKO
title: Super location and amazing service

The hotel itself is very pleasant, the staff is very polite, the cleaning is excellent, the breakfasts are delicious.
I would gladly return to this hotel
