author: Jacqueline D
title: Great 3 star hotel
text:
We normally book 4/5 star hotel so we booked this hotel due to good reviews and a reasonable price.
Check-in went smoothly and the staff were.
We were on the third floor and the stairs can be steep but there is a lift a very tiny one.
We booked breakfast and offered gluten free. 
We walked everywhere. 
We also booked a late checkout as we did a parkrun before we did a last tour of Rome and it was great to check out at 3.
The room was small but very clean and there was no trouble heating. 
Highly recommend the hotel

author: lydia r
title: Good location, nice hotel.
text: We enjoyed our stay! Beds were comfy and the room and bathroom were very clean. Breakfast was also good with lots of meats, cheese, yogurt, pastries, eggs, hot drinks, cold drinks, cereal, etc. Could hear noise outside and when people were walking around the hotel, but were able to sleep through it! About a 20 min walk from the coloseum and an hour walk from vatican city so pretty close to what you would want to see

author: Scott T
title: Good Quality Hotel
text:
We arrived in the early hours so the hotel was locked, but we were met in no time by the night staff.

On letting us in, he went through the details, rooms, breakfast, check out times and taxes for the stay.

Our room was huge, single beds but oversized so perfect for us both.

A good location, 5 minutes from the train station, bus terminal, trams and open. Us tours. A 25 minute walk from all the main historical attractions.

The breakfast is continental, but everything was good quality and tasty.

I would definitely stop here again

author: SERGIO C
title: When I return to Rome, this will be my hotel.
text:
Very positive experience.
Kind staff, willing to resolve any problems.

author: mychelle_gurgacz
title: Excellent location
text: Excellent location close to the station

author: Dante A.
title: A positive two-night experience! Friendly and Helpful Personnel! Reasonable price.
text: A positive two-night experience! From Fabrizio the porter, who deftly handled our eight bags to the front desk clerks (Maddalena, who spoke perfect English, and Maurizio, who ordered us a private car when we learned of a taxi strike and needed to get to the airport) to Carmine, the friendly and efficient waiter in the adjacent restaurant, we were very pleased with the personnel. Our room was more than adequate for the price (clean, comfortable, air conditioned, with a small refrigerator and safe for our valuables). We enjoyed the location near Stazione Termini and a short (half-hour) walk to the Centro Storico (Fori Romani). I have stayed here before, but this was the first time for my wife. She was as pleased as I was.

author: Dr. Ziauddin Ahmed
title: Located in a convenient place
text: Located in a very convenient place close to the Roma Termini station. Colosseum, Roman theater and many other attractions are located very close to this hotel. My room was small one with a double bed. Breakfast was good though limited menu. Staffs were friendly. Many restaurants are located nearby. Parking is difficult to find.

author: wevisitplaces
title: A warm and wonderful place to stay
text: We had a wonderful experience staying at Hotel Hiberia. The staff were so friendly and helpful, always greeting us and making sure we had everything we need. We felt very warmly welcomed as their guests. We had an unfortunate issue with the third party we booked our rooms through (reminder it’s always safest to book direct!) and the hotel was so kind and helpful in working to resolve the issue, following up, making sure we were not stressed about us, and assuring us everything would be resolved and taken care of. It was so helpful to have them take care of us so kindly. The location of the hotel was perfect for walking everything we wanted to go. We saw everything and got helpful advice from the front desk of the hotel. I highly recommend this hotel

author: Valerie R
title: Excellent Location and Outstanding Service in Rome
text:
We had a wonderful stay at Hotel Hiberia. The location is excellent—within easy walking distance of many of Rome’s major attractions, making it a perfect base for sightseeing.

The customer service was outstanding. The staff was always friendly, welcoming, and eager to help. They assisted us with arranging transportation, which made our trip much easier and stress-free.

Our room was clean, comfortable, and well maintained throughout our stay. We truly appreciated the combination of a central location, attentive service, and comfortable accommodations. We would gladly stay here again and highly recommend Hotel Hiberia to anyone visiting Rome.

author: Sophie
title: Okay for a very short stay.
text: Well-located hotel. Very good service from the employees. Good breakfast at the restaurant adjacent to the hotel. The rooms are quite spacious; however, the bed and pillows are very hard. Access to the rooms is via an old elevator that must date back to the early century. Many landings, narrow corridors. I will not return despite the very good service from the employees, which unfortunately does not compensate for the lack of comfort for the price paid.

author: Cátia E
title: Excellent location in the historic center of Rome
text: Hotel very well located a few minutes walk to the Trevi Fountain and other attractions in the historic center. The room very clean and quiet. The highlight for the check in fast, efficient and with Marco and Raphaelo very kind, being that Marco speaks Portuguese well. Very pleasant experience.

author: DerbyTraveller
title: An ok experience
text:
Stayed at this hotel as part of a 4 day trip to Rome and overall we were content.

The staff at the hotel were friendly and helpful, all speaking excellent English. The communications received before our stay were good too, arranging a transfer from the airport for us that got us to the hotel from Ciampino airport in around half an hour.  We were able to check in and access our room and hour earlier than the normal check in time which was good.

Our room was a “Double Classic”, not the smallest they offer, but it was still pretty small with limited storage for our things. We were around the side of the hotel though, so it was relatively quiet apart from some noisy neighbours above us on the last night who were talking loudly and moving furniture loudly at midnight, and then again at 5.30am. We didn’t use the minibar, but prices were reasonable. A kettle and some tea/coffee were provided but no milk/whitener. There were a few toiletries offered in the bathroom. I didn’t really feel it was value for money to be honest, compared to other big cities we had been to.

Breakfast was taken in the attached Restaurant Petrucci and we had no complaints about that, it was well presented and good quality, a range of items that set you up for the day.
 
We did eat in the restaurant one evening and whilst the food was really good, the service was very lacking. It took ten minutes before we were offered a menu after being seated and getting the bill and paying took an age. The staff were very busy, presumably there wasn’t enough of them. We ate out other evenings and there are plenty of places within 5/10 minutes’ walk.

We used the small hotel bar a couple of times, but it was stuck at the rear of the building with limited seating and was not staffed so you had to ask at reception for them to come and serve you. Prices were good value. It was disappointing to sit there one early evening though as the cleaner decided to vacuum up around us – quite an unpleasant experience.

The location is good, just away from the main sights but handy for the Forum, Colosseum, Termini Station and no more than 10 minutes or so walk to the Trevi Fountain and then onto the Pantheon and Piazza Navona area. The hotel is on a steep hill though, and you had to walk back up it to get to it at the end of each day from whichever direction you'd been so be warned.

Would we stay here again? Probably not to be honest. The staff were lovely, but it just didn’t tick enough boxes for us and I suspect there are better value and slightly better locations available with hotels with better communal areas where you could go to to relax at the end of a busy, tiring day in the area.

author: marcoPoggibonsi
title: Good stay in Rome
text: Three-night stay in August. Hotel in a quiet area, excellent cleanliness, thanks to Rome in August no noise at night. Large beds, perhaps a bit firm but it is a matter of habit. I did not try the breakfast because for three of us it cost as much as the room. Kindness of the staff. Excellent stay. Our triple room was practically a mini-apartment! Area that seems quiet, you can reach the subway in 7 minutes on foot. Fair price. Satisfied.

author: Laura L
title: Good hotel with sufficient facilities and services
text: The hotel was very nice and modern feel with sufficient facilities throughout. The staff were lovely and breakfast was good.

author: Kayleigh Edwards
title: Lovely stay
text: Lovely hotel out of the main centre and a short metro to all the main attractions. We booked a family room and it was big and well appointed. Really helpful staff and the roof top restaurant/bar is lovely for the evenings. Highly recommend!

author: loloswa
title: Very good stay and nice neighborhood.
text: We enjoyed our stay (3 nights in July 2026). There is a subway station not too far away and we got an 18-euro subway pass for 3 days, so the hotel is very accessible and makes it easy to reach all the tourist spots. We were well welcomed and informed by the front desk. We were able to leave our suitcases in the luggage room to go for a walk while the room was being prepared. We really liked the breakfast: clean room, lots of variety, and excellent cakes as well. We found the room clean but a bit old with a shower that leaked a little. Foreign TV channels, especially in French, did not work very well in the afternoon and early evening. It was also not easy to get the room cleaned during our stay (it still wasn't done one day at 4:00 PM even though we had properly put up the sign requesting that the room be cleaned). We really liked the neighborhood, quiet, with a good bakery right across the street and restaurants and ice cream shops nearby. We tried the rooftop restaurant: not bad but a lot of wasps, which detracted from the experience. We would gladly return but will ask in advance that the shower leak and TV issues be checked beforehand.

author: Hicham K
title: BAD EXPERIENCE
text: A very disappointing experience. The welcome at the front office was not warm and lacked professionalism. Furthermore, the room was extremely noisy throughout the night due to a lack of proper insulation and partitioning, which greatly hindered the quality of my stay and my rest.  Very bad experience. The front office staff was neither welcoming nor attentive and lacks experience. Furthermore, the room suffered from poor insulation, leading to numerous noise disturbances throughout the night. A stay far from expectations for an establishment of this category.

author: Relapsis
title: A place we always return to
text:
We have stayed at this hotel several times and from the last time to the present, many improvements have been made and from the entrance you can notice the changes in floors and furniture, the rooms are totally new and super comfortable.
Breakfast is still in the same place and it is fine, it would just be missing more variety of fruits and waffles.
It has been a pleasant surprise the changes for the better that were made.

author: enaclements
title: Highly Recommended
text: Just returned from a week at Colonna Palace Hotel. Can't fault it. Staff were so helpful and location is perfect for seeing all the sights. Rooms cleaned every day. Good breakfast and nice little bar to finish off the evening.  Hand rail in shower would have been helpful.

author: Priscilla M
title: Ok option
text: It’s in a nice location, you can walk pretty much anywhere but the beds are not the comfortable. Also, our safety didn’t work, we told the front desk but the guy never showed up. Really safe place, a lot of police around

author: Brianna M
title: Great location!
text: This was our first stop on our honeymoon. The  room was clean! The hotel is in a great location, we walked everywhere! I was able to email the hotel a few weeks before our stay for a private transfer from airport upon arrival.  Very basic amenities and everything was always clean. Our only complaint was the AC(of course we are Americans visiting during a heat wave) it never seemed to catch up but cold showers helped! The staff was always kind and the breakfast being included helped our day start off right!

author: Jonathan H
title: Location, location, location
text: Location was spectacular, it was literally the center of it all, our longest walk was 20 minutes to the colosseum. Everything else was literally just mins. Restaurants, stores and monuments were relatively close the only thing we got a taxi for was for the Vatican otherwise it was beyond great. Breakfast was good, staff was amazing.

author: christian m
title: Dinner on the Seine.
text:
We had a very good time, very pleasant, a beautiful boat ride on the Seine, another way to see Paris.
The singer was brilliant, bravo.
The staff was attentive.
The dinner was very good.

author: Zoh B
title: Superb experience.
text: It's just a shame that after the meal there isn't any entertainment on the terrace with a bar, music, or something else.

author: Cfkhamis
title: Celebration 50 anniversary
text:
Wonderful experience 
Best tour to do in Paris

author: Mathilde M
title: Perfect
text: Perfect friendly staff clean room excellent meals

author: mary s
title: Terrible Customer Service
text: I redeemed a voucher for a dinner cruise and overnight stay on the yacht on Nov 26 and got my email confirmation on May 16. I then went ahead and booked the rest of my Paris plans and tickets on to the Netherlands for November 27. Then on July 10 I get an email from VIP yacht saying they don't do dinner cruises on Thursday in the Winter which is strange because they knew it was a Thursday when they confirmed. They say they'll move my reservation to Friday night and not charge me the weekend surcharge but I'm from Canada, I can't easily change plans without costs and I immediately emailed back saying this and have been ignored for 10 days. Buyer beware, they don't care once they get your money.

author: Steve
title: Hôtel Elysées Union – 2 Night Stay
text:
Location

The hotel is in a fantastic central spot. It’s around a 20‑minute downhill walk to the Eiffel Tower and close to cafés, restaurants, shops and major attractions. There are metro stations at both ends of the road, making it really easy to get around Paris. The locality is simply beautiful.

Staff and Service

The staff are incredibly friendly and helpful. The lady on the front desk when we arrived gave outstanding customer service and genuinely made our trip. She went above and beyond to upgrade us for our second night and gave us what must be one of the best rooms in the hotel, with a beautiful balcony and an unforgettable view of the Eiffel Tower. We were celebrating our daughter’s graduation, and she made it feel extra special.

Hotel and Facilities

The building itself is beautiful, with a bar, lounge and a lovely atrium garden. There’s a lift, a gorgeous staircase and a free bag‑holding service. They offer breakfast you can simply turn up for without booking.

Rooms

The rooms have everything you need. The bathrooms are modern, while the rooms keep a traditional Parisian charm. The beds are comfy, everything is spotless, and you get a safe, mini‑bar and a TV in each room. Rooms were peaceful with no noise from neighbours.

Overall

We had a wonderful stay and would 100% recommend Hôtel Elysées Union. Good value for money. We’ll happily return every time we visit Paris.

author: mandmoya
title: Two nights in Paris
text: Had a great time at this hotel with my daughter for our two nights in Paris. We had a courtyard view for the first night then an Eiffel Tower view for our second night. Both rooms were spacious and clean. The location is perfect,a ten minute walk(we walk fast) to the Eiffel Tower in one direction,ten mins to the arc de triomphe in the other direction. Close to the champs elysees shopping street too which is amazing. We ate at a nice restaurant just up the street from the hotel called le Copernic,good price too. The people on reception were really friendly and helpful. Loved our stay and definitely want to come back to Paris and this hotel.

author: tafuri2015
title: Good option
text: Hotel well located, helpful staff, good breakfast, small room but with a balcony with side view to the tower, I did not understand very well because they make many warnings in the sense that if you stain the towels will be charged 99 euros, it happens that the towels are well wrapped, so you will understand né? also charge a bail of 200 euros in my case was stained at the end of the stay.

author: Paul Z
title: Loved it
text: We LOVED the Hotel Elysees Union. It was our first time in Paris and there were four of us with plenty of luggage. Shaheen was an incredible help with everything. We were able to walk to most of the sites.  The staff and our room were excellent.  Everyone's English was excellent, so there were never any language barriers.  Don't know when we'll make it to Paris again, but we would love to stay here!

author: Elle76_11
title: A good quality, well located hotel option for visits on a budget
text: We stayed here as a group of friends for a weekend in Paris. It is a decent hotel, really well located with plenty of cafes and restaurants within minutes walk and a lovely view of the Tour Eiffel from the street-facing rooms. It isn’t the lap of luxury and the rooms aren’t huge but it’s clean and with lovely service from the maids and reception (who are dealing with a stream of holiday-makers like us!) it was perfect accommodation for us. One of our rooms faced a lovely quiet courtyard and the other had the amazing view. Both had a massive French window and juliette balconies, which was also really Parisien and so charming. Breakfast was included in our very reasonable rate and was perfectly good. No complaints whatsoever!

author: Pasquale D
title: Excellent hotel.
text: Excellent location and welcoming staff. Daily towel change, the only downside is the carpet in the room.

author: Stephanie N
title: Great Hotel
text:
We travelled to Paris as a family of 3 for 5 nights. 
The hotel provided a great base for our holiday. We were able to get to the Centre of Paris, Disney and Versailles with no problems on the trains and Metro and it was walking distance to the Basilica and Monmarte. 
The hotel room was spacious with air con and a window that opened fully, so with the high temperatures we were able to keep cool at night. The room had everything we needed such as tea, coffee machine, fridge and bath robes and the shower was a good size.
The breakfast was a continental breakfast, there was a good choice of breads and pastries. The cheese and fruit options were limited on some of the days, but still lots to choose from.
We really enjoyed our stay and it met our expectations for a 3 star hotel.
The staff were so friendly, always offering to help and give helpful advice. 
If you only need a place to rest after a busy day in Paris I would recommend.

author: Psyché P
title: Highly recommend
text:
It was my third stay at this hotel and I have never been disappointed.
Very good value for money. 
I also stay regularly at the Libertel at the Austerlitz train station; very good as well.

author: bridget c
title: Great little budget hotel.
text: Great location within short walking distance of the Gare du Nord ; plenty of restaurants and cafes nearby also the Marche St Quentin for food. Super-clean , air- conditioned ( we really appreciated this in the 35degree heatwave) and thanks to double glazing, beautifully quiet. Friendly staff and terrific value for money for Paris. Will definitely stay here again.

author: steviebcycling
title: Good value for a hotel ideal for access to Gard du Nord.
text: Good position for transport around Paris and excellent for Gard du Nord. Compact rooms but clean and comfortable bed. Good value, welcoming staff, would recommend staying here for a short stay.

author: NOELIA M
title: Hotel Opera Melia
text: Very nice and centrally located hotel. The receptionist Ivan is a true professional and always very pleasant.

author: Nani E
title: Excellent location and quality
text: We will surely repeat. The breakfast is small but very complete and delicious.  Excellent room with a terrace on the top floor and exceptional staff… Ishara is a delight who helped us with everything. Nothing bad to say…. The location is unbeatable. A place not to be forgotten….

author: Kristy H
title: Our week at Hotel Paris Opera - Exceeded our expectations!
text:
My husband and I spent a week at Hotel Paris Opera Affiliated by Meliá and had an excellent stay. From the moment we arrived, the staff welcomed us warmly. Our room included a lovely welcome gift of chilled Cava, cookies, a tote bag, and a handwritten note.
Ishara at the front desk was outstanding—he recommended restaurants and attractions, booked tickets and reservations, and at the end of our stay walked my husband through Uber and gave clear instructions for navigating Heathrow. His calm help gave us real peace of mind.
We had some noise the first two nights, but the front desk quickly upgraded us to a quiet corner room. The location is ideal, with many sights, restaurants, cafés, and Galeries Lafayette within a short walk. The lobby and breakfast area were always clean and bright, the queen size bed was very comfortable, and housekeeping kept our room fresh daily.
The room was small (as expected in central Paris), and we missed having better TV/streaming options, but overall the value exceeded our expectations. A big shoutout to Ishara—his attentiveness made our stay exceptional. We’d happily stay here again and highly recommend it.

author: JULIA H
title: Family trip
text:
The best part was the location, a very good area with all services nearby.
As for the rooms, we took 2, we were traveling as a family, worse impossible. Small, they faced an interior patio, terrible ventilation, very unpleasant smell of humidity. Located on the top floor, not comfortable at all.

author: Kathie V
title: Great Hotel/Staff!
text: Hotel Paris Opera by Melia was an excellent hotel to stay in! It was so close to many tourist sites in Paris and was a great place to feel like a local. There were so many good restaurants near by and the hotel was very clean. The staff was extremely helpful, especially Ishara who went out of his way to help us on numerous occasions. We highly recommend this hotel and cannot thank Ishara enough for his help with directing us on how to get to each of our tourist locations. Thank you again!

author: Simone
title: A Montmartre Gem – Wonderful Hotel & Exceptional Staff
text:
I write this review with genuine sincerity.

The wonderful staff at Timhotel Montmartre have this week accommodated the smallest of requests for a dear friend who is staying there on my recommendation. They have been so patient with the time difference, so obliging with my requests, and wonderfully accommodating in arranging a small gift and note for her.

My uncle has stayed at Timhotel for many, many years, and I too have had the pleasure of staying there.

If you choose to stay in Montmartre — always my favourite part of Paris — Timhotel is a wonderful choice. The views are magnificent, whether of the beautiful street life below or across the rooftops of Paris.

My sincere thanks to the wonderful staff, particularly Eliza and Yazid, who have moved mountains to make my dear friend happy upon her arrival today. Sometimes the smallest gestures mean the most.

Thank you once again 

Simone

author: Andrea H
title: Worth Booking a Room with a View!
text: We loved our stay here and had an amazing view of the Eiffel Tower! The staff were friendly and helpful. Hotel is in a part of Paris with lots of character! Air conditioning works well and can be adjusted to your liking. Friendly staff. Our room was cleaned daily which you don’t always get in the United States.

author: Heike S
title: Small and nice
text:
Great location, as already mentioned so often 
Room as expected very small, especially the bathroom
But very clean and even equipped with air conditioning

author: Jean-Louis V
title: Big disappointment.
text:
We are regular customers and we hesitated for a long time before sharing our disappointment with you. Not because of the service, but because of the lack of commercial spirit during the mishap that happened to us following the cancellation of our train (for which we were in no way responsible and which we learned about on the 23rd) and the lack of listening on your part to postpone our stay from 06/28 to 06/29 by one day or to obtain a refund, even though we had booked and paid on 3/8 (210.06€, a supposedly more advantageous price but non-refundable, according to your receptionist, even though she offered us to pay about 189€ again..., quite contradictory remarks). We received no proposal or start of a solution. The only answer given was: " “We have instructions.” Under these conditions, I think we will never set foot in one of your hotels again, and you can count on us to give you (bad) publicity unless you make a commercial gesture...
Mr. & Mrs. Vanantwerpen-Somers

author: Angelica B
title: June 2026
text:
Got a room without working AC, had to change after two days AC worked but the toilet was so small that you could not sit straight with your legs but sat crookedly on the toilet minimal shower area, old carpets where it was not cleaned properly….bad to hang clothes when there was a lack of a rod for the closet….no vegetables for breakfast, a kind of bread ran out…location good!
We will never come back…

author: Carlotta M
title: Recommended!
text:
Small but clean and functional hotel, centrally located, convenient for walking around. Our room 303 was small but perfect, with a very clean bathroom and linens. Varied breakfast with sweet and savory options, drinks from the machine were not bad, overall very good.
A special thanks to Peter at the reception, kind, helpful, and always ready to lend a hand, giving advice to make you feel at home. I recommend this hotel!!

author: Mily1980218
title: Professional stay
text:
Very nice stay at this hotel! The establishment is ideally located, in a quiet street, which allows you to enjoy a peaceful environment while remaining central
The staff is friendly, the room: you feel at ease right away.
I recommend without hesitation

author: Linda Halter
title: Timmhotel Palais Royal
text: The normal rooms are very small. The accessible room is very large with separate hotel access and accessible shower. It is recommended to electrify the room door as it is very heavy and closes independently and to hang a shower curtain in the bathroom.

author: audreykorpal
title: just for one night
text:
medium, tiny shower, room difficult to pass if 2 people. well located
The air conditioning didn't work, you bastard in the room
For breakfast, perime yogurt for two days

author: manuellnano
title: A comfortable stay at Christmas
text:
We were looking for a hotel for a quiet Christmas holiday in Paris and found Timhotel Palais Royal has a perfect location in the center of Paris and we must say that we are very satisfied and happy with the services and kindness of the staff.

Highly recommended

author: Nikkian
title: A fabulous hotel with just the best staff
text:
What a tremendous “find”, this quaint hotel, is not the biggest but it has a real heart…its staff!
The staff are tremendous, nothing is too much bother, always a happy smiling disposition!
Reception lady when checked in was so helpful and set the tone for the rest of the stay giving useful advice when asked.
The breakfast was thoroughly enjoyable especially sat outside in the courtyard. Excellent food, good selection available that accounted for all tastes. The ladies preparing and serving the food were just fantastic, full of laughter and beaming smiles.
I really do recommend this hotel, great location close to a splendid little restaurant ( a must go to!) and close to all transport (around the corner from the Duplex M station) making accessing Paris a breeze.

author: melissa c
title: Street noise a problem.
text: I spent 3 nights here in May. it was a single room which had a double bed in it which was great. the staff were all really helpful and friendly. the breakfast buffet had a great selection of food particularly if you had gluten or dairy intolerances. its located a few minutes walk from several metro stations and is about 12 minutes walk from the Eiffel Tower. All very positive however I got little to no sleep due to street noise. Deliveries to surrounding businesses and what sounded like construction work left me still awake at 5am. Rue Juge is not a quiet street. If i had known it would continue like that for 3 nights I would have requested to change rooms if there was availability. Disappointed and frustrated.

author: Andrea N
title: Bad experience
text:
There are 4 of us, 2 adults and 2 11-year-olds... 2 rooms booked as there are no quadruple rooms available 
A room on the first floor that looked like a closet with an even smaller bathroom where the shower cubicle touched the siphon closing it 
A room on the ground floor next to the reception (imagine the comings and goings of people) with a disabled bathroom where there is at least one curtain for shower...
Good breakfast... but not even a placemat on the tables 
In brackets to go to the first floor or use the stairs or an elevator for 1 person 
Price not justified although close to the Seine and Eiffel Tower

author: LINETTE S S
title: Suggestions
text: The hotel said it had a view for the Tower and it's not true.  The staff did not want to help for the mistake of the rooms.

author: rebeccaravasi0
title: TimHotel Tour Eiffel
text:
Very nice room, wonderful view from the sixth floor
The staff was very nice with me and my boyfriend, always smiling! 
The breakfast was perfect!!

author: Antonio Luciano Battaglia
title: Excellent service, Mr. Rocco Modesti is great.
text: An excellent location in the center of Rome across from Termini Station, qualified and kind staff, in particular Mr. Rocco Modesti who puts guests at ease, offering the best services that the property provides, which are quite numerous. Elegant, well-structured, and air-conditioned rooms, with excellent bathroom facilities, free Wi-Fi, and everything else, breakfast and dining services for all tastes. I highly recommend it both for individuals and for those traveling with family.

author: Marge Lombard
title: Rome experience
text: I was a little worried about the location but never had a problem. Transport was practically on our doorstep. Although the hotel is quite old we were comfortable and we can ot fault the hospitality we received.

author: Giuseppe A
title: HOTEL COROT ROME
text:
we use it a lot as a company for our staff in transit through Rome
easy to reach
located in a strategic and convenient spot next to Roma Termini train station
ideal for a pleasant stop while waiting for your next trip or a meeting
you can reach tourist or shopping spots on foot such as Via Nazionale or Via Veneto 
welcoming but simple environment, everything clean and staff courteous and always available...excellent in everything
I send friends and relatives and no one ever has a complaint or service issue
WELL DONE

author: Antonio T
title: The visit was for work, but I would return every time.
text: I spent 4 nights at this hotel and had a great time. Excellent welcome, excellent hotel, very kind and helpful staff, excellent location near the station.  I will definitely return and I recommend it to you.

author: nenette75011
title: Very decent
text:
Very decent hotel, we were worried after all the negative reviews we read at the last moment. But once again, that was unfounded. We then stayed at a hotel in Pisa and a hotel in Florence, and neither matched the Corot. So, indeed, you have to ask at the reception to turn on the air conditioning, or at least to adjust it, but once you know the technique, it’s very quick. The staff is very nice, except for one young woman; the gentlemen speak French, and the blonde lady is simply adorable. The brunette lady at breakfast is the same ☺️. Breakfast is classic: bread, croissant, toast; for fruits, it’s either canned or fresh apples, but then there’s a hot drink dispenser. We are indeed facing the Termini station (personally, I live in Paris, so I found it relatively calm 😂). There is a wide choice of restaurants nearby; we actually ate several evenings at Julie’s, a little further away where the owner has some nice anecdotes to share about the flame in Beijing,
Regarding the hotel, the bathroom is perfect, I liked the vintage side, the room is basic; personally, we just ask for a decent bed to sleep. The curtains are very blackout, and there are shutters behind; no power outage between June 25 and June 29. Honestly, we recommend it without fuss (ps: wifi is fine in the rooms and the elevator is fine for 2 adults, 2 large suitcases, 2 backpacks, and 1 banana 😅 honestly, $100 a night for 2 on a trip, that’s not asking too much)

author: Denise B
title: Terrific place and restaurant
text: Everyone is so friendly and helpful. We ate at the restaurant and the food was so good. I had the ravioli and my friend had the scallopini.  Both were delicious!!  Tha waiter was very friendly and fun.

author: Naomi Denisse H
title: Feedback
text: They are so kind and they are very professional

author: Skilde170
title: Best Hilton staff ever!!!
text: I travel extensively for work and spend about 100 nights a year in a hotel and have to say this was the best service I have ever had in a hotel. From the check-in to check-out and everything in between, the staff was second to none. Chiara gave us the best restaurant recommendations and left a little treat in the room for my wife’s birthday. Lorenzo was incredible giving us directions and recommendations for our travel days and hailing us a cab. Flavio worked wonders in the kitchen and Giulia was always there to greet us with a smile. Kudos to this hotel and its wonderful staff. Also the location was incredible. 1 block from the subway, laundromat, grocery store and plenty of top rated restaurants. I can’t recommend this hotel enough for your stay in Rome!!!

author: Rochelle T
title: Restaurant
text: The Restaurant was great!! Bartender who was also the server and cook was excellent!

author: Abel M
title: An oasis in hot Rome.
text: Everyone from the front desk, bar and restaurent was extremely friendly and most helpful. My wife rented an electric scooter for our stay in Rome. The Hotel staff was very accomodating. The hotel is clean and well kept. Our shower was very refreshing after venturing the hot city. The Spring House was like an oasis next to the Vatican and the Cipro station.  Thanks the Mayo 's from Alabama USA..

author: Mary Louise W
title: Perfect spot in Manhattan
text: Never disappointed by the Arlo.  I stayed here somewhat randomly the first time but it is now one of my go-to spots in NY.  Love the garment district location and the amenities are perfect.  Don’t miss the rooftop deck or the atrium seating just to hang out and enjoy NY.  And use an umbrella if it rains!!

author: Carlos v
title: Theft of deposit
text:
Good afternoon, we had this hotel booked and paid for through an agency in my city (Seville), upon arrival they charged us 200 euros in taxes plus a 100 euro (by card) deposit that is returned on the day we check out.
That day I asked them why they hadn't returned the deposit and they told me that it is a held amount and not charged and that sometimes Spanish banks take up to a month to return it.
A month has passed and they are already in Seville and the hotel keeps telling me the same thing. When more than a month passed and after speaking with my bank, the hotel told me that they had charged me the 100 euros (it was no longer a hold) for some drinks that they claim we had consumed.
THEY ARE LIARS AND SCAMMERS. WE HAD NEVER CONSUMED ANYTHING OF WHAT THEY ARE TELLING ME.
As of today, a month and a half has passed, they have not sent us receipts for those drinks that they say were signed by me.
It is clear, they keep 100 euros from each of us who go there, some of us do not notice and others they tell (months later and once back in Spain) that it is for drinks.
NEVER STAY AT THIS HOTEL BECAUSE THEY KEEP YOUR MONEY IN A VERY RUTHLESS WAY.
Trip typeVacation · Family
Rooms1.0
Important detailsThe management are crooks, they keep your money and are not capable of justifying that theft.

author: sandragallagher2020
title: Rooftop restaurant

A lovely member of your staff

author: Sonia M
title: Excellent hôtel !!!
text: Excellent hotel, close to everything. The breakfast was very, very good! Very competent staff.

author: Dave X
title: You Will Love This Hotel - Arlo Midtown
text:
Beautiful, impeccably maintained, and infused with state-of-the-art technology, this hotel offers a modern and thoughtfully designed experience. While the rooms are compact, the efficient layout makes them feel comfortable and more than adequate.

As impressive as the property is, its greatest asset is the exceptional, world-class customer service—especially from Nikki. Her attention to detail, genuine thoughtfulness, and proactive care elevated every aspect of our stay. She anticipated our needs, ensured everything was seamless, and made us feel truly valued. Nikki’s outstanding hospitality transformed an already beautiful hotel into an unforgettable experience. Highly recommended.

author: judi&vic
title: A Charming Boutique Hotel
text: We love Hotel Bolivar with its comfortable rooms, traditional Roman decor, a beautiful breakfast room and best of all, the hidden location between two main streets. Because of this it is very quiet in the rooms, which we really appreciate after a busy day of sightseeing in Rome. There’s also a fabulous restaurant right across from the front entrance, Ristorante Santa Cristina al Quirinale (reservation highly recommended).

author: atjtetmt
title: I’d stay again.
text:
Pros:

Such a beautiful place. Hand painted murals all over. 
Lobby has seating and a bar. 
AC in the room was cold and adjustable. 
Balcony was big enough for table and chairs. 
Room for 3 people was big enough to maneuver around. 
Plenty of toiletries and big towels. 
Bed was firm if that’s how you like it. 
Breakfast area was beautiful and many choices for breakfast. 
They stored our bags before check in and room was ready at 2. 
All employees were encountered were friendly and welcoming. 
Quiet room. 

Cons 
Bed was too firm for my liking. 
Some of the breakfast items were dry and guessing from the day before.  There were plenty of choices so everyone ate enough.

author: B H
title: clean, good location, great staff
text:
we stayed here as a family of 6 , 3 rooms and we had a lovely experience. The man on reception on check in was friendly and helpful as were all the staff on reception. 
It is an extremely clean hotel, quiet in a back street in a very busy location. 
I had an amazing single room on the third floor with a balcony with wonderful views of Rome.
The breakfast while adequate could improve slightly, ie cold scrambled eggs and cold boiled eggs but apart from that no complaints. 
I hope to return.

author: אלעד ז
title: Get away!
text: The hotel with zero consideration, big problem when canceling a reservation. Bad service.

author: johnandelaine12
title: Attractive hotel in a perfect city centre location.
text:
Eight of us stayed here for two nights over the weekend. An attractive and comfortable hotel in the heart of the city. Friendly and efficient service from reception. 
The bedrooms were spacious, well furnished and tastefully decorated.
Breakfast choices were many and varied. The breakfast room on the top floor was bright and offered some lovely views across the city towards the countryside.
Our accommodation was priced very reasonably, given  there must have been high demand for hotels over the weekend because of the Italy v Scotland rugby match.
Highly recommended. We’ll book this hotel next time we’re in Rome.

author: Foteini S
title: Nice and tasty dinner
text: Very nice food and service. Very beautiful ambience

author: Gurl P
title: Ok in August I guess
text:
I had a mostly pleasant stay here, and the room was definitely one of the highlights. It was cute, stylish, and had a great overall vibe. The AC worked really well, which in Rome in August is not a small thing. The shower was also excellent and honestly one of my favorite parts of the room.

The minibar was fine—nothing particularly exciting, but it did the job. The gym was also perfectly adequate for getting in a quick workout, although nothing particularly memorable.

Unfortunately, the breakfast was where things took a serious turn.

For the price, I expected much better. The bacon was hard and tasted suspiciously like pepperoni, while the scrambled eggs were watery and essentially flavorless. The espresso tasted burnt, and somehow the cappuccino managed to be disappointing too—which, in Italy, feels almost personal.

Then there were the pancakes. Calling them pancakes is generous. They tasted like actual cake and seemed to contain enough sugar to launch a small child into orbit.

The pastries weren’t much better. The cream croissant was the best of the bunch, but there was approximately three molecules of cream inside. At that point, just call it a croissant.

The fruit was fine. Nothing to write home about, but perfectly acceptable.

Overall, I liked the hotel and enjoyed the room, AC, and shower. However, the breakfast was expensive, underwhelming, and easily the weakest part of the stay. I’ve had some incredible food in Rome, so unfortunately this was not the final Italian breakfast experience I was hoping for.

author: Marika B
title: Perfect hotel
text: Hotel near the Spanish Steps and therefore easily reachable on foot. Across from Villa Borghese and near excellent venues, 500 m away there is also the Rinascente. The hotel is very clean and the staff is super friendly and helpful. A beautiful experience

author: Gloria
title: Excellent

author: Susie P
title: Thank you!
text: I had lunch at the restaurant and was served by Fabrizio he was so kind and attentive!!!!

author: OnAir310314
title: Pleasant stay
text: We have been there several times and always a good welcome, the room clean, the kettle and the minibar restocked every day. The breakfast is really high quality

author: Pierluigi D
title: Convenient and comfortable hotel
text: Excellent value for money

author: Morgane R
title: Parisian stay
text:
Pleasant, quiet, and functional hotel.
Elevator, decent breakfast, pleasant staff.

author: Linda B
title: A nice hotel in Paris
text: We stayed there for one night as a family. Everything was really good, from the welcome to the breakfast service to the check-out.

author: Lava
title: Convenient to public transportation
text: Great location in between Rome and Clichy. We were able to walk to the train stations and convenient bus stops. The staff was very friendly and had complimentary soft drinks in the room. We had a room with twin beds and it was very clean. My only issue was that the walls were so thin and the floor creaked in several places as you walked around. There isn't much they can probably do about that but we could hear conversations and the alarm of the room next to us. The air conditioning was good and there was a window that could be opened. This place was great for our trip.

author: BeverlyBee
title: A Wonderful, Relaxing Stay in Monti
text:
My husband and I stayed at the Hotel Colosseum in August 2026. We specifically wanted to stay in the Monti neighborhood, and this hotel was perfect for us.

- The street outside and the hotel itself were wonderfully quiet. Our room was both comfortable and peaceful, making it a great retreat after long, hot days of sightseeing.
- Every single staff member we encountered was friendly and helpful.
- The free breakfast was a highlight. Instead of a small two-hour window, they offer breakfast over a generous four-hour period. There was a fantastic variety of food, including plenty of healthy options that I really appreciated.
- We were within easy walking distance of the Colosseum, the Roman Forum, and a few other major attractions, as well as a wide range of restaurants.
- The views from the rooftop bar are stunning, and our bartender was a very sweet guy who made great cocktails.

We thoroughly enjoyed our time here and would absolutely stay at Hotel Colosseum again on our next trip to Rome!

author: keyvan2026
title: Colosseum in Rome! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
text:
We had a wonderful stay at Hotel Colosseum in Rome! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

The hotel was very clean and comfortable, the breakfast was delicious, and the location was perfect—close to many of Rome’s main attractions, restaurants, and shops. The entire staff was friendly, welcoming, and always ready to help.

A very special thank you to Mr. Alexandra, who went above and beyond to help us find a nearby hotel when we arrived very early. We truly appreciated his kindness and excellent service.

We had such a great experience and would definitely stay here again. Highly recommended!

author: Extraordinary549963
title: Great location & very clean
text: Single mom traveling with 12 & 14 yo kids. Felt like a safe area to walk even at night. Found many restaurant and shopping options within walking distance. Beds are hard but I was comfortable. AC worked great.

author: SFTraveler1234567
title: Solid 3-star hotel near Colosseum and Monti neighborhood; I would return
text: Very solid 3-star hotel. Would definitely recommend. We booked a triple, but were upgraded to a quad with 2 full bathrooms for no extra cost. Decent A/C and tall ceilings in our room. Helpful front desk, who helped us with taxis, restaurants, and tours. Lovely rooftop terrace with a great view of Rome and a small bar. Our room rate came with a free welcome drink. The hotel asks you to keep the room key at the front desk when you go out (old school vibe). Breakfast was good -- scrambled eggs, sausage, ham, cheese, breads, pastries, yogurt, fruit, cereal, coffee, juice, etc. -- although was somehow a bit lacking. Breakfast started at 7:30am, which sounds reasonable when you are on vacation, but was too late when we had early tours (we booked the first tours of the day to avoid the August heat). Convenient location near the Colosseum and the trendy Monti neighborhood with lots of cafes and small stores. Also not far from a Carrefour Express. Luggage room was not locked, but seemed safe. Overall, a great find and I would return.

author: ray
title: Loved our stay, would definitely stay again, great locay and loved rooftop bar for sunsets and cocktails before!
text: We absolutely loved this hotel! Location is great and walking distance from lots of locations. Very friendly staff and clean rooms. They put on a fantastic breakfast spread every morning that’s included. And it’s not just stale bagels n coffee! It would keep us full till lunch, I’ll attach pics. The best part is The Rooftop Bar! Opens at 6pm, we would go every night for sunset and cocktails before going out! I would have given it 5 stars but there is no restaurant or  ice machines! Us Americans love our ice! But every night when we got back to hotel the kind man at front desk would fill up and ice bucket for us so we could fill our water bottles! Would definitely stay there again!  :)

author: Advisor_Mio
title: Good although a bit dated hotel
text:
A small a bit dated hotel located at the doorstep of Santa Maria Maggiore, near Cavour metro station and in a walkable distance from Termini station. Clean although a bit small rooms with air condition, free wifi, kettle and fridge. Friendly and helpful staff. 
A restaurant in the neighbouring building. Breakfasts in the hotel available, but we didn’t try them, there are many local cafes nearby.

author: Maisie E
title: Great Location and Friendly Service, but a Little Dated
text: The location is definitely the main selling point of this hotel, making it a really convenient base for exploring. The atmosphere was pleasant and relaxed, and the service was very good, with friendly staff who were happy to recommend places to eat. The reception is staffed 24/7, and you have to hand your key in whenever you leave, which is a nice security feature. The rooms were clean and did the job, but the hotel is quite dated and could definitely do with a refresh, with things like broken lampshades. The cleanliness was good overall, although the **amenities** could be improved, particularly the air conditioning, which didn't work very well and wasn't ideal during the August heatwave. The noise level wasn't an issue for us during our stay. Overall, the hotel offered decent value for what we needed, mainly thanks to its excellent location and friendly service, but it would benefit from some modernisation.

author: madison o
title: Most uncomfortable bed I’ve been forced to sleep on.
text: Absolutely nothing like the photos, plus the most uncomfortable bed I’ve ever had to sleep on. There are zero amenities so it’s basically a cot and a bathroom. Photos show an outdoor dining/seating area, balconies on the rooms and plush beds — not the case at all. Way over priced, old, dated and gross. Only upside is how lovely the staff was, otherwise I was completely scammed.

author: Silvana D
title: Awesome experience with the staff at this hotel.
text: 1000/10 Highly recommended! Throughout my entire stay, the staff at this hotel took wonderful care of me and answered every question I had. I can't recall their names at the moment, but a special thank you goes to the lady and gentleman who recommended where to buy whole-bean coffee, and another special thank you to Mohamed for his attentiveness. Everyone there was incredibly friendly. I thought the location was phenomenal—just a 10, 20, or 30-minute walk to all the beautiful sights in the historic center. Plus, you have everything right nearby: a supermarket, a pharmacy, bars, and restaurants. Thank you, Hotel Verona!

author: Din D
title: Lovely central location
text: Amazing location. We would stay here again. The 24 hour staff / concierge are delightful. It feels safe and there is next to no noise when the window is shut. However, the room temperature is then hard to control. The other major down side included a very firm mattress and thin flat pillows. Towels aren't changed mid-week: only the beds are turned down. There is just one key, which they require to be left at reception whenever going out.  Guests with mobility problems or large luggage would not manage easily as the lifts are strangely located on the landings between two floors.

author: Luciane C
title: Praise
text: This hotel is wonderful! The staff at this hotel helped me a lot even without being a guest. Excellent service! Excellent hotel!

author: sarahando13126
title: Would stay here again without hesitation
text:
We stayed here 28th may-1st June prior to arriving i emailed the hotel to ask about ensuring our room had 4 beds (2 adults one teenager one child) as some reviews said it was a sofa bed. They emailed me back within 20 minutes! Which alone is unheard of.
I was  reassured all rooms have been renovated and it will be fine. And it was! 
Biggest room ive ever had on a city trip. Long corridor which consisted of full sized wardrobe bathroom with shower and bidet,a double bed and 2 single beds perfect!!

Air con in the room hot water for everyone's showers.Room serviced every day!

Staff were all very friendly.

Hotel is literally 15 mins from most big attractions in Rome (apart from vatican, but even that is only a 30 mins walk)

The underground were on strike whilst we were there so couldn't utilise that as much as we'd like.

Monti Is a trendy area of Rome to stay, lots of boutique shops restaurants etc 

As a family we all felt totally safe too!

Would stay here again without hesitation

author: Aleksandra G
title: Highly recommended!
text:
We gave the stay at Hotel Virgilio in Rome to my mom for her birthday – and it was just a great choice! We were very satisfied all around.

The room was large and very nice, as was the spacious bathroom with a large shower. Everything was freshly renovated and really spotless. Our wishes for two beds and a shower instead of bathtub were fulfilled without any problems, which we greatly appreciated.

Although it was a bit noisy from the street, but at night we could still sleep well – after all, you are in the middle of Rome and very centrally located. The proximity to many attractions, such as the Trevi Fountain and the Colosseum, is a big plus.

Special praise goes to the team at reception: The boys were incredibly friendly – thank you for the warm welcome!

Breakfast also convinced us: delicious, varied and something for everyone. We were particularly happy about tomatoes and cucumbers, which is not always a given in Italy.

Thank you very much for the wonderful time in Rome – we would love to come back!

author: fillin402
title: Perfect for a visit to Rome
text:
Staff attentive and available 
Breakfast quite correct 
Cozy room and practical bathroom 
1 single flat the street noise

author: Omar A
title: Great location, close to everything

Comfortable and spacious bed, large bathroom. Perhaps it would improve the isolation between pieces because the conversations of the neighbors are felt when everything is silent. The location is great and the neighborhood is very nice and quiet. Good breakfast buffet. The receptionist spoke Spanish and very friendly and helpful. I would definitely come back

author: Ian B
title: Noisy, not good. Not recommended.
text:
Last two stays have been really poor. My room was upgraded and has me near a local pub/club and the noise from the outdoor music is ridiculously loud so I can’t sleep. 
My previous stay the room service meal was cold and air con not working. 
In my experience it’s really gone downhill and not recommended at all for business travel.

author: 273Louise
title: Modern, comfortable hotel in great location
text:
Great location for mainland trains and underground plus buses
Hotel staff were friendly and helpful. 
Issa on Reception was most welcoming on check in, as was Aida on departure.

The twin room we had was bigger than most London hotels we have stayed in, and very clean and comfortable.

Good choice of food on the buffet breakfast as well as food to order for breakfast.

author: Kris A
title: Beautiful hotel in great location
text: The Canopy by Hilton London City is located within a short walking distance of the Aldgate bus/train station which makes it easy to see all the sights London has to offer. The hotel has a nice upscale atmosphere with rooms that give a modern industrial feel. The breakfast was fantastic with many hot items as well as cereals, fresh fruit, yogurts, cheeses and breads. Wonderful fresh juices were available. Staff was amazing and often remembered us by name and room number. It was a pleasure staying there.

author: Blake R
title: Amazing !
text: First time staying at a Hilton in London & I can highly recommend! Had such a nice welcome from Alicia, super helpful

author: Lisa S
title: Overall good experience
text:
We loved this hotel's location close to the Tower of London and Whitechapel and overall really enjoyed our stay.  

The only mark against the hotel was that one evening, when sitting directly between the front desk (staffed with 2 employees) and the bar area (staffed with 3 employees), my bag was stolen by two women.  We were at one of the tables having a glass of wine, and it was by my feet.  It was planned and they were working in pairs - with my cards being used within a half an hour of the grab.  The police were notified, and it was on camera.  And I know no place is safe.  But it was crazy to have it done in a hotel lobby.  Thank God my passport was not in my bag.  Sadly no follow up from the hotel regarding the situation.

author: eider701
title: Nice hotel
text:
We stayed at this property for three nights in January 2026. The location is very good: close to Montparnasse station and close to the Luxembourg garden.
The welcome and service are very good. The property is clean, the room is spacious and very quiet.
The breakfast buffet is good.
Only problem: the elevator is smaller than our old phone booths.

author: Deborah S
title: A very good 3 stars. With lovely staff.
text: Charming staff!!!! Nice location. However the hotel is for me a 3 star. The room has equipment in medium condition.( broken bedside lamp, split bathroom sink...) bcp small details despite a great team.

author: Johanna S
title: Excellent
text:
I had a great stay at the Nude Paris hotel.
Welcoming was excellent, friendly staff and care. 
The place is very nice and it is ideally located. 
I recommend++++

author: felipe p
title: Total disaster. Lack of commercial loyalty. Total absence of air conditioning.
text:
We arrived on June 29, 2025 and stayed until July 5 to celebrate our 50th anniversary of marriage. We pay for everything in advance. They lied to us that they had air conditioning. THERE WAS NO SUCH AIR OR VENTILATION. 
PARIS WITH RECORD TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 35 AND 40 DEGREES. They wouldn't give us another room or return the money paid. The deal was practically terrible abandonment of elderly people in a country foreign to us. We spent only one night without air could not breathe and the window that overlooked the street got warmer. EXCRUCIATING. An embarrassment for French hoteliers. No one took responsibility. It seemed more like they were funny situation. They wouldn't let us settle any complaints. They were shielding at the counter from what looked like a reception. They were just saying that there were difficulties with the air that on some floors were not walking but that they had no idea when it would be fixed, amid laughter.
In my country never could this hotel have obtained the 4 STAR rating.

author: Richard S
title: Unsatisfactory. Non-existent conditioning.
text:
Everything was good, except the complete lack of air-conditioning in our 5th floor room at the onset of our 5 night stay. We spent the check in night in blazing heat, wrote a message via Booking.com message, requesting another room or we would seek a relocation / refund. The next morning we were offered another room, if we could check out and leave our bags. We were on our way to catch a train to our tour, and could not do so. That night we were given a portable fan. The next morning we checked out and when we returned we moved into a room on the 4th floor. No air-conditioning again. I asked the desk clerk to come check the room to verify that everything was turned on and working. He came up and said he was sorry, but the owner was in the process of correcting the old building's air-conditioning. We were given a fan for the remaining days, and as the temperature had dropped, we slept with the windows open and the fan on all night. Once you are in Paris, it's too late to change. Check my other ratings, I have nearly always given 10 out of 10 ratings in our prior trips to Europe.

I didn't see many negative reviews, and marked it up to outliers. If the ambient temperature is satisfactory for you to sleep in, then risk it if you choose. At least you can open a window, although without air-conditioning the humidity may be uncomfortable regardless of the temperature.

author: Emma B
title: The best hotel in Paris !
text:
A wonderful wedding anniversary!
We had the most amazing time 
Hotel and staff are so incredible and can’t do enough for you. 
The pool was a bonus and lovely although a bit cool !

author: Staci B
title: Lovely, quiet location near the Opera and Galleries Lafayette.
text: We booked two rooms for our family of four for our recent stay in Paris.  The hotel is in a very quiet location, and it is an easy walk to a metro station.  The hotel staff was lovely and accommodating, the rooms are clean, and the decor is fun.  Our rooms were a deluxe and a classic.  The deluxe room was quite small, but we were out and about seeing the city, so that wasn’t a problem.  If you wanted to spend much time in that room, it would be a bit snug.  Bathroom shower is great, if small!  Classic room was a much more comfortable size.

author: marylyn r
title: Great experience!
text: I was very pleased with my room. The location was fantastic. I was able to walk wherever I’m able to be. The staff were friendly and accommodating, even though I didn’t speak French. I was able to get a great night sleep. The staff was very helpful in getting me anything I needed.

author: syndi z
title: Thank you for everything and then some.
text: Our wonderful experience with this hotel began months before our arrival. Every question I had was answered and every request I made was fulfilled. Explanations were given, reservations were made and even a special pick up was done for us. All with smiles by a very attentive staff. Kudos and a special thank you to Freddy.

author: Adelaida S
title: Content
text:
Our stay was perfection. The rooms
Were beautiful and each was designed for comfort and a luxurious feeling. Everyone at the front desk was always so happy and willing to help. Especially kudos to Marwan who kindly booked trains for us and always advised us well. Will always recommend this place to friends and family.

author: Marcaret
title: In general terms, very good
text: The price-to-comfort ratio is very good, and it is very well located. Additionally, it is very central for the tourist

author: cibarbosa
title: Rest time
text: Thank you for making our stay something very special. The staff is very attentive and helpful. Impeccable rooms.

author: yaelr771
title: Great stay
text: Great location and service, every request fullfilled, we loved the room the location and will come back again

author: Mhprins72
title: Pleasant stay
text: We had a great experience here. We felt very welcome and the staff was extremely helpful. Highly recommended!

author: elenaK4522CP
title: Disappointing stay
text: Very disappointed with our stay . It’s up a very steep hill so not advisable for older people. And not for families as the rooms are very small

author: Irene Z
title: Top
text:
We stayed at the Hotel Trevi for 5 nights, in two rooms, a quintuple and a double.
At the time of booking we asked for the possibility of having the two rooms close together, we were pleasantly accommodated and the double room was of a higher standard than the one booked.
Clean, spacious, finely renovated rooms. Spacious bathrooms with shower and tub in both rooms; in the quintuple room, the tub was a whirlpool.
Excellent daily cleaning; we even found a small bottle of water each as a welcome.
The reception staff was very kind, available for our every request, and even helped us manage the emergency that forced two of our guests to depart early.
We also appreciated the excellent quality breakfast.
A positive note for us was the location of the rooms outside the main building; it guaranteed us greater privacy and also easier management of the children.
The hotel's location a stone's throw from the Trevi Fountain is priceless.
This is the third time we have stayed at the Hotel Trevi and it has never disappointed us.
Highly recommended

author: Carolina B
title: Excellent
text: Excellent location, excellent work by Roberto the receptionist. A very good and comfortable atmosphere. I traveled alone and they were super helpful

author: mundial862026
title: Unbeatable location
text: Very good treatment from the staff in general. In a privileged area, a few meters from the Trevi Fountain, and despite that, no noises were heard inside the rooms they gave us. It is a place to keep in mind in case of arriving in Rome.

author: Fiona
title: A great central base
text: Hotel Trevi was lovely and did the perfect job of being a central base as we ran around Rome.  Our room was in a building near to the main reception, which was unexpected as we weren't informed about this prospect at all prior to booking.  But it wasn't too much of a problem; we were still very close by.  There was a very narrow lift to our floor, which wasn't always working.  The air conditioning in the room was much needed in the heat wave.  I had booked for 3 adults and 3 separate beds, but we got a double and a single.  We made do. The room was very clean and had everything we needed.

author: Ellen Y
title: Great hotel!
text: Fantastic hotel and value.  Clean and modern rooms.  Great air conditioning.  The staff is friendly and helpful.  I would definitely return.

author: Caterina L
title: Disappointing hotel. I would not return.
text: Hotel Julia, although located in the heart of Rome, has absolutely embarrassing rooms. I stayed for two nights in July.  The bathroom was old with a broken shower stall, and there was only a shutter in the room, with no screens. There was no desk and not even a surface to put things on. Not very clean; in fact, the first night there was an insect on the pillow. Quality/price ratio... paid too much!

author: Francesco M
title: Worst hotel ever
text:
Location ok close to Trevi fountain but is
An hotel without a soul. Terrible rooms terrible reception terrible lights terrible bathrooms terrible showers terrible beds. Noise of water during the night. Don’t chose this hotel do yourself a favor
For the same price you can get much more.

author: Emanuele P
title: Convenient.
text: A convenient hotel for exploring Rome, close to the Barberini metro stop and the Trevi Fountain. Friendly staff.

author: Mgc
title: Best price if you want to be in the center of Rome
text:
A very central hotel of everything, less than 5 minutes from the plumbing. It has no frills but is clean and the rooms are not dwarfs. We had a very nice week, and the price is very good to be in the same center., and in the evenings it was not noisy either. They change your towels every day and your sheets one day a week. 
You can even have a simple and very cheap breakfast. 
The staff is also very nice and helpful.

author: Peter P
title: Not enough of a budget hotel to return
text: I am afraid that a third time will not be the charm. After a six year absence, I decided to visit Hotel Julia once again in an effort to save some money because of bloated Jubilee year rates. The savings was not enough. I knew breakfast was eliminated but you would think the hotel would offer a pot of regular perculated Maxwell House coffee (never mind those espresso machines) and the Rome equilavent of Tim Bits gratis, just to get you going in the morning. The on again/off again Wifi in the rooms in this day and age is inexcusable. But there are pluses...excellent location, walking distance to major sites and bus line is close by and a subway station is just around the corner and only two stops to Termini rail station.

author: Melissa Lezcano
title: DO NOT BOOK THIS HOTEL
text:
A very disappointing experience and unacceptable conditions.

I am writing this review as a travel agent, on behalf of some passengers who recently stayed at this hotel.

The experience was extremely negative. The establishment is very old and the facilities are in urgent need of renovation. During their stay, the air conditioning in the rooms was not working correctly, despite the high temperatures in Rome. The hotel only provided them with fans, a totally insufficient solution, and my passengers could not rest or sleep properly due to the unbearable heat.

The problem did not only affect one room: other families staying there also expressed the same complaints. The passengers recorded the situation at the front desk, but they did not receive an effective solution or an alternative room.

The conditions were so difficult that they considered leaving the establishment before finishing their reservation and looking for other accommodation on their own. It is unacceptable to offer rooms in these conditions, especially during the summer, without informing guests beforehand that the air conditioning system is not working correctly.

I would not recommend this hotel until they carry out a serious renovation of their facilities and improve the way they respond to their guests' complaints.

author: Jonathan F
title: Very disappointing stay – avoid this hotel
text:
The welcome was barely satisfactory.

The parking, advertised as included, is not even located at the hotel. Even worse, the reception staff advised us not to use it, explaining that they had recently experienced a problem with it.

In the bathroom, there was only one tiny packet of soap provided for two people (see photo).

The breakfast buffet was extremely limited, with very little choice (see photo). In addition, the dishes and cutlery were simply dirty (see photo).

Although it was around 34°C (93°F) outside, the air conditioning did not work. We reported the problem to the reception. When we returned later that day, the issue had still not been resolved. We were then offered another room, but the electricity was not working there. We were eventually moved to a third room, which was larger and had a fan. Unfortunately, the air conditioning still did not work there either, and the room was dirty.

During this whole situation, I also witnessed a particularly shocking scene: the reception staff reprimanded the technician in front of guests in a manner that I found humiliating and completely inappropriate.

The only positive aspect of our stay was that the Wi-Fi worked well.

We will not return and cannot recommend this hotel under any circumstances. In our opinion, it does not deserve its four-star rating in any way.

author: Francesca C
title: Terrible
text: Terrible, fortunately, I only stayed one night. Air conditioning not working in the middle of July (the issue was reported immediately without receiving assistance or intervention). Dilapidated bathroom and inefficient plumbing (the flow of hot water was just a trickle in both the shower and sink). Breakfast with very little choice, especially in savory items, as there were neither eggs nor cheese and nothing in terms of fruit. Highly discouraged

author: Kerry S
title: Basic, good value
text: This hotel fit our needs well. The room was small, but that is typical of hotels in the area, and this provides a good place to sleep. Maybe a 10-minute walk to the train station, with one subway stop even closer and many busses nearby. In this historic building, rooms are old but clean, and ours had windows opening onto a quiet back street. There is even a church on the third floor! This was our second stay at this property, and we would return again.

author: Magnus R
title: Older charm with great location for a weekend in the Eternal City
text:
A perfect location for a long weekend in the Eternal City. 5-10 minutes walk from Termini and many nice restaurants in the immediate area. 
The palace, that is, the hotel, which was the residence of an early pope, has its own chapel, beautiful halls and charm. But like most older houses a tad tempered with a certain need for care.
Very quiet in the room, a little hard beds, spacious bathroom, and nice view of the beautiful courtyard.
Breakfast was a bit limited, with ok anyway.

author: Fatiha C
title: Very negative experience
text:
I travel very often for work and usually stay in hotels. During my stay from May 19 to 22 at the Celicia Hotel in Rome, I had a very disappointing experience.

Upon my arrival, I presented my driver's license, unfortunately recently expired, having forgotten my ID card and passport at home. Despite explaining that my daughter could immediately send me a copy of my identification document, the manager, Mr. Antonello Greco, reacted aggressively and in very loud tones in front of other employees, leaving me deeply disappointed and uncomfortable.

The first room assigned to me, located on the ground floor, was very damp, with a strong smell of mold, and even the mattress was damp, causing me to spend a sleepless night. Fortunately, the next day Mr. Gaetano at the reception proved to be helpful and professional, managing to get me a room change.

The hotel is dated and needs more attention to cleanliness and maintenance. Regarding management, an improvement in communication and respect for customers would be truly desirable.

author: Stephanie C
title: Awful - do not book!
text:
DO NOT STAY HERE. This hotel is awful. 

We wanted to stay near the Appian Way, and booked one of the “best” rooms in the hotel.

We arrived in our room to find peeling wallpaper, cigarette butts on the balcony, holes that had been patched but not painted. The electricity did not work.

The walls behind the front desk are covered in stains, it’s in a sketchy part of town on a very busy street, and just outside the driveway there are big overflowing trash cans being sifted through by the homeless.

We left and went to a nicer hotel - we did not come to Rome to stay in this miserable dump. When we asked for a refund the front desk clerk said no, we should have given them time to fix the problems (clearly impossible) and that he didn’t care if we left a bad review.

The only good things I can say about this hotel are that it was reasonably close to the Appian Way and that the young woman who originally checked us in was pleasant.

This place sucks. Trust me and book somewhere else!

author: Luciano
title: For one night is fine!
text: Hotel neglected but "acceptable" value for money, also considered the area and the presence of parking (for a fee)

author: Nico F
title: 550€ and 200U$D stolen
text:
A stay that started more or less acceptable, turned into chaos.

We arrived on October 6 at night and were given a room that had the defective Safe.

I went to warn them of this problem and they told me that there was no other room or safe, that I could use the lobby if I wanted. I refused to use the lobby, as I didn’t find the idea too safe.

On our last day at the hotel, October 9, we entered the room and while I was assembling the luggage, I thought to count the money I was bringing (which I had kept in the suitcase, hidden among the clothes). To my little pleasant surprise I was missing 550€ and my friend 200U$D. 

The hotel director, Antonio Greco, wouldn’t give us any answers, treating us as liars and saying that if we wanted to walk to the police station. We insisted on calling the police to come, he refused to say the police were not going to come for such a small thing.

Eventually we called the police and the police came, took our complaint and told us that it was a good thing we did that since the police station was closed.

Anyway, they gave us no answer, and we were left with less money.

I attach photos of the police and the hotel.

A beautiful stay in Rome, ruined by the ineptitude and insecurity of this hotel.

author: Sarah H
title: Perfect for short stay great location
text: Warm friendly greeting on arrival gentleman was polite helpful. Room was clean and tidy unfortunately the shower well that was a experience for my husband as it was very small cubicle .shower curtain was tatty and there was mould around the cubicle that I’m sure with a good scrub would come off. ! There is meant to be a bar service but it’s not really maned waited a long time to get a drink which seem to annoy the female on reception. The hotel is perfect for short stay great location metro was easy to use lots of shops nearby too. Breakfast was pleasant and has a nice out side space too. Hotel is just a bit dated needs a bit of tlc but overall a lovely stay. It’s 3 star 🌟 good value and would recommend for short stay great location.

author: Sheryl P
title: Ok
text: Ok hotel. No real welcome. Couldn't find our booking no communication about that by the boss Daniel.  Finally found it. Did not explain that if we took wrong lift we would end up in hotel next door. Otherwise clean but dated. Breakfast fantastic & rest of staff good! Restaurant next door excellent - the boss - fabulous & food too!

author: Toby La Rone
title: Good location no frills
text:
Good location for exploring all the sites everywhere is walking distance except the Vatican.  
We had a basic room that was clean and a comfortable bed.
The roof garden is nice for breakfast especially the very top terrace.
Only downside was lots of wasps and pigeons in August.
Staff were good and efficient.
Would recommend

author: TheDales
title: Lovely hotel!
text: This hotel was stunning. Staff friendly and hotel was spotless. The views from the Roof Terrace were stunning! Only criticism I have is that there is 1 small lift on which is slow, especially in the mornings around breakfast and check out time

author: Tamara L
title: Nice hotel
text:
The room was a comfortable size for three people and very clean. My only real complaint was that the refrigerator never got cold, even after maintenance came to check it, and the air conditioning struggled to keep up with the outside heat. The hotel’s breakfast was adequate—nothing special—and after two days it did start to feel a bit repetitive.

The staff were consistently friendly and attentive, and the location was excellent. Being so close to Termini Station made getting around incredibly convenient. Pro tip: if you’re waiting on the main elevator while guests with luggage load in and out, there’s a smaller elevator around the back. It only fits two people and no luggage, but it’s almost always free.

Overall, despite a couple of minor issues, I would stay here again.

author: Sean M
title: Wife got food poisoning.
text: Hotel staff and room was lovely. Food was absolutely poor, set menu and we only liked 2 things from it and then after the beef fillet my wife has been throwing up and diarrhea since Tuesday night. We got home friday night and its now sunday and shes still poorly.

author: Amber M
title: Loved It!
text: Excellent! Would absolutely recommend and of course stay again 😃 We stayed as our only day & night in Rome and cannot say enough about how comfortable, accommodating, and thoughtful the hotel team looked after us. Laurene especially could not have been a better host to us. And the hotel is a lovely boutique-style with large rooms including a lovely little tea/cafe sitting table, a roomy bathroom, and a big comfy bed, Thank you Laurene! Amber&Will 🙌

author: Leilanie G
title: Great stay in Rome!  Cute terrace for breakfast!!!!
text: Our stay in Hotel Cellini was great!  Rooms were so clean and bathrooms seemed very updated.  Mel at the front desk was so nice and welcoming.  We liked how the hotel was located very close to so many major landmarks in Rome.  The neighborhood felt very safe walking around even in the evening hours. The terrace for breakfast was so cute!  We enjoyed the breakfast spread each morning with a cappucino.  Thank you for a wonderful stay, from your Filipino friends from the US!

author: midnighter94
title: Walking Distance to most things
text:
We had a lovely stay!  We booked a double room.  Prior to our arrival, I emailed and had airport transportation arranged by Mel.
