It was a relief to have someone waiting at the airport for us and taking us right to the hotel.  Our room was nice, with large windows.  The shower was really small - barely enough space to turn around.  The bed was ok, but a bit firm.  We had a small fridge and a coffee maker.  Breakfast in the morning had a variety of croissants, eggs, yogurt, cereals, meats, cheeses, fruit & more. 
The staff were all nice.  There is an elevator, but it's small.   It's in a quiet neighborhood, close to the bus and metro stops.  We were able to walk to the Colosseum (about 20 minutes), the Vatican (about 20 minutes), Trevi Fountain (20 minutes).  There are several good restaurants in the area that we ate at.  The Termini train station was about a 10 minute walk.

author: Sue N
title: Great Hotel, wonderful staff!
text: We were very happy with our stay at Hotel Cellini. The hotel is in a short walking distance to most of the main tourist attractions. The rooms were very spacious, super clean and comfortable. The staff at the reception were friendly, polite and were always willing to help with anything we needed assistance with. We enjoyed our time there and next time we go to Rome we will stay at Cellini again

author: Kimberly P
title: A lovely place with lovely people
text:
We stayed here for at the end of March for our visit to Rome.  The staff were positive, professional, friendly, and very kind.  They were so good to us and communicated well. They were kind enough to watch our bags after check out so we could see one last thing before grabbing our train to the next city.

The place was clean, safe, had a lift (for those with heavy bags), and the rooms were a decent size.  It was well lit and a lovely atmosphere.  We had the family room (a double and a twin) which did not feel crowded. We did not hear other guests and the place always felt very safe. I liked the little details in the room, which made it feel elegant and Victorian.  Tables in the corridor allow you to enjoy a cup of tea while planning your next excursion, adding a touch of charm.  Orchids in the room were a lovely touch.

They have breakfast at the hotel if you wish to done there.  The place was located within walking distance to the subway/metro and it was walkable to many go-to sites.

The cost was a good value for the location.  I would definitely recommend staying here to anyone and would come back in the future.

author: Apo Geo
title: THE BEST !
text:
A big thank to the staff. They make you feel like you have known them for years. The lady who welcomed us on Monday 10th of August I don't remember her name . And then Mario and Francesco. Also the housekeeping did an amazing job . Thank you . 
The location is our favorite. Via Nazionale feels like it's the center of Rome . Buss stations and metro station so close. Coffee shops, pubs and tigre supermarket is 2 minutes way . 
The view from our room was AMAZING.  Can't wait to go back for our 3rd time.

author: Peixoto I
title: Excellent hotel!!!
text: Excellent!!! The staff Francesco was very helpful, we loved your tips. An excellent professional. I highly recommend this hotel!

author: schtroumfette89
title: Ideally located in the city center close to the train station.
text: Very good one-night stay at this hotel perfectly located in the city center and 10-15 minutes on foot from the train station. Room for 3 or 4 is quite large, but the extra single beds are not comfortable at all. Beautiful modern bathroom. Well-equipped and air-conditioned room. Very good breakfast with a variety of options. Very good welcome (in French) with recommendations about Rome, thank you!

author: Bernhard Wannemacher
title: A good hotel in a central location.
text:
A nice hotel, very centrally located near Termini, the metro, and the bus. Many attractions are easily reachable on foot. Rooms are adequately sized and clean, as is the bathroom. The staff is very friendly. The only downside: the breakfast could be significantly improved. Aside from the fact that there is almost nothing for vegans (which we are used to), unfortunately, there is not even vegan milk for cereal here. Only toast bread and small, soft rolls are available. 
It was bearable for 6 days, but not great.
Aside from that, there is nothing to complain about.

author: FabrizioCantoni
title: Great location
text:
Small but very comfortable hotel, clean and conditioned rooms. Very good reception, they waited for us with the rooms early which made it easy for us to arrive. 
It has a very good location, ideal for walking to most important sites.

author: Explore09742193213
title: Excellent experience
text: Excellent hotel in Roma termini. I was impressed by the politeness of the staff particularly Erika. She was effective, polite always hvaing a smile on. I had an enjoyable stay.

author: Gillian O
title: Disappointing ecperience
text:
Nice hotel, staff professional and somewhat friendly. Clean and modestly decorated.
Did not have breakfast at the hotel so cannot comment on it but there are lovely cafes nearby that are good value for money. Good transport links and based in the centre of the historical attractions.

CAVEAT ... Be careful of your possessions. Left a beautiful dress in the wardrobe when i checked out and within 24 hours of contacting them, they claimed it wasn"t there and the housekeeping team had no knowledge of it which is quite dishonest of them as i actually saw it but git distracted and didn't take it. Makes me wonder what else. Not impressed at all and on that basis alone will not be returning to the hotel or recommend it to anyone else.

author: Ani G
title: Very Disappointing Stay
text:
0 out of 5

The only positive thing about this hotel was the staff—they were polite and friendly. Unfortunately, everything else was extremely disappointing.

This hotel is advertised as a 4-star property, but it felt more like a no star hostel. It certainly does not deserve its 4-star rating. The rooms were outdated, poorly maintained, and nothing like the photos. The overall condition of the hotel did not justify the price.

The biggest issue was the neighborhood. It felt unsafe, especially in the evenings. Even several locals warned us to be extra careful because of the high number of pickpockets in the area and advised us to avoid certain nearby streets. That made us feel uncomfortable throughout our stay.

I would not stay here again or recommend it to anyone. The staff deserve credit for being kind and helpful, but they cannot make up for the poor quality of the hotel and the disappointing location.

author: Anet52
title: Great location and friendly staff
text:
The hotel is less than 5 minutes from Rome Termini station. My room was very clean, comfortable and quiet.
Good coffee at breakfast (you can request cappuccino or expresso )
Great food choice for me as a vegetarian..
All staff were friendly and very helpful.

author: Natssha B
title: Crack avenue
text: I want to be as honest as I can be writing this review. I am writing this whilst waiting to board my plane. This hotel is not a 4 star more like 2/3 The hotel its self is okay if you are using it only for somewhere to sleep (like a base). We picked this hotel based off location and being in walking distance to the major sites like the Trevi Fountain ect. This location is vile. You have drug addicts sat outside of the hotel. During the day and night. First day we arrived we witnessed 2 people smoking crack right outside. We also witnessed a women smash a glass bottle and hold it up to someone else’s throat. We The whole area is full of drug users. I am glad that we done a coupes trip and didn’t bring our children along this isn’t a location for children! This area doesn’t feel safe at all. The hotel room could be better horrible bathrooms and room could be cleaner. Some staff friendly. Other not so much. Breakfast wasn’t great. Overall I wouldn’t recommend staying this side of Rome definitely not near the train station anyway.

author: Basmati B
title: Best hotel experience.
text:
Breakfast is always a great experience. Rose and Norma was fantastic today and everyday. 
They really are an example for the hospitality industry. 
Not forgetting the reception staff, Christine and  Stanley are so welcoming and friendly. They do their best to help with amy issues . 
This hotel staff should be the industry standard. 
Everyone tries their best to be helpful and solve problems.  The maintenance and housekeeping staff are always at 5 star level.

author: Pioneer47800978891
title: Poor Front Desk Experience!
text: The 2 stars are mainly because of the staff. The hotel itself is clean and very well located. Unfortunately, the daytime staff was unfriendly and disrespectful. We were given incorrect information, and when we tried to clarify, they made it seem like we were the ones who had made the mistake. Customer service definitely needs improvement, better training and more careful hiring at the front desk would make a big difference.

author: Gater27
title: Christopher saved the day!
text: This past Saturday, July 18th, my husband and I were traveling from O’Hare (through Newark) to see Bon Jovi perform on Sunday night (7/19). We had an 8:40am flight. At 2:15pm, our flight was cancelled due to weather in metro NYC causing ground stops. After rescheduling, we were rerouted to Boston with a connecting flight to Newark, getting us into Manhattan after midnight. I called the hotel to explain the travel nightmare and I gave my authorization to check us in over the phone. Within less than five minutes, our flight from Boston to Newark was cancelled (still bad weather). I immediately called the hotel and explained my plight to Christopher, as I didn’t want to be charged for the room for Saturday, but still needed Sunday's reservation.  He put me on a brief hold and told me that he’d be able to cancel my reservation. He told me to book a separate reservation for just Sunday. I did that with him on the phone. He confirmed he was able to see it in the system, and then he cancelled my original reservation. After 32 hours of travel, we finally made it to the hotel. We were able to check in and relax before heading out. Our travel was a nightmare, but Christopher was able to remove my anxiety by ensuring we would not be charged for our initial reservation. Thank you, Christopher!!!

author: Tamsy K
title: Don’t stay here
text:
I would not stay here again.

First, the rooms are extremely small for the price. We paid around $300 per night, and it definitely felt like the rates were inflated because of the Jay-Z concert. For what we paid, the room did not meet expectations.

Our biggest issue was the air conditioning unit. On the first night, we noticed a small leak and assumed it was just condensation. By the next morning, we had to place towels and a pot under it because so much water was dripping. Later that day, after we returned to the hotel, the entire floor was soaked. My luggage had been sitting underneath the AC unit (where there wasn't a leak when we left), and the unit had apparently been dripping directly onto it for hours. The inside of my suitcase was completely soaked, and the handle became so weakened from the water damage that it eventually broke off.

When we called the front desk, maintenance came up and opened the AC vent, and water literally poured out like a waterfall. It was obvious this wasn't a minor leak. We requested to be moved to another room, which they did, but when I mentioned my damaged luggage, I was immediately told there was nothing they could do about it.

To make matters worse, when we went downstairs to get keys for the new room, the front desk employee had an attitude and insisted we return our original room keys immediately. We explained that we still had to pack up all of our belongings and move everything into the new room before we could turn them in.

The following morning, I spoke with the manager about my damaged luggage, only to find out they had no idea the room had flooded, that maintenance had been called, or that we had even been moved to another room. The night staff had never communicated any of the incident to management. After the manager contacted their supervisor, I was told they could not reimburse me for my damaged luggage. The only compensation they offered was a refund for one night's stay. While I appreciate that gesture, I'm still left having to replace an expensive suitcase that was damaged because of the hotel's leaking AC unit.

To make matters even more frustrating, after the handle on my suitcase broke, I asked if they had duct tape so I could at least secure it enough to get home. Instead, they handed me a roll of Scotch tape, which was completely useless for a broken luggage handle. At that point, it just felt like one disappointment after another.

I also filed a claim with Marriott, but I was again told there was nothing they could do regarding my luggage.

Overall, the rooms are overpriced, the maintenance issues are concerning, and the communication between staff is clearly lacking. Some of the daytime staff were pleasant, but the nighttime staff were not very friendly or helpful during a stressful situation.

If you're considering staying here, I would be very cautious. Based on my experience, it doesn't seem like the AC units are being properly maintained, and if your belongings are damaged because of a hotel issue, don't expect much accountability.

author: Stefanie P
title: Xavier & crew here amazing.
text: View from our room is amazing !! Floor 46! Xavier L was professional & quick w check in etc ! :) couldn’t be happier w our experience!! Thx Xavier! :)

author: Richard Sterling
title: Excellent stay except the air conditioning
text:
Pros : Walking distance to Gare du Nord, Staff Friendly, Majority of customer facing staff spoke good English, Hot and Cold variety of things for breakfast, good room service (food) during evenings. Close to pharmacies and GPs (walking or short taxi ride). Lots of Uber Eats selections available.
Cons : Air conditioning simply is not good enough. Max fan speed is only a quarter of power you would expect in a UK hotel (e.g. premier inn). Also set to 18 degrees it auto changes it hours later to 22 degrees. When challenged they offered a plug in fan which we accepted and it helped along with keeping curtains closed entire visit.

author: Manuela M
title: my favourite hotel in Paris
text: Cosy rooms, very clean, great location, nice people and profesional staff, very good service, good value for money, a place where you are welcome every time!

author: Bryher H
title: Highly recommended!
text:
For our girls trip we stayed at Hotel Mademoiselle and had a great time here. The building, the interior and the rooms are all very nice and cozy. We stayed at the room with a balcony which really gave us the perfect Parisian vibe. Very close by, and in walking distance from Gare du Nord and very close to other metro stations. 
A/C was working and made our stay comfortable, also rooms are clean, quiet and the breakfast is really superb!
Overall a great experience, value for money and service! We would definitely come back!

author: Sharon G
title: Lovely little boutique hotel
text: Lovely little boutique hotel ideally situated for transport links across the city. Staff very friendly, clean and beautifully decorated. Definitely recommend

author: Renaud R
title: One. Great Lady
text:
Very nice hotel, not very far from the Gare du Nord but away from the hustle and bustle and very close to the covered market.
Room 605 on the top floor, under the roofs of Paris, quiet, clean, spacious, in short, a good time. Very good breakfast and thanks to the receptionist who has a lovely Romanian accent.

author: baydatema19
title: Very good
text:
I loved the hotel and the staff are very professional. I hope to be back soon. 
Continue with your excellent service

author: edenhlg11
title: Excellent
text: Was a really nice stay! Reception very friendly and helpful at all times. Room was nice and clean and in a good location in terms on metro and buses.

author: dewitjoke
title: Price quality fine choice
text: Price quality fine hotel with ideal location in a lively safe-feeling neighborhood 1.5km on foot from Montmartre. Fully equipped rooms.

author: ngenar666408
title: citytrip
text: excellent position in Paris/ accessible by bus from and to North station/ hôtel a little old fashioned but great welcoming and breakfast

author: TobiausGer
title: A hotel in a good location for tourist activities
text: The hotel offers friendly staff, air-conditioned and clean rooms with good beds, and a normal breakfast buffet. Only the subway and the street are somewhat noticeable.

author: Jorge E
title: Sufficient for a good stay
text: Well positioned in relation to the city, near the metro, enough breakfast, helpful reception staff, rooms with no great amenities but good to rest. The main problem is that we felt in the rooms the subway passing underneath. The breakfast service by some employees is not expeditious, they let the food run out and were late to resume.

author: Lindynine
title: Love Paris, enjoyable stay.
text: This is the second time we stayed at Hotel Opera Lafayette through JET2 City Breaks.  We stayed in a room on the fourth floor we had emailed in advance asking for a room on a higher floor as we knew the road noise could wake us. We slept very well in room 47 at the end of the corridor no road noise and hardly felt the metro this high up. Lovely french windows to open   for fresh air and take in the view.  The room was cleaned, beds made and new towels every day.  One day we had put on a do not disturb sign on the door for a sleep in and left the used towels outside. Later housekeeping came back and knocked, in my basic french I managed to ask for new towels and a bath mat, the ladies were very friendly and helpful.  Shower powerful and just needed a few minutes to warm up.  Used the hairdryer provided in the bathroom and I had to remove the end cap or it would cut out but worked fine after that.  Shower body wash, hand wash, shower caps, cotton buds provided in the bathroom. Safe to use in the room. Kettle,paper cups, bottle of water and a few coffee sachets included. We didn't have breakfast at the hotel as there are many boulangeries nearby.  Cadet Metro a few minutes walk away.

author: Alina
title: Good location
text:
The hotel is well located, right next to Cadet metro station.Many restaurants and supermarkets nearby.
The carpet in the room is very dirty and should be changed. The subway passes under the hotel, I knew it, but apart from the noise of the subway, the walls are very thin; you can even hear someone blowing his nose in another room. One day, someone entered my room around 3:30 p.m. while I was trying to rest after a long walk (no one apologized). The bathroom door is sliding and does not close properly.If you use the shower, the entire bathroom is flooded because the pipe is defective.Breakfast without fruits or vegetables.

author: steve w
title: A great find!
text: I had never been to Paris before and I stayed 3 nights at this hotel including breakfast. The hotel is very clean and comfortable. The day and night concierges were excellent, very friendly and helpful! Easy to travel to from Orly airport, via metro . This hotel is in an excellent central location for visiting the main attractions in Paris, either by metro,bus or walking. I walked all over Paris, le Louvre, le Marais, Eiffel Tower, Montmartre etc. The breakfast at this hotel had an excellent, good selection of options. My single room (double bed ) was very comfortable with a lovely bathroom.  Close to Metro, Restaurants, bars etc, this hotel is a great choice. I can't recommend enough! Thankyou

author: Marica F
title: WEEKEND IN PARIS
text: We received this hotel as an alternative to another for a mishap and I must say it was a nice surprise as it is practically on the road leading to the Lafayette Gallery. Serviceable rooms with the necessary, good lighting, excellent soundproofing as the street noises are heard very little (unfortunately I can not deny that you hear a slight roar of the metro passing under, but it has not affected the living room at all). Breakfast easy from sweet to savory, good cleaning of the tables. Cleaning of the rooms every day and very neat. Perhaps I would recommend a mirror before the exit of the room as it is only present in the bathroom and small. Friendly, kind and especially understanding staff as I did not speak French.

author: Sabina R
title: Not recommended
text:
I stayed at this hotel and the experience was not pleasant. The property is quite far from the center of Paris. To reach it you have to use the subway, but the walk to get to the station is not safe at all.
The hotel is located in a highly degraded and dangerous area, adjacent to a car park full of homeless people and surrounded by real mountains of trash. The feeling of insecurity is constant.
To make matters worse, there is the staff: politeness and courtesy are not found here. The staff proved to be cold and unwelcoming.
The only positive note of the entire stay was the Uber app. Thanks to this service we were able to get around everywhere, at any time and at absolutely affordable prices, avoiding walking in the area around the hotel. I strongly advise against this property.

author: Patrizia R
title: Never again
text:
Hotel to avoid, it is located in a dirty and disreputable area. You
are even afraid to take the subway
Far from the center and often an Uber or Bolt driver will refuse the call
Poor breakfast, acceptable cleanliness

author: Sara R
title: Friendly staff and large rooms
text: The staff is very friendly and the rooms are very clean and of a good size for what is standard in the city. The only not-so-favorable point is that it is located in a somewhat dirty neighborhood, although it does not feel dangerous

author: Sohail M
title: Pathetic, Dirty Location
text:
We have stayed at Novotel Suites Paris Montreuil Vincennes for 3 nights on 15June-18June 2026 with my family of total 3 person in a family room The room was average with a double bed and a sofa bed. The washroom is small with a closet type shower where within a minute waters flows up in the floor, very slow water drainage system, a tiniest separate toilet at the entry door. 
Atmosphere just pathetic, the area just in front of the hotel's main & only door is the most dirtiest place in Paris, numerous poly bags are floating in wind everywhere, dirtiest footpaths, the whole roads actually like a disaster, This is the Paris !!!!, no it should not be...please take care of your belongings and locked.
Cleanness inside average, Value for money Overpriced property like this.
Service at the Reception, Super, which is the only good thing of this hotel I must admit that, everyone is very helpful, easy to communicate. Thank you for that

author: CHRISTÈLE G
title: PARISIAN getaway
text: The bed is very comfortable, top-notch service, a big thank you to Sofiane and the rest of the team

author: Tony P
title: Pink paradise.
text: Fantastic staff and lovely hotel. Close to Metro locations. Would recommend.

author: rivardjf2014
title: Pleasant stay
text: Very good service from the front desk staff, they recommended good places to us and answered our requests well. The neighborhood is lively and was a great discovery. The hotel also offers the tranquility we were looking for.

author: Nathan F
title: A fantastic hotel for a 5 day stay in Paris.
text: We had an amazing time at Hotel Le Mille Rose during August 2026 - the room was perfect, ideal size, cleaners did an amazing job, air conditioned (which helped during 39 degree heat), good location for the metro and food outlets - and finally the staff...couldn't do enough to help us and make our trip special. A special call out to Miriam who was so helpful, and David, who helped us on our last day. A business is often as good as its staff, and these two excelled. Thank you both.

author: Peyman N
title: Nice and cozy hotel in the heart of Paris
text: We visited Paris from August 9-12 and stayed in this hotel which is located in the heart of Paris close to metros and tourist sights. The room was small but very cozy and nice. The AC was not cold but we asked the reception and they quickly sent a technician to fix it. I recommend reserving a room with breakfast because it was very delicious. Thank you very much David and Merriam for your quick responses.

author: Gabriela K
title: Great
text: Perfect!!! Very nice staff and very clean hotel. Lovely breakfast aswell!

author: dedoyemalingerak2026
title: Rating
text: The staff was nice. They are there to address customer concerns. The welcome was very good.

author: mnikit222904
title: Great cosy hotel
text: Very clean, cosy hotel with friendly staff and located in safe, quiet area. Only 7 minutes until Metro/RER, also very convenient transfer from and to airport CDG. Rooms are larger then average in Paris, also very clean and with comfortable beds.

author: ys791
title: Jacob S
text:
Wonderful Hotel , Clean peaceful , nicely renovated with very friendly Staff.
15 mins walking distance from Arc De Triomphe and Eifel Tower.
Recommend to all.

author: Jenny Wren
title: Very satisfied - will return
text:
Well located close to 2 metro stations
Friendly staff
Great breakfast
Comfy bed
Well equipped bedroom

author: Kypu_0107
title: Very nice hotel with easy logistics
text:
Very friendly and supportive staff, renovated rooms very good.
Not far from the metro station and the park.

author: Laura D
title: It was great! In short, everything went smoothly and we had an amazing time.
text: Great location, right next to Times Square and the subway. Pleasant atmosphere. The room was quite small for four people, but I understand that rooms in NYC are generally like this anyway. It was very clean, with daily towel changes

author: Minzaghi L
title: Absolutely recommended
text:
Fantastic experience, very helpful staff, room taken care of in the smallest details with a truly comfortable bed and pillow. Location that finds us near Times Square and therefore convenient both for reaching points of interest on foot and in the center. Good breakfast, even if not with a huge selection. Fantastic room cleaning, never seen such detailed cleaning down to the smallest details. 
Absolutely recommended as a hotel

author: Natalia A
title: Loved it!
text: I had a great stay at this hotel! The room was very clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The staff was friendly and always willing to help with anything we needed. The location was also very convenient, with restaurants and attractions nearby. Breakfast was fresh and had a good variety of options. Overall, I had a really pleasant experience and would definitely stay here again!

author: Elena J
title: Excellent service
text: The hotel staff was very friendly and attentive at all times. The rooms really stand out: they are much more spacious and cleaner than in most of the hotels I have stayed in. The only detail to improve is the breakfast schedule; it is a shame that it is only available until 10:00, since it forces you to get up a little early if you want to take advantage of it. In general, a very pleasant stay.

author: Igor Alves
title: Family trip
text: Staff is amazing. Very friendly and helpful. The overall conditions are great for the hotel type and class.

author: Sara C
title: Recommended!
text:
Excellent hotel, clean, very kind and helpful staff, good breakfast.
In a strategic position to visit Paris, well served by public transport.
Many places to dine in the surrounding area.

author: JonesieLinthicum
title: Comfortable, Reasonable, and Well-managed
text:
We stayed here ten years ago when we needed to be near  the Montparnasse train station. I have been recommending it ever since as a good-value, well-managed hotel. If anything, it's even better than before. 

We were able to check in right away when we arrived midday, which was a delightful surprise. The process was quick and easy. 

Our room was comfortable and well-equipped, with some really thoughtful touches. The light switches made complete sense, with one to light up the entryway as soon as you enter the room. That is not always the case!

We actually had two stays here, a few weeks apart. For the longer, second stay, we upgraded to a top-floor junior suite. The huge room had a sitting area and a large marble bathroom with double sinks, a tub/shower combo, and a separate WC. It was the largest room I have ever had in Paris, and I have been coming here for over fifty years.

We used the honor bar one night, and had a great conversation with some wonderful folks who, like us, love travel, live music, and combining the two.  The breakfast room/ lounge is very comfortable and a great place to meet up with family or friends. 

The location is convenient, even if you are not arriving or leaving from the Montparnasse train station. There are several historical markers on rue Delambre alone, and dozens more in the surrounding area. There are metro stops at either end of the street. You are surrounded by great cafes and restaurants. 

The staff here is very kind and helpful. When you stay here, you know that you are in good hands. I could not recommend it more highly!

author: Amanda Floyd
title: Amazing hotel, would stay again 🥰
text: What an absolutely beautiful hotel, the hospitality is amazing, the staff are lovely and so friendly.  Breakfast is delicious there is lots of different options, fantastic area for restaurants as

author: amelie v
title: Absolutely UNREAL
text:
How has this hotel ONLY got 3 stars?!

Me and my boyfriend stayed here for 3 nights and it was AMAZING!

It was super close to 3 metros and a train station and there was nowhere in Paris we could not get to from these stations.

The staff are absolutely lovely and cannot do enough for you. They go above and beyond and even upgraded us to a junior suite which was so spacious and just absolutely unreal!!

It is super clean and a lovely classy atmosphere. Amenities are spot on, had robes, slippers, 24/7 bar and room service.

Excellent value for money, could not recommend anymore and will definitely return!!

author: Yann g
title: Clean and well placed, nice welcome
text: Nice little hotel close to Montparnasse, rate in the neighborhood average.It has been redone recently,everything is clean and in condition.Little flat, during our visit the elevator was broken down...Room reserved on the 6th floor! No gesture of compensation that would have been commercially the least of things...

author: Mary L
title: Charming hotel in a less touristy area
text: This was a cozy and charming hotel close to boulangeries, shops, metros and pharmacies, and we loved that it was not very touristy.  We ate at restaurants where we heard mostly the chatter of locals.  We loved that you can open the balcony doors for fresh air and despite being hot during the day, the night breezes were lovely.  The metro is close by  for when we were too tired to walk.

author: Marya M
title: Extremely disappointing experience — especially because of the management’s unacceptable and aggressive behavior.
text:
I stayed for four nights, and on the fourth night I was moved to an attic room that was completely unacceptable. When I complained about the room and asked to cancel, the manager refused to cooperate and instead became aggressive, shouted at me, and insulted me. Even when I decided to leave, he followed me and continued arguing.

The room itself had serious issues: the bathroom was built inside the room, with an extremely narrow entrance that required you to turn sideways to get in. There were also two doors inside the room, in addition to the main entrance, with no clear explanation of where they led. I felt genuinely unsafe and spent the night worried about my security. The bed sheets were also visibly dirty.

For a hotel charging over €200 per night, this level of
 room quality, cleanliness, security, and especially customer service is completely unacceptable.

I strongly recommend reconsidering this hotel before booking.

author: dbwillows
title: Father Daughter Trip Base in Paris
text:
Here’s a more complete TripAdvisor review that incorporates your experience:

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Hotel Minerve. This was a father-and-15-year-old daughter trip, and the hotel was able to provide comfortable twin beds, which worked perfectly for us.

The location is outstanding in the Latin Quarter—an easy walk to Notre-Dame, the Panthéon, Luxembourg Gardens, and countless cafés, bakeries, and restaurants. Metro and bus connections are excellent, and getting to and from CDG Airport by RER and Metro was straightforward.

Our room was air-conditioned, clean, and surprisingly quiet despite being in the heart of Paris. The double-glazed windows blocked out the street noise when closed, but it was also nice to be able to open them for fresh air. The elevator was appreciated after long days of sightseeing, and every staff member we encountered was friendly and helpful.

For anyone looking for a comfortable, well-located hotel with excellent transport links and plenty of dining options nearby, Hotel Minerve is an excellent choice. We would happily stay here again.

author: NDaya2026
title: Gateway to Paris
text: We were thrilled with the location of the hotel - easy access to transportation and walking distance to many interesting places! The room was spotless, cool, and quiet. It was small, which one expects in Europe, and we had packed accordingly. Great view from 6th floor balcony. Very satisfying breakfast. The staff are all very helpful and kind.

author: Carol S
title: Lovely Paris Hotel
text: Minerve Hotel has helpful, friendly staff, rooms are charming and clean, and the location is convenient for sightseeing.

author: CathyM Wales
title: No traffic noise
text: Great location which felt safe and relatively quiet for London. Room was very quiet with no traffic / emergency vehicle noise - first for London. Approximately 8 minute pleasant walk to Paddington station and tube. Rooms were a good size. Only downside were public toilets which were dirty on day of arrival and had no toilet paper on day of leaving.

author: Victor M
title: Great location, friendly staff
text: The staff were friendly,professional and extremely helpful throughout my stay. The hospitality was excellent and I will definitely come back

author: Karen R
title: An amazingly friendly hotel in a great area
text:
We loved our stay at this Premier Inn.
The staff were so friendly and helpful and there always seemed to be someone around. The hotel itself was clean and tidy, it looked quite new actually.
We found it was in a great location, literally round the corner from the canal basin and floating pocket park. We wouldn't hesitate staying here again!

author: Trudy-Jo D
title: Comfortable Stay
text:
The hotel is located very close to Paddington Station and it made travelling from the airport a breeze. It is central for exploring with amenities like groceries, drugstores and restaurants right next to it. The staff at the reception area were always friendly and helpful. The rooms were a good size for our family of 3. The rooms were clean, the beds were very comfortable and it was very quiet. The Aircon in the room worked perfectly and the bathroom was big enough to get dressed in after a shower.
All in all the hotel is basic but offers the essentials for a comfortable stay at a reasonable price.

author: Tour15525156457
title: Perfect 👍
text: We had a wonderful weekend at this hotel. It's very well located in the heart of London. The rooms are cozy and spacious. The staff is very friendly and attentive.

author: Daniel A
title: Unsanitary room
text:
I rarely leave negative reviews, but after my experience at The Washington NYC, I feel obligated to warn future guests.
My son and I had just completed a cross-country drive from San Antonio, Texas. After checking into the hotel around 7:00 PM, we immediately left to visit the One World Observatory and the 9/11 Memorial. As a 100% disabled U.S. Navy veteran and medically retired LAPD police officer, paying tribute at the memorial was one of the main reasons for our trip.
When we returned to our room around 9:30 PM and had a chance to actually look around, we were shocked. The room was filthy. There were boogers and what appeared to be other bodily fluids on the walls and doors, dried food residue on multiple surfaces, what appeared to be feces on the wall next to the toilet, black mold in the shower, stained curtains, and a refrigerator that smelled like a dead animal. It honestly looked like the room hadn't been properly cleaned in a very long time.
I immediately contacted the front desk. After waiting approximately 20–30 minutes, we were moved to another room, and I was assured it had been cleaned.
Unfortunately, the second room was nearly identical. Once again, there were boogers on the walls and doors, food residue on the walls, dirty and stained curtains and bedding, unpleasant odors, and an overall feeling that the room had not been sanitized. By this point it was nearly 11:00 PM. My son was exhausted after our long day and had already fallen asleep. After traveling across the country, moving to a third room late at night was simply not a realistic option, especially after seeing the condition of the first two rooms.
I also contacted Priceline, but our call was disconnected before the issue could be resolved. We checked out early the next morning because we could not wait to leave.
Since then, I have repeatedly tried to speak with the hotel manager—on the night of my stay, the following morning, throughout the day, and again afterward—but no one has returned my calls. At this point, I'm not even convinced there is a manager available to address guest concerns.
I've stayed in countless hotels throughout my military service, law enforcement career, and personal travels, and I can honestly say this was one of the most unsanitary hotel experiences I've ever had. The condition of not just one, but two rooms raises serious concerns about the hotel's cleaning standards.
I have photographs documenting the conditions I encountered.
The location is excellent if you're visiting the World Trade Center and Lower Manhattan, but that does not make up for the deplorable state of the rooms or the complete lack of management response.
I cannot recommend this hotel to anyone until significant improvements are made to its cleanliness and customer service.

author: Shan mattis
title: Spend the extra money for somewhere nicer
text:
I’ve previously stayed here due to location being perfect for access to everything including 9/11 memorial, close to Brooklyn bridge, Wall Street, trains straight to mid-town etc. The first time was manageable (2024) minus a few issues. However staying there this year seemed that they lowered their standards to the floor. 

Not only did we request to change our room four times…before we had even been there an hour due to stains in the sheets, holes in the bed, tears in the sheets, missing fridges, filthy bathrooms or smells but the the comfort of the room is terrible. For the amount of money you spend to stay here you might as well of slept on the bench across the road. 

The staff were as helpful as they possibly could have been but you can tell they all just don’t care. 

Out of six lifts present in the hotel. Two worked. 

One in the main entrance and one other to get you from the lobby to the rest of the 50 odd floors. You will be waiting a significant amount of time just to get in or out of the hotel. 

It has a gym which can be accessed, pretty standard. They do not have a breakfast/eating facilities on site. Eating out is necessary but this is expected with this type of trip. 

Overall, the first time I would have given it 5/10 just for the fact it was my first time in NYC. But I most certainly will NEVER be staying here again. -1000/10

author: Angela L
title: No luxury here. Just handy and pretty rough and worn out.
text:
A bit dated and in need of better lighting and a very good deep clean. Bathroom was dimly lit. Hairdryer was all noise and no action. No iron. No coffee making or even a kettle. ( After long flight this would have been nice)
Dated furniture in the guest lounge, all seen better days. Lighting terrible. Less than interactive staff. Door man was the friendliest. On pulling up, it looked closed. Carpets and lift all need revamp. If you want luxury, move on, you won't find it here. Lifts are slow DnD often out of service. Housekeepers were lovely and made up our room. We had plenty of towels, but given time, they don't have chance to deep clean bathrooms and floor was slippery when wet!!! Yuk.
Very close to the 9/11 memorial and for food Flavor Deli is open 24/7. Great food, fab staff, good prices. No services at this hotel. Also close to O Haras Irish bar for good and a drink. Well placed, but past it's best.

author: Giarca
title: Shut them down.
text: Absolutely the worst Hotel I’ve ever had the displeasure of staying at. The staff is about as friendly as a pile of rhinoceros feces, and they are as honest as the Trump administration. After barely honoring my reservation, they stuck me in the worst room hotel that had no air-conditioning. I tried for over 24 hours to resolve the situation until they finally moved me into another room. The servers been admitted, but the air-conditioning didn’t work and that the thermostat was broken in the day were not able to get a part to repair it. I tried to have that first night refunded to me and they refused. I’m in the process now of suing them.

author: Jonathan B
title: Don’t understand the hate!  This place is fantastic value for money
text: I don’t understand all the hate and complaints in the reviews.  I had a great stay here in April.  Large room with a king sized bed, great views and clean bathroom and closet.  Friendly and accommodating staff, efficient room cleaning, and super location.  It’s a tad inefficient getting to the rooms with two elevators but frankly I’ve stayed in Ritz Carlton hotels with the same thing.  This is an excellent value for money.  You will be hard pressed to find a hotel room in New York as nice as this at this price point.

author: Inna C
title: Great Stay
text: Great location if you want to stay close o Termini Station. Hotel is being renovated and we stayed in a very comfortable and large. The breakfast is great! They have a large variety and the food is fresh. The staff is very friendly and helpful, especially Diogo at the front desk.

author: christèle T
title: Very good choice for Rome
text:
Location near the station
Triple room, actually 2 separate rooms, ideal for parents + 1 child or teenager. 1 bathroom + 1 shower room.
The rooms have been recently renovated, soft and harmonious decor. Our room overlooked the courtyard, no noise disturbance. I highly recommend this hotel, which does not deserve the average rating on Google and TripAdvisor.

author: Evelyn H
title: Highly Recommended hotel.
text:
Would recommend this hotel.  Very close to Termini Train Station for connection to Airport & within walking distance of a lot of attractions.
We had a Junior Suite & it was very  nice & clean.  Breakfast was a bit repetitive but was handy to have before setting off for the day.  Refreshing glass of Prescesso !
Overall,  we really enjoyed our experience at San Remo.

author: Daniel R
title: Good home base!
text:
Excellent welcome. A very friendly team.
The breakfast is rich and diverse. The service is impeccable.

The room is pleasant for a couple or a family. 

The hotel is well located: the proximity to Termini station is a plus for Roman getaways but also for the connection to the airport.

author: Sara Z
title: Great experience
text: Great experience! Very convenient for those arriving by train at Termini station, clean and well-kept environment. Some rooms are being renovated, others already renovated like the one I had. New bathroom, TV, safe... everything you need for a stay in beautiful Rome! Perhaps breakfast could be improved a bit as it offers many savory options, a little fewer sweet ones! But it remains a recommended hotel nonetheless!

author: Jake S
title: The best view of the trevi fountain
text: Perfect location and incredible views

author: AKA
title: Right at the Trevi
text: Trevi fountain right outside the front door. Staff was pleasant, room was clean. Lots of activity in the area, a little difficult for automobile pickups and drop offs but not impossible.

author: Extraordinary732574
title: Avoid
text: The hotel is in a great location opposite the Trevi fountain but that is all it has going for it. The hotel is dark and dingy and smells of mould. Furniture is old and broken, paint is peeling from the walls. The bathroom was damp and in desperate need of an upgrade with mouldy sealant when present. Room was cleaned daily with a fresh threadbare towels left to use. Breakfast staff were lovely but the man at reception was rude and aggressive. Tourist tax had to be paid in cash only! Be aware that due to the location the hotel is very noisy throughout the day and night.

author: LoveTravel746809
title: Best spot with the worst service.
text: This is the best spot in Rome with the worst service possible. They behaved like they were  tired of tourists. We pay $25 per person to visit the rooftop and had the worst experience ever.  They included 1 drink and a snack with the price, however they didn't have most of the drinks in the menu. No whiskey, no rum, no tequila, no coke and the peanuts were soggy. Basically you are almost obligated to have a spritz and a bag of potato ships. The lady was not happy with us and we were the only group  in the room (4). The view is beautiful, but we were not allowed to take pictures or basically to move in the room. The room was hot and the a/c is too small to cool the space. Visit is not recommended at all.

author: Tanya Ball
title: Just returned from a lovely 3 night stay at this lovely, quirky, welcoming hotel
text:
We have just returned from a 3 nights stay at this lovely, quirky, welcoming hotel.
Yes, this is an old building but it adds to the charm of this hotel. 
We were a family of 4 staying in 3 rooms 103 & 104. Both had comfortable beds and were very clean.
All the staff on reception were very welcoming and friendly and happy to help with any questions or queries.
Every morning we injoyed our continental breakfast overlooking the trevi fountain, the ladies who looked after our every need were very accommadating and very friendly. 
This hotel is a situated in a perfect location to enjoy all the best sites of Rome! 
You can step outside and join the buzzing atmosphere of the city on your doorstep then retreat back into a quaint hotel and relax in a cool airy relaxing room.
Would we recommend? Yes!
Would we return? Absolutely!

author: choosey1
title: Very small rooms but very clean
text:
Initially, I was disappointed with the hotel since the room was very small. My husband and I had several suitcases and there was no room to open them or even walk around them. Being a Hilton gold member, I expected an upgrade. We asked to be moved to a bigger room but since they were full, we had to wait until the next day. We were upgraded to a junior suite which gave us adequate space. I wanted to change hotels before we were given the upgraded room, but they refused to refund our stay. This is a boutique hotel so amenities are limited. There is a restaurant and a gym. No pool or rooftop and a very small lobby. 
Hotel is very clean and staff is friendly. Bathroom has nice, thick towels. Unfortunately, the bed is very uncomfortable. I requested a mattress topper but that did not help much. Pillows are also very thin. The rooms are best for solo travelers are very short stays with limited luggage. 
Breakfast was a buffet and it was quite good, 
We were in London celebrating a milestone anniversary but there was no recognition of our special day.

author: TiphaineReb
title: Cosy spot with outstanding service
text:
Tattle has such a warm and peaceful atmosphere. The selection of drinks was excellent, and we really enjoyed what we ordered.
A special mention has to go to Jun! He was incredibly friendly and helpful, and have us some recommendations for places to visit. We had a really wondeful time here. Highly recommend!

author: LG
title: Nice London Hotel
text:
We stayed for one night and had a room on the 6th floor. Check is was easy and although our room was not ready, it was cleaned as a priority and we were given a voucher for a free drink. Our room was very small and with two suitcases, we would not have been able to cope for more than one night. A strange thing was that when we opened the curtains we could not see out of the window as it is covered in some sort of film making people not see in or out. It did make the room seem a little claustrophobic due to the size and not seeing out of the window.
Breakfast was nice and the restaurant was not too busy. The location is good although I did hear the rumble from the underground trains through the night.

author: MBA-OGTA
title: Apparently, this isn’t accidental.
text:
First time @ Lost Property was three years ago and a really terrific experience.   Super location, fun aesthetic, engaged staff (we have extraordinary food allergies)… we left grateful, and totally pleased.  So much so, the restaurant manager (Constantine) became embedded in group-lore as a standard of exceptional customer attention.

THIS TIME… same story.  Constantine still runs the show in a busy (but effortless) manner, the staff was GREAT; special thank you’s to Katan, “the new guy” and the other guy (sorry to have misplaced the card that I used to write down both of your names!).  And food is so well crafted, it’s hard to believe it’s a ‘hotel restaurant’.

Just to be objective, the house Pinot isn’t that great.  

Anyway, making plans to return and a snap-salute to the GM “Catrin(?)” for her obvious leadership. 

Seeing the Lost Property’s stellar position on TripAdvisor’s hotel ranking over-time is no accident - it’s hospitality by design (as it should always be).

author: Claire P
title: Amazing hotel
text:
There’s a reason why this hotel has excellent reviews. The staff are so nice and helpful.
The hotel is spotless and the rooms are lovely - no wear and tear.
The breakfast was very nice, with lots of choices & I’m sure the restaurant will be good too.
The location is great. So close to St Paul’s, lots of restaurants & you can easily walk across the Millennium Bridge to the Tate Modern, the Globe & even more restaurants.
There’s buses to/from Kings Cross, Trafalgar Square, Covent Garden, London tower etc as well as the tube.

author: Holly W.
title: Excellent Boutique Hotel
text: Hotel Santa Maria is the CUTEST boutique hotel nestled within the alley way of Trastevere. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. The staff was so accommodating and friendly and Kevin (the bartender) was seriously the best! The breakfast and aperitifs were great! He gave us phenomenal service and we had so much fun! 10/10 would stay there again and highly recommend!

author: Jim B
title: Wonderful Place!!
text:
I just spent five nights at this beautiful little oasis in the heart Trastevere. I could not have been happier or more comfortable. A stunning, quiet, haven from the August heat with cool aspect and orange trees - it was an absolute pleasure!!
It would be unfair to single out staff members by name because everyone from the reception staff to those who served the complimentary breakfast (and the delicious cocktails), to those who kept the rooms and grounds clean and fresh were super friendly, helpful, kind and considerate. I send them all my heartfelt thanks and best wishes - and I really hope to be able to stay here again in the future.

author: Rachel J
title: Amazing
text: Excellent location, unbeatable service, absolute delight to stay here.

author: Elena García
title: A charming and peaceful stay in Trastevere
text:
My boyfriend and I stayed at Hotel Santa Maria, and we had a wonderful experience. The hotel is beautiful, peaceful, and full of character, with a lovely courtyard that makes it feel like a hidden oasis in the heart of Trastevere.

The room was clean, comfortable, and quiet, and the staff were exceptionally friendly and helpful throughout our stay. The location is perfect for exploring Rome, with many restaurants, cafés, and attractions within walking distance.

As a traveler, I truly appreciated the warm atmosphere and the excellent hospitality. We felt very welcome and enjoyed every moment of our stay. I would highly recommend Hotel Santa Maria to couples looking for a relaxing and memorable stay in Rome, and we would definitely return.

author: notsofussy186605
title: A calm little oasis in Trastevere
text:
Hotel Santa Maria was wonderful. It's set in a little oasis in the middle of Trastevere. It's not the easiest to reach by car, but the taxi dropped us in front without any trouble.
The staff were really friendly, the buffet breakfast was wonderful, and the evening cocktails/apeo were welcome after a lonf day sightseeing  — I'll miss my basil smash. The rooms very clean, and the whole place feels calm. It's not modern — but that's exactly the charm. A really special stay.

author: Deb P
title: Very nice hotel in a great location!
text: Kadesha and T'sai were excellent!  They were very helpful in accommodating our request for a higher room to avoid noise.  They were so professional and kind.  I wish all hotel staff were as dedicated to customer satisfaction.  The rooms were very clean, and the beds were incredibly comfortable.  The high end hair dryer and steamer were a nice touch. (The doorless shower was a little awkward, but we proactively put towels down to catch the splashing.) The windows are not soundproof, so you may want to bring a noise machine.  But there wasn't too much noise from Port Authority.  (the location is excellent if you are going to Broadway!) The $25 daily food credit was very nice, and the "to go" sandwiches were delicious!  The gym is spacious, and the equipment is in great condition.  And I didn't have a problem with the elevators, even though we were on the 31st floor.  The fee is reasonable, and I would come back here again.  Thank you!

author: Journey04798699082
title: Worst experience of our life
text: This trip has been hell. There is a protest going on outside the hotel 24/7 and we were never warned, even though it was going on when we booked. We cannot sleep a wink. They have drums and are screaming. They have saucepans and are blowing whistles. I cannot believe we paid so much for this. They refused to put us at the back of the hotel when we asked.

author: richvinrootjr
title: Great Bonvoy stay in NYC. Very good location. Very nice staff. Great little bar. Very convenient and well priced for NYC
text: Excellent locale and Value in Times Square

author: Sandrine M
title: Wonderful 3 night stay at the Delta Hotel
text: Spent three nights with my daughter at the Delta hotel. The price to quality ratio is excellent. The hotel is located by the neighborhood of Hell’s Kitchen on one side which offers many moderately priced ethnic restaurants. On the other side, just a short walk away from Times Square and broadway shows. Our room on the 26th floor was well equipped and quiet. The desk is large enough to do some work. I would definitely consider staying again at the Delta hotel.

author: 45ier
title: Would Stay Again
text: This was my first time staying at a Delta hotel and i will definitely be back. Location location location, is everything while in Manhattan and this property was in the center of it all. Nicole and team were great even allowed an early check-in. The bathroom situation as a little strange with no shower door, but it worked. I visit NYC a lot and this was probably one of the larger of the rooms that i have been in. Overall, when looking for a place to stay within the Marriott family, I always hope this property is available.

author: Meander05031522788
title: A Confirmed Booking Meant Nothing
text: One month after my confirmed reservation, the property cancelled my booking, citing a “system error”. Meanwhile, the room was being offered again at a much higher price. This was extremely disappointing and demonstrated a lack of reliability. I definitely do not recommend this place.

author: Oren P
title: Scam Alert: Do not book here. They will force you to pay for their broken rooms.
text:
Save your money and book somewhere else. This hostel uses predatory bait-and-switch tactics to squeeze extra cash out of exhausted travelers.
When I checked in, the AC and fan in my room were completely dead. The room was a sauna. I went to the desk, but instead of apologizing or moving me, the staff strung me along for two hours making up ridiculous excuses—like claiming a broken AC "takes 30 minutes to get going."
When they finally admitted the room was uninhabitable, they refused to move me to a working room unless I paid them an additional $30 "upgrade fee." It was past midnight, I was dead tired, and they essentially held a safe, cool room hostage until I handed over more money. I was forced to pay it just to get some sleep.
The kicker? The AC in the "upgraded" room was broken, too. I spent the entire night sweating in a sweltering room after being scammed into paying a premium for air conditioning they didn't even provide.
Management clearly does not care about guest comfort or fulfilling basic reservations; they only care about extracting hidden fees when you are too tired to fight back. Avoid this place at all costs unless you want to pay extra for the privilege of sleeping in an oven.

author: Julius J
title: Great location and clean facilities, but beds might fall short of expectations
text:
Location is excellent, and the facilities are clean and well-maintained. There’s a kitchen area and a lounge space where you can work, which is a nice bonus. The staff were friendly and helpful—for example, they adjusted the air conditioning in the evening upon request.

The only downside is that the beds didn’t match what you could expect from the website and their advertising material. I was anticipating capsule-style beds that can be fully enclosed and dark, but in my room they were regular bunk beds with a small curtain covering only about one-third of the bed length. As other reviewers have mentioned, there's only a thin sheet + a polyester blanket.

author: Linda Schuyler Ford
title: Cozy bed, Bright Lights
text:
The location is great, with easy walking to theaters, Times Square and Central Park. I was in a quad room which was very clean, as was our bathroom.

5he one 5hing that brought down my rating is, the bright ceiling lights are on motion sensors.  Not only did the lights come on when a guest arrived late, or when someone got up to use the restroom-they came on every single time I moved in my lower bunk! Several times a night. A curtain covers half of each bunk' giving some privacy but not prote lion from bright lights. Sleep masks are available but I thought they were more a gimmick. Even using one the second night only helped a bit. I still woke each time the lights came on. Surely there is a reasonable fix for this.

Location, price (still not cheap) and cleanliness would bring me back again. I just will not expect a good night's sleep.

author: LuckyLuke040
title: Very convenient
text:
Handy if you have very little time in New York, I was there for an afternoon and evening and still wanted to take a shower somewhere and leave my luggage before I went into town.
You have a bed with light and sockets, and a locker. With a curtain it is separated from the hallway. The shower and toilet are in the hallway and in my case shared with another 'pod'.
The clean, quiet, fine shower, affordable and 5 minute walk to Central Park and 10 minute to Times Square.

author: AddieCMomOfThree
title: A solid choice - a very good value for a new, clean and comfortable room in a convenient location
text: Stayed in a city view, two queens room for two nights. New, clean, and a pretty decent size, for a NYC hotel room. The beds were comfortable, and the A/C ran quietly (NOT the kind which continuously cycles on and off). We stayed on the 13th floor, and the street noise wasn't too bad. We could have used more hooks in the bathroom though (I think there was only one), so there weren't enough places to hang all our towels in the bathroom. Took off one star off because the room was not ready by the 4:00pm check-in time, and the elevators were a bit slow (one of the three elevators was out of service). Front desk was friendly, but they could have been more helpful in explaining how the elevators worked and mentioning that there was coffee available in the mornings and a water machine in the food area. A good value and in a convenient location, near major subway lines and a 10-minute walk from Moynihan Train Hall.

author: sonia b
title: Hotel right in the city center
text: Nice hotel, the view from the room is magnificent, very clean. Pleasant staff. Very disappointing breakfast. We had to buy food for the morning. Little choice. Needs more effort! No parking.

author: Chrystel2014
title: Very good location and good bedding
text: Great location to visit New York. Quiet street in the center of New York. Located in the flower district. Metro line 1 around the corner 3 minutes walk. The bedding is good. Shower room correct, a little small. On the other hand no storage in the bedroom or in the shower room. It was quite embarrassing to have to open the suitcases every day, especially when you stay 1 week. But otherwise we really enjoyed the situation and the bedding.

author: brett M
title: Couple of Kiwis in NYC
text:
Whole stay was excellent 
Shout out to the amazing Tara!  at the hotel bar 
arriving back after a long day sightseeing was nice to see a friendly face and have a chat and of course help with fantastic drinks choices 
She knows her stuff!

author: Shaun S
title: The flower district is a great option
text:
Out of the Marriott tiers, Aloft is a more basic option; however, the Chelsea location is pretty decent. 

Pros include location and nice folks at the front desk. 

Negatives include the cost and the low quality furnishings. 

Still, not bad.

author: Michelle C
title: They lie. Avoid
text: This was horrible. There is no air conditioning, we had a heat wave. They didn't care and would not refund or compensate. They also waited until I checked in to disclose. The entire stay was bad. Broken shower, dirty room. The staff are horrible. AVOID.

author: René B
title: Book a better neighbourhood.
text:
The hotel is located at the start of Pigalle, the Red Light district.   What attracted me initially was the decor, each room decorated in the style of a famous artist.   We stayed in room 304, the Augustine Renoir room.   Small, ideal for one or two nights, no more.   Air Con was out of action for the previous 2 months which in August heat was terrible.   Lots of homeless and immigrants hanging out at the little fountain outside a noisy at night.  Not recommended for solo travellers as seen someone robbed as drunk by a guy going over offering to help him.   Paris in general is expensive.  Lots of good places have queues outside at all times of the day.   Moulin Rouge 5 minutes walk away.

Best little cocktail bar nearby is an unassuming place called ‘Dirty Dick’, not a gay bar! But with the cheap cocktails starting at €17 a pop, we had 2 each and left.  Bring a good pair of walking shoes, the subway system can be tricky to navigate and unless you know the zone your travelling, your better off getting a day pass.

Flat rate to the airport is meant to be €56.  Hotel advertises it at €63, driver charged us €72.

Took 30 minutes and not up to 3 hours as advertised on some reviews.   Safe too than the RER B train at €14 per person one way and we saw someone robbed on the train out from the airport.

author: GRMY64
title: Hotel with original decor.
text: Very good location right next to the Pigalle metro station, with many attractions and restaurants nearby. The staff is pleasant, available, and ensures that the stay goes as smoothly as possible. The room was clean and quiet (street side) with a small balcony that included a table and two chairs. The decor (just like the rest of the hotel) is unusual. A fridge was present in the room, and two bottles of water were provided as a courtesy. Excellent water pressure in the bathroom. Complete breakfast in the hotel's basement with very cheerful staff in the morning. A few downsides: not many electrical outlets in the room, a larger partition in the bathtub would be helpful to avoid flooding the bathroom when showering, the air conditioning, which works well, is apparently turned off at night (not great given the current temperatures), the elevator is a bit slow, and the breakfast room is rather small and narrow (maximum of about twelve seats). Despite these few points, a very good establishment in Paris that I recommend.

author: June P
title: Great experience
text: My Granddaughter and I have just returned from this hotel and we loved everything about it. The Moulin Rouge theme is tastefully done. Room was an ok size and everything worked and was spotless. Bathroom was good size and good hot shower. Staff were exceptionally helpful. Breakfast was good value and tasty. We will certainly return when it's not so hot!

author: Laurence D
title: A pleasant Parisian interlude.
text: A very nice hotel, just like its staff. The rooms are pretty and clean. I recommend it 100%.

author: MALIK C

author: Jason O
title: Nice hotel, very far west, hike to the trains

The staff was friendly and the rooms were roomy and clean. There is a nice courtyard which was beautiful but a little noisy from some kind of mechanical equipment, maybe an air conditioning unit.

hotel excellent location,

they should include food and drinks at an affordable price at times that allow us to consume them, so the guest does not have to go out for a simple breakfast, (even in the rain as happened to us), the service could improve.

author: Calpurnia0016

author: Maverick598
title: Nah, not worth it.
text:
Pros:
Great location right next to Liverpool Street. Easy check in and check out. 
Staff nice and polite. 

Cons:
Rooms are small. I was on my own but we would have struggled if there had been two of us. Maybe about foot on the right and at the end of the bed. Shower room small.  
Lights - I’m pretty good with technology but I struggled to get the main light off. Without turning the whole room off.  It’s a touch pad where nothing seems clear and you’re there asking yourself why won’t it turn off? Am I pressing too hard, too soft, or in the wrong way?!
Not ideal at the end of a day or night, and I was sober. 
Air con - room had air con and I appeared to have got it working despite the touch pad, but it wouldn’t cool the room, only the fan came on. Not great. 

Overall maybe you’ll have a good experience here but I’m not sure I’ll go back even if I need a crash pad for the night. The price would have to be ridiculously cheap to make me book again.

author: MarkyP264

author: dellie50
title: 24 hour stopover in London
text:
1. Great location; very close to Paddington Station which is the terminal for the Heathrow Express and has a number of Underground lines. It is walking distance to the West End and other areas of interest.
2. The staff were so helpful. I arrived at 7am from Heathrow after a long flight. They managed to check me in which meant I could shower and then go exploring.  The hotel also has baggage storage facilities which I used after I had checked out.
3. Spring Street has good eating places. 
4. The hotel was clean and tidy.
5. The hotel offered compact rooms for a very reasonable rates, which was ideal for me as I was staying 1 night.

author: Jay
title: Room paranoia. Useless manager.
text:
An incident occurred during our stay which significantly affected our experience. I am awarding 2 stars, primarily because the air conditioning was functioning well.

Our first impressions were positive. The gentleman at reception was polite and kindly stored our luggage before check-in.

Unfortunately, the lift was out of service, which was inconvenient when carrying suitcases. As we made our way up the stairs, the age and condition of the hotel became increasingly apparent. There were cracked walls and worn carpets with visible damage. While some wear and tear is understandable in a budget hotel, there are reasonable standards that should still be maintained.

After checking into our room, we had been there for less than ten minutes when a member of housekeeping entered without knocking. At the time, I was lying on the bed without clothing, trying to cool down during the heatwave.

I found the incident both embarrassing and upsetting. I immediately contacted reception to raise a complaint and was informed that the manager would contact me.

After waiting for approximately an hour without receiving any response, I went downstairs to speak with the manager directly. Unfortunately, I found her attitude unhelpful and dismissive.

I explained that the situation was unacceptable and appeared to demonstrate a lack of communication between staff members. As paying guests, we are entitled to privacy within our room, and this should never have occurred.

Although the manager apologised, my request for a partial refund was declined. No alternative form of compensation or goodwill gesture was offered despite the distress and embarrassment caused.

As a result of this incident, we felt both uncomfortable and unsafe for the remainder of our stay. Knowing that someone had entered our room without warning left us concerned that it could happen again.

We found ourselves constantly watching the door and anticipating further interruptions. The situation caused significant anxiety, to the extent that my partner placed our luggage in front of the door for added peace of mind.

Given the impact this had on our sense of privacy and security, we ultimately decided that we could not continue our stay and requested a full refund. A refund still not received. 

I made it clear that I would be leaving a review of my experience. Based on this incident and the way it was handled, I would not choose to stay at this hotel again.

author: MARIA ANGELICA L
title: Very good value for money
text:
We had a very pleasant stay at this hotel. Its biggest advantage is definitely the location, which is excellent and makes it very easy to explore the area and access nearby attractions, restaurants, and transportation.

Another highlight was the friendliness and helpfulness of the staff. Everyone was welcoming, attentive, and always willing to assist with any questions or requests.

The hotel itself is rather simple and could benefit from some refurbishment and general maintenance in certain areas. However, considering the price paid, we felt that the overall value for money was very good. The excellent location and the quality of service more than compensated for these minor shortcomings.

We would gladly stay here again and would recommend it to travelers looking for a well-located hotel with a friendly atmosphere and reasonable rates.

author: marydurhone
title: Excellent customer service
text: I walked into the Edward Hotel in May 2026 after getting stuck at Paddington late in the evening when all trains to my destination were cancelled.  Helga, the receptionist, saved the day by being welcoming, giving me her full attention and finding me a room. I've met few hotel receptionists with her customer service skills. Thanks again!

author: Fozia K
title: Worst hotel ever! Unsafe conditions and appalling service.
text:
This was hands down the worst hotel experience I've ever had. From the moment we arrived, it was clear that basic standards of cleanliness and hospitality were optional here.

The room smelled strongly of damp and stale cigarettes, and within 10 minutes my daughter, who has a lung disease, began breathing very heavily. The stench was so overwhelming that my husband, who is immuno-compromised, began vomiting.The carpets were stained beyond redemption and so dusty it felt as though they hadn’t been cleaned since the hotel first opened. Although the downstairs areas look presentable, do not be fooled — this place is a complete waste of money. 

The staff were equally disappointing. When we addressed our concerns with the manager, we were met with blank stares and excuses. Management were unwilling to help in any way. They repeatedly directed the receptionist to deal with complaints, who confirmed she had no authority to do anything. They refused to provide any certificate or proof that the hotel is damp-proof. We spent over two hours trying to negotiate a refund, which was also refused. 

Other guests were complaining that there was no hot water in their rooms. We didn’t even get a chance to use any facilities as we left immediately. We were forced to find another hotel in the middle of the night. 

Avoid at all costs, especially if you have children — the service and conditions were disgusting and clearly pose a risk to health. If I could give zero stars, I would.

author: Marina I
title: Wonderful stay in Rome
text:
We had a wonderful stay in Rome. The hotel was beautiful, very clean, comfortable, and offered spacious rooms and an excellent breakfast. We especially appreciated the attention to detail and the warm hospitality of Katia at reception, who was extremely kind to our daughter.

We thoroughly enjoyed our experience and look forward to returning in the future. The hotel is also very well located, in a quiet neighborhood close to the Colosseum, making it an excellent base for exploring Rome.

We highly recommend staying at this hotel to anyone visiting Rome.

author: NorthStar22902600298
title: Rome 26

author: Helen D

author: Tom

author: Luciano  P
title: Leisure trip
