author: Robin H
title: Wonderful Roman Hotel
text: I have stayed at this hotel on each trip to Rome for over 20 years. We have always been treated lovely, the breakfast is amazing and the beautiful marble throughout the bathrooms is just gorgeous. It is centrally located to everything and has the best pizza place in Rome right down the street on the right. I recommend the Pear and Gorgonzola pizza.

author: Brian N
title: Outstanding service
text:
What a lovely hotel, the staff are outstanding ( went to the colloseum but forgot my wife's passport, phoned the hotel and they emailed a copy to us so we could get in OUSTANDING SERVICE)
The hotel is clean with a nice old school feeling with a lovely bar to relax in at the end of the day, it has central locations minutes walk to the shops and restaurants, (go down  the side streets and it's a lot cheaper, 2 mains ,water, two drinks and bread 50 to 70 E ) you are 25 minutes walk from the Vatican and 15 minutes in a taxi  20 E from the colloseum.
Fle markets on Sundays 20 euro by taxi.
I will definitely book this hotel in the future and recommend it.

author: Nia J
title: Brilliant hotel, central location near to the main attractions
text: The hotel is in a fantastic, central location which means all of the must see sights are within easy reach. There is a metro station just steps away so if you want/need to use public transport then this is easily accessible. The staff were all pleasant and friendly. The rooms felt authentically Italian with their decor & the beds were some of the comfiest I’ve come across at a hotel in recent times. Breakfast was great, with a variety of choice & always plenty of space available in the breakfast room. We’d all leave full up after breakfast ready for a full day ahead. Later of an evening after a busy day of sightseeing, this hotel was close to lots of restaurants within a few minutes walk, which meant we didn’t have to go too far from our hotel of an evening to find food. We often found ourselves going later on for a sit by the Spanish steps as these are within a short 10 minute walk. I would certainly recommend this hotel to someone who wants a hotel in a central spot to all of the main sightseeing attractions.

author: Pia75
title: Great choice in Rome
text:
Overall: well located hotel and clean, nice and very good service.

Location: as many others say, the hotel is very central and nice. 

Service: Very friendly, even when I needed to change room. Effective, kind and very professional employees. You feel like a guest, not a customer. Everyone is welcoming and friendly. 

ROM: 
All rooms are beautiful and clean. It is tastefully decorated and well equipped rooms. But the standard and DeLux rooms are very small and there are narrow and slow elevators in the building. Therefore, it is advisable to make sure that you book a room that suits your needs. We upgraded to one of the rooms at the atrium. That was lovely. Nice bathroom with luxurious products, delicious towels and bathrobes. The room is very clean and nice. 

Common areas: everything is clean and neat and neat. The breakfast room is cosy and we always had good space. The bar is cosy, especially sitting out.

Food: breakfast is very good, especially to Italy to be. Good selection of fresh fruit and proper eggshells. Delicious coffee and good selection of both sweet and salt.

author: Adventure51910016451
title: An oasis of calm, coolness & welcome.
text:
I traveled with my partner and young adult sons.  We’d booked the deluxe rooms and they overlooked the courtyard; it was always calm and peaceful.  The hotel is a little bit quirky (one lift to the first floor and a smaller lift to higher floors) and the rooms are individual, beautifully decorated and the air conditioning was quiet and effective.  It was lovely to lie in the bed after a busy day in Rome and relax before going out to enjoy the evening.  The room sizes were not an issue for us, I unpacked and my partner lived out of his suitcase and there was plenty of room.

Breakfast was great, lots of choice and always plentiful, even towards the end of service.  
The bar area is beautiful and we had THE best Aperol spritz of any we had in Rome…we tested extensively.

All the staff without exception were friendly, welcoming and helpful.  

The location is fantastic…close to the metro, tram and bus stop.  Across the road from Piazza del Popolo and the city awaits…  You can see the Flaminio obelisk from quite a distance, so it was always easy to navigate home.  We bought a weekly travel pass and zipped about.  The buses and metro are good.  

We would return to River Palace in a heartbeat…Thank you so much for having us.

author: Sam D
title: Perfect location
text: The location of this hotel is perfect. All tourist attractions walkable distance.

author: Sophie C
title: Avoid at all costs!
text: Aside from the staff, who are friendly, and the central location just behind the Galeries Lafayette, this hotel should be avoided. I stayed there during a week of heatwave, and the establishment has no air conditioning. The fan provided only circulated hot air. The temperature in the room, tiny with a low ceiling and carpet, reached 95 °F: impossible to sleep there. As for the breakfast, it was very disappointing, served in a cramped and stuffy room. All of this for €250 a night. A completely unjustified rate considering the services provided. An experience I do not recommend.

author: Delphine L
title: Terrible hotel
text:
My room smelled very bad, I would say it was truly awful. 
I immediately informed the front desk.
I said it is lamentable to give a room like this, and he told me not to complain because there is another room, especially at that price, and then he told me that I am not pleasant; I told him, excuse me, the one suffering is me, I am changing floors with all my luggage and there is no normal help.
At breakfast, no one says hello.
The orange juice is disgusting, and the pastries are not good and frozen.
Breakfast where there are too few options.
Avoid at all costs.

author: bibimapi
title: Disappointing.
text:
I spent three days in this hotel located in a very convenient and central position in the city. The presentation photos on various sites, including the official one, are beautiful and indeed convincing for a 3-star rating. In reality, the structure is quite different, with small rooms, uneven flooring even though covered with carpet, no wardrobe or drawer in the room, no air conditioning, and at night it was impossible to sleep due to the heat, no safe, and a minimal breakfast served in a tiny room.
In short, a two-star rating would have been more appropriate because the only thing three-star was the price: 900 euros for three nights.

author: François L
title: AVOID!!!!!!
text:
Do not trust the photos on online booking sites or the positive reviews.
It's a rat hole. 830 euros for 3 nights in a room less well-equipped than at Ikea... an old rack, a handmade desk made from 3 plywood boards... 830 euros for 3 nights!!! We are much more comfortably welcomed in budget hotels around the ring road for four times less. Avoid it, respect yourself.

author: Michele D
title: Good stay!
text: Stayed here two nights. The room was good sized, beds were comfortable and bathroom was clean. The AC wasn't working very well..we went back to the room a few times during the day it was very warm in the room. We couldn't set the AC below 68. It was cool enough at night though while sleeping. Breakfast was good, not crowded at all like other reviews say. No issues waiting for elevators either. Pretty quiet for NYC also. The rooftop bar was great..amazing views! Great location too, near Times Square and Rockefeller Center. Probably wouldn't stay here again as we really didn't need a suite with stove and dishwasher, etc but it was free since I had won my stay in a sweepstakes.

author: Vanessa R
title: Excellent!!
text:
Our experience at the hotel was incredible, all the staff were super attentive and willing to help with any request, the breakfast is 10 out of 10, varied and super abundant, we loved the help that Jose santa fe offered us, he was super kind, cordial and very attentive to making us feel comfortable with the breakfast and with our questions, he made us feel at home.
Congratulations to this hotel for its very kind staff.
The hotel is super clean and the rooms, although they are not very big, are very comfortable.
The hotel's location is another plus that should not go unmentioned.

author: maayan s
title: Great
text: We stayed here twice during the World Cup and had an amazing time! Huge thanks to Ynocencia for being so wonderfully helpful with our baby during breakfast. Excellent hotel and incredible service – highly recommended!

author: Gunjan V
title: Friendly service and perfect location.
text:

I want to especially highlight Ynocencia, who was incredibly kind, attentive, and helpful throughout my entire stay. She always greeted us with a smile and was willing to help with any question or need, making us feel very welcome.

I would definitely stay here again and recommend it to anyone visiting New York. 
Thank you, Ynocencia, for making our stay even more special!

author: Paola Cristina A
title: Excellent service
text: Excellent service from Ynocencia in the dining room 10/10 very kind treatment, she should have a better position with the service she offers

author: andreO5838IA
title: Good hotel in central London.

author: Hugh P
title: Well-worth a visit
text: This is a very good up-scale hotel in a neglected corner of central London. Rooms are very clean, and a decent size by London standards. The beds are exceptionally comfortable. As a whole the hotel is very comfortable rather than luxurious, but that's the way I like it. Staff members are lovely, Breakfasts are very good, evening meals less so but functional if you need an on-site restaurant. It's a bit off centre but equally it's not that far from the sorts of places people might want to visit. The area itself is not much visited but actually of great interest especially: the historic Inner Temple legal area and the Temple Church, accessed through a gate in the courtyard behind the hotel which is always open on weekdays, and for much of the year also at the weekend; the Thames Embankment, and South Bank on the other side of the river; and Somerset House including the world-class Courtauld Gallery. There are some very good restaurants nearby (Spring and Toklas are excellent, and Covent Garden is restaurant-central). All in all, I highly recommend staying here

author: Jorge_E_VT
title: Great hotel in a quiet area but still very central
text: I was happily surprised with this hotel. Staff and facilities are great at a decent price for central London. The hotel has a beautiful yard and you can walk everywhere.

author: Blondy08
title: Excellent value for money

Excellent stay. Bedroom was lovely and spotlessly clean, quiet room and spotless en-suite.

Would definitely return as great value and very close to many theatres and Covent Garden

author: Wan Ching H

author: Jacky2701

author: Yvonne N

Operationally, the hotel seemed to struggle with their full capacity. Our room assignment occurred 2 to 3 hours after 4 PM and our room was not cleaned on a daily basis.

author: Barry S

Check in can get busy at times but the staff is very accommodating. Thumbs up to Jaziah at the reception desk. Discount vouchers are a welcome touch. The lobby bar and restaurant can be crowded but hang in there. It's a fun spot. And you can't beat the views if you can get a high floor room. Looking forward to my next visit.

author: Catone001
title: A nice stay at nyc

author: Vacation11308380911
title: Outstanding Hospitality and Unbeatable Location!
text:
I absolutely loved my time here! The staff are incredible—so attentive and welcoming that they actually remembered me from my previous visit. A special shout-out to Kenday the bellhop, who was consistently patient, helpful, and kind throughout my stay. They also stored my luggage for free while waiting for my check-in time! 
Having stayed here twice, I can say the accommodations are great. My first room was perfectly comfortable with plenty of space to move around, while my second room was impressively spacious.
Don't miss the Victoria Restaurant! While it is on the pricier side, it is well worth it—the food tasted fantastic and the portion sizes were excellent. To top it all off, the location is unbeatable. You are steps away from everything: shops, street vendors, banks, subways, bus stops, and the iconic Apollo Theater. I will definitely be back!

author: Isaiah B
title: Good stay

author: flerij
title: Air conditioning is problematic.
text:
The hotel is acceptable, but in my opinion, it does not deserve a four-star rating. My room was nice but not very large (just a bit more than the size of the bed).  The staff is really friendly (thanks to the receptionist on Monday evening who pointed me to a good restaurant). The street is quiet. Close to the subway and the tram. 
 The breakfast is pleasant, but the choice of products is not vast compared to other hotels.
For me, the main problem was the air conditioning: it made very loud creaking noises, making it impossible to keep it on at night. Fortunately, I was there a little before the big heatwave.
Another problem: every morning I hung the sign "please do not clean the room," an option offered by the hotel to limit the use of cleaning products. And every evening I noticed that the housekeeper had come to clean the room.  So, inconsistency...

It's a shame there is no connecting room

author: MarG
title: Good Location and affordable prices with poor breakfast practices
text:
We booked this hotel through the BW website, and it turned out to be the most affordable option given its location and proximity to metro and tram stations. The check-in process was smooth, and we are grateful to William for his professionalism. We stayed with our family in two rooms for five nights and were given the highest, 6th floor, as requested during booking.

The triple room, intended to accommodate two adults and a child, smelled strongly of cigarette smoke, so we were offered a free upgrade to a more spacious family room on the second floor, thanks to the forthcoming and helpful approach of the manager, Violet.

The hotel itself is somewhat outdated, with small rooms and tiny bathrooms, half-detached curtains, etc. The tiny elevator, which could fit only two people at a time, added quite a bit of nighttime noise and vibration to one of our rooms located next to it. However, the rooms were equipped with modern air conditioning, which made it unnecessary to open the back windows for fresh air—especially since, instead of fresh air, you could often smell cooking odors from the neighboring buildings’ back doors.

The buffet breakfasts were rather poor and did not meet the standards expected from a BW Plus hotel, nor those of travelers who prefer more than a croissant and a cup of coffee for breakfast—especially considering the price of €18 per person. It was quite annoying to have to ask for bread repeatedly and receive the same nervous reply, “I will check,” only to be given 3–4 slices of bread for several guests. Joceline, the lady in charge of breakfast service, seemed to spend more time staring at guests and waiting for requests rather than replenishing the food. Sometimes, she even declined requests nervously, well before the official breakfast closing time. This was the first time we felt genuinely uncomfortable with BW’s food service, as it almost felt like we were taking Joceline’s personal food rather than enjoying a prepaid hotel breakfast. We believe the management should address this issue promptly if they want to encourage guests to have breakfasts at the Hotel rather than eat elsewhere—which, in fact, many tourists chose to do.

Fortunately, there were several good dining options nearby, as well as a well-stocked supermarket just a one-minute walk away. The neighborhood felt safe, and we had no concerns about security at any time.

The location of the hotel is excellent. It is only a 1–2 minute walk from the Porte de Vincennes Metro station, where you can access Metro Line 1—the main line that easily connects to all the major sights of Paris, including Notre-Dame, the Opera, the Eiffel Tower, the Louvre, and even to trains leading to Versailles and Disneyland (with a simple line change). Metro and tram tickets can be purchased directly at the Porte de Vincennes station entrance. Note that at some busy stations, such as Opera, tourists may be asked to show their tickets, so it’s advisable to buy them in advance to avoid fines.

Overall, Best Western 61 Nation is an average hotel offering decent prices compared to other chain hotels in Paris. Its convenient location and the responsiveness of its management are definite strengths that make it a reasonable choice for budget-conscious travelers.

author: Josue L
title: Nice option
text: Nice location, Great experience. Close to the train and accessible for all. Fully recommendable a great experience  fully

author: Enaldo J
title: Friendly
text: Great location and friendly people

author: Alexander C
title: Great Weekend Stay
text: Had a great stay and the staff was very accommodating! Thank you to Elizabeth R and Alonzo for the great service!

author: Jeff D
title: Cordial staff. Welcoming.
text: Great place to stay. 3 minute walk to great theaters on Times Square. Clean, comfortable, quiet. Excellent temp control. Garvey’s is great place for breakfast and for drinks. I’d stay there again any chance I get.

author: Apple E
title: For God's sake
text:
Horror!!! 
One of the worst experiences ever in New York
We book with the reassurance: "pay directly at the property, no advance required".
Perfect, except that a week before the trip I find myself $2,000 deducted from my credit card without any clear explanation. And it doesn't end there: on arrival we are also asked for a deposit of $150, which after 15 days has not yet been returned (at my phone call I was only told to "be patient").
1 150& should make them to us.. as a reward for staying at this place....
As soon as we arrived the situation was surreal: check-in is literally inside a pub/restaurant, between the smells of cooking and people eating and drinking. The
"reception" is a desk in the corner near the door. If we hadn't already paid, we would have run right away. Now I see why they're parading your money earlier. Otherwise at the sight of this "place"
Everyone would run.
Up in the room, the disaster continues:
• Lift with buttons attached with scotch.
• Small room, with air conditioning so noisy that you do not sleep. Options to choose from: dying of heat or dying of cold of cold.
• Non-working refrigerator that, in addition to not cooling, gave off hot air to the point of melting my lipsticks in the beauty that I had placed on top of the desk (the fridge was located below)
Bed so soft you could spend the night
to "go up the mattress", so during the day you walk around New York and at night, instead of resting a poor man has to go up the mattress....
• Non-existent cleaning: blonde hair not mine in
bathroom (I'm a brunette) remained there all holiday, a coin left on purpose on the ground never collected in 7 days, behind the bed old trash. Towels changed only partially we found the dirty ones folded as if they were clean. And in 7 days only
3 even partial changes in towels.
Cleaning is done every other day. Why is that? Mystery. We do not know... 
A nightmare. Holiday ruined

author: Kaitlyn A
title: Ruined Our Trip! Shady!
text: This hotel lost our luggage & ruined our trip!Natalia at the front desk told us to leave our luggage in a small black hallway by the front desk/door before check in & against my better judgement we complied. It’s scary enough to travel to NYC for the first time but they made it hell! Elizabeth at the front desk later on told us multiple times that our room would “absolutely be comped” and then told her coworker trying to help find our bags that the place was “ghetto.” We missed our Broadway show due to our wallets and etc being missing in our bags. Bags were eventually found but we could not get an answer as to where they were. Manager emailed us when we got home trying to say we will only be given $100 due to the full compensation “not being approved.” It’s even funnier that it’s been two weeks and we have yet to even receive the $100! We will be disputing this with our bank-Avoid this shady “ghetto” place as Elizabeth says! Not to mention the room had a bathroom trash that was full upon first walk in! Gross!

author: Emma J
title: Fine for NYC
text: It was fine. Expensive, but thats NYC. It was pretty loud at night but they do provide ear plugs which worked great. Gym is small but does the job. Breakfast is 6-9am but we didn't make it down in time. Subway is about a 5 minute walk.

author: Amy C
title: We were very happy here.
text: We had an excellent stay at this hotel. It was myself and my husband there to see Rush and just do tourist things. This hotel was friendly, clean and our room was pretty quiet. There were ear buds but we didn't need them. The air conditioning was excellent. We had a view of the Empire State Building and the full moon one night. The outside of the hotel was clean and safe with many options for dining on the same block. We mostly walked but also had easy access to and from the subway. We picked up a few items in the dining area during breakfast and they weren't the best but I appreciate that they offer anything. The bagel shop next door is great. The folks at the front desk were very friendly, professional and helpful. We really enjoyed our stay.

author: Flwagner
title: Family stay in the heart of the city
text: Great location and enough room for my family of four including utilizing the sleeper sofa.  We loved being able to walk the city and come back to a quiet space.  The included breakfast was a plus and it was plentiful.  Hotel was clean, a great value and every staff member we encountered was friendly and helpful.  The front desk helped us arrange transportation to the airport and provided waters daily.  There was also a refill water station in both the lobby and dining area that we took advantage of.  All of our request were met promptly for extra pillows and blankets.  If you are looking for a family stay in the city this is a great choice!

author: kawaii40
title: Small rooms but clean, friendly staff and environmentally friendly
text: The room was smaller than standard Hyatt rooms but that's understandable considering we are in a very compacted city of New York.  That said, the room was clean, the staff were helpful and the management  was noticeably environmentally friendly. Love the planters outside hotel lobby! I hope they'll find a way to get more sunlight for those plants!

author: Heather H.
title: Great stay in convenient location.
text: Great location, very good customer service, and breakfast bar was well done. The room was unusually quiet for mid-town and the top floor terrace, overlooking the Empire State Building, was really nice.

author: eliane
title: WELL LOCATED, but....
text:
I have been to this hotel several times, which is very well located, near the subway, theaters, restaurants, and shops; 
The rooms are small, but comfortable and clean. Several times, the elevator was out of order....... I did not return because the prices had increased terribly after covid.

author: flavia
title: Very good
text:
Qualified and friendly staff, clean, tidy and comfortable rooms. Very quick check in and check out. Great location.
Recommended!!

author: lrpvinci
title: Excellent

author: Jutta S
title: 3 days City
text: The hotel is super central.the staff are very friendly and very helpful.we were nicely received and the room on the 6 floor was also ok.great view,the breakfast as well as the coffee was fully adequate and it was delicious ,you can recommend very well

author: Ross
title: Excellent experience
text:
We just stayed at this small hotel in the 9 arr of Paris. The location is strategic, close to two metro stops, a short walk from rue de la fayette and Opera. A 15 min walk from the quaint Montmatre district. If you want you can walk to any site of interest.
Our room on the top floor was bright and spacious, maybe a little dated, but we were not there to spend the days in the room... anyway, despite being in the center, very quiet. Very comfortable beds.
Good breakfast.
The staff was very kind and helpful. A special mention to the nice Mr. Oliver who was able to give us valuable guidance.
I highly recommend this property

author: Cris S
title: Absolute ripoff
text:
I spent £250 staying at the dump. It was a very hot night in London and my hotel had no air conditioning. So I checked out and traveled across London to stay in the ‘fully air conditioned rooms’. I spent my £250 checked in, only to be told that ‘oh yea, sorry the air conditioning doesn’t work in that room. We can give you a fan!’. So I am sat here with a tiny window that opens into a well that contains all the working AC units, so any air that does make it in is baking hot.
So my advice is don’t believe anything anyone says about this hotel. The place is an absolute dump and they will scam you for every penny they can get.

author: Derek C
title: Won't stop there again
text:
Location brilliant for Buckingham Palace
Nice and friendly
Rooms are expensive 
Value 5 out 10
No restaurant for evening meal. You could order in and eat in the room where they serve breakfast
Breakfast is continental only, despite someone posting their omelettes were cooked to order.

author: Amy L
title: Good hotel if you're watching Wicked
text: A great little hotel l, just 5 minutes walk from Apollo Victoria (Wicked). Room was clean and perfectly usable for an overnight stay. Super shower! Breakfast was ok, continental with a few choices but perfectly adequate.  Friendly staff, would recommend for a cheap break in Theatre Land.

author: mminuscoli
title: Good hotel, privileged location
text: Good hotel, room is small but very comfortable. Breakfast good but simple, has the potential to improve guest experience. The best thing was the location that allowed us to make various travel with quite ease. My reservation was regarding the hygiene of the room because when I picked up a Lego from my son on the floor I was quite surprised by the amount of dust that was under the beds. I suggest you do a more thorough cleaning!

author: Johanna S
title: A good hotel
text: After we'd booked we read some reviews and as a result almost cancelled our booking. So glad we didnt. We asked for a top floor room - it was really quiet and a good room for the price. No complaints at all. It was a continental breakfast but quite a good variety. Would stay there again.

author: Noemi N
title: Noemi Nonell-Spain.

The hotel is standard and comfortable and close to any tourist spot in the city.

author: Natasha M
title: SOMETHING OUT OF A HORROR MOVIE AWFUL HOTEL!
text:
DO NOT STAY HERE AVOID!!!

I just stayed at this hotel with my boyfriend for 7 nights. As soon as we walked into the room we were shocked and disgusted and completely underwhelmed. The rooms look nothing like the photos , completely misleading! Carpets are stained, room really old and shabby I was horrified and they moved our room to one with a balcony . This room was just as bad, 
the shower base door was falling off and the shower door do not shut, the bathroom floor was wet my boyfriend fell out the shower as the door wouldn’t close one day and hurt his back, we complained about the room first day were told all rooms were identical by the lady at reception, but she moved us to one with a balcony and we made do with it. Throughout the stay, the room just had a dirty feel about it , I felt uncomfortable using the shower and bathroom, the hotel lacks facilities . No kettle, no water, no fridge in the room basic things you would expect, I complained to the lady at reception about the fridge and she just laughed . My boyfriend told the other man about it at reception who said he would sort something out but never did, it was hot and we couldn’t chill out drinks which made it quite painful. The air conditioning did not work at all and we went end of May in 31 degree weather!  Again we complained about this to the staff who just did nothing about it; completely ignored us everytime we complained about something, on day 4 we had left the clea my room sign out side the door and our room was not cleaned , my boyfriend went down to reception again we explained about all the issues she then moved us only on day 4 to a bigger room with four beds. title: A lovely surprise - We will return!
text: Hotel is easy to find and a quick walk from either Termini station or the metro.  The area is a welcome respite from the fray of Rome, being in a tranquil location. All of the hotel staff were pleasant and kind, they were extremely helpful and responded quickly to our needs. Breakfast was delicious, offering a great variety and served at the rooftop lounge/restaurant. Although it was extremely hot, the rooftop had a nicely cooled A/C area and an open area with shade and lovely breezes. Cocktails were carefully prepared by Ugo and were delicious - we really enjoyed the extremely relaxing atmosphere on the roof! Our room was large and nicely furnished - the bed was extremely comfortable with high quality sheets. There are restaurants nearby and the front desk personnel gave us excellent recommendations. This hotel doesn't have every possible amenity but what they do have is extremely well-done with attention to detail. Thank you for a lovely stay, Hotel Montecarlo!

author: Maria S
title: Centrally located, great receptionists and overall great experience at hotel
text:
We stayed a total of 8 nights at the Hotel Montecarlo in Rome, Italy.  We were warmly greeted at Reception, and all the receptionists during our stay were knowledgeable and helpful.  Full breakfast included a full range of hot and cold items (scrambled eggs could have been a little warmer, but we have known only one hotel that was able to provide hot scrambled eggs during our many years of travel).  
We used their Bistro the first night we arrived for a wonderful pizza and wine.

It's an old hotel, but well maintained (absolutely love the elevator, which was always working!).  Very clean bathroom with a sauna feature which we weren't able to figure out but didn't miss anyway.  Only slight negative was the clearing space between the sink and the bathroom door - we're not large people, but you basically have to open the door, get in and then you have to close the door in order to access the sink.  Not insurmountable, just required maneuvering!

The bedroom was a good size for the two of us - particularly liked the wood flooring instead of less hygienic carpeting found in other hotels.

Within walking distance of many restaurants and Metro and Termini Train Station.

Overall, an excellent stay - we would stay here again.

author: Samantha A
title: Shocking - not the good kind.
text:
​Prospective guests should be extremely cautious before booking here.
​Our family stay was ruined by severe health and safety violations:
​Biological Hazard: Our room flooded with raw sewage (feces and urine) from the toilet, soaking into the carpet where my young children had to walk. No sanitization or footwear assistance was provided.
​Unauthorised Entry: Staff entered our locked room unannounced under the excuse of "refilling the minibar"— we stayed in two rooms and neither room had a mini bar so I am unsure how that is an excuse.
​Safety Risks: The replacement room offered to us contained chipped, broken glassware.
​Management will likely respond below by claiming they "addressed the situation" or offered loyalty points. 
Do not be misled: offering loyalty points for raw sewage and broken glass does not erase a severe public health hazard. Furthermore, the booking platform has already acknowledged the severity of these issues in writing and issued a cash refund directly from their own pocket due to the hotel’s refusal to take responsibility.
​The health, safety, and security of your family are not worth risking at this property.

author: Teni A
title: Valuable belongings disappeared from our room and the hotel’s response was appalling
text:
My three friends and I checked into Novotel Paris 17 on 19 June. Our initial check-in was pleasant, but the rest of our experience was extremely concerning and disappointing.

One of my friends had brought a very expensive pair of shoes with her. She did not wear them on the evening we arrived, the following day or on the Sunday. On the second day of our stay, we left the hotel at around 2pm. When we later returned, we were told that our room could not be cleaned because the housekeeping staff had already finished for the day.

The following morning, when my friend went to wear the shoes, we realised they were no longer in the room. We searched everywhere, turned the room upside down and checked every bag, cupboard and possible location, but they had disappeared.

We immediately reported this to reception and asked the hotel to investigate who had entered our room. The electronic door records showed that the housekeeping manager had accessed our room after we left at around 2pm.

The hotel later claimed that CCTV showed the housekeeping manager briefly opening the door and looking inside to check whether the room had been cleaned. This explanation made no sense to us because the room was not cleaned afterwards. We could not understand why an occupied guest room needed to be accessed simply to look inside, especially when we had been told that housekeeping had already finished.

When we explained the situation to the front-desk staff, they were rude, blunt, discouraging and completely unsympathetic. Instead of showing concern or reassuring us that the matter would be properly investigated, they blamed us for not putting the shoes in the safe. A pair of shoes would not reasonably fit inside a hotel safe, and guests should not be made to feel responsible when belongings disappear from a room that hotel staff have accessed.

The disappearance of our belongings was serious enough, but the rude and dismissive attitude of the front-desk staff made the situation even worse. We were treated as though we were at fault rather than guests reporting missing property from a room that hotel staff had accessed.

Despite the hotel confirming that a member of housekeeping management had entered our room, there appeared to be no serious or transparent investigation. There was no meaningful search for the shoes, no clear explanation and no practical support. We were simply told to report the matter to the police.

Unfortunately, the police were not very helpful, partly because of the language barrier, and appeared only to file the report.

After returning to our home country, I also discovered that my leather card holder was missing. It contained all of my bank cards, loyalty cards and membership cards. My ID was the only item not inside because I had removed it before going out.

We have since contacted customer service and escalated the matter to senior management, but we have received no satisfactory resolution or meaningful support.

I cannot personally prove who removed the missing belongings. However, the facts are that valuable items disappeared from our room, the hotel’s own records confirmed that a member of housekeeping management entered while we were away, and the hotel failed to conduct what we considered to be a proper investigation.

author: Sylvain M
title: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ An Excellent Stay – We Would Definitely Return!
text:
We had a wonderful stay at the André Latin Hotel. From the moment we arrived, we were welcomed with warmth and professionalism. The front desk staff are exceptionally kind and always willing to help. A special thank you to Joël and his daytime colleague, whose outstanding hospitality made our stay even more enjoyable.

As Canadians visiting Paris during the heatwave, we especially appreciated the air conditioning. Unlike many European hotels, it was powerful enough to keep the room very cool, and we loved being able to adjust the temperature ourselves. After a long day of walking in the Paris heat, it was a real luxury!

Our room was a comfortable size, very clean, and we never had any issues with hot water. Everything worked perfectly throughout our stay.

The only minor suggestion would be to add a little more variety to the breakfast. The food was fresh, tasty, and of good quality, but a wider selection would be appreciated, especially for guests staying several days.

The location is also excellent, just a short walk from the Luxembourg Gardens and in a wonderful neighborhood that's easy to explore on foot.

Thank you to the entire team for making our stay so enjoyable. We highly recommend the André Latin Hotel and will gladly stay here again on our next visit to Paris.

author: Lorenzo
title: Hotel Andre Latin
text: Hotel in a very convenient area of Paris, well connected especially to the RER and buses, and lively, full of restaurants and young people. The staff was very kind, especially all the guys at the reception. The room is very well-kept, with all the essentials. The breakfast is complete and satisfies everyone. An experience to repeat.

author: UrbanTeacher
title: Nice hotel, small rooms, in a great location in the 5th
text: I really liked this hotel. It was in a great location in the 5th, about a five minute walk from both the Luxembourg Gardens and the RER B (convenient for both airports), 10 minutes from the Pantheon, and about a 15-20 minute walk from Boulevard St-Germaine, and the fabulous Cluny Museum. The front desk staff were very friendly and helpful. The air conditioning in the room was good, which was important since I had a room on the 6th (top) floor. I'm only giving this hotel a 4 out of 5 (I'd give 4.5 if I could) because the rooms are very small, which isn't generally a problem for me, since I'm not a big person, but might be if you are tall. The bathroom was nice but very narrow, which means it might be a challenge for someone with long legs to use the toilet. I don't know if other rooms have larger bathrooms. Other than that, the room was comfortable. There were also a lot of restaurants/cafes nearby, so it was easy to find a local place to eat. I don't have an opinion about the breakfast since I didn't purchase it, as there were many cafes nearby.

author: SheisS65
title: Please do not book this hotel during hot weather (summer months), as no adequate aircon
text: This is a really nice small hotel well located very near Kings Cross. I stayed in a small double room, with the following facilities: hairdryer, two shelves - one with tea/coffee facilities, safe, large under bed space for luggage, wall mounted bed lights, extra blankets, openable window, nice clean shower room with lovely soap and shower gel, and a great shower, with removable shower head, and space for shampoo etc, shaver sockets, heated towel rail. However, the shelves didn't really provide much room, the sink also had little space for anything but toothpaste and a toothbrush, there was a traditional key that you had to hand in each time you left the building (!), you had to knock on the door to be kept in in the evening (!), and my room was up some narrow winding stairs. But the worst part was (and this is the reason for my rating): I understand that this is unusual, but I arrived in the middle of a heatwave in London - temp around 30 degrees every day. Even with heavy curtains blocking the window, and a rotating wall fan, the room was just too hot, and my level of comfort during my stay was virtually zero. I maybe slept for a couple of hours in a row interrupted by wakening due to the heat each night. It was pretty exhausting. A rotating fan is totally inadequate for this temperature. I ended up having to dampen a couple of towels to lie on during the night, couldn't even wear my short jammies! What's worse is that I was there to attend two concerts at Tottenham Hotspur stadium that required a lengthy walk to the underground station after a very long day queuing in the heat, both nights, and the thing I really needed was some good sleep. I would not book a room here during summer months again, given climate predictions. If you're used to that level of heat, then go ahead, but I imagine that most people who live in hot countries who can afford a trip to London are probably used to nice cold Aircon! My advice is that if you are staying in London during June, July, or August, only book a hotel with proper Aircon. Even if you have to pay a lot more. If not, you'll just be exhausted, having had no proper sleep for the length of your stay. I'm sorry to have to give this review, because the price was reasonable for the location, staff were friendly and helpful, and the room would have been fine in any other weather conditions.

author: Veronique M

The downside is the bathroom is very small no small shelf to put toiletries that is what is missing in the bathroom. Very comfortable bedding. author: Jill B
title: Convénient for Kings X and St Pancras
text:
Small room, small 4 ft 6 bed up against 1 wall . Slightly below Street level, no lift 
,down steep stairs but young reception staff were very helpful . Fortunately it was cool in the basement and a window with a fan light that opened. Clean and fine for 1 night. No breakfast but plenty of choice nearby and at the stations. Reasonable price for London.

author: Stephen Matthews
title: Great stop for travellers
text: Picked this hotel for its proximity to Kings Cross/St Pancras - just a few minutes’ walk. Perfectly good for a two-night stay. Room was up 30-plus stairs - no lift and a task with a suitcase, but desk staff offered to help. Staff were great generally. The room was small and had a single bed, which was all I needed. There are spaces where you can slide bags etc to keep floor clear. The ensuite was modern and did the job. The free daily cookie was welcome, and the complimentary bottles of still and fizzy water were a godsend as the temperature passed 34C. The cooling was by fan, which helped but struggled with the heat. It’s a very busy part of town so expect noise from outside if you’re facing the road, or if Arsenal have just won the league. Was very grateful to be able to leave my luggage in storage after checking out. Recommended as a stopover for travellers.

author: Cheltenham Camper
title: Brilliant Hotel
text:
Spent three nights here with my daughter. The hotel was really easy to get to from the Gare du Nord, just a 10 minute walk. The staff were so friendly and welcoming when we arrived and throughout our stay. The room was spotlessly clean, the en suite was modern and the beds comfortable. 
We loved the courtyard garden and the fact it was so close a metro. It made getting to the Louvre, Pont Neuf and Montmatre really easy. 
The area the hotel is in, is a little run down and the view from the window wasn't the most picturesque but we would definitely stay there again.

author: Denis C

author: askin e

author: Gabriela G
title: Unsanitary bathroom conditions
text:
We stayed at Avalon Hotel Paris Gare du Nord for one night after having a great experience at Avalon Cosy Hotel earlier in our trip. Unfortunately, this stay was a huge disappointment.

After my husband showered, we discovered the shower drain was severely clogged. Water pooled in the shower and eventually drained, bringing up black debris, hair, and other unsanitary material. Every time we used the bathroom sink, dirty water backed up into the shower again. It was clearly a maintenance issue that should have been caught before the room was rented.

The front desk staff were polite and genuinely tried to help. A staff member attempted to fix the drain, but the problem remained. We were told no comparable rooms were available, and the only alternative was for me to use the shower in a different room.

What disappointed us most was the lack of response afterward. I emailed management with photos and videos documenting the issue and even followed up weeks later, but never received any acknowledgment.

It's unfortunate because we had such a positive experience at Avalon Cosy Hotel. The front desk staff deserve credit, but the condition of the room and the complete lack of follow-up from management left a very poor impression.

author: Catherine T
title: It was okay.

10 € for breakfast was not worth it.... Getting such hard baguette in the middle of Paris is quite an achievement!

author: cocolatte76

Also easy to reach the top sights.

author: goertzjp

author: Toni A
title: Horrible
text:
Stay away at all costs. We booked through booking.com. The manager, Oscar. Would not reimburse us for a tour booked with Viator that we missed because our safe would not open. They claimed they had to get a technician only to have the cook come 30 minutes later with a key. Oscar advised us that because we left a bad review on trip advisor there is nothing he can do. I took the review off but am reinstating it. I waited for the director, a Mr Rosen to call me to no avail. Booking.com reached out for a resolution and was unable to find a suitable solution. 
Please do not stay. They do not honour guests.

author: Mella
title: Spend the extra money if you can for a private bathroom and a good night sleep
text:
If you're looking for a place in a good location that doesn't break the bank, this would be reasonable. But the rooms are so small and tight you can barely move.

Plus, you can hear every single little thing as the cubicles are so close together, and you can hear people's footsteps, coughing, and peoples' conversations in the common areas and bathroom. So if you want to get a good night sleep, this is not the place. I was lucky to have gone back to sleep, but I was woken up by so much noise (and I'm not talking about the noise that you would hear in the city like from sirens, cars, honking, and just overall city noise), but noise from my my room.

Plus I had to walk up 5 flights of stairs to get to my room. Check-in is on the fourth floor. I did not know any of this. I wish there was an elevator because I had my stuff to bring up and down the stairs while checking in and checking out.

The good thing was that I always felt safe here, since they give you a key to get into the front door, as well as a key for your room. Check-in process was very easy and smooth, as well as checkout. The staff were nice and pleasant,!and the other guests were polite, but it came down to not having a good night rest, and peace and quiet, especially at night. Plus not a ton of space to move. 

I woke up with a terrible headache the next morning from being woken up to all of the noise coming from my floor, even though the hotel reinforces quiet and they have quiet hours. You can still hear everything.

Breakfast is very minimal and bathrooms are so tight. The stall is only one stall and the sinks had other peoples' hair on it. They do have a hair dryer that is high speed and works well, but would not recommend trying to get ready there because you are sharing space with everyone else on your floor. And if no one happens to be in the bathroom while you were trying to blow dry or curl your hair, then you're all set, but you can't count on that.

Overall, try to find another place to stay.
Even though this is a really fair price, and you can't beat this kind of price in Manhattan. I would not be staying here again.

author: Joey
title: AVOID
text: I haven’t been able to sleep well during my stay and decided to rearrange my trip by canceling and flew back home early. Only way I was able to get a full nights rest was by sleeping around 3-5am. You can hear and feel when people walk by. To stop someone from snoring, one of the staff members will knock until the snorer stops… This will also wake up others. What was supposed to be a peaceful trip quickly reminded me most ppl wont care if they disturb others as long as they find something affordable.

author: Lol L
title: Great friendly staff
text: Very very friendly staff like sunny. Loved the whole stay. Got more than what I expected. Suitable pricing for center of Manhattan.

author: Alex Y
title: Great and convenient stay
text: Great location, 2 minute walk from Penn Station and MSG. You can go anywhere in a very quick time. Continental breakfast was super useful and the staff were extremely friendly!!! Super fair price for the location, especially in Manhattan. Would come here again if I had to. I want to thank Sunny for being so courteous and friendly!

author: Victoria M
title: Better than New York itself
text: Thank you Sunny for an amazing stay in New York. Affordable, homey and great people! Thank you for feeding us every morning, too!

author: Mattia B
title: Let's not even go there
text:
Really ugly place. Old, cold rooms and mattresses as hard as concrete. Small and dysfunctional bathroom. Poor and limited breakfast, only English breakfast available. 
The only saving grace is the location, near the subway.

author: Ems D
title: My BDay Vacation in London
text: We had a wonderful stay at this hotel. The room was clean, comfortable, and well maintained. The staff were friendly, welcoming, and always ready to help. The location was convenient near in subway and bus lines. it was an excellent experience, and we would happily stay here again. Highly recommended!

author: M-C B
title: Good value for money for London!
text:
We spent 3 nights at the Gresham Hotel and, overall, we are satisfied with our stay. The hotel is very well located, a few minutes from Paddington, which is really convenient for visiting London.

The rooms are small, but that is quite standard in London. They are clean, decent, and sufficient for a city trip. The bed was a bit soft for our taste, but we still slept well.

The staff is really very welcoming and helpful, always with a smile.

The breakfast is simple but gets the job done: English breakfast every morning, some pastries (pre-packaged), cereals, hot drinks… The selection is not huge, but it is decent. The breakfast room is in the basement and can be a bit noisy. The hotel's soundproofing could also be improved.

In summary, a simple hotel, well located and with very good value for money to discover London. We would return there without a problem.

author: karenmay1002018
title: Enter at your own RISK!!
text: Location ok, the place itself is so bad, never ever have we been in anything like it, after 3 room changes we settled with the best but is far from the best, the place is smelly, dirty, falling to bits, it should never be trading, please don't go there, worst experience in our lives.

author: Francesca M
title: Pleasant stay and cleanliness top
text:
I stayed for 5 nights with my boyfriend in this hotel. Its location is excellent, just minutes from the metro, TESCO supermarket, MC, various souvenir shops and where you can eat. The staff is present h24 in the reception. Cleanliness is great, towels are changed daily and milks redone and arranged.
The only downside is that the master bedroom was very small and was located in an area of the hotel where noises were heard all the time, making rest a bit difficult. The bathroom was quite large and functional, with hot shower and hairdryer.

author: cathy971
title: Pleasant
text: A very pleasant welcome A clean hotel a cozy terrace

author: Clare G
title: Great location
text: As previously mentioned in other people's reviews we found the room cosy, fine if you dont have much luggage to store away,but no where to store larger luggage. There are no fridges within the room should you need one. The mattress were quite hard. Great air condition lovely to come back to a cool room after a day in Paris. Location really good easy to get into the city by either bus or metro, both a few minutes walk away. Lots of food choices on the doorstep and a supermarket a short walk away. Lovely quiet neighborhood.

author: Lisa J
title: Best air con.
text: I only stayed at this hotel because after researching online extensively, I realised that the air con in Paris hotels can be hit and miss. With temperatures high at the moment, I didnt want my trip ruined by a hot hotel room.  After staying at this hotel for 4 nights I can indeed confirm that the air condition was suberb, in fact it was so cold at points that i had to adjust it and turn the temperature up. Other than that, it was comfortable, clean, the bed and bedding was good quality. But if you are looking to get out of the heat then go to the Apolonia.

author: Evelyne
title: We keep coming back here.
text: We have already been here 14 times. Stayed in this cozy hotel and will come back again and again. It is located at the foot of Montmartre and is a wonderful starting point for exploring Paris. The hotel team is super friendly and attentive. We were especially taken with Tina and Gabriela, who brightened every moment for us with their warmth. Thanks to the entire team!

author: Azeddine I
title: Excellent experience
text:
Excellent stay at the Apolonia Montmartre hotel! The location is ideal for discovering the Montmartre district and the main sites of Paris. The room was clean, comfortable, and quiet, which made our stay very pleasant. The staff is welcoming, smiling, and always available to help. We also appreciated the proximity to the subway and the quality of the breakfast. I recommend this hotel without hesitation and I will gladly return during my next stay in Paris.

Azzeddine and all the friends.
Room 102.

author: lrvarone
title: Our No. One Choice
text: The staff at the hotel is very friendly and helpful, this is especially true for Sergio at the front desk.  For all four stays at your hotel (over the past five years), he has always gone out of his way to be extremely helpful with suggestions that have made our stay in Paris all the more enjoyable.  Sergio is one of the major reasons that return to the Hotel Muguet year after year.

author: Robert S
title: Splendid Muguet
text: A  golden 3-Star gem which is a bit like our home away from home which brings us back!  We have stayed here numerous times over the past 1 !/2 decades simply because it is consistently clean, quiet, and staffed by those who focus on superb service.  Sergio is the exemplar of FINE SERVICE!

author: rpatta
title: Pleasant stay in a setting that is still human.
text: Very welcoming hotel with very pleasant staff, Sergio in particular, not to mention the other staff members.

author: Laura E
title: Incredible find in Paris
text: I was traveling eventually to Lamotte Beuvron for a horse competition and took the opportunity to visit Paris and Bruge before heading south.  I picked Hôtel Muguet because of the location but was pleasantly surprised with what a find it was and great value for the money.

author: Eamk
title: August
text: My 2nd time here. Always a great stay! Location is excellent, Sergio is just fantastic and the rooms are wonderful!

author: Rosemary B
title: Happy travelers
text:
We stayed for 16 nights. August 2026.

The hotel is beautiful and perfectly situated for visiting all the wonderful sights of Paris. 

Suggest using uber to get around. They arrive fast , and they are cheaper than taxis. 

The hotel staff were brilliant and helpful and so very friendly. 

Highly recommend for one night or a longer visit.

author: brianne a
title: Nice would stay again
text: Hôtel was clean and in a good location. Was offered complimentary coffee and croissant when checked in. Was also able to leave our bags as we got in early. And were able to have early check in.

author: Jennifer S
title: Lovely stay for a quick visit to Notre Dame
text: Wonderful experience with this charming hotel. Staff were friendly and extremely helpful in securing shuttle service to and from the hotel/train/airport. Easy walk to Notre Dame. Nice-sized room (by Paris standards) with a petite balcony, mini fridge & safe. Highly recommended!

author: Kateryna B
title: Perfect experience
text: The service was excellent; we received a friendly welcome, and the staff were very attentive. Special thanks to Sebastian ️ The rooms are comfortable, and the location is great, with parking and plenty of places to eat nearby. You can cycle to the Tower in 20 minutes. We will definitely be back—thank you to the hotel for taking such good care of us.

author: McHaggis69
title: A great little hotel in a wonderful location
text:
This little hotel is a fantastic base to explore Paris.
It sits in a quiet street in the Latin quarter just around 10 minutes walk from Notre Dame. We booked the balcony room on the 2nd floor and it was really nice. A small room, but with everything we needed - fridge, desk, balcony with table and chairs. The bathroom was clean and fully equipped with kits like toothbrush, shaving etc.

The staff were all super-friendly with us.

As a base, its in a fantastic spot just minutes from many, many bars and restaurants. Notre Dame is just a short walk as are the tour buses and the Seinne itself.

We couldn’t find any fault to be honest. We took breakfast one morning and it was a decent selection of pastries, eggs, cold meat etc. All good and we’d certainly consider returning to the same hotel if we come back to Paris.

author: vadrouillex
title: Incredible value for money
text:
I was able to get a single room for 65 euros, an incredible price for this three-star hotel that offers small, but very clean and quite well-equipped rooms.
A courtesy tray is provided. The air conditioning is effective (I preferred to turn it off!).
The welcome is friendly (rare in Paris!).

author: daphneemorvan80
title: Hôtel 55 Montparnasse
text: Everything was perfect, I highly recommend it. The staff is pleasant and the hotel room is similar to the photos

author: lucaJ9356SO
title: bref
text: We had problems with our AC and it didn't seem like a priority problem to the staff even tho we mentioned it several times and where very nice about it. They told us they would fix it but we didn't hear a check up after  we needed to mention it several times they didn't even compensate it with something. It was very warm, in our room it went up to 30 degreees. only on te last night they changed our rooms, i don't do reviews normally but this was necessary.

author: Mathieu C
title: Not the best, but it gets the job done.
text: Given the price and category, I expected better. Small room, struggling air conditioning, a lot of noise from neighboring rooms.

author: abetra990012
title: Unacceptable.
text:
We were apparently overbooked, and instead of notifying us in advance, We were informed that we are in another nearby hotel in a room of the same category. 
While this room was smaller, older, and there was no continental breakfast at this hotel, and the street was busier.
No discount was offered. 
I was very disappointed.

author: Valeria V
title: Very nice and well-kept hotel, with some small reservations
text:
I stayed with my children at the Hotel Magenta during a trip to Paris in August and we had a very good time. The hotel is really nice, very clean, and recently modernized. Our triple room was definitely more spacious than the average Parisian room: it had two large windows overlooking the Boulevard de Magenta and a small, but brand new and very functional bathroom.

Also much appreciated was the possibility of having hot and cold drinks available for free, as well as a small outdoor space at the back, pleasant for a break during the day.

Two less positive notes. The Boulevard de Magenta is a very beautiful and convenient area, but in the evening hours the people frequenting the street make returning to the hotel a little less peaceful, especially for those traveling with children. Furthermore, we were asked for 15 euros to be able to check in just an hour before the scheduled time: a request that I found a bit excessive, considering the very small margin.

Overall, however, we liked the hotel and I consider it a good solution for staying in Paris, especially for the cleanliness, the care of the rooms, and the quality of the room.

author: Rob C
title: This is a good one
text: We have had a amazing and awesome stay , I was clean , and the staff were amazing and excellent Sophie was the standout helped with all our needs and our requests and even gave us excellent places to eat. My only recommendation would be is to bring your own corkscrew as France is the only place still using Cork for their wine bottles🤣🤣🤣🇬🇧🇫🇷🇦🇺

author: Daire
title: Perfect for a weekend in Paris
text: Super Hotel. Located close to metro & train stations. Lots of restaurants and cafes in the area. Clean and comfortable rooms. Very friendly and helpful staff. Highly recommended and will definitely return again.

author: Doris K
title: Convenient location in a good hotel
text:
Everything was very good and comfortable- the room was small but perfect for 1 person. Comfortable bed and I liked specifically the shower floor - you can’t slip- perfect. 
The people who worked at the Reception are super friendly and accommodating- very good experience in this Hotel. Will recommend it

author: jp c
title: Practical option near the main train stations
text: Cheap and cheerful option if you are needing somewhere close to the main train stations. Rooms are basic, but have all the things you need for a nice Paris stay; and the water pressure in the bathroom is good by parisian standards. Our room had  lovely view over courtyard.

author: Traci S
title: Great boutique hotel. Friendly staff. Great location.
text: Nice boutique hotel. They were able to accommodate us with an handicap room and my husband was on a walker. It was in a really great neighborhood with many restaurants within walking distance. The metro was close by (metro not handicap friendly) but the bus a op was also close by which was. The staff was very friendly. I would recommend bringing your own soaps but everything else was on point and great. They had some breakfast breads available every morning or you could pay for a full buffet breakfast which was also great. We enjoyed our stay immensely and would recommend again.  Thanks to the entire staff.

author: Jolyon S
title: Touring Paris?  Touring Hotel.
text:
We got there early, so the room wasn't ready - which wasn't a surprise.
Lovely welcoming reception and the lobby is delightful.
We were able to leave our cases in there as we walked around the city.
The necessary lift is comically small but functional.
The room was OK.  Lovely big bathroom.  Nicely and completely tiled.  Very nearly done.

Would we stay there again?  YES.  Great location, friendly hotel staff.  Clean and tidy.

Do it. 👍🏿

author: Vera G
title: Paris optimal!
text: A small hotel ideally located to get around Paris by bus or metro , there are 3 metro accesses in the immediate vicinity, as well as bus stops for all distances and sights. Room small but very cozy and clean plus a pretty modern bathroom. Breakfast sweet or salty, all there. I would definitely like to come back!!

author: Björn Z
title: Very nice experience.
text: Nice and clean with good service and friendly staff.

author: Vanessa D
title: Hotel well placed with helpful staff
text:
Professional stay of 7 nights.
Good value hotel in the heart of Paris in a quiet street and in a pleasant area near the main boulevards and a few hundred meters from the metro. Spacious room and bathroom with bathtub, classic decoration.
Breakfast is very complete and diverse (with omelet or pancake proposal). A dedication to the very helpful and pleasant staff.

author: GRMY64
title: Central hotel in New York.
text: The strength of this hotel is its central location: next to the Empire State Building, a fifteen-minute walk from Times Square, and a subway station with several lines is located 30 seconds from the hotel door. Numerous shops and restaurants all around the hotel. Very pleasant reception and quick check-in. Large, clean, and well-equipped room, notably with the presence of a fridge. Housekeeping and towel changes are done every day. Classic breakfast, but it will suit most people. We never had a problem finding a spot. Coffee and tea available throughout the day. Effective Wi-Fi and very quiet hotel. Two minor drawbacks: the room faced a wall, and the wait for the elevator can be a bit long at certain times. A hotel that we recommend.

author: MECruzGon
title: Great location
text:
The hotel has an excellent location, making it very convenient to visit many of the city’s main attractions. It is within walking distance of both a subway station and Penn Station, which made getting around extremely easy.

The staff was friendly and accommodating throughout my stay. Upon arrival, I discovered that the air conditioning in my room was not cooling properly. The team handled the situation promptly and courteously by moving me to another room.

Areas for improvement would be customer service responsiveness and the breakfast offerings. While requests were eventually addressed, a faster response time would enhance the overall guest experience. Regarding breakfast, the menu remained exactly the same each day. Although I understand that the selection is limited, adding some variety—such as pancakes, fresh fruit, or different protein options—would make the breakfast experience much more enjoyable for guests staying multiple days.

Overall, we had a pleasant stay and would consider staying here again due to the excellent location and helpful staff.

author: Jim
title: Great Overnight Experience
text: A quick overnight with friends at a centrally located hotel. Great, friendly, staff.  Surprisingly large rooms for Manhattan - very clean, comfortable, quiet. Decent breakfast too. Couldn't ask for more!

author: paulina3107
title: PLEASANT HOTEL FOR A SHORT CITY BREAK
text:
We enjoyed our stay at the Stanford Hotel.
Basic rooms with all necessary facilities available. Comfortable beds, decent bathrooms, free safe and free breakfast. We didn’t enjoy the food and ended up eating out. 
The best thing about this hotel was its price and location. 
It is close to the all the transport links and main sightseeing points within the 5th Avenue.  
I have requested a room on the higher floors due to traffic noise and was given room on the 11th floor. 
Overall a great hotel for a short city break!

author: Pascal C
title: Very pleasant stay at the Stanford Hotel in New York.
text:
Very pleasant stay at the Stanford Hotel in New York.
The staff was particularly professional, welcoming, and available throughout the stay.
The room was of high quality, clean, and comfortable, with impeccable services.
The included breakfast was also very enjoyable before heading out to explore the city.
The hotel's location is very convenient for visiting Manhattan and quickly accessing different neighborhoods.
A very good experience that I recommend without hesitation.

author: Heike M
title: Average hotel in a good location.
text:
The location is super, it is quiet and clean. 
We had a very dark room on the 1st. Floor. 
Things were crumbling off everywhere.
The breakfast was overpriced and always the same. 
We have been to Paris many times and have always had 3-star hotels that were all a bit better. 
The price-performance ratio is not right.

author: iromasa
title: For those who are content
text: You do not expect much indeed! Everything ''spartan'' from breakfast to amenities. The ''green'' policy and the fight against waste has reduced the cleaning of the room no longer daily and the accessories in the bathroom so ''forget'' the conveniences (no wardrobes, mini mini desks, no mini bar). Ah breakfast: very little variety for which you have to settle. Good location and satisfactory staff Fine for those who settle.

author: paolo r
title: Family in Paris
text:
Family trip , three with their 17-year-old daughter .
 Very clean hotel , strategically perfect for Metro travel .
Located near Montmatre, in fact you can 'go safely on foot.
  We recommend it

author: Eric B
title: Nice hotel near Gare du Nord
text: Nice room, but the fallacious term of ecology is everywhere.... Not to mention the principle of economy! All this to avoid making the room five days in a row.   It is on request! Not the bed, not the bathroom. Good breakfast. Great location!

author: Paolo C
title: Gare du Nord within walking distance, but quiet area
text:
The area is very well served by public transport; 5 minutes walk to Gare du Nord and 10 minutes Metro Poissonnière.
The premises are well soundproofed, very warm and in reception they were very helpful. Breakfast at 18 € per person seems excessive but I do not judge the service as I have not used it; there is a very nice bar 30 meters away.
In a 4-star hotel, however, as is customary in France without a bidet, it is not possible not to clean the room, not to clean the services and not to change the towels for 4 days; perhaps it is a paid service to be requested at the time of booking? It seems to me that the subject of ecology is being used today increasingly as an excuse to omit certain services. In the context, however, positive stay.

author: IrishSurfer
title: Well situated in London, great staff, and on a quiet street with easy walk to stations and restaurants.
text: The Princes Square Hotel is a lovely, clean, and safe hotel that is centrally located in London with two nearby stations within a 5 minute walk, Bayswater and Queensway.  Super convenient if you are taking trains to anywhere.   On this same street as the underground there are a variety of nice restaurants, a pharmacy, and stores that are popular with the locals.  The beds were blessedly comfortable and the shower in the bathroom was easy to use.  The whole hotel was well maintained both inside and out.  All the staff were very helpful and professional.  We dragged ourselves through the front door after a harried day of travel.  The front desk not only gave us a very nice room, but he also carried our luggage to our room to make things easier.  There is an elevator in the building, but he felt we would be more comfortable on the ground floor.  He was right and it was a really nice room.  They have a 24 hour front desk person if you need anything.

author: carolina v
title: “Our Parcel Went Missing and Was Returned Opened
text:
Our experience at this hotel was extremely disappointing.

A parcel sent to us was successfully delivered to the hotel reception. The courier company confirmed the delivery with GPS tracking and a delivery photo clearly showing the parcel at the front desk. Despite this, the hotel repeatedly told us they could not find it, and we had to insist for several days for them to investigate.

The parcel was eventually returned to us, but it had been opened. Our personal mail had been tampered with without our knowledge or permission, which is completely unacceptable. Although all the clothing was inside, we have no way of knowing whether the items were handled or used while the parcel was missing.

What was even more disappointing was the complete lack of involvement from hotel management. Despite the seriousness of the situation, the manager never spoke to us or came to address the issue. All communication was through a receptionist, and we never received a proper explanation or an apology.

If you are planning to stay at this hotel and expect to receive parcels or important deliveries, I strongly recommend being extremely cautious. Based on our experience, I cannot trust the way guests’ belongings and deliveries are handled.

author: caccolaemicrocaccolaetonnetta
title: Proper hotel
text: This hotel is really nice and quaint. We had a really good time. The staff is very friendly and welcoming. The rooms are very nice, equipped with all amenities. The cleaning service is excellent. The location of the hotel is great, with nearby restaurants, bars, supermarkets. I have to write a super positive note for the bed which is of extreme comfort. I really recommend this property. Thank you.

author: Go590346
title: Watch Your Belongings
text:
I visited the hotel for four nights in February. A brand new, quality shoe polish brush that I had bought and taken to the hotel disappeared from my room, the only persons to have had access to it being myself and the housekeeping staff. I reported this to the front desk and asked them to speak to housekeeping, but to no avail. I can only conclude that this hotel employs dishonest, untrustworthy cleaning staff. Lock up any item of value. 
The only (and tiny) window in the room had been badly installed and rainwater had seeped from the outside into the plasterboard, causing paint to peel in two places. See pictures. This is really sloppy maintenance.
As there was no heat in the bathroom and it was February I had to forego my morning shower. Also, please be aware that there is minimal sound insulation between floors, making for a noisy hotel. Keep earplugs with you. 
Finally, the TV channel, on which I was trying to watch a murder mystery, displayed an annoying pop-up that could not be permanently removed from the screen and moved from one side to the other at random. It was so distracting I had to give up watching. See picture.
This hotel is poorly run and maintained and, despite its good location, I will stay elsewhere from now on.
