author: InesCarreto
title: Lovely stay 3 nights
text: Very beautifull,cosy, friendly hotel. Kind staff and very good location. 4 min walking to bayswater station. Good breakfast.

author: francesnicole18
title: Pleasant stay
text: Perfect location located in the city center but not crowded,a bit quieter. The hotel has aircondition, beds are comfortable, clean and they have 24 hours reception.Special shout out to Brian the night reception he was very accomodating, he gave us all the information we needed, and Rudy the housekeeping he was helpful.Good value for money includes breakfast. Many thanks

author: Sue C
title: Good budget hotel.
text:
Good budget hotel with basic facilities but you don't really need anything else in Rome because you are.out.all day. Breakfast was basic but adequate and you could have as much as you want.
It is in a good location and not far from the termini. We travelled on the Metro which was easy to navigate. Ask reception for a map and which line to access for different destinations. It's really quick and fairly cheap. 
Would stay here again.

author: Lynette Mc Eneaney
title: Once in Rome is enough.
text:
Lovely hotel. Rooms basic but clean. Beds were very hard, which I like but my daughter found them very uncomfortable.
Breakfast was ok  but it would have been nice to offer a variety of fruit. Only apples and oranges. Staff were really nice but didn't know about the lovely restaurants  just across the road. 
Taxis are a total rip off.

author: tina_small
title: Read all reviews before booking
text:
Do read all about this hotel before booking
Positives
Clean 
Friendly staff
That’s it
Never before have we experienced a breakfast like it.  You cannot help yourself.  Very limited choices 
Room so dated   
We felt we had to take taxis to get to anywhere 
Would not go back to this hotel

author: Fraser G
title: Great stay
text: This hotel.was really quite remarkable.  A former convent with the reception having direct access to the beaitiful Bascillica of santa Croce directly access from the hotel. Staff were wonderfully friendly.  Typical continental breakfast served by warm, welcoming staff. Hotel.is handy for Lodl metro station, trams.and buses. Easy access to the rest of the city. Next time I'm in Rome I'll definitely stay here.

author: ivetteastacio
title: Not worth it in my opinion…
text:
I booked this hotel at a higher price because of its location right on Via del Corso, so I was very disappointed to find out upon arrival that our room was actually in a separate building away from the main hotel. This building did not feel like part of the hotel at all, yet we were charged the same price. Unfortunately, the experience did not match what we expected for the price.

The bathroom was quite rundown and had visible mold, which was especially disappointing as it is a health issue. On our last day, the air conditioning was turned off or it stopped working completely. The room became extremely hot and humid, making it very uncomfortable to stay there. I called reception, and they sent someone to restart the AC, but the room never properly cooled down.

Because of the heat, I struggled to fall asleep until very early in the morning. We had an early trip the next day, so this really affected the end of our stay, my daughter’s birthday and left us exhausted and irritated.

I usually try to find something positive to say about the hotels I stay at, but unfortunately, this experience was so disappointing. The location is great, but given the price and the overall condition and comfort of the accommodation we received, I don’t feel it offered good value for money. I sadly don’t recommend this hotel, check for reviews in other locations.

author: Carole M
title: Horrible
text: Despite a confirmed reservation since May for a 12:30 PM lunch at the garden rooftop and without any communication from the hotel, we were shuffled from floor to floor to be told that the rooftop did not open until 4:00 PM

author: Pjulie54
title: Central hotel
text: We have just come home from a 2 day visit, the accommodation was clean.  Staff friendly.  The hotel is very central just what we wanted for our short visit, the Spanish steps no more than 5 minute walk.  Lots of restaurants and shopping on the doorstep.  Would definitely stay again

author: Pioneer33917258559
title: Excellent Excellent Excellent
text:
Fantastic hotel in the best location in Rome. 
With a winning team and large and spacious rooms , a bomb air conditioner , no noise from the main street as soon as you close the windows . We were in the wing and the stunning Weldy , a safe, bright and pleasant entrance . 
All first close winner! 
I wish everyone to enjoy how much we had here. 
Welcome to Hotel Mozart, Rome 
We will go back to visit. 
🩷

author: Aga G
title: Unwelcome choice
text: The rooftop is a very nice place. But the change of the Coca-Cola from 33 cl to 20 cl at the same price is unacceptable

author: Luke C
title: Unfortunately wouldn’t stay again
text:
Room itself was in poor condition. The shower head was broken and wouldn’t stay in its holder. One of the plug sockets was hanging out of the wall exposing wires. Several of the light switches didn’t work. Noise levels were terrible, we was unaware they would be completing refurbishment in the hotel therefore hammering and drilling woke us up at 8am every morning. The upside of the room was that the bed was extremely comfy. On our final morning, we had staff walk into our room 3 times, twice without knocking, around 8am, then 10am and 11am, despite check out not being until 12!
Good location, easy underground routes to central London. It’s worth knowing that security staff will question you where you are going if you get back to your room after hours, but this is to be expected as it’s located inside the grounds of the football stadium.

author: Robin B
title: Awful again
text:
Once again disappointing 
Come here again as Chelsea my fave place being a life long supporter every time it’s a disappointment and don’t reply for me to contact someone cause that’s a farce they never get back to you 
Once again over zealous security trying to limits my access and genuinely rude 
Heater of hotel room on the hottest day of the year had me wondering if air con was working 
I’ve had some disaster stays here and as much as I love Chelsea this will be my last

author: Safiah S
title: The place and the people can make you happy or they can ruin your time.
text:
The accommodation is lovely. All the staff are wonderful and friendly, especially the on-duty manager (Habiba). She is incredibly kind, friendly, and sophisticated in her dealings. She is also very responsive, calm, and extremely respectful. 
All the staff were friendly and responsive from the first day I arrived at this hotel, except for the duty manager (Maria). Her treatment was absolutely terrible, unbelievable. 
I extend my sincere thanks and gratitude to the duty manager, Habiba. She is an exemplary and respectful employee who deserves all the appreciation and respect. I was delighted and reassured by her presence and her pleasant and comfortable manner. With her around, I regained my comfort and relaxation, and I will spend enjoyable and pleasant days during my stay with her and her assistance. Thank you, Habiba, from the bottom of my heart.

author: Theresa
title: Excellent!
text: We were so impressed with the care and kindness shown during our daughter’s stay. Our 19-year-old daughter was staying at the hotel throughout her internship in the city when she became unwell. Neal and Maria took such great care of her and really put our minds at ease, especially as we were not nearby. Communication was excellent throughout, and the level of care and attention they showed was exceptional. We are incredibly grateful and would highly recommend this hotel.

author: Tony F
title: Another fantastic visit to Stamford Bridge
text: Some places always deliver, no matter the occasion or the individuals present at the time of your stay. Fortunately for my Son and I, The Stamford Bridge Hotel (formerly Millennium & Copthorne at Chelsea F.C.) is just such a venue. Having decided that a night in Chelsea would be the ideal culmination of a few days travelling about England, once again our choice of venue did not disappoint. Having stayed in this hotel a number of times in the past, we hoped that we would experience the kind and friendly welcome that had been extended to us previously. This visit would not disappoint. No football this time, just somewhere to have a bite to eat and a couple of rooms in the grounds of the young fella's favourite Premier League team. From the moment we arrived in reception to be greeted by Habibe and her front of house Team of Izedora and Ayoade, we were made feel welcome and valued. Ayoade explained that there was extensive renovations ongoing, which did not concern us in the slightest. Having been given information regarding an offer that was available at the time and providing details of the location of the rooms, we headed to the 2nd/3rd floors respectively. We had opted for Superior rooms and these were spacious, well appointed and extremely comfortable, with ample tea/coffee/biscuits to allow us catch up on stone TV before heading to the bar for a bite to eat. The menu may not have been extensive, however, it was varied and extremely well priced, considering the location and the somewhat captive audience. We both opted for the Calamari to start and a Pepperoni Pizza as the main offering, accompanied by J2O and excellent quality lattes, served by another dynamic duo of Prajjwal and Anamika,  who along with Sujit at breakfast, completed the triumvirate of Nepali natives that we met and, thanks to each of them, it was easy to see why the people of the Roof of the World are considered amongst the warmest and friendliest you will meet anywhere. Following our evening meal we bumped into the fabulous Habibe once more and this time she introduced us to DM Neal. Having met before, some time ago, it was like a reunion and Neal took time out of his crazy schedule to explain the renovations, the changes to the hotel and to assure us that whatever we needed we need only ask. After a good night's sleep breakfast in the 55 restaurant was tasty, hot where required and varied in the buffet-style offering. The aforementioned Sujit along with Mamata were attentive, friendly and professional throughout, ensuring we had everything we needed to provide the perfect kick-start to the day. Which left checkout and the only change to the front of house Team from the night before being the arrival of Kalkidan as a late substitution for Ayoade. I can assure you this was in no way detrimental to the team and to our overall experience as, once again, we were treated every bit as well on departure as we had been on arrival. So, yet another visit to Stamford Bridge and it's hotel was over. However, we still had time to visit the club shop followed by an hour in the adjacent Tea Bar, which turned out to be a highlight of the entire visit to London. Again the coffees, one latte and one iced mocha, were excellent and the prices were, once more,  extremely reasonable, but it was the pleasure of meeting Adriana that made the visit so memorable. We were regaled with reminiscences of Adriana's 20-odd years of association with Chelsea FC. This was such an enjoyable way to end our 22 hours in West London and all of the people mentioned made our sojourn much more enjoyable than it might otherwise have been. Thank you, Stamford Bridge Hotel, 55 Restaurant and The Tea Bar. We will be back... You have been warned!! TF & AF.

author: WDbxl
title: Freshly appointed rooms and kind welcome but facilities could use more care.
text:
Kind welcome from the front desk team and clean, recently refreshed facilities. The welcome amenity and note for my status with Accor was a treat.

On the flip side; the aircon did not work suitably well in our room, the shower  temperature varied quite widely from hot to cold without adjusting it, the shower panel leaked substantially, and the toilet did not flush fully. 

I’m confident that the management would have found us a different room had we asked, but we were only in the room very briefly between a late arrival and early morning airport departure, so I just left it alone. 

That said, I expect these sorts of issues not to occur (especially all at the same time!) in a property of this caliber and cost.

author: Petros Chasiotis
title: Grazie mille
text: Very clean and comfortable hotel in a quiet neighborhood. The staff was amazing. All of them are very helpful and kind. We will be back for sure!!!

author: Rodrigo
title: 100% recommended
text: Excellent hotel, great service and adequate service, very well located

author: FrancyPiccy
title: Perfect stay
text: Great location, nice rooms and the staff is spectacular!

author: ppath
title: Just out of town and a good spot
text:
Visited this hotel for the Italy v England Six Nations weekend as part of a package. 

While slightly out of the city centre (to the East), the tube is super close and it's just three stops to Termini, so absolutely perfect. 

We did bed and breakfast and the offering was great - loads of choice and replenished pretty quickly. The coffee machines were a bit temperamental and/or slow. 

The staff here are all great - very cheerful and helpful. 

The room we stayed in had a decent sized bathroom while the room itself was a little on the small side, but fine really. There was a huge TV in the room but very few channels you'd want to watch or that are in English. 

We didn't visit the bar but it seemed to stock all the essentials. 

In terms of restaurants / places to eat and drink in the local area, there isn't, frankly, an abundance. We did find a couple of decent places after some short walks but don't expect to be absolutely spoilt for choice, considering where the hotel is. 

The hotel is very clean throughout and we had no issues with that at all.   

The only gripe I had really was that the shower pressure was pretty rubbish.

author: Isabelle P
title: Tourist stay
text:
Top-notch staff, well-stocked breakfast, very clean room.
Proximity to the Gare de Lyon is perfect for dropping off and picking up luggage.
I recommend this hotel.

author: 444staycation
title: Lovely staff and great location!
text: We stayed here recently as it was so close to the Gare de Lyon train station which is what we needed. The price was really reasonable. The hotel lobby is gorgeous, and the staff were all lovely and helpful. The rooms are tired but they were very clean. We travelled as a family of 4 in two separate rooms as our teenager and pre-teen to share a sofa bed now. I would stay here again.

author: Annick L
title: Great hotel facing the Gare de Lyon.
text: Very good hotel in its category! Well-insulated rooms, very clean, friendly staff. Everything to like!

author: valeriegourgout
title: Remarks
text:
3-day stay for various exhibition visits.
Ideal location for train arrival and departure, and access to other transport, restaurant on the ground floor with half-board very convenient, and a very hearty breakfast!

author: silvi86b
title: Comfortable and clean hotel
text: We stayed at this hotel for only one night while passing through. Convenient because it is right in front of the Gare de Lyon station. Clean hotel, kind staff who also spoke Italian.  I recommend it

author: alecagliari74
title: Good experience, top location
text: We had a good time, we took two doubles, spacious and confortable rooms, good value for money, excellent location near the metro and pubs and restaurant. Typical English breakfast, Kind and efficient staff

author: Tim B
title: Great stay and great location
text: Had a lovely time at this hotel, hotel staff super helpful and friendly, perfect location with the tube just down the road, 5 minute walk or 10 if you have a 5 year old, and the air conditioning was the best, especially being as hot as it’s been, we would definitely stay again.

author: Holly H
title: Perfect for 1 night with children
text:
Convenient location, easy check-in & out and good breakfast.
A quad room was a bit of a squeeze but absolutely fine for 1 night.
Room could do with a bit of maintenance and the double bed was very hard and uncomfortable.

author: CBK G
title: Best hotel
text: Amazing. Everything. Location

author: Katie G
title: amazing
text: sabhana was very friendly !!!

author: DerKey
title: Event in the Regency Suite
text: Our event was for family and friends and we booked the Regency Suite. We were very impressed by the quality of the function room, services, food, staff and also bedroom. We would absolutely recommend the Clarendon and staff without reservation.

author: Rebecca
title: Amazing staff
text:
Had a lovely meal here with friends and was really impressed with the food. Everything was delicious and full of flavour! We all really enjoyed our meals
A special mention has to go to Samantha behind the bar. She was amazing! quick, friendly, and really welcoming throughout our visit. Her great service really added to the experience. She was also helping the rest of the staff clear the tables and food. She really went above and beyond 
We had a brilliant time and would definitely come back again. Highly recommended!

author: Nyasha N
title: Lovely staff and great wedding venue
text: I had my wedding at the Clarendon Hotel in August 2026. Julie and the entire events team were amazing to work with and were able to answer all of my questions leading up to the big day. Both the Regency Suite and Meridian Restaurant are lovely spaces for hosting a wedding and the staff worked so hard making everything just right. We also received many compliments from our guests about the food provided - another great touch to a special day ☺️

author: Journey728053
title: Surprise birthday lunch in the Marquee.
text: We had a fantastic event courtesy of the Clarendon. The arrangements were carried out perfectly and the staff were attentive, friendly and professional. I fully recommend the Clarendon if you are considering a celebration event.

author: Gemma d
title: get afternoon with great friends
text: i had the pleasure of attending the clarendon on Sunday the 23rd of Aug all staff members were very accommodating with all the requested that our larger group of 12 needed and every thing was done with ease. The ambience was beautiful and the piano player was extremely talented. Special thanks goes to Isabelle and Samantha for their amazing service. We will be back again thank you

author: Kim G
title: Missing items
text: I went to the hotel with my daughters. When we got there, there was a ton of construction going on lots of dust and dirt andnoise. The power went off periodically throughout the day and evening as well. An entirely separate note my daughter left her rings on the dresser when  went out and when we came back, our room had been made up and there were no rings. I immediately went down to the front desk to let them know that we are missing our rings. They said that they would check with her housekeeping staff. I continue to go down each day to no avail. I asked to speak with a manager. I spoke with a manager, and she said that she would contact the owners and discuss it with them and call me back. This never happened. I never received a phone call or an email. I think that they just felt that I would go away. I’m not going away. I’m missing valuable items and didn’t have a stay that was up to my expectations. I would strongly suggest staying somewhere else if you want to keep your stuff safe and have a peaceful vacation.

author: Liz K
title: RUN! DON’T DO IT!! Pictures are Deceitful!!
text: The hotel looked nothing like the pictures online. The room was very small with old furniture, and the window faced a brick wall. We found a roach in the bathroom, and the shower made loud rumbling noises. I didn’t feel safe sleeping in the bed because of the roach. We left after the first night. We only stayed because it was late and I had a conference the next morning.

author: Julie J
title: Perfect Location
text: We really enjoyed our stay at the hotel St James. Was it luxuriously fancy and new? No. But it was clean and charming and the staff (particularly Emma!) were super friendly and helpful (we had never navigated NY). The location is PERFECT! Right on Times Square and we walked to most of the highlights of the city including our broadway show. The subway took us everywhere else and that was convenient too. Take advantage of the ice and water station in the “bar” and the neighboring pub and deli were fantastic. This hotel was exactly what we needed for our visit and within our budget. Highly recommend.

author: Joey W
title: Great location in Midtown
text: Spacious room for Manhattan nearby Times Square and 5th avenue. Staff was friendly.

author: Dan M
title: 50th birthday in NYC
text: Very dated hotel & room, had rain water hitting AC unit that sounded like a child’s metal drum being hit next to your ear all night very disturbing when trying to get to sleep after a long day. No tea or coffee facilities, however the location is excellent & housekeeping was superb very clean room bedding changed daily & clean towels replenished everyday, wouldn’t stay again as the hotel room took shine off a great 5 days exploring NYC

author: Latchacha
title: Pleasant surprise
text: We were there as a family. Very comfortable room (bedding very good and air conditioning) and clean, quiet for our part. The staff is very friendly. The hotel is located in a neighborhood steeped in Hindu culture. You will always have restaurants open and the train station and its brasseries are 200 meters away.

author: Gabriella N
title: AWFUL
text: Stay away from this place, 40 degrees and the ac was broken moved to a different room and the door wouldn’t lock and the reception staff said nobody would come in after he said our room number out loud to the whole lobby. Absolutely rubbish service we were told we would be refunded and nothing has been done they lied to us and never gave our money back. Dirty rooms and the staff did not help once we had to move rooms 3 times due to the terrible quality

author: pillowtester
title: Honestly, it's fine and they have air conditioning.
text: Honestly, I can't say anything really negative except for the neighborhood (almost across from the La Chapelle station), which is lively during the day but questionable at night. Good air conditioning in the rooms. You can walk to Gare du Nord and Gare de l'Est.

author: Tanya C
title: NEVER AGAIN!!
text: Nice pictures on the website are very deceiving it was clean but the pullout bed was horrible hard and just uncomfortable. The only thing I will say is that this place had air conditioning and was fairly clean other than but never again. We were three women alone and the neighborhood  was dirty and really felt unsafe. The police sirens were many all night. We checked in  at one door to and had to walk alone to another door 5 doors down past men just leering at you, then you get into the smallest elevator I have ever seen. Also, no one at the front desk in this building. It just didn’t feel safe. And then I called for more towels and front desk couldn’t have someone bring the to us because she was there alone so if we wanted more towels we had to go down the tiny elevator, walk over to the other building, walk past all the leering men in a dirty sketchy neighborhood retrieve our towels and walk past again. Also, the bathroom had a glass frosted door which even if you are with family you can see them clearly using the toilet or get a few view of the out the shower not very private. And then let me say something about the location, the neighborhood is not what people tell you about Paris there are many homeless living on the the streets or in tents, the garbage is literally all over the street it smells and again, I can not stress this again, it did not feel safe for women. We only stood for two days before I could rebook a different hotel. Never again!!

author: Lucas P
title: Despite the location, everything you could want and need
text:
Unfortunately, the Sure Hotel is located in a not so favourable area. But, if like me you needed to be located around here for an event/visit etc. this hotel is definitely the best place to go.

Perfectly clean room, not a single part of it made me feel uncomfortable. Very comfy bed, excellent shower pressure and temperature, plenty of wardrobe space, more than enough sockets (plug and USB A and C ports), tea, coffee, and best of all, outstanding air conditioning (it was nearly 40 degrees Celsius outside!).

If you want to go to Paris to be in Paris, stay in a nicer location. However, you are only going to stay in a place like this if you have a specific reason, or for a short stay. It therefore offers everything you need.

author: Craig Robert H
title: Highly recommended
text: Excellent affordable hotel. Good location. Friendly staff in a good location. Room was clean and bright. Breakfast buffet is decent. Highly recommended.

author: ele m
title: Great family experience
text: We stayed at this hotel for 4 days with my son and husband, and we had a wonderful time. Even though the Termini area is not very beautiful, the hotel's location is truly excellent for visiting Rome both on foot and by public transport. Moreover, the hotel was a pleasant surprise for its elegance, cleanliness, and the availability of staff 24/7. A well-deserved 3 stars.

author: Catherine042
title: Hotel Windrose
text: Close to Republic metro and city bus servives this hotel was an excellent choice for a mini break. Nearby there is a great choice of affordable restaurants. Comfortable room with spacious ensuite and large balcony overlooking city rooftops. Reception staff were extremely helpful. Breakfast offered plenty of choice. Certainly worth a second visit and value for money.

author: Sue C
title: Excellent stay
text: We are just back from 3 nights at the hotel Windrose. Rooms were really great spacious with a lovely balcony. Close to the metro and terminal. Room cleaned every day.  The gentleman on reception was really a great asset to your hotel. Lovely restaurant opposite. Thank you for a great stay.

author: Voyager51650127683
title: Very good location and attention
text: We stayed 6 days in total, a first stay of 4 days, left bags in guard for 15 days and returned another 2 days and everything was taken care of and protected. The location is excellent, close to Termini for trains and subways. We highlight the kindness and excellent attention of all the staff who made us spend some unforgettable days. Thanks Windrose, we will be back!!

author: Janeen H
title: Magical beyond words
text: This place has a sense of magic - words do not equate - from the people that run the ship - the warmth of the entrance - the rooms so efficient - the location - we stay here rather than closer to our son's school because it is truly that magical - home from home - again just not enough words!

author: Pernille Augustinussen
title: Amazing style and location
text: Amazing location in a fantastic arena. The hotel is an amazing experience with great style. Loved that there are rooms with 5 beds.

author: Linda H
title: Not worth the price
text:
Unfortunately, my stay was very disappointing. The first room was dark, smelled moldy, was not clean, and the air conditioner was extremely noisy. After complaining, I was moved to a better room, but it faced the street, and the noise made it almost impossible to sleep. I also had to pay extra for the room, despite being told I would receive a discount.

The check-in time (4:00 PM) and check-out time (10:00 AM) are not guest-friendly. The rooms need modernization, housekeeping should pay more attention to cleanliness, and the staff could be warmer and more welcoming.

Overall, the hotel offers very poor value for money and is not worth the price.

author: Daisy V
title: A nice New York stay
text: Very nice took care of our luggage before and after checking in so super nice to not have to rake care of that stuff. Very walkable from stores and the metro. Also a nice sitting area underneath the reception to relax in. Clean and comfortable just a little small but that comes with the city.

author: Marlo S
title: Excellent historic property - clean + quiet room
text: Loved this hotel - would stay again and highly suggest to anyone. Friendly and helpful front desk staff.  Large quiet room with a very nice bathroom, comfortable beds, great bedding + pillows. We did specifically ask for a quiter location and they delivered - slept great!   There are two lounge/lobby/seating areas to gather - the first floor one especially great to meet up/chat with travel mates. Note that there is a large flight of stairs to get to check in/rooms (and more stairs to upper floors). Hallways are also narrower than typical as it is an old building - this had no impact for us but maybe useful to know. Also note official check in is late - 4pm - and there is a charge for early check in (though they did offer complimentary late checkout if needed)

author: S M
title: Pleasant stay and exceptional hospitality!
text:
Our stay was truly very pleasant. The hotel is small but well-managed, extremely clean, and located in an excellent position for getting around. 
A special thanks goes to Mr. Ahmed at the reception, who distinguished himself for his extreme kindness, helpfulness, and attention toward us. Throughout the entire stay, he was always friendly and ready to help us with any need, making us feel welcomed and looked after with great professionalism. 
We really appreciated his thoughtfulness and the way he took an interest in making our stay as pleasant as possible. An exquisite person who certainly contributed to making our experience even more positive. We highly recommend it!

author: Onmyway T
title: Eight nights stay
text:
I decided to stay in a different location in Paris this time, very close to Gare du Nord. The hotel was small with a small lift. My room had issues with the bath sink not holding water, this was a problem when I wanted to shave. I told reception and eventually I was offered a different room. 

The other room had a wall right behind of the window, so no light was coming in, it was during the heatwave, so the days were very bright. I informed reception of this issue and again I moved to a superior room this time which was very bright and spacious. Plug and charging sockets could be better placed

Breakfast was "ok" the lady seemed stingy with cooking the sausages, and I often had to ask her to make some because there were none left.

Vibe was calm and nothing special.

author: María B
title: Excellent
text:
A hotel with all the amenities. 20-30 minutes from the monuments of Paris (Eiffel Tower, Arc de Triomphe, Louvre Museum, Orsay, Tuileries, Luxembourg Gardens...). Gare de l'Est station is a 5-minute walk away and you have several bus, train, and metro options. 

The hotel is modern. The rooms are very comfortable. The cleanliness is very good. The breakfast is very decent and the staff is very attentive and friendly. Toufik offered to store our suitcases for us at no cost upon checkout. 

The truth is that it has been a very pleasant experience, a place to return to without a doubt.

author: alina
title: Small but charming – to be recommended without hesitation!
text:
We spent ten days there while temperatures were very high in Paris at that time. The very pleasant atmosphere of the hotel, the extremely friendly staff (especially Toufik and Ahmed who never stopped providing us with information to help us find the best route for our excursions), the delicious breakfast, and the air conditioning in the room after a long day of heat made our stay even more pleasant and successful! If we return to Paris, we will return without hesitation to this very pleasant hotel, which also benefits from numerous transport and dining options in the immediate vicinity. The Gare de l'Est is only 5 minutes away!!! We will recommend it without hesitation!
Thank you very much, Toufik!

author: Marielle D
title: Good.
text: Two nights stayed at Hotel Soft with my daughter. Nice room with nice view! Lovely air conditioning after a hot day walk. Lovely bathroom, everything you need is there. Breakfast is fine! Very nice to be close to the station and metro and also sights such as Monte Marte is within walking distance. We were kindly helped by TOUFIK. Highly recommended this hotel!

author: Ben
title: Budget by name,  but perfect for the price!
text:
Along the main road through the 19th arrondissement, the IBIS budget La Villette 19éme is only a 10 minute walk in either direction to the nearest Metro station, making it perfectly situated for quick transportation across the city. 

With budget in the name, it provides a comfy bed, shower, toilet and storage for luggage. And if you’re on a city break, that’s more than ample to have place to rest and recuperate after exploring Paris.

The front desk was staffed by friendly and welcoming Parisians, who cheerfully checked us in, even if my French is rather rusty.

author: JekkuBattery
title: Decent for the price
text: Rooms are quite small. Breakfast buffet OK. Bath towels with a funny smell...

author: Pedro
title: Okay for the price.
text:
Does the job for a decent price-quality ratio.
Lacks a bit of staff at the front desk. 
Room for 3, more like for 2.

author: Maayan200709
title: Simple Hotel, Great Location and Good Value
text:
We had a very good stay at ibis budget Paris La Villette 19ème and would definitely consider coming back. It’s a great example of a budget hotel that offers exactly what you need for a short city break.

The hotel has a very convenient location, just a short walk from Jaurès and Stalingrad metro stations, which made it really easy to get around Paris and reach all the main attractions.

We stayed in a room with a bunk bed, which worked really well for our group. The room is small and very simple, but clean, modern and practical. The beds were comfortable and we all slept well.

The bathroom is compact but functional and well maintained, and everything was clean throughout our stay.

The staff were friendly and helpful, and the hotel overall felt well organized. It’s a basic hotel, but everything works as it should.

The breakfast buffet had a good selection of simple items, enough to start the day well before heading out to explore the city.

Overall, it’s a no-frills hotel, but clean, comfortable and excellent value for money, especially thanks to its great location and easy access to public transport.

author: GoPlaces67813536473
title: worst
text: Lower your expectations, the staff barely knows any english and they’re very unintrested about your issues on your stay and they can’t cooperate. I was there with my school and when we arrived the door wouldn’t open with our code and they told us to wait, we were staying echsausted from a long day and they didn’t helped us with anything. All our bagadges and chlotes etc were in that room, they told us just to wait when the next day at 8 AM we should go back home…UNBELIEVABLE.At breakfast ( a poor one) the dishes were dirty, the towels were stained also and the bedsheets. When you entry your room it’s probably been vacuumed a week ago or so, very bad conditions. Even if we are with our school now, i don’t reccomend. Run away when you hear IBIS BUDGET, unbelievable

author: sjoerdslavenburg
title: Nice hotel naar Place de la Sorbonne
text: I stayed at this hotel for two nights.The staff is very helpfull and friendly. I like this neighbourhood very much, next to the Sorbonne, close by the Pantheon, Jardin du Luxembourg and the Bv St Germain.

author: marcelQ7121CX
title: Great centrally located hotel
text:
A beautiful centrally located hotel with excellent service and excellent coffee! We wish we had the same coffee at home, including the coffee machine. 👌👌👌

We stayed there in July and were delighted. The nearest metro and bus stops are within easy walking distance, as is the nearest park for relaxing, and a beautiful museum for lovers of the Middle Ages and history.

The service and helpfulness at the hotel are also excellent; you really feel very well taken care of.👌

author: Alice C
title: A reliable choice
text: The Hotel Design Sorbonne is a great choice for a stay in Paris. The rooms are clean and well-appointed, and the air conditioning works well. The hotel is far enough away from many of the main sights to be quiet, yet close enough to everything you might want to do during your stay. If you are in basic good shape, you can walk to the Louvre, the Paris Opera, and all the main sights on the right bank. Notre Dame is a stroll away. The neighborhood is charming with lots of options for food and shopping. The Cluny Museum and the Pantheon are a five-minute walk away. The  Sorbonne Pantheon is across the street. The hotel staff will help you with anything you want to do. Uber picks up out front.

author: miniedu
title: Very good location
text: We have stayed at this hotel, I recommend it because it is very central, it is next to the Pantheon, about a 10-minute walk from Notre Dame, the rooms are small, especially the bathroom, but we were there for a short time so we didn't notice the difference compared to a larger one. I recommend it with breakfast because it is very good, very pleasant staff

author: Mark E
title: Charming hotel in a great area.
text:
We have stayed in Paris many times but this hotel is one of our favourites. It’s located in a lovely area, a close walk to the metro or the river which allows you to explore all the main attractions. There are plenty of great restaurants nearby too.
It’s a small hotel with a friendly feel and the staff are so helpful. We were travelling with elderly parents who were gluten free and they were happy to provide suitable products for breakfast which was a great help.
A great stay in a charming hotel.

author: About
title: Wonderful hospitality and a very comfortable stay
text:
I stayed at BH Hotel for two nights and had a wonderful experience. From the moment I arrived, the front-desk team were exceptionally warm and attentive. They helped with my luggage, offered me water and snacks, and when I mentioned that I was hungry, they kindly gave me three small pastries to take with me. It was such a thoughtful gesture.

My room was not ready when I arrived, so they stored my luggage while I went out to explore. By the time I returned, the room was ready and my bags had already been placed inside. A member of staff personally accompanied me to the room, explained how everything worked and showed me where the restaurant was.

The hotel is modern, beautifully renovated, clean and very quiet at night. Breakfast is available for a generous amount of time, with a fresh and well-chosen selection of juices, coffee, pastries, desserts, hot food and cereals.

The location is also extremely convenient for sightseeing, taxis, restaurants and the train station. What impressed me most was how well managed the hotel felt—everyone working there seemed genuinely positive, welcoming and happy to help. I would definitely stay here again.

author: Алина Ч
title: Comfort and care
text: Everything was wonderful! Pleasant aromas, a delicious and healthy breakfast, the hotel staff is very hospitable and caring, wonderful location, near the station, bus stop, and taxi stand.

author: Carmen M
title: Great choice for visiting Rome
text: The hotel is beautiful, the staff is excellent, very good location, the breakfast is very complete!

author: Arturo G
title: Great place to stay in Roma!
text:
Great place to stay in Romal! The people at front desk, restraunt / bar and house keeping are great people and gave us a very warm welcome. I'll recomend it.

Thanks for all!

author: Paco S
title: Excellent option
text: Excellent option for staying in Rome,

author: Heleen H
title: No air conditioning available and this is lied about!
text:
Attention: false advertising! The hotel does not have (working) air conditioning and that is advertised and was mentioned on our booking confirmation. We had specially selected for this because there was a heat wave in Paris. We unfortunately did not get what we paid for and are therefore forced to check out with our 3 children after a bad and hot night. Now the hotel refuses a refund of the 3 remaining and therefore unused nights! This is hallucinatory: if you offer air conditioning through Booking.com, I expect to get that as a customer. So pure deception and then again refusing to pay back... 

When I checked in in the morning, I had asked if the air conditioning definitely worked: yes, they said, and “if it’s not enough for you, you can come get a fan.” But it didn't work at all, and they knew that very well. If they had just been honest, I could have found another hotel. Judging by the reviews, they knew for at least 2 weeks that the air conditioning was not working. Disgraceful!

author: Julio M
location: Costa de New Jersey, Nueva Jersey
title: Bad
text: Bath is a plane size bathroom very small, bath tub in other room smell, this place DO NOT HAVE A/C if you are  planning to go in the summer  be prepared to be in hell, people was begging for a   fan in the reception, metro station close but u have to pass a bridge homeless under the bridge  asking for money

author: Christophe85
title: Very good for the price
text:
Well-located hotel 30 minutes from the Stade de France, with parking [€20], room very well laid out, upgraded to a triple suite due to an availability error.
Well-stocked breakfast.
Friendly and professional staff.
Thank you for your hospitality

author: Bodine V
title: It's terrible. Never again.
text:
We are very disappointed with our stay and absolutely do not recommend this hotel. As far as we are concerned, this hotel is not worth four stars. Not only because of the faulty air conditioning, but especially because of the way we were treated as guests.

On arrival, the air conditioning in our room did not work, while it was 40 degrees in Paris during our stay. The room became unbearably warm. We immediately reported this to reception. An employee told me someone was coming by to fix the air conditioning. After two hours of waiting, there had still been no one. When we went to the reception again, it was said that people did not know when someone would come, but that someone would still come along. At the end of the day, no one came.

Because we were then told that we would get another room the next day, we decided to spend the first night in this room anyway. However, that was terrible. Without air conditioning or fan, the room was unbearably hot. We put wet towels on top of us and literally lay down in bed with soggy towels to cool our bodies a bit. Nevertheless, we hardly slept.

The next day it was again 40 degrees. The poor sleep and the constant heat made all three of us feel exhausted, drowsy and unwell. I myself became so dizzy while shopping that I almost fainted and we had to interrupt our day. Your body simply can’t recover if you can’t cool off for a moment at night.

When my girlfriend asked if we could get extra towels so we could shower more often to cool off, this was initially refused. Although we had explained how warm the room was and that we had hardly slept, no understanding was shown and no apology was offered. Only after insistence did we finally get one extra towel.

The next morning we were told that we could leave our stuff in the room and that we would get another room in the evening. We entered the city on the basis of that commitment. When we came back that night, suddenly there was no other room available at all. It was then said that we should have come in the afternoon, when we had never been told. The promised mechanic had still not visited either.

The lowest point was the attitude of the receptionist. When we told him how bad we felt and I told him that I almost fainted because of the heat and lack of sleep, he started laughing. There was no excuse offered, no understanding shown and no thought given to a solution. We found that perhaps even worse than the broken air conditioning itself.

Eventually we decided not to stay in this hotel for the second night and to book another hotel at our own expense for about €400. This cost us a lot of extra money and unfortunately left a big negative mark on our city trip to Paris.
We hope Booking reviews this property critically. The way we have been treated as guests, we do not grant anyone. In the end, the problem was not just the broken air conditioning, but above all the way it was handled: empty promises, no understanding, no excuses, no solution and even being laughed at when we said how bad we felt. In all our trips we have never experienced that we have been treated like this as paying guests. For that reason, we absolutely cannot recommend this hotel and hope that future travelers will be saved from the same experience.

author: Monica g
title: Very special mood - retro sporty!
text: Cosy hotel with retro- mood ambient. Very keen and professional staff. Clean wide room, while bathroom not so comfortable (sort of box). Silent. Breakfast very basic self service under the expectation vs the rest of the hotel. The district is not really the best in Paris but much more “clean” then in the past.

author: Tammy M
title: Cool room in hot Rome.
text: Decent experience. 4 day stay. Very convenient Monti neighborhood. Not so little Pam grocery store right next door. Still working on the double booking charge. But that shouldn't affect this review. Pleasantly surprised how cool the room was considering how hot Rome was when I arrived and the rules on how how cool an establishment can keep a place only 15° below the outside temperature. I even had to turn the temperature up a few times. The mini bar was stocked with their beverages, so hard to keep any of my own items. And it is on the floor, fairly small and could be colder. There is a kettle with some coffee and tea samples I didn't try. My room was on the 2nd floor, king bed, comfortable. A little desk and chair. Clean room. Pictures can show more than I can describe. There apparently is a new service charge of 30€ besides the daily city charge of 7.50€. It was not mentioned at booking so I declined to accept the charge. Oh, the electric outlets- I'm not sure why but it took forever with the micro USB for my phone and tablet. My euro adapter wasn't  any better. I can't describe the breakfast, I got a better deal by opting out. They have a little offering at the entrance of either coffee or tea and a pastry or cookie in the early morning. There was also pastry occasionally in the afternoon. I guess whatever was left over.

author: Sandy K
title: A Gem in Rome
text:
This was our 3rd visit to Hotel Raffaello, but our first visit in about 12 years, and I can say it was every bit as good as before, if not better. It is perfectly situated in a quiet street just off Via Cavour, and close to Termini Station, the Colosseum, Forum, Repubblica, the Metro, etc, and even close to a children's playground. 

We had booked 3 rooms for our family and the baby cot was set up in the one room as requested. Check in was very easy and the staff are extremely helpful. The hotel is undergoing renovations with one floor closed off, and we were fortunate to be in the newly renovated rooms. Everything about the rooms was amazing (although we did miss the "old charm" from the previous rooms a little bit 😜). The bathrooms are large by Rome standards and well equipped with all products required and have a huge walk-in shower with good water pressure, and the beds were very comfortable. There was fantastic air-con which helped as we were in Rome in the heat wave and the wi-fi and TV channels were excellent too.

Breakfast was of a high standard with a continental buffet including the most delicious freshly squeezed orange juice, fresh fruits, meats, cheeses, cereals, yoghurts, eggs, bacon, sausage, breads and pastries. There is also a coffee and cake station in reception available at all hours. Unfortunately we had an early train to catch on our last day so we missed breakfast, but when I mentioned it on their survey I was immediately contacted by the hotel to apologize and explain that we could have asked for a packed breakfast. I appreciate that they took the time to reply to me, and I will know for next time.

I would highly recommend Hotel Raffaello for people staying in Rome as it is a high quality hotel and still fairly reasonable priced. Thank you.

author: Mariano I
title: Great hotel for families in Rome
text: Unbelievable hotel with an amazing staff that makes you feel at home. Nice and clean rooms and an excellent breakfast. All the facilities working Ok during a terrible hot wave. Thank you Hotel Rafaello!!

author: Stacy B
title: Perfect Hotel
text: This hotel is wonderful. The beds were comfortable. The staff is friendly. The bar at the top has great service. Anoosh is kind and helpful. It’s easy to walk anywhere from here. You won’t be disappointed if you choose to stay here. We would definitely come back.

author: Debra F
title: Wonderful place to finish our European Journey
text:
This hotel was a delight.  The front desk staff were wonderfully helpful and friendly.  They all spoke English, which was a big help to this non-Italian speaker.  
Our room was well appointed, pretty, and clean.  We had a King Standard Room and there was plenty of room for our 2 weeks worth of luggage for 2 people. 
Breakfast was delicious, albeit a little expensive. 
The location was great.  Easy walking distance of Santa Maria Maggiore.

author: Mimidinh
title: Great location, Awesome Staff, Cool Decor
text:
Pros: Great location, very friendly service, clean room and shared spaces, really cool decor
Cons: The A/C never really made the room cold, the rooms are very compact, no free breakfast or welcome drinks for Marriott Titanium members

author: 41Fever
title: Okay if the temperature is just right
text: Location is good. Lobby bar is 24/7. Room was clean and quiet. Unfortunately, the room is terribly stuffy. There is no airflow and no windows to crack open. I am aware AC isn't a thing in a lot of places in the area but even with the fan on "high" you literally cannot feel any air coming out of it and this was all compounded by ending up here during an unprecedented heatwave. Now obviously that is out of anyone's control but if you find yourself in this situation be prepared to figure out a fan at least because there is no circulation whatsoever.

author: ReeceP
title: Fabulous modern hotel
text:
Brilliant service by the hotel. The rooms are super cool with a nice iPad to help set the lights mood etc.
My only issue was the bedding. It was a little too rough for my liking and the lack of a kettle or any tea/coffee

Staff were friendly and approachable but both check in and check out was done by just yourself.

The hotel is ideally located near Southbank and only a short walk to borough market, bringing a lovely atmosphere.

author: Discover801453
title: I'm still angry about this hotel.
text:
This is not a 4 star hotel. No coffee or tea facilities, no kettle, no iron, no fresh water, no minibar, not even a glass to get a tap water. I was told to come downstairs to borrow glasses. In the morning, I couldn't even make a cup of tea and downstairs they wanted to charge me extra for it. This is completely unacceptable for a hotel clearly intended for business travelers. 
The room is tiny, poorly laid out. The bed is pushed against the wall, sink in the bedroom, no fresh air, no in-room temperature control. The bathroom is moulded plastic and feels like showering in a school dinner tray. Even the hair 'conditioner' was awful - I doubt it was even conditioner. The TV is controlled by an ipad, with no TV guide and limited channels. 
There's no proper reception - you're expected to self-check-in and out. The 'canteen' is as basic as you could imagine. Plastic everywhere, school-style trays. The room and lobby look nice, but don't be fooled. 
If this was 2-star, I'd give it a nice review because it looks nice, but I'd still take issue with the lack of iron, tea, coffee, kettle etc. It's genuinely the worst hotel I've experienced and I've stayed in some dives.

author: Geraldine J
title: Cetral and clean hotel
text:
Opposite the Tate modern, 5 Minutes Walk to the Southbank of Thames and Millennium Bridge. Only a short distance walk to London Bridge Station and Bus Stop direct opposite the hotel.
Modern, warm atmosphere with very small but clean and fuctional rooms. 24h reciption, self check in and out, bar an restaurant, but didn't use the service during this stay. 
Unahappy with the noicelevel with a room to Southwark Road after I had to change the room from the opposite and quiter side of the building. 
They have free highspeed wifi but it was often without  good service or completly interrupted. No big issue for me personally, but someone who need a fast and stable wifi connections could come in trouble.

author: Lauren G
title: Dirty and noisy ….AVOID
text: Stayed above ground in a room with a ‘window’ which was half frosted and could only be opened a few cm’s. Tried to dry my hair and got told off because it set off the fire alarms and got offered to finish in the communal area (don't attempt to blow dry your hair guys). The rumbling from the underground is so constant! Luckily enough we were at a concert so we were not in the room long but as a light sleeper this kept you awake ! We had read reviews and decided to pick a higher floor to avoid it god were we wrong.  The sheets were stained and covered in what looked like wee and the whole room was covered in dust. Staff are unhelpful tried to book an additional night before travelling and was told i had to make another booking and the phone was put down on me. Location is good but i think we will go somewhere else next time

author: TwixUK
title: Ideal quick stop over
text: Great convenient overnight. Basic facilities, small room - but perfect for a quick stop over. Some staff were super friendly, one a bit abrupt & rude. Clever concept for the type of traveller & accommodation it targets.

author: Esther T
title: Good Stay
text:
The hotel location is good as Edgware station is nearby and Paddington station is not too far off. There are lots of Middle eastern restaurants in the vicinity. 
The rooms are compact and if you have big luggages and carry-ons, a bit of a squeeze. 
The staff members are friendly, helpful and always with a smile. As there’s no kettle in the room, they are kind to fill up the water bottles at the reception. 
Overall a good hotel

author: Binniesaska
title: Ideal for getting to Wembley without being in the center
text:
Hotel is very well located if you want to attend a concert at Wembley as the gate is close with a train to Wembley.
Smiling and friendly staff. The room is sufficient in size. The bathroom is, however, a bit narrow,
You can sometimes hear the subway, but at night it does not run.
The hotel is ideal for spending a night or two.

author: Caroline A
title: Fabulous hotel and staff
text: Amazing hotel, my daughter booked it as I wanted to spend a big birthday in London. The staff were so helpful and nothing was too much trouble for them. The room was clean and comfortable. There was air-conditioning in the room. Breakfast was amazing it is continental, which is my preference, the selection was so good.  If you're looking for a good location, clean,comfortable and staff who go above and beyond hotel look no further

author: Maddy M
title: Incredible
text: The location was incredible! Everything is fairly close by or at least reachable through grand central which you can get to in 5 minutes. The only thing I was a bit confused about is that there is no toilet brush 😂 But other than that 10/10

author: Tour36768631542
title: Home in New York
text:
Pod 39 is my favorite place to stay in Midtown Manhattan and has become my go-to choice every time I’m in New York. This was my third stay, and probably one of the best.

The location, at 39th and Lexington, is perfect for everything I need. The hotel has a genuinely great atmosphere, excellent amenities, and, by Manhattan standards, remarkable value for money — easily the best quality-to-price ratios I’ve found in the city.

My rooms have always been impeccably clean and, surprisingly for such a central and consistently busy hotel, extremely quiet. I’ve never had issues with street noise or with sound from neighboring rooms, even when the hotel was fully booked.

The staff are exceptionally kind, relaxed and helpful, and the whole place manages to feel lively without ever becoming chaotic or impersonal. There’s a real sense that everything works exactly as it should.

After three stays, I no longer really look elsewhere. Pod 39 simply feels like my New York base.

author: 4reign
title: Perfect for a weekend getaway
text: Comfortable stay, friendly and helpful staff. The room was small but it was exactly what I needed as a solo traveller. Grand central station was less than 10 minutes walk, and the location of the hotel is in the quieter part of the neighborhood.

author: Gabriel T
title: Love the pod !
text:
Pod Hotels are just incredible - staff are amazing and friendly, they provide great service and they answer any of your questions !
Location is perfect ! The vibes are great.

author: Ann & Gary G
title: Great experience
text: Excellent location!  Entire check in / check out process easy.  Room was small but perfect for our needs.  Without hesitation would recommend and plan to stay again.

author: aneatab
title: Lovely, friendly and clean hotel
text:
It was a wonderful stay. The staff were all extremely helpful and friendly, especially Raphael. The room we were in was small, but so cleverly designed that we really didn't feel cramped at all. The en suite was really lovely. Very clean throughout the entire hotel.

The breakfast is continental and is open from 6.30 to 11am, so plenty of time to have a leisurely meal. The food was very fresh, and regularly replenished. Hot and cold drinks readily available within the breakfast time slot.

The only down fall is that the corridors were dimly lit which wasn't great for my mother to navigate with poor eyesight.

It is perfectly positioned, close to King's Cross and St Pancras Station, with a lovely Greene King pub opposite!

Highly recommend this hotel.

author: kristen m
title: Would definitely stay again
text: Great location--walking distance to Kings Cross even with luggage. Small rooms (typical in London) but SUPER CLEAN. Not super luxury but had everything I needed. Front desk staff was so friendly--welcomed me every time I walked into the hotel. I really liked the area--ate at multiple restaurants in the area (breakfast and dinner) and they were all great. Always felt safe even late at night by myself.

author: stacicarr
title: Brilliant stay
text: Stayed for 1 night for a concert at Wembley. Convenient location for King’s Cross, very friendly and accommodating staff. Karolina especially made my stay very comfortable and was very welcoming.

author: Lisa H
title: Best for Budget Near King’s Cross
text: I’ve stayed here multiple times and enjoy this establishment. It’s five minutes from King’s Cross and the pub next door is awesome for food. Room is always clean and comfy and staff are super friendly and helpful. Highly recommend.

author: Antonella T
title: Excellent
text:
Room 504 cozy, fragrant, very small bathroom but clean, perfect shower.
Room with a window, not so obvious in England, so I recommend paying attention when booking.
Air conditioning and chromotherapy in the room.
Comfortable bed, I would suggest the possibility of a sheet, because even though it was hot, there was a duvet inside the duvet cover.
Two elevators
Water fountain available for guests.

author: Adviser
title: Great city break.
text: City break with granddaughter. They organised all our trips and guides and a surprise in her room for arrival. Very comfy beds and nice rooms. Would very happily recommend. Thank you for a brilliant four days.

author: Melanie Theodoulou
title: comfortable stay in a great location
text: The Independent Hotel in Rome offers clean, comfortable rooms, friendly staff, and a convenient location near Termini Station. The rooftop breakfast was varied and enjoyable, making this a great choice for exploring Rome.

author: Jorge B
title: Great Stay
text: We had a great experience at the hotel. The hotel was clean, close to the train station and the staff was very helpful with directions while we were there. We will return.

author: Chloe T
title: Wonder Hotel
text: We went to Italy as a birthday celebration and decided to stay at the Independent Hotel. The staff were always friendly and happy to help. The room was clean and tidy. The view from the restaurant/bar on the top floor was  was simply stunning, particularly at night. The breakfast had a good variety to chose from, and the drinks were amazing! We were particularly fond of the cocktails. It's in the perfect location to catch transportation. The reception will happily call you a taxi if you need one too. Everything was a short distance away. The atmosphere was very pleasant. It was cosy and charming. The air conditioning was a life saver after being out in the July Italian heat!

author: bec202
title: Great location and lovely hotel.
text:
Stayed for 3 nights as a family with two teens. Lovely hotel, very clean and all staff very welcoming. The room was a great set up for us all. Perfect location to explore Rome as the termini main station is a couple of mins walk away.  Highly recommend. 
Only suggestion to the hotel is to get some citronella repellents for the roof terrace- the wasps swarmed at breakfast. We will recommend this hotel to others and will hopefully return again.

author: David Lake
title: Class & elegance in the City
text: We had a lovely experience at the new Derby - everything was fresh and appointed beautifully in our room. We didn't get time but the high tea experience also looked amazing. Nice location close to Monument Tube station and Liverpool St if you are flying into Stansted. Thanks again to Soumya for the delightful sweets waiting for us when we got to our room.

author: Sarah H
title: Wonderful experience
text: A lovely time with our daughter Darcy-Really helpful staff particularly Setenay and Alby on the front desk this morning. Our room had a bath with amazing views over the river and was well appointed . Lovely cocktails last night and a fantastic breakfast this morning . Thank you for a great stay in the city

author: Christina T
title: Absolutely Excellent
text:
I stayed at The Derby for a week while traveling for business and honestly, best service I’ve had at a hotel. I tend to get a little anxiety when I travel but Sam at the front desk was absolutely wonderful and so so helpful. He made sure I had everything I needed in my room, including wall adapters. And when I checked out, he made sure I had the right transport to the airport, and switched out my room cards so that I’d have prettier ones as a souvenir. It’s that kind of individual care that I value. 

Overall, my room was very clean and comfortable. The cafe had really good food and great service. 

Finally, the location of the hotel itself was super convenient. It’s right down the road from the Tower of London, Tower Bridge, The Shard, the Monument to the Great Fire, and so many really fun restaurants and bars.

author: Almanzo M
title: Refreshing stay  stay - Great value for money
text: Was an awesome stay. The staff are really accommodating and polite. Wonderful accommodation; slept well. Breakfast spread was decent. Beautiful colour scheme - Green and gold. Very centrally located to London’s attractions and near a train station.

author: Kevin J
title: Charming Stay at The Derby
text:
My wife and I stayed at The Derby for our first international vacation for a week stay. It was also the weekend of a friend's wedding, which was down the street from the hotel.

Even before the stay, we were welcomed by the head concierge, Adelino, with an email detailing itinerary options for tours, restaurants, pubs, and more, that helped to shape our stay.

Upon arrival, we were greeted by Setenay, who was extremely helpful and polite for our entire stay. The room was clean and elegant, with views of the City of London area from both our bedroom and bathroom. During our stay, we had one small issue, and the staff handled it with class and professionalism. 

Overall, the stay felt like a home away from home. It is a charming hotel with an outstanding staff. We would highly recommend The Derby to anyone visiting the area.

author: martinbrechin
title: Premier Experience At The Premier Inn!
text: Third time staying at Premier Inn Blackfriars and it didn’t disappoint.  The hotel is in a great location, it’s in good condition in terms of both the public areas and the rooms, breakfast buffet is good and the staff are all super friendly and helpful. The one thing that let it down was the cleaning.  My wife is focussed on cleanliness, especially the bathroom and seeing a toilet bowl that didn’t appear to have been cleaned properly for quite some time was a real turn off.  However, overall a great experience once again and well will be back.

author: dieseldope
title: Great hotel for cyclists in center of London
text: We came for a one night stay without reservation, after cycling a whole day.  We received a warm welcome and the manager told us that if we made the booking on line, we could benefit from a cheaper rate (instead of having the hotel complete the booking).  So that was really appreciated, it saved us money for a lots of beers!  We could store our bicycles at our room or at the luggage room.  Service was excellent, room was clean, shower refreshing, bed was nice so had a good sleep and breakfast was great. We were ready for another day of cycling!

author: Anna M
title: Lovely stay
text:
Good morning,

This was our second time staying at this hotel, and just like the first time, it was great. Everyone was very welcoming and friendly, and always happy to help.

I was celebrating my 40th birthday with my girlfriends, and we were offered complimentary breakfast, which was a lovely touch.

We will definitely be coming back again!

author: Dawn A
title: Our favourite premier inn
text: We had a really enjoyable stay at the Premier Inn. The room was clean and comfortable, with a lovely comfy bed and a really good shower. The staff were friendly and welcoming, and the food was also very nice. Overall, a great stay and we would happily return.

author: DevonMan
title: Perfect stay near Fleet Street
text: I received the warmest of welcomes at Reception, and when I explained that I had a change of circumstances, he and a lady who joined him were most helpful, and I felt they genuinely cared. The room was spotlessly clean, very quiet and very comfortable. The hotel is located just off Fleet Street, close to bus stops and Blackfriars Underground. I was very lucky with a scratchcard I was given, as it was for 50% off main courses at dinner, so I made use of it. I had chicken makhani curry, with rice, poppadom and mango chutney, and it was delicious. There was a small technical issue which meant there was a lull during dinner when there was noone available to order dessert, but sometimes these things happen - it wasn't a huge problem for me. Full breakfast was included in my deal, and there was a choice of full English, cereals, croissants, yoghurts, fruit, various hot and cold drinks/juices... It was all fresh and delicious. I would definitely stay in this hotel again.

author: Connector15364954433
title: Broken mirror not by us!
text: We stayed in this rundown hotel, as it calls itself. The room was small and the air conditioning was noisy. But what really upset us was that they kept our $100 deposit, blaming us for breaking the mirror, which was absolutely not our fault. The staff was not at all courteous; no matter what we asked, they didn't respond politely. The breakfast wasn't plentiful; the tables were few and dirty, and often occupied. The morning we left, we asked if they could pack us a bag of breakfast, since we have a young child, but they refused. I wouldn't recommend it to anyone, even though the location is good.

author: Nicolo
title: Strategic hotel
text: Quiet hotel conveniently located close to walk to Time Square and surrounded by quiet places to eat, basic clean hotel, clean rooms, normal breakfast nothing exaggerated but normal nutritious and good , friendly and courteous staff

author: Boy_Scout
title: You Get What You Pay For
text: The hotel is priced below most hotels in NYC.  There are reasons for this.  It’s about 3/4 mile to the theater district; the rooms are very small and it’s definitely “no frills”.  That being said, if you’re just sleeping there and don’t mind the walk (or taxi ride) to get to where you’re going it’s an OK choice. The staff was friendly and helpful; the breakfast was just what you would expect from Comfort Inn, and we felt safe, even walking back from the theater at night.

author: Michael P
title: Unacceptable Experience at Comfort Inn Midtown
text:
I rarely write reviews, but my recent stay at your Midtown location compels me to be brutally honest: this was one of the worst hotel experiences I’ve ever had.

The Wi-Fi was a complete nightmare—slower than DSL, intermittent, and completely unreliable. Two public networks were available, neither functional: one (“Comfort_Inn”) promised connectivity but failed to reliably log in, and the other (“Wireless”) barely registered at all. For a hotel in the heart of New York City, this is absurd and unacceptable.

The staff’s behavior, however, was the most egregious part of my stay. I was subjected to a litany of unprofessional, petty, and legally questionable behavior, including:

Unjustified demands to enter my room: Staff repeatedly tried to gain access without valid reason and refused to provide details in writing, turning a simple stay into a stressful ordeal.

Harassment over my service dog: Staff insisted on seeing physical certification or a vest, despite ADA laws clearly stating this is not required. They attempted to intimidate me, citing a “no pets” policy that has no legal standing for service animals.

Dismissiveness and outright rudeness: Every attempt to address the situation calmly was met with condescension, ignorance, and petty power plays. Staff seemed more interested in asserting authority than actually serving guests.

General incompetence: Between the Wi-Fi issues and the staff’s unprofessionalism, it felt like the hotel actively worked against providing a basic level of service.

This experience was not only frustrating but also made me feel unsafe and disrespected. A hotel’s responsibility is to provide a secure, welcoming environment for paying guests—not to create unnecessary drama, violate guest rights, or showcase ignorance of fundamental accessibility laws.

I strongly urge management to seriously address these failures. Training, accountability, and a thorough review of policies regarding guest rights, accessibility, and professional conduct are essential. Guests should never leave a hotel feeling belittled, harassed, or disregarded, as I did during my stay.

author: Roam08015208904
title: This hotel was disgusting! Booking photos were lies!
text: This hotel was disgusting, unclean and dilapidated. I was moved once and neither room matched the booking photos. My first room had no working lights and a dead phone. Your front desk staffer wouldn't go with me to look for it so I had to wait for the shift change to get one of your employees to care. I have never seen such terrible service and unfit facilities. author: Lorena P

author: english_f
title: Decent value
text:
Great location, room was clean if a little basic and small but had everything we needed. Decent AC which we made good use of. 
Breakfast was also pretty good.
I'd definitely recommend this hotel if you want a cheap room in London.

The most annoying thing about this hotel was the bedroom lights are either all on or completely off, which makes the bedside lamps completely useless.

author: Francesco Fasanella
title: Excellent location for visiting London
text:
Very nice hotel and, above all, in an excellent location for visiting London. We stayed for 5 days and had a very good time: for those who use the hotel mainly as a base to tour the city, it is more than fine.

The rooms are a bit small, but functional nonetheless. The bathroom has a somewhat unusual layout and might not be to everyone's liking, but overall we had no problems.

Breakfast is good, with a more than sufficient selection to start the day.

Overall we were satisfied, especially with the location and the convenience for getting around. Good hotel for a stay of a few days in London.

author: Debra C
title: Lovely and comfortable stay
text: Grove Guest House feels like a real find. Wonderful breakfast, I slept like a log and Hazel is a warm and welcoming host. This is a real family home full of art and photos and history.  I hope to come back and stay again.

author: 田村明美
title: The best guest house that always welcomes you gently
text:
I have been with Globe Guest House for the past eight years whenever I have been to London.
Owner Hazel is also an artist who creates wonderful works while also working diligently in the community.
They are very kind and you can spend a relaxing time as if you were home in London.
Is it okay to serve such a luxurious breakfast in overpriced London? So much so that I am worried.
Forest Gate Station on the nearest Elizabeth line also has a co-op by the station, and some shops allow you to take out biryani and other items until midnight, so you can source food even after an opera performance.
I would love to keep it as my secret hideaway, but I hope many people will know how wonderful it is.

author: Ray B
title: Hazel's house 😄
text: I've stayed with Hazel many times for a number of years. She runs a lovely guest home. Quirky but that's what makes it special as opposed to a generic branded hotel room...which btw you would pay more for. Easy access to Zone 1 along the lizzy line. Rooms are clean and its very quiet at night save for the trains nearby...which is basically London lol. Free WiFi, friendly atmosphere and a warm welcome.

author: Scenic146464

author: Tony F

author: Asem G
title: STAR – BE VERY CAREFUL WITH YOUR CREDIT CARD
text:
⭐️ 1 STAR – BE VERY CAREFUL WITH YOUR CREDIT CARD

I strongly recommend that travelers think twice before staying at this hotel.

I had already paid for my reservation through Expedia. At check-in, the hotel asked for my credit card for a security deposit/incidental authorization, which I understood would be released after check-out.

Instead, my credit card was actually charged.

After I contacted Expedia and the hotel, I was told that the refund would be processed. Expedia even confirmed in writing that the hotel’s front office supervisor would process the refund and that I should receive the money within 3–7 business days.

More than 15 days later, I still have not received my money.

I provided the requested bank/credit card documentation to Expedia, and I have continued to cooperate with every request. I was even asked for a separate hotel receipt that was never provided to me.

The most frustrating part is that I have documentation showing the charge, documentation showing that the reservation was already paid through Expedia, and written communication confirming that a refund was supposed to be processed.

This is not about a small inconvenience. This is about taking money from a customer’s credit card and then making the customer spend weeks trying to get it back.

If you are staying here, PLEASE check your credit card statement carefully after checkout and make sure that any security deposit or incidental charge is actually released.

I hope the hotel finally does the right thing and returns my money. Until then, based on my personal experience, I cannot recommend this hotel.

Travelers deserve transparency, honesty, and their money back when they are owed a refu

author: Marie-Carmen C
title: Close to Times Square and activities
text: We had a wonderful family stay. The cleanliness was great, the breakfast in the morning was complete, and the coffee was good for hotel coffee. The most positive aspect is my distance from this hotel to Times Square. We were able to go rest between two activities with the children. The room was not very big but well-equipped. A microwave was missing, however.

author: GoraDelhi
title: Good option nearer to Times Square & Penn Station
text: It was a very short trip and identified this property because of its location : close to Times Square and NYC Penn station. The hotel seems to be designed for guests looking for a good sleep in the night with the day & evening spent outside. The room had a comfortable bed and a good bathroom with a shower. Keeping even two strollers was challenging. Downstairs make shift breakfast area gets heavily crowded but the spread is reasonably good.

author: Michelle B
title: Horrible Loud Dirty Stay Consider Yourself Warned
text:
I was really disappointed with this hotel. After booking, I called ahead and specifically requested a quiet room away from the street. When we arrived, we were still given a room facing the street. When I asked to be moved, the front desk said the hotel was fully booked, but I later checked online and there were still rooms available.

Another major issue was the cleanliness. There were a noticeable amount of flies in the front desk and dining area, which was very off-putting. The breakfast was also underwhelming—mostly reheated items like sausage, biscuits, bagels, yogurt, and oatmeal, with nothing particularly fresh or appealing.

The room itself was very small. While it looked clean at first glance, the carpeted floors throughout the property were dirty. Noise was also a big problem; you could clearly hear doors slamming in the mornings from guests and housekeeping, and there is a club across the street that plays loud music all night.

Even the window shades did very little to block out light, making it difficult to get a good night’s sleep. Overall, this stay did not meet expectations, and I would not recommend it for anyone looking for rest or comfort.

author: Mark P
title: Awesome
text: Awesome great location.   Nice staff

author: pgarcia_192019
title: Good experience
text: The hotel was very good, the receptionists were friendly and offered a very good service.  Breakfast was good and the gym as well.

author: Andrew Z
title: Unprofessional service and a complete theft of $1,400.
text: Do not book here. I prepaid 100% of my 4-night stay ($1,400) via Expedia, but my flight to NYC was delayed. I called the hotel multiple times to inform them, but nobody answered the phone and there was no voicemail setup. I then sent an official message through Expedia letting them know I would arrive 12 hours late the next morning. When I arrived, they had cancelled my booking and refused to give me my room, claiming they never received a notification. Unprofessional service and a complete theft of $1,400. Avoid at all costs.
