author: Grumblepoot
title: Excellent home base
text:
Cleanliness- 10/10
Staff - 10/10
Location 10/10
Breakfast- exactly what you need to fuel the day exploring the city. Bonus points for being free, which saves funds for doing what one needs to do most - have fun in NYC.
Room- exactly what we needed with a super comfy bed. As other reviews have mentioned it’s not super large, but I’ve stayed in much, much smaller rooms in NYC (there’s only so much space on the island), and TBH, I’m not spending much time in my room anyways. 
Balcony - excellent view of the Chrysler Building and a wonderful amenity.

Looking forward to returning!

author: BayAreaTraveler2
title: It’s ok
text: It’s ok. The room is kind of small and had no real view, but the room and the hotel were clean and up to date. The breakfast area was the only common area and it was small but it worked. Space between the front door, front desk, and elevator was small and understaffed but it functioned. The room’s bathroom door was semi-transparent in a not really revealing way, and its only function seemed to be so that if one person uses the bathroom at night, the other person has the bed illuminated. Several subway lines were nearby, and plenty of food and other options nearby. No guest laundry and we didn’t try the exercise facility.

author: bizbdm
title: Hotel away from the hustle and bustle but still very convenient

author: mari m

author: GENNADY S

text: The location is good, and breakfast is surprisingly acceptable. The rooms are small, power outlets are few, and the wifi is the worst I have seen in a hotel in many years.

author: doclorenzo
title: Much better than the reviews, overall nice!
text: Stayed 3 nights on business. I was concerned due to mixed reviews. But, the room was clean, quiet and comfortable. The breakfast was standard for any Hampton Inn. The staff was EXCELLENT, maybe the friendliest front desk staff I have come across in a long time. The parking was a block away but explained well. Yes, the rooms are small, as are msg hotel rooms in NYC. But other than that I have no complaints, and I would definitely stay there again. There are absolutely fancier hotels with bigger rooms and more amenities...at double or triple the price. Plus, the walkability to the wonderfully modernized South Street Seaport area was great. Actually I was surprised just how much was walkable, even at night for food, coffee houses, etc...Great job!

author: pkpenny
title: Good value and location for central London
text: Stayed for 2 nights on a theatre/ sightseeing trip for my wife and I. Paid extra for early check in and room with a view. Check in was smooth and friendly. We had a room on 12th floor of the new tower with a view of the London eye. We really liked the location of this hotel for Waterloo underground ( 5 mins walk) and same to Big Ben. Staff were friendly and the evening meal and breakfast were good with fair amount of choice. Bed was super comfy and room aircon worked really well. Only gripe was the room size. It was REALLY small ( we had difficulty passing each other between the bed and walls ! ) VERY  compact wardrobe space and no drawers to speak of to store clothes / pads etc. If we had been staying longer with more luggage this may have been more of an issue & I may have opted for the County Hall Prem Inn 100 yards away where I remember much bigger rooms. Overall though it was good for our needs this trip and good value.

author: Meander53901232405
title: Decent but …
text:
Hotel very well located, clean, helpful staff.   Breakfast quite decent.  On the other hand, the pizzas at dinner leave something to be desired … no taste and the crust very dry … disappointed 
Cost of the rooms quite high, especially to have a room with a view of a wall …

author: Andrew T
title: Andrew and Paula
text:
We booked this hotel as it was central to most of our plans while staying in London. 
Check in was smooth with no issues as was the check out. 
We found all of the staff extremely friendly, attentive and helpful during our stay. From breakfast staff, bar staff, reception staff and cleaning staff all extremely polite.
The hotel was very clean with tea, coffee ,milk and sugar at reception to replenish the room as required. 
We would recommend anyone to stay at this hotel for its great location and friendly staff.
Thank you to all the staff at the hotel for a lovely stay.

author: Yas M

Comfortable and clean hotel. The subway is 5 minutes away, and BIG BEN is 10 minutes away. 
We spent 3 very pleasant nights there after long days of exploring London.

author: NYC
title: Amazing stay!!
text:
Stayed at this hotel for the weekend with my friends and it was great. The service was amazing and the room was very clean and up to standards. The location is perfect for what ever you’re doing as it’s so central. I would highly recommend staying and I will be definitely be back!!

author: Ant H

The rooms were nice and cool and quiet despite proximity to the trains. There's a Waitrose and Tesco express just downstairs and you can easily catch trains, busses, and the underground.

The breakfast options were fresh and delicious, with a great variety to choose from.

author: igm1974

Truly fantastic, very kind and helpful staff, well-kept and clean environment. 
Top!
Thanks a lot and see you soon.....

author: Lynn A
title: Wonderful Hotel
text: An excellent hotel. The movie themed decor is clever, not ovedone. The hotel and our bedroom was very clean. The staff is courteous and efficient. The breakfast is abundantl, Lewis at the front desk was particularly helpful with restaurant reservations . There are some extra touches which are very nice. They the stock the  in room mini bar for free with non alcoholic drinks and put in drinking glasses so they chill! The free afternoon through evening drink and snack offering is abundant. This is an amazing hotel for a better than expected price. The location is right across the street from the metro .

author: D M
title: Paris made comfortable.
text: We arrived early after a long flight from Australia and were warmly greeted and immediately felt at home. The front desk staff were a wealth of knowledge and always happy to help. We stayed 7 nights, all excellent. Our room and the entire hotel was very clean. The room aircon was a saviour during the week long Paris heatwave. Breakfast was plentiful, varied and most delicious. French pastries too. The breakfast staff were personable and always helpful. Nothing was too much trouble. The hotel is in such an excellent position, with easy access to the Metro / RER and walking distance to many good restaurants. We have already recommended the hotel to our friends as we would stay again. Repeating the words we said as we left, the hotel contributed to our fabulous week in Paris. We highly recommend staying at 123 Sebastopol.

author: LJWooo
title: Terrible security
text: Terrible security. We had to hand our key in when we left the hotel and when we returned it was a different member of staff on reception who did not check who we were- we just said a room number and he handed us the key. Anyone could walk in and say a room number and they just hand over the key without even checking the name! Glad we only stayed one night. Also charged 2,50€ for a tiny bottle of water and did not offer any tap water. Bright light outside the hotel made it hard to sleep.  Shame as location was ideal for us.

author: w l

author: Antonio R

author: David J

author: Christine F

The location is perfect! The subway next door with lines 1 and 14 + RER is super convenient!
The professional staff and the breakfast were top-notch!

author: Abbie
title: Great budget option if happy to travel into Rome.
text:
Great little hotel. We had booked 2 x rooms and pre requested adjoining if possible but at check in we’re told the rooms were next to each other. On getting to the room we found both were double beds but reception were quick to send someone up to turn one room into single beds. 
The rooms were newly renovated and clean. Lacking in a USB port. One room had a massive walk in shower but my room was a small bath with a hand shower and no way of attaching to the wall so I used the other room. Disappointed that the coffee facility in the rooms were paper cups but I’m sure they would not have minded if I’d raked proper cups from breakfast. 
The hotel is a 20 min train from Romes main Termini and then a 10 min walk. 1.50 euro. 
The hotel has a small restaurant where we had daily buffet breakfast. Lovely and fresh food options, home made cakes and biscuits and the staff were happy to make me a fresh coffee rather than from the available machine. We visited the water park one day and this was only 15 minutes away via Uber.

author: Salvador D
title: Good hotel
text: Good hotel, very friendly and helpful staff.

author: Jennifer W
title: Would not recommend. Left early.
text:
I booked my hotel through the Chase travel portal. The price was great esp during high season and a lot of other hotels much more expensive. 

The good:
- Able to put three people in a room for a reasonable price. This seems uncommon in Italy. 
- breakfast nice, continental style. Coffee machine the bomb
- free street parking around the block. Surprisingly safe. 
- nice family style neighborhood pizza/restaurant called 6zero9 down the street
- reasonable walking distance and access to Cornelia station with access to metro 
- did not charge us for city tax for last day when we decided to check out early.
- cleaning lady came daily to clean room. 

The bad
- breakfast is not free if room booked through Chase (which is seen as Expedia on hotel side)  -8 euro pp
- a/c not working pretty miserable as room seemed to generate heat. Mosquitos come if you leave door open to ventilate. No ETA on A/C fix. 
- shower made entire bathroom floor wet.
- toilet super high off the ground. A really weird set up. 
- poor lighting - bring a headlamp! Lights also generated a lot of heat. 
- mini fridge does not generate cold. It is more of a cooler that generates more heat. 
- no luggage rack 

Would not recommend. Poor experience.

author: Jasmine J
title: It should be removed from the IHG portfolio
text:
Terrible Experience – Completely Unacceptable for an IHG Property

We genuinely do not understand how this hotel qualifies as an IHG property. It fails to meet even the most basic standards of comfort and customer service.

First, the location is directly on one of the busiest streets imaginable. Motorcycles, trucks, and cars are constantly racing by—it honestly sounds like a war zone, with what feels like a nonstop Harley-Davidson parade. 

At check-in, the front desk associate (Steven) was friendly, but gave us no warning about the major issue awaiting us. When we entered our room, it was extremely small and very basic. Worse yet, the temperature inside was 30°C (87°F). We opened the balcony door hoping for relief, only to be hit with overwhelming street noise and mosquitoes—there is no screen.

We called the front desk about how to operate the air conditioning, only to be told that the system had been broken all day, no technician was coming, and there was nothing that could be done. Because of the noise, we could barely hear the conversation and had to go downstairs in person.

There, we found multiple other frustrated guests in the same situation—rooms were unbearably hot with no solution. One couple had just arrived from a long flight from Korea with a ticket at 7am the next morning to visit the Coliseum, and two women was from the U.S.—all IHG members, all completely dissatisfied.

We requested a refund so we could move to another hotel, but were told that only the manager and the booking department (who would not be present until the next morning) could approve it. We then spent two hours of our vacation contacting IHG customer care, only to be told the same thing—nothing could be done until the next day.

Ironically, the lobby and bar had working air conditioning (standalone units), which made the situation even more frustrating.

So to summarize:

-The hotel had a known, property-wide air conditioning failure on a hot, humid day.
-There was no management onsite to handle the situation
-Guests were left in unsafe, unlivable conditions with no immediate solution

Ultimately, we had no choice but to find another hotel late at night. Fortunately, just behind this property we found the Ergife Palace Hotel, located in a quiet oasis with a huge pool, palm trees, spacious rooms, and a luxury breakfast buffet—all for €50 less than what we paid here. We didn't get to rest until midnight.

Even with functioning air conditioning, this hotel does not meet IHG standards due to its location, room quality, and overall guest experience. The complete lack of accountability and support only reinforces this. The next morning, we did go back to speak to a manager for our refund, he apologized and asked us to send him an email regarding the situation in order to process our request. We did as he instructed, but we have not heard from him as of now, nor have seen a refund on our credit statement. 

This property should not represent the IHG brand. Members deserve far better than being misled into staying at a substandard hotel like this.

author: Eli G
title: Avoid
text: Slow, small rooms, unrelyable. I recommend: do not go there

author: Uktourist77256
title: A litte smelly
text:
A good hotel. Close to the stations with good service. 

Unfortunately the only downside was the sewage smell that lingered. We were on the 6th floor,  and it was worst outside in the corridor but our room smelled musty.

Can't fault the cleanliness as the room was spotless and the view was amazing.

As others have noted there was a sporadic rumble caused by the nearby metro. 

Good value just a shame about the smell!

author: Lucas J
title: Lovely Hotel Near Stations, Minor Smell Issue
text: A really lovely hotel that we enjoyed a lot. It's super close to the stations and the service was genuinely helpful throughout our stay. The only downside was a sewage smell that lingered around the place. We stayed on the 6th floor and it was worst out in the corridor, though our room did smell a bit musty too. That said, I can't fault the cleanliness at all because the room was absolutely spotless and the view was amazing. Like other guests have mentioned, there was a sporadic rumble from the nearby metro that you could hear now and then. Honestly it's very good value for money and the location can't be beaten, just a real shame about that smell because otherwise it would have been a completly perfect trip. We'd still happily come back and would recommend it to anyone visiting Paris on a budget.

author: Suse M
title: Always happy to return
text: I have been coming to this establishment for many years. Especially in the summer, I appreciate the air conditioning and mini-fridge. The location is unbeatable and the staff (from reception to cleaning staff) are super nice and always helpful. The small balcony made drying my swimwear easy. Facing the front, you even have a view of Sacré-Cœur. (But I prefer the quieter rooms in the back)

author: Road44410994137
title: It was not a privilege to stay in a privilege double room.
text:
Upon arrival(having been travelling since 3am) we had to wait a further hour and a half for our rooms to be ready even though check in is 2pm. 
The privilege double room was a lot smaller than expected. The room was quite dark and some lights were not working. The hair dryer was not working and the shower head left a lot to be desired(standing in a shower of rain would have had better results) 
The area for the hotel is VERY noisy so bring earplugs if you want to actually sleep. The pillows are uncomfortable and lumpy.
The breakfast was minimal to say the least, we ventured down for a look one morning with the hopes of having a nice buffet. We were told the pancakes/crepes were finished and the rest of the buffet could fit easily on a kitchen sideboard( for €14pp there were very few options,we went elsewhere) 
Simple things like toilet paper is also an issue as we were expected to use less than half a roll between two adults from one room refresh to the other(they didn’t leave any if there was half a roll left in the room) and we had to keep asking for it when we arrived back from sight seeing each day.
Also the room manager walked in on my daughter while she was in the room, he was doing room checks but rather than wait for a reply he simply opened the door and stuck his head in to see was the room cleaned! 
My daughter was very distraught as she could have been changing or showering when he opened the door! 
Having the train station across the road is good for sight seeing.

author: serzou
title: Perfect!
text: We come here often, next to the Gare de l'Est, beautiful hotel, beautiful room and bathroom, everything very clean! Beautiful common areas and a very good breakfast. Efficient and friendly staff.....that is why we keep coming back!!

author: Daniela B
title: Convenient

Breakfast from 6 to 10, with little choice and some mix-ups. One day they couldn't find the cutlery and another day the delivery hadn't arrived, so no breakfast. Well... author: Coastal02633596174
title: Great location
text:
Great location
Attention they have withdrawn a larger amount than due after check out.Be careful.

author: GRMY64
title: Very good hotel for day use.
text: We went to this hotel for day use. Pleasant welcome and quick check-in at the reception, where we were informed that we could stay until 9 PM (instead of 8 PM as indicated on the website we used). author: sebastien f
title: Stay at the top
text:
Ideal location, between The Edge and Empire State. Room not large but very functional, bedding at the top, bathroom too. Hearty sweet and sufficiently renewed salty breakfast.
Perfect Wifi connection.
Excellent value for money.

author: pedropinheiroo
title: A Charming Stay at a Great Location
text: First of all, I loved the attention Adriana gave me while answering all my pre-stay questions through the Hilton app. I truly appreciate that level of care! Upon arrival, I was delighted to learn that breakfast was included. My room was lovely and spacious, and the location is perfect as it is close to everything. It was an excellent experience, and the entire front desk team was very friendly.

author: NikoLatre
title: The best thing is the location
text: A fairly basic hotel, but it delivers for the price-quality ratio. I booked it for one night to be close to the station to take the train early in the morning. The staff is friendly.

author: Tessy M
title: Memorable stay
text: Very convenient and central location.  Quite environment. Nice and cozy. Affordable with value for money. Absolutely very clean. The staffs, specially Mr Marco, Ms Ida and Mr Jovani were very nice and helpful. Thank you for making our days memorable in Roma.

author: Mrs C
title: Awful customer service
text: Don’t do it! I reserved a room for 5 days. After reading many reviews about people arriving and having non-working A/C, I needed to confirm that our room would have a working A/C unit as we would be traveling with people (with medical issues) & medications that could not withstand certain temps. I sent 2 emails with no response and then tried to call the hotel. A woman answered & said “this is not for confirmations, lady”, I explained what I was trying to verify & was hung up on. Tried to call back more than 15 times throughout the day & was hung up on every time.

author: satu j
title: Great experience
text: Location really good, easy to explore the city. Atmosphere cozy and the staff is so friendly. Room was small but just enough for sleeping. Value for the money is excellent. I am sure to come back also next time. Thank you🩷

author: Donaldo84
title: A train brought me to safety.
text: Rome is definitely among the most beautiful cities in the world, and I love spending weekends there. This time, however, I was just passing through, and I needed a place to spend Sunday night while waiting to catch the train the next morning. I will start with the positive aspects: the proximity to Termini Station. The facility is really just 50 meters from the entrance of the train terminal. There were no issues with check-in, despite the late hour; after all, I had made sure to inform the hotel several times by phone about my arrival around midnight. Unfortunately, the list of pros ends miserably here. The rest was a nightmare. I had booked a single room for about €100, so I did not expect much. But certainly, I did not deserve to stay in the staff room. Of course, those who work in hospitality will always have my esteem and respect, but the dignity of the customer must still be respected. The small room assigned to me faced DIRECTLY onto the small breakfast room: something between absurd and embarrassing. The small thin wooden door, of course, could never have shielded the room, and so I had the honor of having breakfast with all the hotel guests. But, unfortunately, much worse had happened during the night: I simply found myself in the water. The bidet's drain was not working, and the water simply flooded the bathroom and part of the room. Some of my clothes got wet. At 2 in the morning, I contacted the night porter, who, upon arriving in the room, could do nothing but assess the situation, and nothing more. And so I fell asleep in a semi-flooded room. After the hotel guests "unintentionally invited" me to breakfast, I crossed the threshold and joined them. Just enough time to enjoy a rather unappetizing brioche and a piece of tart, then I decided to finish breakfast with a coffee and a cappuccino. Unfortunately, when I returned from the machine to my little table, I found it cleared of the saucer and cutlery, and already occupied by two other guests. I tried to ask the waiter for an explanation, who simply invited me to take another table. The disbelief was great, but fortunately I had a train waiting for me not far away. I managed to wash my teeth and face (fortunately the sink's drain was different from that of the bidet), I put the pajamas back in the suitcase and fled. I have never been so happy to check out. At the time of paying the tourist tax, I took advantage of the presence of what I believe was the owner of the establishment to inform her of the "small" inconvenience with the bathroom (I limited myself, out of pity, to just that). She had already been informed by the night porter. Unfortunately, a sudden phone call did not allow her to apologize properly. Fortunately, I had a train waiting for me. I have elaborated on this story, but the experience was truly traumatic, even though it was very brief. I sincerely hope that the other rooms are normal (I saw that the keys, unlike mine, were magnetic), but in case you need a single room, only accept it following a good offer: personally, I would not agree to relive this stay even if they offered me 50 euros. I find it hard to believe that I had to pay for that "room."

author: Manuela B
title: Little Caterina
text:
Our room was located on the first floor far from the reception (so I did not see the rest of the property), I can say that the location was excellent for moving towards the main attractions of Rome.
The room was very small for three people, but clean.

author: Mona H
title: Nearby hotel in the centre of Rome! Obs no elevator!
text: Nearby hotel in the centre of Rome! We were placed elsewhere than the hotel that we booked! The hotel communicated well with us so it went well and found out to the other hotel! The hotel was nice but no elevator and had to walk many stairs! Rooms were nice and big! Nice staff!

author: Spipard
title: Bad experience
text:
Maybe I was particularly unlucky, but my experience was this: 

1) On January 9th I book a room for 2 nights in February. The reservation, guaranteed by Mastercard circuit card, was successful.
2) Five days before departure I receive notification that the card was not charged and I am required to change my Card.
3) I immediately change my card but a few hours later I receive another notification similar to the first: the property can not charge me the cost of the reservation.
4) Since both cards are fully functional, covered by liquidity and with adequate ceilings (I used them both for other purchases on the same days), I try to contact the structure and here the problems arise: on the phone they do not answer (I called at different times and on different days), on the Booking chat they do not respond to my many messages in which I request to be contacted to understand if maybe I can provide a transfer.
5) Four days before departure I receive a notification that my reservation has been cancelled, all without ever having received a shred of response from the structure. So I found myself having to look for another one in a hurry and it was particularly stressful. Obviously I successfully booked the new structure with the Card that did not work for them.

And that's it. All documentable, so I challenge these Gentlemen to contest this review.

author: Emmanouil
title: Very bad experience
text: Dont book with them. They double charge and they dont reply through booking.com or through calls. Very bad experience.

author: Silvia
title: DISAPPOINTING
text:
Professionalism is not at home.
We made a reservation on Booking in July for an apartment for 9 people, 2 days after the date of alleged charge of the stay (15 days before departure) we are reported that there was a problem with the charge with the credit card, after several attempts to call the structure for more information obviously without any answer and have entered another credit card, the email with CANCELLED BOOKING arrived.
The property could not be contacted for more information and Booking assistance could not do anything.
Subsequently I saw that the structure has done it several times symptom of very little seriousness.

author: Jannah H
title: Perfect central london stay
text: Perfect hotel for Hyde Park. Quiet street,  air conditioning and comfy beds. The staff are so lovely and were even kind enough to provide complementary breakfast!

author: TSH90
title: All right.
text:
We first got room 51, which is definitely not recommended. It needs a solid upgrade. The room was not properly cleaned etc. in addition. 
However, after a little while and we got to switch to another room in a slightly newer part. Totally curant room for short stay. Small rooms, cleaned fine (but could be even more thorough) and newer aircon here.
Most of the people we talked to who work there were very nice and therefore land at 3. 
Location attracts very much.

author: Gemma Y
title: Will definitely stay again
text:
I was a little apprehensive before arriving because I’d read some mixed reviews, but our experience couldn’t have been better. We originally booked a room with two single beds, but the hotel kindly upgraded us to a much larger room with two double beds and a single bed, which was perfect for our family and gave us plenty of space for our pushchair.

The room and bathroom were both spotless, the air conditioning worked brilliantly, and the beds were very comfortable. The staff were so friendly, welcoming and helpful from the moment we arrived.

For a 3-star hotel, we thought it was excellent value for money. We had a really enjoyable stay and would happily book here again.

We stayed here because my husband had an appointment on the other side of Hyde Park and it was a really good location close to everything we walked up to Oxford Street

author: James F
title: Great
text: Very central to everything. Staff were extremely friendly and helpful.

author: Naveen K
title: It’s a cheap deal for a reason , and it still won’t be cheap enough - avoid
text:
Whilst the room was cheap - sub £100 for the night (single room), it isn’t cheap enough to make that worthwhile. 

Tiniest room and shower cubical I’ve ever seen and everything felt cheap and nasty. Wires visible leading to the air con unit , paint work touched up by Stevie Wonder, as paint was all over the spot lights and sockets. Just bad. Curtains are as thin as tracing paper. No matter how cheap it might be, stay elsewhere - avoid

author: Michael Skaarup
title: Very central
text:
Boede has 5 days for a city break in beautiful Paris 
The room and bathroom were large and bright 
Rent and good furniture 
The bed was super comfortable and we slept well 
The purchased breakfast gave a good start to the day 
Can highly recommend the hotel for a city break

author: Vinicius Daudt
title: Bom hotel, com excelente localização.
text: We stayed at the Hotel de Suez between May 4th and 8th, 2026. I've been to Paris many times in recent years. The location of this hotel on Boulevard Saint Michel is certainly one of its strong points. It's close to iconic Parisian landmarks like Notre Dame Cathedral and others. The area is well served by the metro, with lines 4 and 10 providing easy access. The room is a suitable size for a couple. The reception staff provides reasonable service. Overall, the hotel adequately meets the needs of a couple.

author: Anatole S
title: Avoid if you value sleep or service
text:
While the location is "okay" because it’s near the Latin Quarter and Saint-Germain-des-Prés, it is situated on a busy, noisy boulevard. Unfortunately, any convenience was completely overshadowed by a frustrating and poorly managed stay.

We booked eight months in advance for our anniversary, specifically requesting a quiet room on a high floor. Instead, we were placed on the second floor, directly over a noisy bus stop. The room was unbearably warm, and we were informed the AC isn't turned on until June. Despite complaining several times, a fan was only finally provided on our third night (out of four). To make matters worse, the fan was loud and it sounded like industrial equipment.

Management completely ignored multiple emails regarding our experience. On our last day, we were told we could finally move, but when we arrived back at the hotel, the staff claimed no rooms were available. After I pushed back, they initially tried to give us a twin-bed interior room that was even worse than the first.

It was only when my wife and I stood our ground in the reception and with a few other guests present that the staff "suddenly" found a key for a room on the 5th floor—a room that had clearly been available the entire time. While this room was finally away from the street noise, it was still tiny—so cramped that the bathroom uses a sliding door because there is no space for a normal one. It remained uncomfortably hot, and we had to move the fan from the previous room ourselves.

At over €200 a night, the service was unhelpful and the rooms are small with uncomfortable bedding. I would not recommend this hotel.

author: Reparmigiani
title: Excellent Location and Cozy
text:
From the reception to the departure everything was excellent! The best croissants of my life, hot, crispy, deliciously dried! In addition, the copper's sympathy cheered our mornings, striving to speak Portuguese with us!
Great shower and bathroom that had towel heater and soft towels.
We were in three adults and we stayed comfortably installed!
The only detail that could be revised is that the mattress of the double bed was a bit deep on one side, but did not affect us. 
We were very satisfied with the stay that provided us with water with and without gas and kettle.

author: EpicurienLR
title: Nice but noisy hotel
text:
We stayed at this hotel for several days. Our room was clean but facing road. Very difficult to fall asleep with the noise of cars and especially the sound of sirens (police, ambulance, fire...). 
We also need to review the hallway light that goes under the door and illuminates the room at night, as does the thermostat that illuminates the room far too much. The maid is not as discreet in the morning because not everyone gets up at 7am!
On the other hand nothing to complain about the welcome.

author: Semra T
title: Very clean
text: Very clean, high quality products in the room, very good location.

author: Annemarie
title: Cheerful, artistic, and very friendly
text:
Very friendly, clean, cozy, trendy, cheerful, and artistic hotel
This will be our favorite hotel in the coziest neighborhood of Paris. We are not staying anymore. On a little jump from the Moulin Rouge and 300 meters from Boris Boulangerie from Miraculous Ladybug

author: Stephanie K
title: Fantastic hotel
text: 5+ stars! Impeccable customer service, incredible location in the heart of Montmarte, friendly, helpful staff and beautiful rooms. So many little touches that made this a unique experience and a hotel to come back to. Merci!

author: Alin D
title: Great value for money. Staff makes
text: There are plenty of good things about the hotel. Staff is the most important one, great smiles and great service. The hotel is nice, simple, efficient. Rooms are small same with bathrooms. It did work for us but bigger people will not fit in the shower, at least not in our room. This is a typical refurbished old building, so the feeling is different from a typical chain hotel. We loved it and many people will find it an exceptional value for money. But know what to expect

author: Claudia
title: Cozy, small, clean hotel
text:
Perfect hotel for exploring the Montmartre area. The room was small, but well-equipped. View into a small courtyard, but very quiet at night.
Staff was very friendly and accommodating. When checking in, I also received a map to explore the neighborhood. I did that, and it was very interesting and worth seeing.
The hotel is located in a quiet area; walking home at night (alone as a woman) was no problem at all.
I enjoyed it thoroughly and will likely come back again.

author: Aissata P
title: I had a great stay in the hotel
text:
Very attentive and pleasant staff, specially Dery and Karina who were true darlings. 
Very nice room with an incredible view of New York. I will most definitely come back. Thank you

author: santiagocobo@gmail.com
title: Excellent!
text: Excellent service at Noel at the bar

author: Connor M
title: Great hotel in LES
text: They upgraded me to the sickest room with a full floor balcony overlooking the city. Dery and Chris are the goats. Will come back soon.

author: Zuhare R
title: Excellent Lower East Side Stay
text: Dery and Jessica were exceptionally helpful, offered us cold waters after we dragged luggage up from the train, they were both very accommodating to our requests throughout our stay. Excellent location, high volume of restaurants within a 20 minute walking radius, easy to access, close to the F Train. Room itself was very nice with decent space, CA king bed, nice bathroom, even though we were on a lower floor, lots of light and no smells from the balcony. Will absolutely book here again our next stay.

author: Justine P
title: New Favorite Hotel!!
text:
We stayed here over the weekend for my son’s birthday and had such an incredible time! The staff truly went above and beyond to make our stay so special. They decorated our room with balloons, a birthday banner, and the sweetest handwritten note. He was SO excited and immediately felt like a VIP. They even accommodated his very specific request for apple juice during wine hour!! Thank you, Dery, for making him feel so special and for going the extra mile!!

The location honestly cannot be beat. It was the perfect landing spot after a busy day in NYC.  We loved being able to walk everywhere and easily pop back in when we needed a break. 

The whole experience felt so warm and personal. From the thoughtful birthday surprise to the incredibly friendly staff, they really made our weekend memorable. We’ll definitely be back!

author: CARLOS S
title: NASTY HOTEL!!!!!
text:
Horrible hotel! Look at the pictures and read the reviews carefully before booking. The actual room was NOTHING like what was shown in the pictures.
The hotel was dirty, and the bathroom was unbelievably small. The toilet was only about 6 inches from the wall, making it nearly impossible to sit. The shower was so small that a normal-sized person could barely use it.
Our bathroom didn’t even have water, and there was a towel on the floor with what appeared to be human feces on it. 🤢
As soon as we saw the room, we asked for our money back, but they refused. We ended up leaving and paying for another hotel that was much nicer, clean, and had air conditioning.
Don’t waste your money! Before making a reservation, ask them to send you REAL pictures of the exact room you’ll be staying in. The pictures online are extremely misleading.

author: Marcela C
title: The worst hotel I have ever booked in my life.
text:
The worst hotel I have ever booked in my life. The photos are completely misleading and look nothing like the actual property. The location is okay, but everything else was absolutely unacceptable.

The reception area is old, cluttered, and full of construction materials and debris. The elevator is unbelievably tiny — barely large enough for one person at a time.

But the worst part was the room and bathroom. The room is extremely small, dark, and absolutely impossible for two people to stay comfortably. There is NO AIR CONDITIONING, which is unacceptable during the European summer.

The bathroom is even worse. It is so ridiculously small that you can barely fit inside. It is practically impossible to sit on the toilet properly because there is simply no space. The shower area is absurdly cramped, making the entire bathroom almost unusable.

To make matters worse, we found a dirty towel lying on the floor when we entered the room.

We walked in and walked right back out within five minutes. I have traveled and stayed in many hotels, and I have honestly never seen anything this bad. The property is completely misrepresented by the photos, and the reality is shocking. I would absolutely NOT recommend this hotel.

author: Aka Y
title: Unsafe living conditions in central Paris - stay away from!
text: Unsafe living conditions in Central Paris. Building has sewer issues that owner knows about it but decides to do nothing about it hence their response was - wait 5 minute your toilet will clear itself ( it didn’t , got worse) . No replacement rooms available either when requested one. Sneaky people don’t leave hotel before you’ve got your refund in your hands otherwise you’ll have to go through your bank . Careful this hotel will ruin your holiday .

author: Ygor M
title: The booking was charged twice on our card!
text: Don't fall in the blow. They charged the reservation on our card twice and do not return the amount. They report that two reservations were made, but we did not. We warned that the charge was wrong before even the card released the amount and still continued the charge!

author: Haydon d Bayliss
title: Poor quality, hazardous and quite frankly, false advertising.
text:
I checked in to the hotel Eiffel Kensington the 6th of may with my partner to celebrate my birthday in Paris. On check in we were greeted by a friendly gentleman who gave us our keys and directed us towards our room. on the desk was a sign saying the wifi wasn't working, unfortunately no compensation was given for this. when we left the elevator we emerged into a pitch black corridor where I almost tripped on a mop bucket haphazardly left by the stairs. once we got into room 14  the bedroom was clean but poorly decorated and the bed was small with 2 thin pillows, we asked for more pillows but were informed that the hotel was full so they didn't have any spare. they did have a spare adapter for us which was very friendly. once we went into the bathroom we discovered the toilet seat did not fully open which means we had to have it touching us to stay open. the shower was poorly positioned with the holder causing the water to soak the ceiling which was clearly rotting and coming away. the skirting board in the bedroom had painters tape where they had clearly forgotten to take it off, we found painters tape in the hallway as well. we were given no information about breakfast or the hotel facilities. 
Your website paints a very unrealistic portrait of your hotel, advertising luxury rooms and a high quality establishment "we are not settling for less when balancing maximum quality". you also advertise wifi multiple times as benefit of staying at your hotel "Surf with ease and stay connected to the digital world with our free, high-speed Wi-Fi. Emerse yourself in an ocean of information, communicate effortlessly, or post those picture-perfect moments without a hitch—an entire digital spectrum is at your disposal with our cutting-edge connectivity solutions." "and, of course, gratis WiFi, satisfying your strive for modern warmth while staying true to authentic Parisian charm." "Offering the luxury of affordability combined with indispensable intricacies including an ensuite bathroom, television, and WiFi access, Eiffel Kensington Hotel sets the stage for an indulgent sojourn in the heart of Paris." which should be a standard in todays world. 
I have attempted to contact the hotel directly about these issues and unfortunately not heard anything back, as someone who works in a hotel myself I am reluctant to pot reviews on trip advisor but felt that people needed to know that this hotel is definitely not worth the money and it certainly not the luxury budget friendly accommodation they advertise themselves as. 
I will definitely not be staying here again.

author: magicmagic1
title: Great hotel in Monti area
text: First visit to Rome and the location was perfect; Monti is a short walk from pretty much everything you would wish to see in Rome. The area was quiet and felt safe. Room was spacious and had everything you would need. Great that the mini bar is initially complimentary; the room was clean and as expected. Breakfast was good and set you up for the day. Would return if in Rome

author: Patricia A
title: Great experience
text: Great location, the staff is very friendly, the room is excellent

author: Juan Carlos R
title: There is no better hotel. 100% recommended
text:
This hotel could not be better in practically anything.
The location is excellent, less than a 20-minute walk from any important monument (Colosseum, Trevi Fountain...) and also very close to Termini station.
This is not the most remarkable thing about the hotel. The room is excellent, spacious, the air conditioning works perfectly, the bed is impressively comfortable, and the cleaning service does an excellent job of leaving everything spotless.
Without a doubt, what is worth highlighting is the kindness of the receptionists and waiters. They understand Spanish practically to perfection with excellent, very friendly service, and with a smile always on their faces, they have resolved any question for us instantly.
I recommend booking the breakfast service to be served by good old Giacomo and his waiters. And you have to order their delicious themed cappuccinos, no matter what!
Thank you very much!

author: Xisco R
title: SERVICE AND FACILITIES OF BARELY 2 STARS (IF THAT) AT A PRICE OF ALMOST 5 STARS
text: The price of this hotel is practically double that of any other hotel in Rome of the same category, features, and location, but it should actually be less than half that of those hotels; in other words, it is not worth even a quarter of the price they charge. It is a supposedly 4-star hotel, but its service and facilities do not even reach those of a 3-star hotel. They charged us no less than 250 euros per night (1,000 euros for the 4 nights we stayed), and the service and room they assigned us are not worth more than 50 euros per night. We booked it assuming that cost with the intention of having a wonderful stay as a couple in supposedly exceptional facilities, and they were indeed exceptional, but in a totally negative sense, as I will proceed to explain in detail so that no other person has to endure their extremely low quality of service at a luxury price: Small room with small "views" of a road through a window (obviously without a balcony, much less a terrace). Very scarce breakfast, very little variety (two or three plates of cold cuts and cheeses, bread, scrambled eggs, boiled eggs, and little else), only one type of milk (cow's milk and whole, of course), three small bowls of fruit (almost always empty), and on top of that, the products would run out and they wouldn't replenish them if you didn't ask. Each of the 4 days when we arrived for breakfast, all the product trays were practically empty (the dining room was full of people), and if you didn't ask, they wouldn't replenish (at 250 euros a day, I repeat). We even felt embarrassed for them because of that restriction of products. Paper napkins, and cheap ones at that, and no tablecloths on the tables; directly on the table. Restaurant without any type of air conditioning (we didn't dine there even once because the temperature was 37 degrees), without any special atmosphere—well, neither special nor not special, just no atmosphere at all. Zero delicacy in the treatment by the staff, robotic-style attention, 2-star hotel service or less. Upon arrival, we asked the receptionist if he could give us a room with a view, just as we had requested by email days before; his response was that the room was already assigned and that he did not assign them. They gave us a room with a "view" of a road through a window. In addition to the above, we were also unable to have shared views from the supposed rooftop terrace because it was closed (they told us it was due to construction). As a final touch, on the last day we left our luggage in their storage room for a few hours, and when I went to pick it up, the receptionist, instead of handing me the luggage, gave me the key to the storage room where it was located and told me to go get it myself and lock it back up—"wonderful" 4-star service at 250 euros a night!!! We booked this trip through "Viajes El Corte Inglés," an agency we have been customers of for years, but we are considering not booking with them again if they do not better filter their choice of hotels, as they should not market establishments like this one. Finally, I beg everyone who reads this to share it so that it gets maximum exposure and no other person has to suffer these terrible facilities and service at 250 euros a night.

author: Ina N
title: The photos sell a dream. The reality, however, is in the building across the street.
text:
Enticed by the stunning photos on the official website, we booked directly with the hotel. The first surprise upon arrival: a truly impressive lobby, worthy of a 4-star rating. We think we made the right choice.

Then comes the moment to go to our room… in the building across the street.

Result: a tiny room, a bathroom the size of an airplane cabin, no desk, no minibar. An Ibis without the Ibis sign.

When we pointed out the glaring difference from what was presented online, the reception's response was curt: "We do not have another room to offer you."

No solution. No commercial gesture. The photos sell a dream. The reality, however, is in the building across the street.

author: Rorri S
title: Don’t book here. Go somewhere else
text:
Update #2 (May 24, 2026)

One of the worst hotel experiences I have ever had. Thankfully, I documented everything with photos and videos.

The AC is not working during a current heat wave in Paris. The room smells unpleasant due to dirty carpets, and we even found spiders in the room. I spoke with three different front desk staff members and explained the situation multiple times. Their solution was to offer a fan, but the room still feels unbearably hot with almost no ventilation. On top of that, I had to use the fridge at the hotel’s concierge desk just to store my personal food because the fridge in our room was not functioning properly. This was incredibly inconvenient and unacceptable for a hotel advertising basic amenities.

We bought cheese and butter for dinner and lunch, but because the fridge in the room was not working, the items melted and became unusable.

I have already escalated this situation to my bank and shared documentation of the conditions and service failures. I am also considering sharing my experience publicly across platforms including Reddit, TikTok, Facebook, and Instagram because guests deserve transparency before booking here.

This hotel was recently acquired by new management, and there appears to be a major decline in both service quality and maintenance standards. Based on my experience, the new management seems unprepared to operate a hospitality property at the level advertised online. (I doubt this management is European or American). 

UPDATE (May 20, 2026)

1. The AC is not working. According to the night concierge, the cooling systems across the building have been disabled.
2. The WiFi/internet was also not functioning properly.
3. We were informed that some safety cameras in the building were affected due to the internet outage, which raised additional safety concerns.

It is extremely misleading to advertise AC and WiFi as available amenities when both services were either unavailable or unreliable during our stay, especially during a heat wave. I am currently speaking with Expedia regarding a refund for the sleepless and uncomfortable nights we experienced.

author: Mike R
title: Clean, Safe room exactly next to the train station
text:
This place is exactly across the street from Rome Termini Station. Booked it because we had an 8am train and didn't want to deal with any commute. 
Found this. The older reviews were lackluster but newer ones much more positive. Figured, at worst it's just 1 night. 

What we got was a quirky,  old fashioned hotel but everything was spotless and modern. The decor in the room was like my grandmother's place from the 1940s... but new. Very unique and nice. 
Loads of dining nearby. We left early in the morning so didn't take the breakfast option. Obviously, no opinion on that regard
The price point was a little high compared to some other areas in the city but you have ultimate convenience to the rail system, a clean, safe hotel and helpful staff... perfect for late train arrival or early departure. I could see using it as a base for a couple days but for longer stays, I think I'd choose something away from the train station

author: CriticoCostruttivo
title: Not really...
text:
Leave it alone unless you want to spend "little" (very relatively) and have an absolute need to be close to Termini.
Friendly staff, excellent location... sufficient breakfast.
EVERYTHING else is negative; the rooms are not old, they are completely in need of renovation: rust in the bathroom, destroyed floors, phone in the room not connected, bidet with a blocked stopper, balcony blocked (overlooking a busy street with noise all night), shower in the tub without even a $10 curtain, shower gel bottle completely empty upon arrival... etc. etc...
A maze of rooms, I imagine all like mine; I understand that it is difficult to renovate them all and it is more convenient for them to "get by" since they still earn from tours, etc... but they must do at least a MINIMUM of maintenance; otherwise, it is hard to understand how they can remain open. Also because it costs less than other hotels in the area, but it is still too expensive for the conditions in which they leave it.

author: Trini
title: Friendly, attentive, clean and cool!
text:
Lovely stay and would recommend. What really stood out for us was the customer service. Responses to emails ahead of the trip were very prompt and professional, and the warm welcome we received when we arrived really set the tone for a positive and comfortable stay - management should be proud of their staff as you cannot underestimate the importance of making guests feel at ease and welcome as soon as they arrive. 

We arrived a few hours before check in and appreciated being allowed to leave our bags in a storage room - being offered bottled water before we headed off for a little explore was a kind touch. It’s v hot in Rome atm and we were grateful to receive a message to let us know our room was ready (earlier than expected) and our bags were waiting for us in our room. We also appreciated the ice bucket delivery to our room, and a complementary bottle of fizz. 

In terms of the hotel itself - its very clean, great location (there’s a super market and mini market close by, and restaurants a short walk), quiet (we had a room with a balcony and couldn’t hear traffic when windows were closed) and great air con. 

Overall a lovely stay - the highlight being the staff and their approach. Keep doing what you’re doing - it works and is appreciated! Thank you!

author: Isabel F
title: JUST AMAZING
text:
We stayed at Trulissa Palace Hotel in Rome from the 8th–10th and honestly, it was amazing. We were a little sceptical after seeing some of the negative reviews, but it completely exceeded our expectations and we genuinely couldn’t fault our stay.

From the second we arrived, the staff were so lovely, welcoming and helpful. Every time we had a question, they were more than happy to help and were always so informative. The hotel itself was absolutely spotless — genuinely, there wasn’t a single bit of dirt anywhere. Everything was so clean and well looked after.

We stayed in what I believe was one of the more basic rooms, but even that was exceptional. We had a balcony, a mini bar and everything we could have needed was provided. One night, our TV stopped working at around 12–1am, and they immediately sent someone up to help us. He had a little look around and managed to get it working again, which we really appreciated considering how late it was.

We also booked the spa, which you get at a discounted price as a hotel guest (up to 30%, I believe). Unfortunately, we completely overslept and missed the time we had booked, but they were so understanding and more than happy to let us go in a different slot instead. Everyone was just genuinely so kind and accommodating.

Breakfast was included with our stay and there was such a huge variety, so there was loads to choose from. The rooftop bar was also amazing. We unfortunately didn’t get the chance to eat up there, but we went up for a quick drink and it was lovely.

The location was also perfect. It was so close to the centre and there were loads of transport options nearby — buses, trains, bikes, electric scooters, pretty much everything you could need. It made getting around Rome so easy.

Overall, we genuinely loved our stay here. The hotel was beautiful and spotless, the location was great and the staff were honestly some of the nicest and most helpful we’ve come across. We were so impressed, especially considering we had been a little put off by some of the reviews beforehand. I would 100% recommend staying here and would definitely come back! ♡

title: Do not recommend- they will not resolve problems
text:
We were told we had received a complimentary upgrade from our original booking at Regina Giovanni, but unfortunately this did not feel like an upgrade at all.

The room itself was very basic, and to make matters worse, the electricity kept cutting in and out throughout our stay. I genuinely don’t understand how this was considered an upgrade.

From the early hours of the morning, we were woken by constant drilling and construction work taking place immediately next to our room. The noise continued for hours, making it impossible to sleep or relax. We left the hotel exhausted and with headaches.

If major building works are taking place, guests should either be informed before arrival or allocated rooms well away from the noise. It is unacceptable to charge guests for a stay where they cannot even get a full night’s sleep.

To make matters worse, they have still not responded to my emails regarding the experience. 

Overall, the experience was extremely disappointing. Between the basic room, the unreliable electricity, and the excessive construction noise, I would not recommend staying here until these issues have been resolved.

author: Tinus J
title: Very disappointing experience
text:
I had a very frustrating experience with Eiffel Seine Hotel.

I originally booked a room for 2 nights (28th–30th) for 2 adults and 1 child. On the 3rd of the month, our plans changed because a friend was joining us, meaning we would become 3 adults and 1 child. I contacted the hotel to ask whether they could accommodate the additional adult or, if not, move us to a suitable room. They told me there was no availability.

I therefore requested cancellation in the same email and understood the booking to be cancelled. I subsequently made a new booking through Booking.com at another hotel that could accommodate our group.

Then, around the 22nd/23rd, I received an email about hotel services. Unfortunately, I did not properly notice the hotel name and assumed it was related to my new hotel. I ended up ordering flowers costing around €80.

On the 26th, I was surprised to see that Eiffel Seine Hotel had charged my card €315 for the deposit. I immediately contacted them and explained that I had requested cancellation. I also followed their cancellation link to make sure the reservation was cancelled and contacted my bank regarding the charge.

To their credit, the hotel eventually agreed to refund the €315 deposit. However, they refused to refund the approximately €80 charged for the flowers, stating that the order had already been made and could not be cancelled. Initially, I disputed this, but eventually my wife suggested we simply accept the flowers and collect them.

What makes this experience particularly disappointing is the lack of clear communication and the confusion surrounding the cancellation and hotel-service emails. From a customer's perspective, after requesting cancellation and believing the reservation was no longer active, receiving a €315 charge days later is extremely frustrating. The subsequent situation with the flowers only added to an already unpleasant experience.

Overall, this has been a very poor customer-service experience. While I appreciate that the hotel agreed to refund the deposit, the whole process was unnecessarily stressful and confusing. I would strongly recommend that the hotel make its cancellation process and service-related communications much clearer to avoid putting guests in this situation.

Very disappointing experience and, unfortunately, not a hotel I would choose again.

title: Love Hotel Eiffel Seine!!  You will too.

author: kezza345
title: Never again
text:
We stayed at the Hilton Garden Inn Central New York and, unfortunately, wish we had chosen somewhere else.

We are a family of four — two adults and two children — and the room was unbelievably small and cramped. When we first walked in, I genuinely wondered where the rest of the room had gone! There was barely enough space to move around, and we were constantly knocking our feet and legs against the side of the bed and chair because there simply wasn’t enough room.

I have travelled and stayed in plenty of hotels, but I have never stayed in such a small hotel room. Thankfully, we were out most of the day and evening, because spending much time in the room as a family would have been extremely uncomfortable. I asked reception whether there were any larger rooms available, but was simply told, “This is New York.” That really wasn’t a helpful response.

The elevators were another major issue. We only used them once during our four-day stay, to get our luggage up to the room, and after that we used the stairs because the wait was so bad. We were only on the 6th floor, so it was manageable.

However, on checkout morning, we had three large suitcases and three hand-luggage bags. We waited around 25 minutes trying to get an elevator, but couldn’t get on once. The elevators would bypass our floor, and when they did stop, they were already completely full. There are three elevators in the hotel, yet only two appeared to be working at a time, which is ridiculous for such a large hotel.

Eventually, after waiting around 25 minutes, we had no choice but to drag three large suitcases and all our hand luggage down six flights of stairs. It certainly wasn’t the end to our stay that we had hoped for.

Overall, we were extremely disappointed and definitely would not recommend this hotel for families. Perhaps it would be more suitable for a solo traveller who doesn’t need much space, but for a family of four, the room was simply not adequate.

Unfortunately, the hotel did not live up to our expectations or how it was advertised, and we would choose somewhere else if visiting New York again.

author: lexi s

author: Mark S
title: Excellent hospitality
text:
Business travel can be stressful, but this Hilton made the entire experience feel effortless. From arrival through the rest of my stay, everything was handled in a way that allowed me to focus on the purpose of my trip rather than the logistics around it.

Herbie deserves special recognition. His professionalism, attentiveness, and genuine willingness to help made a noticeable difference. He anticipated needs, handled things smoothly, and created the kind of experience that makes a guest feel valued rather than simply accommodated.

That level of service is what people remember. Because of Herbie and the overall experience, this Hilton will be an easy choice for future business trips.

author: Evan A
title: My Stay in Hilton Central Park
text: I was greeted by a very warm and welcoming host with free points! Herbie was his name. He actually helped us get a deal to travel to other Hilton locations as well. From then on, I knew my stay would be amazing. Would recommend!

author: David N
title: Dirty room no air con
text:
Nafia Shabazz 
Reservations agent
hello Nafia 
I don’t have the original email as the only way I was given to make a reply was via your website and the form your hotel Requires you to fill in so once done and you send no copy is returned . If I was given a more direct way to contact, I would have done so and kept a copy.

The essence of the complaint was:

We, my partner and I, the booking was probably in my partners name Mr SL Mack we stayed at the hotel in Shepherd's Bush London from 1-5 July. David

author: Jacqueline W
title: Overnight London stay for the London Olympia.
text: I'll start by saying I love this hotel. We've stayed here 3 times now and will return, however this weekend was challenging. When we checked and went into our room we very quickly realised that the air conditioning wasn't working. Our room was a small double with no windows to let any air in so you can imagine it was like a sauna especially during this heatwave. We asked reception if there was a problem and they confirmed that the air conditioning was not working but they could bring up a portable air con and a fan and we agreed. What we received was a wobbly fan but no air con unit. When we asked why we were told "we don't have one!". After about 30 minutes and after getting hotter and hotter we went back to reception to have another conversation. We were shown 4 other much larger rooms which were at least more airy but no air conditioning. Eventually we settled on a much nicer room, 2 fans and a free breakfast! It was a very very hot night but the reception staff really did do everything they could and actually I felt quite sorry for the staff who remained pleasant and professional despite very challenging circumstances. The barman looked like he was literally going to wilt. I'm sure this was a one off unfortunate situation and it would not stop us returning but I do wish we'd been given an opportunity to know about this before we checked in.  The rooms incidentally are beautifully decorated and furnished, lovely Elemis toiletries and the entire hotel smells devine. Great location with a lovely Italian Restaurant across the green. Perhaps though we'll come back in the winter months just to be sure! 😉

author: Mobile44018697683
title: Bad
text:
Very disappointed with my stay, especially for a 4-star hotel.
The rooms are clearly run-down and badly in need of renovation. I stayed at this hotel about ten years ago, and the difference is shocking. You can really see how much the hotel has deteriorated over the years.
With the extreme heat at the moment, the air conditioning doesn’t even work, making the room extremely uncomfortable. And despite this, they still have the nerve to ask guests for deposits as if everything were perfectly acceptable.
I called reception to ask for a fan and had to wait 50 minutes. For a 4-star hotel, this level of service is simply unacceptable.
It’s honestly disappointing to see how far this hotel has fallen. This is the last time I will waste my money here. Definitely not worth the price or the supposed 4-star standard. I would not recommend staying here.
