author: Jet59425341487
title: Horrible !
text:
I rarely leave negative reviews, but our stay at Madison LES Hotel was disappointing enough that I feel other travellers should be aware.

The biggest issue was that the room we received did not match what we expected based on the booking. We were given a very small ground-floor room that felt cramped and lacked privacy. The window faced the hotel's smoking area, so we had to keep the blinds closed most of the time because people were constantly outside. This also allowed cigarette smoke to drift into the room occasionally.

The room was not properly prepared for guests. Basic necessities such as a dustbin, tissues, and toilet paper were missing, and even after informing the front desk, these items were not promptly provided. The bathroom also showed signs of poor cleaning, which was disappointing.

The breakfast service was another major issue. We arrived at the advertised opening time of 6:00 a.m. before leaving for the day's sightseeing, only to find that breakfast was not ready. This delayed our plans and should not happen when specific breakfast hours are advertised.

Customer service was inconsistent. Most of our interactions with the front desk left us feeling that our concerns were not important, and despite raising several issues during our stay, very little was done to address them. The only exception was the night-shift staff member, who was polite, professional, and genuinely tried to help.

The hotel's luggage storage policy was also unexpected. While there was luggage storage available, we were informed at the front desk that additional charges applied in our situation. The timing restrictions and charges were not something we had anticipated before arriving, which added unnecessary frustration.

The hotel was also quite noisy because of the reception area, street traffic, and nearby trains. Combined with the room location, it was difficult to get proper rest.

Overall, the experience did not represent good value for money. Paying a little more for a hotel with better customer service, cleaner rooms, and a room that matches what is advertised would have been well worth it. Based on our experience, I would not stay at Madison LES Hotel again.

author: surajprasad1
title: Horrible experience
text:
I had a very disappointing stay at Madison LES Hotel and genuinely regret booking this property.
The staff were generally arrogant, unwelcoming, and seemed uncomfortable communicating in English. The front desk staff, in particular, were inconsiderate and came across with an "I don't care" attitude whenever we asked for assistance.
One of the biggest frustrations was their baggage policy. We arrived a little before check-in and were told they would not hold our luggage unless we paid **$6 per bag**, with absolutely no exceptions. This was the first hotel I've stayed at that refused to store luggage for arriving guests without an additional charge. It made me question the point of booking the hotel if they cannot provide such a basic hospitality service.
Although we were eventually given our room earlier than the official check-in time, we were assigned a tiny ground-floor room that looked nothing like the standard room shown in the photos. The room was extremely small, and the window could not be opened because it faced a smoking area with no privacy.
The cleanliness was unacceptable. The toilet had visible stains (photos attached), and there was no dustbin, tissues, or toilet paper in the room. Even after requesting these basic items, they were not provided, forcing us to throw rubbish on the floor. There was also no complimentary bottled water—everything had to be purchased separately.
The hotel was also very noisy. The front desk area generated constant noise, and trains passing outside could be heard throughout the stay, making it difficult to rest.
The location was another disappointment. There was very little of interest nearby, and the area felt deserted at night.
Breakfast was another letdown. It was not ready at the advertised opening time of 6:00 a.m., so we had to return to our room and wait.
What was most disappointing was that even after informing the staff about these issues, no action was taken. They appeared completely unconcerned and showed no urgency in resolving the problems or improving our experience.
To be fair, the only positive interaction we had was with the night-shift staff member. He was professional, courteous, and genuinely willing to help. Unfortunately, by the time we met him, we were already exhausted and had dealt with several issues that had left us with a very poor impression of the hotel. It's unfortunate that the same level of professionalism and customer service was not shown by the rest of the front desk staff.
While this hotel may be a few dollars cheaper than other options, it is absolutely worth spending a little more for a better-quality hotel. The small saving is simply not worth the poor service, lack of cleanliness, excessive noise, missing basic amenities, and disappointing overall experience.
I would strongly recommend avoiding this hotel and choosing another property nearby, even if it costs a little more. The difference in price is likely to be far outweighed by a much better overall stay.

author: Curiosity60396520434
title: Skip this place, unhygenic and poor attitute
text:
Our stay at Madison LES Hotel was one of the most disappointing hotel experiences I have had, and I regret choosing this property.

From the moment we arrived, we felt that our concerns were not taken seriously. The front desk staff were not welcoming and showed very little interest in helping us. Communication was difficult, and our requests were often met with an indifferent attitude rather than genuine customer service.

The room we received was very different from what had been advertised during the booking process. We were assigned a tiny ground-floor room that was directly next to the hotel's smoking area. Because people were frequently standing outside smoking, we could not keep the blinds open for natural light without completely sacrificing our privacy, and cigarette smoke occasionally entered the room.

The room itself lacked basic amenities. There was no dustbin, tissues, or toilet paper when we checked in, and despite informing the front desk, these items were still not provided. The bathroom also had visible cleanliness issues, which was very disappointing.

Another frustrating experience was breakfast. We arrived at the advertised opening time of 6:00 a.m., only to find that it was not ready. Since we had planned our day around the published breakfast schedule, this caused unnecessary inconvenience.

The hotel's baggage policy was also disappointing. We were asked to pay $6 per bag to store our luggage, and there was no flexibility despite our circumstances. This was something we had never encountered at any other hotel during our travels.

The hotel was also much noisier than expected. Being on the ground floor meant we could constantly hear activity from the reception area as well as noise from the street and nearby trains, making it difficult to relax.

What disappointed me the most was that we reported these issues during our stay, yet nothing was done to improve the situation. A simple effort to address our concerns would have made a significant difference.

I do want to acknowledge that the night-shift staff member was courteous, professional, and willing to help. Unfortunately, by then, our overall experience had already been negatively affected.

Although this hotel may appear to offer a lower price than nearby options, I would strongly recommend spending a little more for a property that provides better service, cleaner rooms, and a more comfortable stay. Based on my experience, I would not choose Madison LES Hotel again.

author: Mandy
title: HORRIBLE!!!
text: Horrible stay. Started badly with the rudest, most unhelpful receptionist I've ever come across. Rooms are tiny and need attention. Rock hard bed, exposed wiring, damp dirty spots on walls and window frames and outdated bathrooms. Ripped carpet in the hallway. Breakfast was as basic as you can get, cereal, toast or yoghurt. The noise from the trains was constant. Roof terrace was filthy. Location wasnt very safe or tourist friendly.  We were told by a local police officer not to walk around after dark as we were close to the projects. Take a cab or uber but dont ask at reception for help or guidance because they wont help help especially if they are eating their lunch while on duty, they just waive you away. Would never reco.mend this place.

author: Romseyman123456
title: Very Nice
text:
We stayed here for 5 days during the World Cup. Overall, I found the room very nice. As I was travelling with a friend, we had two double beds (one each) & the room was very spacious. Check in was simple & quick. The hotel is right next to the train tracks on Manhattan Bridge, but in all honesty, you'd hardly notice it. It was so loud outside that you'd forgive a bit of noise coming through, but it barely did. The air con worked perfectly & the room was always lovely & cool. We did not use the room service provided so cannot comment on that one. Beds were comfy. 

The bad parts were cleanliness in the bathroom. The shower looked as if it needed a deep scrub & there were dirty marks all around, but the shower itself was nice & powerful. Plenty of towels & loo roll to keep us happy. Not the hotel, but the surrounding area was a little smelly at times. Lots of bin bags left out in the sun with temps of 30+c was a challenge, but not the hotels fault. Overall 4.5/5 from me.

author: Akanksha C
title: Exceptional Stay with Outstanding VIP Service
text:
Our stay at Hyatt Regency Paris Étoile was fantastic from start to finish. The service throughout the property was top-notch, but the standout highlight was Jeanne from the VIP team. Her professionalism, warmth, and attention to detail elevated our entire experience. She went above and beyond to make sure every aspect of our visit was seamless and memorable, exemplifying true world-class hospitality.
The hotel’s location is unbeatable for navigating Paris. Being directly connected to the transit hub with seamless access to the Metro and RER train lines made exploring the city and getting to major sights completely effortless.
The lounge is another major highlight—exceptionally well-run, offering a relaxing atmosphere, great food and drink selections throughout the day, and breathtaking views over the city. It served as the perfect retreat after a long day of sightseeing.
Between the prime connectivity, fantastic lounge, and exceptional care from Jeanne and the team, this hotel exceeded all expectations. We will definitely return on our next trip to Paris!

author: Peter K
title: Excellent service at clean Paris hotel
text: Excelllent service - nice professional hotel. Clean room and bathrooms. Biggest negatives are that the rooms are a little small and the hotel has a very business/conference feel

author: Christine K
title: Paris trip 8/16/26 to  8/22/26
text:
Disappointed by How Our Family Emergency Was Handled

We arrived on August 16, 2026, as a group of four. We booked our reservation through Amex and reserved connecting family rooms. Breakfast was included for all four of us.

Unfortunately, we had a family emergency during our stay—my mother-in-law passed away unexpectedly. As a result, my husband and daughter had to leave immediately. We canceled one of our rooms, while my son and I stayed for the remainder of the trip.

After canceling the second room, we were told that our reservation had to be recreated and that breakfast was no longer included. This was very disappointing because our original reservation clearly included breakfast. I was never informed that canceling one room would result in losing our breakfast package.

I do not feel this was handled fairly or with much compassion, especially considering the circumstances our family was going through. I am also a World of Hyatt member, but unfortunately, I did not feel that this was taken into consideration. The manager was not friendly or understanding during a very difficult time for our family.

I understand that reservation changes may sometimes be necessary, but I believe the hotel could have handled this situation with much more care, flexibility, and compassion.

author: Simon
title: Definitely worth upgrading to the Eiffel Tower view and Club Access.
text: Stayed in the Hyatt Regency Paris Étoile for 3 nights with my wife and youngest daughter,  and had an outstanding experience.  We shared a room and while cosy, it was spotlessly clean and housekeeping were fabulous.  Some lovely little touches that make it an elevated experience.  The view was outstanding - we had opted for an Eiffel Tower view which from our room on Floor 31 was simply amazing!  The girls loved looking at it day and night out of the window, and was such a wonderful backdrop.  We also had gone for a Club room,  and this included access to the Regency Club which we couldn't recommend more highly.  A great breakfast service that set us up well,  and a wonderful place to stop by and spend some time in with drinks and snacks for a break from the sightseeing.  The staff there particularly were fabulous and always so efficient, helpful but not overbearing.  Thank you!

author: traveldad2018
title: At this reasonable price point, HRP deserves 5 stars
text: Small rooms and clean, you may be competing with tour groups and flight crews to get to your elevator.  Breakfast was quite nice, with eggs made to order.  Staff are generally very good.  I appreciated the option for vegetables/broccoli at breakfast (though for some reason the broccoli was not tasty).  Great views of the Eiffel Tower.  The 17th Arrondissement is nice but a bit away from the main drag (other than Arc de Triomphe) so there may be increased cost for Ubers or one may take the metro.  Would return to this hotel.

author: bru2026
title: Does not deserve its 3 stars
text:
The business rooms are adjacent to the elevator, so avoid them; you get the impression that other travelers are walking through your room (that said, I had been warned about this situation upon booking...). Soundproofing is almost nonexistent.
The shower and toilet are in the room, without any separating door, except for a curtain.
The room is tiny (ship cabin) and overlooks the back, which is dilapidated.
Average breakfast (no fruit salad, few different breads, butter and yogurts are not kept cold), the room is very cramped.
Staff friendliness varies depending on the person. The "breakfast manager" on her smartphone next to the customers.

What remains is the excellent location and the air conditioning, which is essential in summer.
Not worth the price, and certainly not its 3 stars.

author: hugoyvinec1
title: Decent stay, nothing more.
text: Decent stay overall. The hotel is well located and the staff is rather welcoming, but some points need improvement: room a bit aging (TV among others) and soundproofing could be better. The value for money remains decent without being exceptional. A suitable stay for a short stopover.

author: yboclet
title: Very good
text: Very good for everything. Just a slight, somewhat unpleasant smell of stagnant water upon waking, but otherwise everything was great!

author: zoulaitty68520
title: Very disappointing
text: I am not in the habit of leaving negative reviews, but the services here were too disappointing: a king-size bed was advertised when it was actually 2 beds pushed together; very, very low water pressure in the shower; a dusty coffee maker; the lady at the front desk was not friendly, and the gentleman in the evening did not deign to respond to our greeting... the only advantage of this hotel is the location, which is in the center of several beautiful places in Paris.

author: Naomi M
title: simply great
text: very clean. comfortable in everyway. location perfect for a stay in paris. functioning lift. a return stay will occur in the future.

author: Amy E
title: Great hotel
text:
From the moment we arrived early the staff were very friendly and helpful! They kept our luggage safe until we could check in later in the day. They have a spot for you to change after your flights and prepare for the day. 
The room was clean, well equipped and in good shape. We had a triple which worked out great with teenagers. I would 100% recommend this hotel to others. Lots of food and easy stops to walk to in the area. And an easy walk from the train and bus stop too.

author: Gianna B
title: 5 stars all around
text:
Perfect location for a trip to Rome. It was a 5 minute walk from the train station and had amazing restaurants at the corner of the street with amazing food and good prices. Trevi fountain, Spanish steps, the colosseum and many more historical sites were a 20-30 minute walk. The hotel itself was VERY clean and the bed was very comfortable which I appreciated after a long travel day. The staff was so friendly and nice, allowed a early check in since my room was ready when I got there at noon and securely held my bags for me so I could explore the city after check out and before my flight. I will for sure be back 

Small cons: very poor water pressure but that’s everywhere in Italy (didn’t bother me for a quick shower) and the rooms can get a little noisy with outside traffic but nothing crazy that altered my stay.

author: Vicki Lynn B
title: Great location, wonderful staff!
text: I booked this place based on its proximity to Roma Termini, and it was perfect from that perspective.  But it is also a sweet little hotel with staff who really want to be helpful (and are!).  The hotel even provides for some local experiences without additional fees, and we took the night tour around the Colosseum - it was fantastic!  Also, the breakfast was amazing.  I would book again if going to Rome, and highly recommend.

author: Lisa D
title: 5 star staff
text:
We stayed here for one night and found it to be an excellent choice. The location is ideal, just a short walk from the train station and within easy reach of many of Rome’s attractions.

From the moment we arrived, we received a warm and friendly welcome from the young lady on reception, who kindly upgraded us to a spacious room overlooking the Baths of Diocletian. The room was spotless, comfortable, and well equipped with everything we needed for our stay.

Breakfast was very good, with plenty of choice, and the member of staff looking after the breakfast service was welcoming and attentive.

This would have been a five-star review. Unfortunately, on our return to the hotel in the evening, we had an unpleasant encounter with two men in the street outside, We fully appreciate that this had nothing to do with the hotel and was completely beyond its control, so it does not reflect the quality of the accommodation or the excellent service we received throughout our stay.

Overall, we would happily recommend this hotel for its location, comfortable rooms, and outstanding staff.

author: Andresito77
title: Great experience and excellent assistance with the luggage
text:
We stayed at the Hotel Diocleziano and the experience was fantastic. The rooms are extremely comfortable, spotless in terms of cleanliness, and a noteworthy detail, they are very well soundproofed, which guarantees excellent rest after walking all day around the city.
The attention from the staff was very good and attentive at all times. One gesture that we greatly appreciated was that, on the day of our departure, they allowed us to securely store our luggage in a restroom so we could take one last leisurely stroll before leaving the city for good.
Without a doubt, a hotel highly recommended for its comfort, service, and attentiveness to the guest. A place to return!

author: Beth M
title: Great location
text: The location is so good! It is right by Notre Dame and there are so many restaurants around. The room was small but that is expected. The staff was nice.

author: ignaciomW6447BD
title: Impossible to sleep
text: Impossible to sleep due to the unbearable noise from the street. The receptionist was rude and unfriendly to the customers. Not worth returning

author: millie812
title: Noisy hotel
text: Very clean hotel but on a very noisy street.Bars,clubs noisy till 4am.My mistake.Spoiled weekend as everyone tired, o sleep.

author: zlegouteur
title: I slept in a dormitory with 3 single beds. The shower was 50 cm wide. No electrical outlet available.
text: Small and very mediocre comfort.

author: Jens B
title: Perfect location, great value for money
text:
Cozy, small hotel in the heart of the 5th.
Everything is nearby, the Metro/RER is almost at the door, Notre Dame, the Seine 😍
One can reach everything conveniently on foot.
The staff is very friendly and the rooms are clean.
When I am in Paris, I stay here; I can recommend it.

author: Bob Jobson
title: Expect to wait... and wait... and wait...
text: Probably the worst pub I've been to in London. The bar staff haven't a clue, especially the Polish guy. The staff are apparently told to prioritise "hotel" guests, so he ignored all the people waiting at the bar to slowly and methodically sign in 3 separate groups while we waited, without explanation. He was like a robot on snail mode. With around 30 angry and confused people waiting, with more joining, we could see it would take ages to get served so we left. Another great pub ruined because the owner has his priorities wrong.

author: LeeRoisin
title: A good budget hotel that's actively being worked on and improved
text:
The hotel was fine and absolutely what I would expect for what we paid. There's no "reception", you go into the pub and talk to a member of staff at the bar. We waited about 5 minutes as there was only one member of staff on but that wasn't too much of a problem. 

The room was up two flights of stairs and there didn't appear to be a lift. The ground floor was also actively being worked on by builders so I'm not sure whether this is planned for the future. 

The room itself was a good size for what we needed and the bed was comfortable. There was a small fridge and some unopened bottles of milk to go with the small boxes of cereal they provided. There was a window in the ceiling which could be opened and closed. There didn't seem to be a heating system or an AC system in the room but they did supply a fan.

The ensuite bathroom had a good shower. There was a window in the ceiling which didn't have curtains or a blind to cover It and so it did get incredibly hot in there. 

Towels were provided and these were changed to clean ones whilst we were out. They also restocked the cereal.

The location was pretty quiet - we didn't really hear anything even with the window open. Lots of small corner shops nearby to grab food/drink if needed. The Seven Sisters tube station was a 5-10 minute walk away.

Parking was directly in front of the pub/hotel but there weren't many spaces. We had no problem leaving the car there whilst we stayed.

Check out was very easy as all we had to do was drop the keys in a box as we left.

It's clear that they're actively working to improve the hotel. If you're looking for a budget hotel and aren't planning on spending hours of your day in the room, it's a good choice.

author: Martam72769907
title: Highs and lows
text: So it is totally depending on what your looking for , the plus points , the price and location to Seven Sisters tube station were very good , inside the pub which is attached to the hotel was fine , large screen sports , reasonably priced drinks , clean and today , outside seating at rear , the bed was comfy , the bathroom fine , kettle and a fridge in room , now the negatives , scruffy and untidy at front of hotel , the rooms are a work in progress and you walk through a building site , rooms very basic , some may find the area a little not what they are used to but we had no issues at all , so if your looking for somewhere to get your head down cheaply in an accessible area to football grounds and concerts and a beer before or after it works , the staff were nice too … but if you want more than the basics probably not for you

author: BigG
title: Rubbish
text:
Had a room booked for tomorrow, had a email at 7pm to say it was cancelled. Called 3 times, no answer, finally got through to be told to call in the morning as no one available.
When I explained I couldn’t call in the morning as we need to know if this was a mistake or the room had been cancelled, he said il call the manager- phone me back in 3 minutes….
Well that was 1/2 hour ago and they are just not picking up the phone now.
Brilliant customer service……not!!!

author: Sara R
title: Book if you want a very warm room
text:
Wouldn't stay here again 
The room felt like a sauna 
Only very small window in bathroom 
Team unfortunately didn't understand myself very well.

author: Mark L
title: Good price central London
text: Clean and comfortable good location

author: Diego N
title: Aconchego in London
text: The lack of a small fridge/fridge bar was felt. Small and simple, but cosy room. Wonderful staff, very polite, friendly and inquisitive.

author: Thomas B
title: Don't eat the breakfast
text: I had no complaints regarding the check in service nor the room. However, I was mortified that the breakfast items were covered in fruit flies. The first member of staff i approached spoke no English and passed me on to someone else. When she checked she said it may because people left uncovered. However the plate had no cover. While I was there they did not remove and bin the food. I spoke to front desk and all they done was apologised. I'm seriously concerned about their FSMS.

author: janewindsor57
title: No issues at all
text:
Absolutely fantastic, great location , rooms clean and comfortable, buffet breakfast basic but good.
Rooms clean and staff helpful, would stay again xx

author: InterplannerJanet
title: Great stay great air conditioning!
text: Lovely hotel. Great AirCon! Stayed for one night and really liked it. Room 206. Front desk welcome was lovely, continental breakfast was basic but perfect. Very convenient to Paddington. Shower was great. Would def stay again!

author: Maria Q
title: Excellent hotel
text: Excellent location, everything can be reached on foot and close to boarding points for everything, including the airport, friendly and helpful staff, both at the reception and in the breakfast room, clean rooms, soundproof window, no noise could be heard even though the street is always crowded, the breakfast room perhaps a little small to accommodate everyone, it may happen that you have to wait for a table but the very fast staff does everything to reduce waiting times, three ladies truly impeccable and very nice, everything perfect and I would return without thinking about it, much better than many 4-star hotels, I would only suggest maybe putting something in the shower because the marble on the floor with soap tends to make you slip and be dangerous

author: anthony b
title: Exceeded our expectations and more
text:
Absolutely superb location 
Wonderful room and fabulous warm and friendly staff

author: Beth M
title: Nice hotel convenient to the sights and water bus.
text: This is a nice hotel very centrally located in Venice with great access to San Marco Square and the water bus. The hotel staff were very friendly and helpful. Bed was comfortable and the water pressure was great - good supply of hot water. Despite being on a major walking area, the room was quiet. air conditioning worked very well which was essential in July. Breakfast was fine but I will say that you really don't need to pay the price for the breakfast - there are plenty of restaurants or bakeries around where you can eat for less money. The only drawback was that the room was quite small - no room to really put the suitcases other than on the floor and no desk. Although the hotel is on a canal you really can't see it from your room.

author: handalirma
title: Great
text: Room was nice, good Air conditioning, staff great. No Netflix in Italy except Rome

author: Alec Ward
title: Experience of Rome.
text:
The hotel was in a great location, close to the main Termini Train Station and in walking distance.

The room was cleaned every day and was comfortable. The downside was all the TV channels were in Italion, but that is part of the experience. The lift was abit clostrophobic, mamimum of 2 people with cases were allowed in it.

The breakfast menu gave you a cooked menu, cold meat and cheese section and a variety of cereals to choose from. Nearby street cafes provided evening meals and drinks.

The Termini train station has a good selection of restaurants to choose from.

I would recommend the San Marco hotel. Staff were helpful and spoke good english.

Rome has a lot to offer. Do your home work, find out where you want to see and what tours you wish to participate in and hopefully you will have as good a time as I did.

Enjoy a great city.

author: lavern s
title: DO NOT BOOK THIS HOTEL
text:
Do not book this hotel.  I booked through Booking.com and the full amount has been taken from my credit card and my booking confirmed with a receipt received.

I received this message from them and confirmation that they have cancelled my booking:
Our account has been compromised as a result of a cyberattack. Your reservation will therefore be cancelled, as it was made using a rate that was not authorized by our property and was generated following fraudulent access to our account.
Please do not click on any links you may receive.
We apologize for the inconvenience.
Kind regards.
Hotel Milton Roma

I am now left in a situation with flights paid for and no accommodation.  Terrible customer service and makes me wonder if they have had more demand and decided to put the room rates up.

author: Inês G
title: SCAM
text:
I was notified that the cancellation was due to an alleged cyberattack and the generation of an 'unauthorized rate due to fraudulent access'. As a consumer, I am completely unrelated to any security breaches, IT problems, or operational vulnerabilities in your system.
Under European consumer law, a confirmed booking constitutes a binding contract, and economic activity risks must be assumed by the provider, never by the customer.

With less than a month to go before the trip, in the peak of high season, the cancellation of this booking leaves me in an extremely vulnerable situation, without accommodation in an overcrowded city and with almost no viable options on the market for the price originally contracted.

The property has rooms available, so the refusal to honor the contract constitutes a clear breach of consumer rights. 

Furthermore, I would like to inform you that I have previously attempted to contact you via message, but have received no response to date.

author: Carlos P
title: Excellent hotel to know Rome!
text: Hotel with an excellent location, almost in the centre of Rome, with a metro exit to the door as well as bus and tram stops. A 15-minute walk from the Coliseum! Very varied breakfast and friendly employees. There is a bar on a very nice small terrace. Very spacious room.

author: Rhayza R
title: Included breakfast was quite good!
text: I stayed with my family at this hotel in two rooms because there were five of us; the hotel is quite central and very conveniently located near the subway station, the rooms were clean and the other areas as well. The included breakfast was the best and quite varied; the aspect they should improve is the quality of the shampoo and adding hair conditioner.

author: Eloise S
title: Would definitely come back!
text: Great location. Great service in the hotel restaurant from Ehsan!

author: Meg O
title: Highly Recommend
text: Highly recommend for location, cleanliness, and professional staff. Brandon  and the whole Lex Hotel Team were professional, kind, and responsive.

author: John D
title: Overall a great stay
text: The hotel is in a great spot, just a short walk to the subway station. Check-in was fast and Ana was very polite. My room was small, but it was very clean and the bed was comfortable. However, there was no mini-fridge. Overall it was an affordable place to sleep if you do not need luxury. I would definitely stay here again.

author: Juan
title: Five-Star Service from Steven
text: Steven at the front desk made our stay even better. From the moment we arrived, he greeted us with genuine kindness, warmth, and a welcoming smile. He was professional, attentive, and always willing to help with anything we needed. It’s rare to meet someone who makes you feel so valued as a guest. Thank you.

author: Mike R
title: Great stay
text: Everything was super clean, the staff was incredibly friendly, and the breakfast was  just right to start your day . Plus, you can't beat the location if you're in town to see the sights.

author: Muhammad Muzamm... B
title: Would stay again!
text: This was our first time booking a hotel in New York so we picked this for our convenience and the price. We have been to a couple of hotels and the first person you interact with defines the whole experience for me and my family. We checked into the hotel, Ana greeted us with a very warm welcome, accommodating us with our luggage’s and was very helpful in answering all our questions. Our room was clean, the noise level wasn’t too bad except sometimes during the night but that was mostly outside. During our leave, Ana helped us to order a taxi to our airport and it arrived on time. Overall it was a wonderful experience and we would definitely check back here on our next trip to New York!

author: Vasoulla S
title: Good location
text: Good location by the tube station… good clean hotel and good atmosphere . Would recommend .

author: Curious59673681034
title: Disappointing experience
text:
In July 2026, I stayed at this hotel and, unfortunately, my experience was extremely disappointing.

My voucher was for a room with two beds, as there were three people in my family. However, when we entered the room, there was only one bed.

I contacted the hotel to try to resolve the situation, but I was told that the hotel was fully booked and that a room with two beds would only become available on Monday. This was a Friday.

As a result, the three of us had to sleep in one bed for four nights.

To make matters worse, we even had difficulty getting enough towels. Despite asking the manager to provide at least one additional towel, we continued to have only two towels for three people.

It was an extremely uncomfortable situation and completely different from what we had booked and paid for.

And now, as if that experience wasn’t disappointing enough, I am dealing with another issue regarding the refund of the price difference that should have been returned to me.

Unfortunately, after everything that happened, I do not recommend this hotel. 

I 
Ah! It’s always good to mention that one of the elevators may not be working, and that the stairs will be used frequently during the stay, especially in the mornings.

author: Tania Baille
title: Hotel in a super location
text: Very nice hotel, spacious room, close to Canal Street and West Broadway, subway at the bottom of the hotel, I highly recommend.

author: Sasha D
title: Horrendous Experience
text:
HORRENDOUS EXPERIENCE. i had a reservation that the hotel could not honor because they did not have a room available for me. Wouldn't it be more professional to reach out to me BEFOREHAND to tell me this BEFORE accepting my money?! I'm STILL waiting on a full refund. 

The staff is extremely dismissive, unprofessional and rude. The hotel itself is dingy, old, dirty, and in bad condition.

author: Clipped Wings
title: Pretty Good, Room for Improvement
text: A good value hotel by NYC standards, helped by its non-descript but convenient location on top of Canal Street subway - so only 15 mins from mid or downtown.  Rooms are fine, big enough and well kept. Bad points are the lukewarm showers, seemingly perennially broken lift (although there is at least another working), the poor soundproofing - we had a front facing room and it is not for light sleepers what with the noise of the traffic.

author: M B
title: More like poor youth hostel quality
text: The website looks promising but in reality the hotel is very dated and dirty. The room we stayed in was actually very poor. Located directly on the street side. During our stay it was very hot and the air conditioning wasn't working properly. The only solution was to open the windows at night but there was so much noise from the street (restaurant across the street cleaning up in the middle of the night shuffeling tables around and a homeless guy residing in a tent directly outside the hotel who made a lot of noise) we couldn't sleep well. The room was really small too making it a challenge to move around. Very small bathroom. Broken soap dispensers. Toilet that didn't flush very well with a reservoir that took ages to fill back up. Door closers that shut the door with a loud bang. Breakfast is very simple and below average. This is more like youth hostel quality. Not recommended.

author: Mirco F
title: Lamentable
text:
Very disappointing experience, mainly because of the receptionist's attitude. Upon my arrival, I was not assigned the room category I had paid for. When I pointed it out, the receptionist had the nerve to tell me that, given the price paid, "I should be happy." Such a remark from an employee is simply unacceptable.

I immediately contacted the reservation center. With proof in hand (photos upon arrival), they refunded me 30% of the stay, thus confirming that the room did not correspond at all to my reservation.

On the second day, I had to change rooms because I had booked twin beds. The receptionist refused to make things easier for me, claiming that it was "not the same room type." In the end, they made me move to a twin room that was identical in every way to the previous one, with the exception of the two beds. A blatant lack of professionalism and goodwill.

author: Sylvie1403
title: Address to remember
text:
We stayed 4 nights in this hotel last week, in 2 different rooms, nothing to complain about.
recently renovated room and bathroom with taste, very clean, air-conditioned. The breakfast is quite good (savory, sweet, yogurts, compotes, fruits,...). The staff is helpful and smiling. The hotel is 500 m from the subway station. The most notable aspect during this heatwave is the availability of a refrigerated water fountain, an espresso machine, a slushie maker, and a small fresh juice fountain at the reception. The only small remark would be about the price when booking several nights; the price is not discounted or a bit cheaper.

author: Journey03988771654
title: A nightmare with entire hotel air condition broken down for five days
text:
Checked in on 24 May, found that air con not working.  Called reception and no one pick up the phone.  Went down and the receptionist said air con in some rooms broken down.  Another guest said it has been 3 nights since she checked in and it was still not fixed. The receptionist said someone will fixed it 8am tomorrow. 
Second day another receptionist said no one is coming to fix the air con.  I asked if we can change to a room with air con.  He said cannot because the rooms are occupied and full.  I said you are still selling room online.   Then he said the manager will come back at 8am.  Then later said 10am, then said today is bank holiday and not coming back. You can check out and get refund. 
In the afternoon, asked another receptionist, she said actually the entire hotel had no air con.  It’s hopeless and now 1:47am, still unable to sleep.  Totally lost of enjoyment.

author: Abc
title: Good - would stay again
text: I would stay again.  I slept really well - nice bed.  The rooms are typical Paris (basic and small).  Great location as well.  The only negative would be the guy who works reception - such a miserable, surly and awful human being.  He should do himself (and customers) a favour and find another job.

author: Paul Leenaerts
title: seeks a vibrant base in the heart of Manhattan.
text:
citizenM New York Times Square is a very trendy hotel in a prime location, just off Times Square. The room was very small, but smartly decorated and equipped with everything you need for a city trip. The hotel is quite pricey, but unfortunately that seems to be fairly normal in New York.
What really makes this hotel special is the amazing rooftop bar with stunning views of the city. The staff was very friendly and helpful. An ideal choice for those seeking a modern, vibrant base in the heart of Manhattan.

author: Accrosstheglobe
title: Go to!
text: Top-notch hotel despite the size of the rooms, but which is largely compensated for by its geographical location (150m from Times Square), the rooms are very well equipped and offer all the necessary comfort and modernity. Very welcoming staff, quick, simple, and efficient check-in!

author: ahjumaof2
title: Ok, but not our style
text: When you check in, a human asks you to please use a kiosk pad. The human standing there will offer help if you need it. We hung out in the area they call the “living room” a few times, and always saw people waiting to check in so I doubt many get early check in. As a gold Marriott member we did not but we did receive late check out.  The young woman we asked seemed to forget who she was helping and neglected to get back to us to confirm our request so we did have to follow up twice. Rooms were reminiscent of European size. There’s a drawer beneath the bed with extra pillows so if you take them out, you can fit a carryon inside to lay flat. If you have two people, there are two slim closets so it is possible to stand another luggage inside. We were not troubled by the lack of floor space for luggage, we made do but the funky smell of the shower curtain with a lack of ventilation in the small bathroom area was off putting.  If they hope to save energy, the button for the curtains on the wall and the iPad caused us to often mistakenly lower the blackout curtains and turn off all lights so unfortunately they didn’t save energy on us. The iPad controlled the lights, tv and shades. We opted to have one person sleep along the wall and one access to get out of the bed easily. You could sleep with both heads towards the window and then both have to scoot out of the bed. The breakfast was a 4/5 for us. Better than a Hampton level. Rooms are a little cramped and not much human interaction if you’re a regular traveler and  in your 40s or 50s.  I called the hotel a few times before our stay but never got through to a human. It was an anniversary stay but no special acknowledgement. Gym has some free weights, ellipticals, and treadmills. Overall, it was a fine stay but likely more comfortable for single travelers. Ok stay, great location if you want to be in the middle of Times Square. Personally, I like staying up towards 56th St even if going to see Broadway shows. Remember, every 10 city streets (not avenues) Is about 1/2 mile. Good luck with your research and stay!

author: Jerome D
title: Ok, but unlikely to stay here again.
text:
Major complaints:  They have a tiny ironing room on the second floor with one iron!  I understand not having them in the rooms - sets off the fire alarms.  But we intentionally did not pack a travel iron because we were led to believe it would not be an issue. Surprise! 
Secondly, the room barely got comfortably cool. Cut the unit down to 64. Doubt it got below 72, and the rooms in NYC are tiny! Day temps were high 80s, low temps 68-70. No excuse not to be able get comfortable on a room facing North!
Look at some of the recent three star reviews for elaboration and other room complaints. 
  I will say the proximity to mostly everything in Manhattan from the museums to the shows to shopping can't be beat. If you are a walker and have time, you can literal walk down south to the WTC and up north to top of Central Park, which has the major museums on either side of it.

author: torv213
title: Form over human function - Not good for couples
text:
I live a modern and minimalist lifestyle, so while I appreciate the concept, the execution and communication are poor in terms of what you expect and what you get. 

I expect a king-size bed with two sides accessible by each person, not a waist-high bed that you have to climb over and climb over your partner, especially when she has rheumatoid issues. I asked for a handicap room, but none were available until the next night, and it was too much bother to pack up and move.

I expect you to be able to drop garbage into the garbage can, not have to do a hand hook shot to get into the bin under the desk. Looks sleek there, but not functional.

I expect wall switches to have signs/symbols that indicate how they work. For future guests, you have to toggle the switches three times to get full lights.

I expect an actual bathroom wall and door, not a shower curtain separating me and my wife from the toilet and shower. Yes, we're a couple, but nobody wants to hear anyone else's business. Related, I expect a wall light for the bathroom, not an iPad control console to turn on the light at night. Seriously?

I expect drawerS. Not one giant drawer for two people, which also happens to be filled with extra pillows, and those have to be stored somewhere else.

I could go on, but the bottom line is that this room is form over function. Beautiful and modern, great location, friendly staff, but humans didn't design the rooms or sleep in it. More like a banker who wanted to pack in as many rooms into a floor and fit in a king bed. Maybe it's okay for one person younger than 40, but for couples and everyone who wants an intuitive room design, pass.

author: John A
title: Tiny rooms and they lie about bed size
text: Hotel advertises KING beds but they only have queens. You have my email. They refused to compensate me or move me because they do not have king beds. Flat out lying and extremely rude hotel staff and manager by the name of Daisy.

author: Amy L
title: Best hotel inManhattan  I etc - Gulbye manager Janine the best
text: An absolute gem of a hotel! The location is unbeatable, making it super easy to explore the area. The room was modern, sparkling clean, and the bed was extremely comfortable. What truly made our stay special was the warm and attentive staff—they went above and beyond to make us feel welcome. Highly recommended and would definitely stay here again! Thanks Ibeth, Gulbye y Janine

author: Kenyah A
title: Great experience from Adam the sales rep at the West time square location
text: This is for Adam the hotel package rep at gone Times central West location. Talk about an asset to the company, not only did he throughly explain the packages to me, He showed me the value of purchasing a package more than anything. Such a knowledgeable representative🙏.

author: Alex R
title: NY for lovers
text:
Great experience 
I Beth was an amazing host!
Located in the middle of all theaters

author: Danielle K
title: Amazing experience!
text: This hotel is very clean, big, and full of wonderful staff! Checking into our hotel Jose is wonderful, he recommended places to eat, entertainment, and overall how to get around, very helpful and accommodating, I will definitely be coming back I 100% recommend this hotel!

author: Loucas M
title: Incredible and affordable
text:
I think it was a very good experience with incredible service. Our door wouldn't open anymore because of a technical problem, but they were there the whole time and found a solution quickly. View of the Eiffel Tower, very close to many monuments, I recommend you go there if you are on vacation. The price is very affordable and the room is large enough. 
Thank you very much for this service!

author: Amel
title: Very good address!
text:
The location of the hotel and the fact that the reception is open 24/7 were essential criteria for choosing this establishment. I was not disappointed.
Hotel located opposite the RER B Port Royal station, very good when traveling alone to the Stade de France...
Great welcome and service, a very attentive team that does its best to take requests into account and make the stay as pleasant as possible.
Continental breakfast with very good products.
Single room sufficient for staying a few nights for those who do not plan to spend their day at the hotel, otherwise it may seem a little small.
No air conditioning in the hotel but fans in the rooms.

A big thank you to the team for their welcome and for this stay!

author: Sylvie B
title: Great experience
text: From the reception, to the kitchens for breakfast, to the maintenance of the rooms, the staff was helpful, smiling, and competent.  The room was very clean.

author: Valentina R
title: Suffocating heat
text:
The hotel's location is certainly its strong point: convenient for reaching the main attractions and well-served.
Unfortunately, however, our experience was not positive. The room was really very small and the bathroom was extremely cramped, so much so that even the simplest movements were difficult.
The absence of air conditioning, especially during the hottest days, made the stay uncomfortable. Usually at night, so much so that we spent 2 sleepless nights, only a fan was present, which unfortunately simply moved hot air without offering any real relief. If they cannot install motors for air conditioning, they should organize themselves with other machines that allow one to be comfortable in the room.
Another aspect that we would have liked to know before booking is that, to reach some rooms, the elevator only goes up to the fifth floor: the last floor must be walked with suitcases. It is a detail that may seem secondary, but that would be useful to specify during the booking phase.
For the location it certainly deserves appreciation, but, considering the overall comfort of the room and the services offered, personally I would not choose to stay in this hotel again.

author: Roci G
title: Centrally located hotel and very cool views
text: Very well-connected hotel, the room was very clean and the staff was very friendly.

author: hum2008
title: Fab staff
text: It was very clean hotel, staff were so welcoming and polite. Very close to the metro literally just outside the hotel so convenient if u get the metro pass.

author: Explore35876029671
title: Good hotel
text: First-class rooms. Good cleanliness and service.

author: chayes2k
title: HOTEL STAY
text:
I had an excellent stay at First Hotel Paris Tour Eiffel, defined by both comfort and exceptional service. Prior to my arrival, the hotel was highly responsive and accommodating regarding my personal needs, which immediately set a reassuring tone for my visit.
From check-in through each day of my stay, the staff consistently delivered a level of professionalism and warmth that is truly uncommon. Every interaction—whether at reception or in the breakfast room—was marked by genuine courtesy and attentiveness.
The room was impeccably clean and well maintained, with efficient air conditioning and fresh, well-prepared breakfast offerings each morning. The hotel’s location is also a standout feature, with convenient metro access directly across the street, making it effortless to navigate the city.
While the rooms reflect the typical, more compact Parisian style, the overall experience is elevated by the hotel’s thoughtful service and prime location. I would gladly return and confidently recommend this hotel to anyone seeking a comfortable and well-managed stay in Paris.

author: Ciro N
title: Paris with family
text: We had an amazing experience at this hotel. WiFi could be a little better but nothing to ruin our trip. Perfect

author: robbieroc
title: Good overall
text:
Was a nice hotel beautiful decor in waiting rooms friendly helpful staff with a smile 
Positioned in a good area city centre not to far if hiring a uber
cafes & bakery close by for yr morning 🥐 & ☕️.
Room bed was very comfy & they have windows so u can open for sunny fresh air

author: Lee M
title: Relaxing
text:
Juliette and her staff are fantastic 👏 
She was so helpful.
Highly recommend this hotel and hope to return soon 👌

author: HetM
title: What can I say...
text:
Warm but worrying welcome, indeed the receptionist warned us to be very careful in Rome and in the surroundings of the hotel, that many people are strange.
Moreover, the hotel is strange... a boutique hotel should offer its decoration items for sale... but here no items for sale, and besides no decor!
The rooms are large but you will hear everything that happens in the other rooms, as well as on the street. Knowing that there are many strange people around the hotel, the noise coming from the street is constant, night and day.
If you go there anyway, take shampoo and soap because those provided by the hotel are only in name, here again they are strange products.

author: Guinnessdog
title: Great value near Termini
text:
Stayed at Yes Hotel on a recent Rome trip and had a lovely experience. The room was cozy, clean, and comfortable, everything you need without unnecessary frills. Perfect base for exploring the city.

Location is a big plus: about a 5-minute walk to Roma Termini train station, which made arrivals, departures, and day trips incredibly easy.

Breakfast is available as an add-on for an extra 9 euro and worth it — good spread, tasty options, and a nice way to start the day before heading out.

One small heads-up: the walls are a bit thin, so if you're a light sleeper, pack earplugs or request a quieter room when booking. Otherwise, friendly staff, easy check-in, and solid value for money. Would happily stay again.

author: Terence G
title: Great location and value
text:
A short walk from the Uniqlo at Termini, makes for an excellent sight seeing hub. Jeannetta was the most helpful concierge I have ever encountered. She gave us our choice of room, suggested restaurants and put us at ease.
The area can seem sketchy for inexperienced travellers, but the hotel is clean, safe and comfortable.
The rooms were perfect for our needs. We were not in Rome to sit in a room. The a/c was actually among the best we experienced.

author: Beverly M
title: Great Stay
text: My wife and I celebrated our silver wedding anniversary with a four day accommodation in the yes hotel boutique-Rome which was truly first class and everything we wanted. A truly enjoyable stay accompanied with very friendly and helpful staff like jonas but special mention to Juliet who was absolutely wonderful and feel as if shes become a good friend which we will definitely hope to see again in the near future xx

author: tamara
title: Room problems, double costs, and no accommodation
text: After changing rooms twice due to smoke and crawling insects, no other 3-bed room could be offered to us; we were supposed to be split up. The air conditioning reached 57 dB. We refused and preferred to change hotels, and now we are not getting our money back. Booking is now fighting on our side; there is no accommodation from the hotel, they want to keep all the money even though we are not sleeping there, resulting in double costs for us and one day out of 4 in Rome lost. So if something goes wrong at this hotel, you are on your own.

author: Dilara B
title: Never again – absolutely no recommendation! Animals in the room!
text:
Our stay as a family at this hotel was a complete disappointment and unfortunately significantly impacted our Rome vacation.

The biggest problem was the broken air conditioning – and that with an outside temperature of 38 degrees in Rome. Even more absurd, however, was that the air conditioning could not even be controlled by the guests themselves. If you wanted to turn it on or off or even just change the temperature, you had to write to a person via WhatsApp every single time, since the reception is not staffed in the evening. I have never experienced anything like this in any hotel.

In addition, the air conditioning was extremely loud at night at about 60 dB. Getting a restful night's sleep was completely out of the question. The constant humming was unbearable and hardly let us get any rest.

Immediately after our arrival, we had to change rooms because the first room smelled strongly of cigarette smoke. Unfortunately, the new room was hardly any better. Instead of a professional solution, a manager came with a handyman who talked to him in the bathroom with the door closed and discussed something in there. The entire appearance seemed completely unprofessional and untrustworthy.

In general, the hotel makes a very run-down impression. The bathroom in particular was in poor condition. Doors and door frames were damaged, the trash can was heavily rusted and extremely unhygienic. There were stains everywhere, which reinforced the impression of a lack of cleanliness.

It was particularly disgusting that several animals crawled out of the door frame and then ran across the entire bathroom floor. One does not expect something like this even in a simple hotel. Several videos were recorded of this. 

Even worse, however, was how problems were handled. The person at the front desk explained to us multiple times that they were not responsible for anything and could neither make decisions nor solve problems. Supposedly, only management would take care of it – but they were simply unreachable. Even after over 24 hours, we had received no feedback or support whatsoever.

Even the first room change due to the strong smell of cigarettes was only possible after a long discussion. Even after that, no one felt responsible for fixing the numerous defects or taking care of the guests. On the contrary: The treatment of the guests was consistently unfriendly, unhelpful, and completely without any accommodation.

Ultimately, we felt forced to leave the hotel early at our own expense, as the conditions were no longer acceptable for us. Despite the significant defects, there was no accommodation whatsoever, neither in the form of a solution nor compensation or even a sincere apology. Ice-cold, explicit refusal of a hotel refund. The staff was practically unreachable, and if someone was on-site, no one could or would take responsibility.

Overall, this was one of the worst hotel experiences we have ever had. Defective and uncontrollable air conditioning, unbearable noise, lack of cleanliness, animals in the bathroom, management that was practically unreachable, and a completely missing service mentality – we absolutely cannot recommend this hotel.

author: Paul C
title: 100% would recommend.
text:
Stayed at Hotel Marisa for 4 nights up to 14th July 2026. Location was ideal only a couple of minutes walk from the Termini train station in Rome. It's about 30 minutes walk from the main attractions in Rome but it was very hot so we used the Metro, which you can pick up at the Termini. 

We stayed in the annex building which was about a 300m walk through the streets to the back of the building. There is a very small lift to the 4th floor that looks a bit ropey but is also a bit like the ones you see in old movies. The room was very clean and most importantly of all had excellent air con (vital for the summer months). Wifi was good. The towels were changed every day.

We only had breakfast 1 of the mornings and that was nice, good value for 10€ a nice selection of fruit pastries, cereals, bread eggs & bacon.

Staff were really friendly and helpful.

author: sergio736
title: Hotel well located but very simple.
text:
Very simple hotel with very small rooms, very small bed and very small dark bath area. 

The pillows were very low and the average bed, which is worth it is the location in front of the TERMINI metro and train station, a supermarket in front and still can make many sights walking.

author: Marusa I
title: Wonderful 3-night stay
text: We have spent 3 nights at Marisa hotel, it is a charming hotel with perfect location near Termini. The rooms are spacey, well air-conditioned and windows are excellently preventing the noises from the street. We had breakfast, it has a good variety of food and the staff, especially Julio, is very friendly.

author: Anja P
title: Great experience
text: Enjoyed my stay. The staff were very friendly, welcoming, and helpful throughout my visit. The room was clean, comfortable, and well maintained, which made the stay very pleasant. Everything was well organised, and I appreciated the helpful service and overall atmosphere. I would happily stay here again.

author: Steph
title: Great London Location
text:
Hotel was a great Central location within walking distance from Euston, St Pancras and King's Cross stations and underground. Easily able to leave cases at hotel for free. Staff were really nice during stay. Room was clean and spacious. Had everything we needed and would expect. 
Breakfast and night meal was lovely, no issues. 
Saw ironboard and irons available incase anyone needed them during their stay.
Only issue I had was I like the option of taking the stairs. This hotel the main room stairs go up through the back of the restaurant. Which I understand wanting to keep strangers out the hotel as you need a card to use the lifts. But it made using the stairs abit of a pain as they only went to reception area.
Will be using this hotel again. Overall great experience.

author: Stephanie L
title: Could do better
text:
Although the reception worked well and the staff on arrival were accommodating it became increasingly obvious that either the place was short staffed or there was some major management issues at play during breakfast.
Over three day stay there was a general lack of plates, bowls, cups, cutlery, clean tables, coffee and milk. The staff in the breakfast room just didn't seem to care and there was certainly a lack of urgency in the service overall.
Even on our arrival at the hotel trying to get lunch was difficult with a non working coffee machine and getting charged extra for crisps which it actually stated on the menu as included. 
We have stayed at other Premier Inns and never experienced such awful service.
The positives were that the room was a decent size and the bed really comfy - note this was nothing to do with the staff.

author: Lowri H
title: Nelson and the staff are great!
text:
We stayed for 4nights this week and I wanted to praise the staff we’ve met, from the bar to the restaurant and the housekeepers who came to refresh our room! You were all so accommodating and happy, especially Nelson who we met during breakfast! It was such a busy morning with obvious staffing/kitchen issues but Nelson was so kind and helpful even when some disgruntled guest were complaining about no plates/bowls/mugs and how slow food was replenished. It was not directly the staff’s fault, and through so many complaints Nelson still smiled, welcomed families and children with enthusiasm and really is an asset to the hotel!
If only other guests were as kind as the staff, when there were obvious issues that they were trying hard to work through! 
And honestly… waiting a few extra minutes for an egg and a sausage shouldn’t upset people as much as it does!! 
Thanks Nelson and all the staff, keep doing what you’re doing!

author: juliekaitani
title: Good, Bad and Ugly
text: The people that work in this hotel are super friendly, easy to approach and nothing is too much. Met by Redae who quickly had us checked in and on our way to our room to rest, he also ensured we had a table booked for our tea.  Service for our food was also amazing Jannat seemed to be so busy but was attentive and again willing to help. The hotel however is very dated, you roll together in the beds, the bathroom is all stained and dated and the room had a strange musty smell, but you get used to that quite quickly.

author: anita p
title: Very nice abd cleab hotel, staff very kind, easy access to city center with bus
text: Hotel rooms was very big, comfy bed, very clean, free access to Spa center, available parking and very good assortiments for breakfast

author: Punarvasu
location: National Capital Territory of Delhi, India
title: Modern hotel with a great bar
text:
If you want bigger rooms with great service, stay here. We were offered complimentary drinks at the bar and the bartender made great drinks. We had issues with the room AC and the staff promptly upgrade a triple room with 2 rooms.
Location is good with local restaurants and supermarket nearby.

author: Chili
title: Perfect stay.
text:
The structure is definitely huge, but despite this, it is not overwhelming and is actually welcoming and hospitable.  Just 10 minutes by taxi from Piazza Navona, so the location is convenient. 

Spacious, clean, and comfortable rooms. We took one with a balcony, and the outdoor space is very large and pleasant, 
despite the view not being the best because it overlooks an abandoned area. 

Very good food (varied breakfast of decent quality), excellent bar with cold dishes and tasty snacks, well-maintained and quality restaurant. 

Brand new spa area, well-equipped and perfect for a relaxing break. 

Indoor parking, covered, included in the price, is spacious and easily accessible. 

The highlight: the staff is extremely courteous, available, professional, and well-prepared. Both at the reception and in the dining area. Truly everyone is impeccable. 

Pets are allowed and especially welcomed without any additional charge. 

Highly recommended.

author: Buongustaio
title: Great for business in the EUR area.
text: Unexpectedly elegant, spacious rooms, quiet large bathroom, and truly professional staff. Breakfast is also good. A little far from the metro.

author: gila2010
title: I felt important!
text:
The 5-star rating is thanks to the staff who, from check-in to check-out, were extremely kind and made me feel important. Large and spacious structure, fantastic room in terms of size and functionality. They granted me an upgrade and I found fresh fruit and wine in my room. Complete breakfast that can satisfy everyone; a gem that is rarely seen anymore: a coffee machine like in a café with a barista included!!! 
Strategic location for my tastes, parking included. I will definitely return next time. Congratulations to everyone.

author: Bill A
title: Charming and Clean Hotel in a Great Rome Location
text: This was a very clean and charming hotel in the Trastevere part of Rome. The hotel staff was extremely helpful and kind. The area has many smaller and medium sized restaurants and is well located on the west side of the Tiber river. A less crowded area, but very charming and full of great restaurants. The hotel was very clean, great A/C, a wonderful staff and a fair price.

author: Nadia R
title: An amazing place in the heart of Trastevere!
text: Residenza San Calisto is simply living the authentic experience in Trastevere: charming, warm, welcoming! Super clean, super well located, and the staff is extremely helpful! Their recommendations are amazing for restaurants, activities... don't forget to check their wine cellar! A treasure!;)

author: Patricia P
title: 100% recommended
text:
​The Residencia San Calixto is a gem in the heart of Trastevere that combines comfort, historic charm, and exquisite service. Located in a serene square in the middle of Trastevere, it offers the perfect balance between rest and proximity to the city's main points of interest.
Highlights:
- Strategic location: quiet area
- Ten out of ten service: An impeccable, attentive, and welcoming team that makes you feel at home from the moment you arrive. 
​- Comfort and charm: Impeccable and clean rooms. 

​Five-star accommodation that I will undoubtedly return to. 100% recommended!

author: Shaunesse J
title: Lovely stay that I'll happily repeat
text: I traveled to Trastevere with my family to attend an academic conference. The staff were so warm and welcoming. They communicated with me a few days before departure to prepare me for checkin, which made traveling into Trastevere so easy. The room was spacious, quiet, clean, and cool, especially considering the heat wave the city was experience. The staff cleaned are room everyday! I know others mentioned it, but the intentionality of maintaining a clean welcoming space was so amazing after a long, hot day walking around. We were even greeted with complimentary wine! This was especially nice since our schedules didn't allow us to make it to Fabullus. The location is ideal for walking to so many major attractions. The restaurants, cafes, and piazzas nearby were fun to explore as well. We will happily stay here again! Thank you all for a lovely stay.

author: Janne P
title: Solo holiday at Trastevere
text: Hotel is at great location with lots of good bars and restaurants nearby. Rooms are well maintained and clean. Air conditioning was working fine and is must during mid summer. Helpful staff helped me to find thing to do that were suited personally for me.

author: RT R
title: Small, basic and clean
text:
Me and my daughter stayed in room 503 for 2 nights. Like all city rooms it’s small but this is pretty small. The balcony window is nicer the lift wasn’t working for 2-3 days so that was a mountain to go up and down a few times a day. Inc with luggage 
We didn’t have breakfast, but there is a Starbucks and Mac Ds just down the road. Really good location near the metro. 
They asked me before our stay if it was for a special occasion and it was my daughter’s 16th birthday: nothing extra was done so not sure why they asked. Other hotels have put something nice on previously.
Air con worked, hairdryer was good. Tv just bbc news or CNN news for English channels. 

There was drinks in the lobby area but no prices or information: 
I wanted some extra milk, they didn’t understand and I tried to ask them about the metro tickets - but not helpful again. 
Bonus was they looked after our luggage on the day of leaving. 
It’s clean, basic an near a metro

author: Nina K.
title: Would not recommend! Way better options in the neighborhood.
text:
The location of this hotel is great. Very central and close to everything (Gare du Nord, Pigalle, Mont Martre, le Marais, etc)
But thats about it. It’s just a bedroom in a boring street (with a club next door) The reception is ok, but the cleaning team is horrible. They started to make noise at 7:30. Loud phonecalls in the hallway, discussions amongst eachother, knocking on the door 2x times while the ‘do not disturb’ sign is up, vacuuming in the early morning in front of your door, not cleaning the towels while dirty, etc.
I would not recommend it. We won’t go back anyway.

author: RDragan
title: Fine, but not great!
text:
Strategically located hotel, 5 minutes walk from the M7 Cadet or Poissonnière line, 20 minutes, however, you are already immersed in Montmartre and 30 minutes you arrive at the Louvre museum. 
Different story instead for the rooms, really very small, it is also difficult to enter with the trolley and close the door behind. Cleanliness of the rooms excellent but attention to the courtesy line equal to zero. 
Breakfast with very little choice and always the same. 
Surely there is much better!

author: FURYO
title: DEPLORABLE, NOISEY, NOT STABLE AND WEAK INTERNET
text:
Deplorable is no match for a hotel for business.
Noise, your soundproofing, subway noise, dumpsters in the morning. 
Room very petie the bathroom let's not talk toilet stuck between the wall and the shower. Defective shower head , low ceiling, non-functional air conditioning and especially PAS. D INTERNET!!! Coneection problem not possible to make a video from your room. Systematic disconnection or too weak network.
Breakfast room small, without windows, poor pastries and bread (yet we are in the center and there are a significant number of excellent bakeries nearby.
