author: starck
title: disappointed
text:
Overall I am disappointed by this hotel , the room is small, and the bathroom tiny, especially the space between the toilet and shower. if you are a little strong , forget, you will not be able to access it. 
TV offers only 4 or 5 channels and almost nothing of TNT , I watched TV on an iPad , yet I reported this inconvenience on my arrival, but no action. for the last night, the person in charge of cleaning the room, did not consider it useful to put towels in the bathroom, good surprise when coming out of the shower on Friday morning.

author: Keith R
title: Excellent service, good location, & budget friendly
text: The service provided by Haileny was excellent as she greeted us with a warm reception and informative knowledge for the area. The proximity of the hotel, value, and rooftop pool/bar makes this a great budget friendly fun place to stay.  It's not bougie, but it is beauty on a budget.

author: Kingsley A
title: Haileny is the best!
text: I was privileged to be helped by the beautiful Haileny! I came in super tired from my trip and she made the process seamless, quick and she even got me an upgrade!

author: Tom L
title: NYC visit
text: This is our second stay at The Empire Hotel. This time for 5 nights. The staff were very accommodating, professional and personable, especially Haileny and Adrik. The hotel could benefit from cosmetic updates but the rooms were clean and very large for NYC. Free bottled water upon each request was a much appreciated bonus!

author: Sebastian S
title: Relaxing
text: Such great employees , they were all nice and generous. i loved the soft voice all of them had

author: Jalen A
title: Amazing
text: Staff was very friendly and willing to help with any of my needs

author: Kevin Michael L
title: Great Stay at Holiday Inn New York City
text:
I had a wonderful stay at Holiday Inn New York City. The location was very convenient, making it easy to explore the city and visit many popular attractions. The room was clean, comfortable, and well-maintained, and the staff were friendly, helpful, and welcoming throughout my stay.

I especially appreciated the convenient location and the overall comfortable atmosphere. Everything was smooth from check-in to check-out. I would definitely consider staying here again on my next trip to New York City. Highly recommended!

author: MJ
title: Good value hotel in Manhattan
text: It is very suitable for business trips. The location is very convenient and the sound insulation is also good. It is even better than some Kimpton and crown plaza. Compared with the Manhattan Hotel, the room is very large, this price. The service attitude of the front desk is very kind and attentive. Robina, the front desk staff, is very friendly and remembers the name of every guest and takes everything to heart, which is very touching.

author: Laura B
title: nice location
text: Decent location in the middle of a lot of places. Walkable to other neighborhoods. We confirmed multiple times on the phone that we would have 2 beds and arrived to a double or full size bed for 2 people. One time a call center confirmed two beds, then the actual hotel said due to the holiday season (even though we booked months in advance) two beds or a king. The hotel did quickly change us to a king size bed which we appreciated. Very busy due to time of year but overall nice hotel and clean. Always returned back to our room clean and towels refreshed. Easy to get cabs from the door.

author: Nick K
title: Extremely rude staff
text:
What a terrible experience at this hotel. I have never encountered front desk staff who were so rude, especially the two women working during my stay. They became extremely difficult when I asked for a slightly later checkout because my train was delayed.

The check-in process was also ridiculous—I wasn’t able to check in until 4:00 PM. Once I finally got into the room, it was essentially a shoebox. To make matters worse, a random charge appeared on my card after I had already checked out.

Overall, the customer service was extremely poor, the room was far too small, and the unexpected charge after checkout was unacceptable. I would not stay here again.

author: Abby O
title: Great Location
text: We enjoyed our stay at Holiday Inn Manhattan 6th Ave for a girls trip! Friendly service, clean room, and wonderful location close to subway and many restaurants, vintage stores, and coffee shops. We will be back!

author: Karla M
title: Great place to stay
text: Great location, great customer service and clean rooms. Really loved our stay. Can’t wait to come back

author: Marie Q
title: Lovely experience and recommend!
text:
Staff was very friendly and helpful.
Location was actually across the street from where we thought, they have locations on both sides of 32nd Avenue. The room was lovely, clean and all the amenities you could think of, which we appreciated.
location was perfect we could walked to everyhting we needed to get to.
Would definitely go back and do recommend.

author: John T
title: Poor Choice
text:
Lesson learned. Make sure you know what company you're using to book at Hotel 3232 NYC. 
We booked a room for 2 nights and was quoted $735. When we checked out, the statement from Hotel 3232 totaled $557, however, our CC was charged 735.

According to Hotel 3232, the reservation was made through Booking.Com, a Priceline affiliate. 

In speaking with Priceline, they said we had to talk to Booking.com who is impossible to reach a human. 

Looking at the confirmation email of the reservation, we see it came from confirmations@travel.guestreservations.com, not booking.com, unless it is a shell company of Priceline/booking. 

So be aware, the reservation we made ended up be a scam in my opinion. 

Hotel 3232 is listed as a 3 star boutique hotel. The only redeeming qualities we encountered were the friendly staff and the location to where we had to go for appointments. Other than that, the hotel needs a lot of work. The AC system in the rooms are basically window units. The rooms are small by any standard used. And don't be fooled by the balcony. Our supreme queen room had a balcony 3 ft deep that you wouldn't in your rightind sit on. outside

author: Boris M
title: TERRIBLE STAFF AND EXPERIENCE !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
text: I usually dont like to put bad reviews but i couldnt believe how terrible staff was and when you message managers they never respond . Not only we had to wait forever to get my room when they knew reservation was there but something was wrong with their system, on the day of leaving at 10 am cleaning people literally threw away into grabage the FOOD the MY CLOTHING A LOT OF PERSONAL BELONGINGS !! HOW IS THIS POSSIBLE THAT AT THE END YOU DONT EVEN HAVE APPOLOGY > THIS IS HORRIFIC EXPERIENCE . MESSAGED TWICE TO MANAGER > ELEVATOR HIT ME SO THAT ARM WAS HURTING 2 WEEKS . And not once response from management , front desk acting a bit like a gangster , terrrible!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

author: Michelle M
title: Great Midtown Stay with Friendly Service.
text: This stay felt smooth and comfortable from beginning to end. The staff were attentive and welcoming, and the added amenities like the fitness center and complimentary coffee made the experience even better. I would definitely return for another NYC visit.

author: Marta B
title: Excellent stay in central London
text: We had a wonderful stay at this apartment. The location is excellent, making it an ideal base for discovering London. The apartment was spacious, clean, comfortable and very well  equipped.

author: AnnMarie D
title: Our first stay in London & love apartment living
text: So nice! So much room! Well appointed!

author: Lucy T
title: Pretty bad
text: Really loud building works going on outside! Working late so nothing being mentioned of this was not helpful. The apartment was boiling hot and hairdryer didnt work.

author: Danny D
title: Not recommended during summer until they add AC
text: It was worse experience, first: the room view  does not look as they post on the social media. There was heat wave for 3 days during our stay, on our day 1 check in, me and my wife with our 3 year old kid couldn’t take a nap after having a flight trip. They gave us 2 fans after requesting but the room was already hot so fan air was like air fryer. We left after 3 hours of check in. Suggestion: as the weather is changing, becoming warmer! Add room AC so the guests, specially with kids and the tourists who come from abroad they can rest after long journey and after having a beautiful tour of your city/country.

author: Johanna R
title: BEWARE NO AC..not good for Summer
text:
I would **not recommend Marlin Apartments London Bridge – Empire Square**, especially during the summer. We traveled as a family with my 10-year-old daughter and my active parents in their 60s, and this stay became so uncomfortable that we decided to leave early.

The biggest issue is **NO AIR CONDITIONING**, and this was not made nearly clear enough when we booked. In summer heat, that is not a small detail. The apartment became unbearably hot day and night. We contacted the property several times and were given THREE fans, but even with all three running, we were still sweating inside the apartment. We asked about switching rooms and were told they could not move us.

What made the experience worse was the response when we explained that the heat was aggravating my mother's health issues. There seemed to be very little concern or urgency, and we were offered no meaningful solution beyond the fans. We also tried to address the situation financially, but no one seemed willing to take responsibility or offer a refund despite the conditions making the accommodation unsuitable for our family.

On top of the heat, **the floor was dirty**, which added to the disappointment considering what we paid.

We had planned to stay longer, but the discomfort became too much and we are **leaving early**. Losing money was preferable to spending another miserable night unable to sleep comfortably.

Guests should not have to dig through details to discover that a property has no air conditioning, especially during the summer. This needs to be displayed prominently before payment because it absolutely can determine whether a property is suitable for a family, older travelers, children, or anyone sensitive to heat.

The location may be convenient, but for us that did not come close to making up for the experience. **I would never book this property again and strongly recommend that summer travelers think very carefully before staying here.**

author: Wale A
title: Fairfield -medicore
text: Given the hotel advertised " fully renovated," I expected more updated  furniture and facility. On the positive, the location is located to many forms of transportation and complementary breakfast was helpful. In terms of price quality I would recommend AC hotel which is around the corner, nicer facility or another marriot.

author: justsaying899
title: Just bad….
text: I jut had a pretty terrible stay there. The staff is not competent and has no say or way to make things right. They are just employees and there are no managers on premise to make things right. No water, no housekeeping… just poor service. Not to mention the small breakfast area insanely overcrowded. I don’t recommend at all

author: Ümit A
title: Avoid this hotel
text:
Terrible service and dishonest billing!
Avoid this hotel. On my arrival, my room was registered as "Not Ready" in the app until midnight, forcing me into an extreme late check-in and ruining my first day. On check-out, the front desk verbally approved a 1-hour late check-out extension. Relying on their word, I checked out at 5 PM, but they turns around and charged my credit card an extra $140.05 USD without my consent, writing a deceptive note on my folio.  
The staff completely ignores messages on the Marriott app, and management refuses to take accountability for the promises made by their own team. Sub-par service and predatory billing practices. Absolute disgrace to the brand.

author: Sara F
title: A good hotel
text: A very good hotel, out of the times square madness.

author: Artur M
title: Location and practicality
text:
I chose the location (for the region), because it belongs to the Marriott network and because it seems practical and cost-effective.
At first I was a little upset because the bathroom in the room was locked (which was resolved by the arrival of an employee) and the difficulty in making the wi-fi work.
But it has its good points and others not so much.
Strengths: breakfast, staff service, bed comfort, acoustic insulation and location.
Points to improve: shower is weak, could have more lockers or place for luggage in the room

author: The-Wild-Ones
title: Really recommend this place as a great base for exploring NY
text: We had a great four night stay here. I travelled as a single parent with two teenagers and felt safe staying here. Good neighbourhood that is busy and felt safe even at night. The location was fantastic and the hotel sits between two subway stops perfect for getting around. The beds were really comfortable and there was a blackout blind on the window so we got great sleep and the room was very quiet even though it faced the street. The beds were really comfortable. The bathroom was rather small but adequate with good products included. Our safe wasn’t attached to anything so that could have done with being screwed into the wardrobe. The free wifi was great. There’s a lovely outdoor sitting area on the top floor perfect for chilling. It’s a nice, clean hotel, with a good standard that provides comfortable accommodation in an amazing location - what more do you need. Highly recommend as a great base for exploring.

author: lorrain c
title: Jonathan saved the day!!!
text:
Jonathan was at the front desk when we checked in and checked out, and our interactions with him consistently reflected a high level of professionalism. Upon checking out today, Jonathan was attentive and accommodating when we needed to leave our bags while we went to grab a bite.
The highlight of our stay, however, was his instrumental help in retrieving my daughter’s necklace after it fell into a crack in the cement floor at the front entrance. His quick action turned my panic into immediate relief.

Thank you, Jonathan, for your kindness, attentiveness, and outstanding service! You truly made a difference.

author: Jonathan A
title: Superb experience
text: We had Jonathan as main contact and he took care of us flawlessly. In an unfriendly city like NYC, having this kind of service is overly appreciated. Hotel location is also great and public transportation will take you anywhere in the city

author: thomas0judy
title: High end hotel in the middle of Manhattan
text: We stayed 3 nights and because this hotel is located close to everything we wanted to see, we parked our car a block away and walked or took the subway everywhere. Lots of restaurants, shops and museums. The Tenement Museum was our favorite.

author: dtempleton21
title: Dave and Wanda
text: Great location, close to restaurants, subway, taxi's ..etc. Clean well kept older hotel with great air conditioning. Friendly staff and descent location.

author: mrjc79
title: Showing it's age...but still good overall.
text:
I've stayed here multiple times since it opened and you can tell it's one of the original hubs: the carpets in rooms and corridors are looking a bit worse for wear and the chair in my room was quite stained.  Also paint on skirting boards in my room was quite scuffed and flaking off where people have bashed into it with their shoes over the years.
However, you can't beat the location and the staff are always amazing: that's why I keep coming back!

author: BillandBong
title: Great London base
text: Great location with easy access to bus routes, tube, restaurants, Covent Garden, Leicester sq etc. Super helpful staff and a really great, fresh, plentiful continental breakfast. Rooms may be simple, with no coffee/tea facilities but 24hr machine available in lounge.

author: Carole O
title: Friendly and Central location.
text: Picked this hotel due to its location, as it is very central.  Staff extremely helpful and friendly. Loved the electronic signs to say DND and dont clean room etc. Rooms small but contain all you need. (Except drink making facilities which are available 24/7 in bar)

author: Alan S
title: Our stay at Premier Inn Hub
text: Amazing stay and perfect location. Staff and management we’re Fantastic.

author: Sarah G
title: Birthday get away
text: Great location clean and friendly staff could not be more helpful

author: Zachary Z
title: Good hotel for Javits Center cons
text: Great location, very helpful front desk (shout out to Jessy), and large room.  Walls were a bit thin, but otherwise solid.  I chose it because it was close to the Javits Center and a reasonable price, bonus was having diverse restaurants within a block because I'm lazy and don't like going on an adventure for food.

author: mary_O101715
title: Basic, comfortable, spacious
text: My Daughter and I had a fantastic stay here. Jessy greeted us and immediately made us feel welcome. We were very early for check in so she checked our bags and offered to call us when our room was ready. Overall the hotel needs some updating but the room was clean and spacious and the bed was comfortable. We were on the 3rd floor so there was a good bit of noise from the street but that is to be expected and it didn't disturb us at night. The hotel is in a pretty decent location. It is about 10 minutes walk from Times Square away from the majority the crowds. Easy walking distance to the subway. If you are looking for all the amenities and luxury this wouldn't be the place for you. It was a great place for my daughter and I to sleep at night. I can't say enough great things about Jessy. She really made us feel at home and she went out of her way to make sure we had everything we needed and more. Thanks Jessy and we hope to see you again!

author: Viv N
title: ANYC 2026
text:
Nice and comfortable hotel with super spacious rooms and super close to everything we were going out to see.  We were able to walk to everything we were in the city for without much issue (aside from the weather but that’s out of everyone’s control).

Also huge shoutout to Jessy at the front desk for being super personable and working with all of my group’s requests.

author: Caitlin C
title: Home away from home
text: Truss has become our home away from home. After our first stay last year for anime nyc we decided to to come back not only due to great rates and how close it was to javits but also because Jessy at the front desk has become of our family away from home. Helpful, insightful, kinda and true. The staff will do their best to help and accommodate you during your stay. Not to mention provide city tips and tricks while you’re staying. We can wait to come back next year and stay at truss but also see Jessy !

author: Brooke C
title: Would Stay Here Again
text: Truss hotel exceeded our expectations and Jessy made it even better! She was so friendly and helpful to talk to every time we’d come and go. Would definitely recommend this hotel, clean and updated rooms. Great location too!

author: FellowTraveler139100
title: Rome Art Hotel 2026
text: The hotel is in a central location making it easy to get around Rome.  On our first day Joseph was wonderful.  Getting us checked in early, recommending places to eat and helping with transportation.  The “bell hops” went over and beyond with help.  The breakfast was a wide variety of foods.  The breakfast was ran by Juliette, who was friendly, attentive and a hard worker.  The room and bathroom were clean, the bed comfortable and the towels fluffy.  Staying here helped make our vacation in Rome memorable.

author: Shelley Cockerham
title: Great spot
text: Great location very central. Knowledgeable staff for sightseeing advice. Nice rooms.

author: David B
title: Do not stay here
text:
My wife and I stayed at Rome Art Hotel for our honeymoon and left within an hour of check-in. The room had a strong cigarette smoke odor, visible dirt on walls and curtains, worn fixtures, and carpet—not the hardwood floors shown on every photo of their website. Our allergies worsened noticeably during the short time we were there, and the thermostat never worked despite waiting an hour. The front desk manager was polite but unable to issue a refund, so we were forced to book another hotel at our own expense on our honeymoon night.

We submitted a formal written complaint to hotel management detailing all of the above and requesting a refund. We never received a response.

The property does not reflect what is advertised. If you’re booking for a special occasion, I’d encourage you to look elsewhere

author: D C
title: Good hotel.
text: The welcome and room were pleasant, and the location in the center of Rome was perfect. We had dinner one evening at the hotel restaurant, which was charming and served very good food.

author: Rafaela Liboria M
title: Changing from a 4-star to a 3-star hotel
text: We had made a reservation for hotel arts rome we were referred from one 4 to the hotel trevi where you do not correspond quality price do not spend on this hotel that you throw money

author: Gemma M
title: family stay in Aldgate
text: I always love Premier Inn, you know you are going to get a comfy sleep and a fabulous breakfast. it was well located, easy to check in, and delivered everything we expected.

author: F B
title: good
text:
A hotel with a very good value for money. The breakfast was good overall, although I found it a shame that there was no cheese such as Emmental or individual pots of yogurt. Apart from that, everything was fine.

But I am writing this review especially for IDA from Bar & Block. I really hope she remembers me, because she truly saved my day from becoming extremely frustrating.

I was travelling with my daughter, who has coeliac disease, which makes food a particularly complicated issue when we travel. When you have a child with dietary restrictions, you prepare everything carefully in advance. I choose hotels and restaurants where my daughter can feel comfortable and enjoy her holiday without constantly being reminded that she cannot eat like everyone else.

Before coming, I had even emailed the hotel to make sure there would be gluten-free bread available at breakfast. I was reassured that everything would be fine and that I had nothing to worry about.

Then, on the third day, I was told that there was no gluten-free bread left because the other guests had taken it all the day before.

I was extremely upset. Not simply because of the bread, but because I had done everything I could in advance, I had trusted the hotel, and yet I still found myself in this situation.

And then IDA stepped in.

She took the time to listen to me, to really understand the situation and, most importantly, to put herself in my shoes. She showed incredible empathy and did everything she could to find a solution to a problem that, I would like to point out, was not her responsibility.

She works in service, but she ended up solving a problem that should have been anticipated and managed beforehand. And that is exactly when I realised that Ida has something special: she understands customers, the reality of the job and, above all, the human side of things.

You might think that it is “just a problem with bread”. But for a little girl who is already labelled as “different” because of her illness, having to be reminded during her holiday that she cannot eat like everyone else is not a small thing.

Ida changed that. She made me smile again and saved what could have been a very disappointing day.

Honestly, Ida, perhaps your place is not only in customer service. You clearly have the qualities for management, leadership or strategy, because you understand what really happens on the ground and what the customer actually experiences.

So, once again: THANK YOU, IDA ❤️  5 stars for IDA

As I told you in my slightly broken English: you are the boss! 👑
The whole staff is also very friendly
From Fetta
(Feta, like the cheese 😂)

author: Emilie D
title: nice hotel for families
text:
Clean and nice hotel. Close to bus and subway. 
A stone's throw from Brick Lane.
Great breakfast. 
Attention, restaurant prices are high.

author: Bex_Stew
title: Good stay, as expected
text:
Area felt safe and quiet yet less than 5min walk to tube (on 2 major lines). Well priced for central London.

Room was clean and beds very comfortable. Typical premier inn, so as expected really. Air con in room was very welcome but switches off during day when not there. Staff polite and efficient on the whole. 1 lift out of order and 1 with key card security not working which was inconvenient at times but we were on a low floor so could use the stairs when needed.

Breakfast tasted good and hot food was plentiful but staff struggled to keep up with demand for cold food, particularly pastries and yogurt (couldn’t always get what we wanted and had to scrape the yogurt to get any. Area around pastries/breads and coffee machines was very cramped so lay out maybe needs a re think

author: Ruby T
title: Allergy family stay
text: Couldn’t not shout out 2 standout members of staff, Ron at check in who sorted our family room early for us to get our children unpacked and ready and Ida (apologies if I spelt your name wrong) at breakfast who very greatfully overheard us speak about our daughters allergies to a member of staff at breakfast who was not very understanding (to say the least!), Ida came over and took care of everything. She made our daughter safe and feel so special. As parents to a child with severe allergies this meant the world to us. Thank you!

author: Giacomo P
title: Amazing experience
text: Amazing service and a wonderful experience! Nikola was extremely helpful, kind, and attentive throughout our stay. The atmosphere was lovely, and the entire team was friendly, welcoming, and very professional. Highly recommended—we would definitely stay here again!

author: Denise S
title: Superb!
text: Great location for all amenities and a superb room! I had a good view of planes overhead and being a plane spotter this was great! No faults from us. Comfy mattress and pillows and although the room was warm we coped with the fan provided. Thanks for a great stay!

author: 3criticsBolton
title: Great stay
text:
Stayed at this hotel during our last visit to London. Great value, clean and in a good spot to explore London. Room was quiet and comfortable during our stay. When we arrived there was no problem storing our bags until our check in time this was a great bonus as we could make the most of our time. Only downside was that there was no AC in this hotel and as it is so hot during the summertime. ( As lots of hotels in London are.) But a fan was provided in the room. 
Nearest tube stations are Moorgate and old street. We found the bus stop right outside the easiest way to get to where we wanted to go. We would definitely use this hotel again.

author: Nehmeena M
title: NIKOLA
text: Good service thank you nikola

author: Joshua O
title: Amazing Travelodge
text:
Staff were amazing, especially Nikola who was so accommodating and understanding of any issues raised. She works round the clock to ensure good service!

Location was very ideal as you can cycle round most of London with hireable bikes nearby.

Room was standard as most Travelodge’s, kept clean and room of a good size.

Overall good value for money!

Only issue was the fire alarm going off a few times, with one at 4:30AM.

author: Explorer51497673385
title: Not the Dream you expect
text: have stayed at the Dream Meatpacking 4 different times, wouldn't stay at this location. It was cheap and we had a flight disruption but the rooms are in very rough shape, ours smelt like someone had been smoking in there for 20 years. We ended up checking out early, they offered us to switch rooms. Lobby is nice, all the amenities were closed which is probably why the room was relatively cheap but still don't think it justified the price we paid, i would have put this in a 2 star hotel category for our stay. Bellman are very nice and others working too, however the billing was all messed up took 2-3 calls to figure it out because we were overcharged.

author: DIOGENES L
title: Not too dreamy
text:
Best feature in the room was a nice working ac. The room itself was very small, and when I asked why there was no Globalist upgrade, I was politely told I should have asked for one. The room was very cute, although not sure if all lights worked. Bathroom and closet were tiny, no room to even place toiletry bag in the bathroom.
It was kind of noisy in the room all night, and not the street kind of noise...Bathroom has a loud fan that will not turn off at all. There was also similar type of noise coming from elsewhere, so sleeping wasnt so dreamy.
Lastly, breakfast was awful. Everything was bad, beverages, food, appearance. Mosquitos and flies circling your table in the restaraunt was an added nice touch.

author: kristina p
title: Dreams could use a revamp
text: Staff was very nice at check-in and check-out. Carpets are old and dirty. Room smelled musty. Bathroom was clean. This hotel could use a revamp.

author: julia w
title: Convenient location
text: Stayed at this hotel overnight for the united airlines half marathon in March 2026 and enjoyed our short stay. The later check out time made it so I could stop at the room and shower before checking out after completing my half marathon (I was in an early corral which made this possible). The attached bar was great and will define let stay here again next time I run the race as it was very short walk from the finish line and close to the subway to get to the start. Room was small and kinda of an odd layout but no issues for an overnight trip.

author: PhilN

author: David C
title: Very good stay
text: It is a 3-star hotel with an unbeatable location, the rooms are simple, but it is clean and we didn't have any problems during our stay. I would definitely stay at this hotel again. The hotels located in this area are exorbitantly priced and this hotel is great value for money. Do not pay attention to the reviews you read here.

author: Karl Z
title: Dishonest Service
text: Had room booked and paid for Saturday night. Was told upon arrival room was not available, and was not given a refund as it was a non refundable reservation . Very unethical and lousy customer service .

author: Leanne S
title: Unexpected welcome
text:
Although the hotel is conveniently located to most tourist attractions I would not return or recommend to families.  
The rooms are very small, the beds a small doubles and there is only one single wardrobe. It’s a challenge to find space to open your suitcase. 
The elevator situation is terrible, we took the stairs down from floor 24 on a few occasions as one elevator was out of action. The elevators are also used by the staff, which also slows down the flow. 

Outside of the hotel had to be the biggest surprise. There are public benches which appear to be the home of several homeless drug addicts, who sit there day and night in various states of consciousness.

author: Karine P
title: Very good for the proximity!
text: Easy to access, comfortable and clean room. Paid parking very close by. The reception is supervised by a guard at all times, so even if the neighborhood seems less secure, it is well protected.

author: Julen G
title: Excellent, ideal hotel
text: Exceptional hotel, helpful and friendly team, adequate and clean rooms

author: Meander17469737493
title: Do not stay here
text: I don't know where to start. First the area in front of the hotel is open to the public so there are drunks and people smoking weed all the time. Then the front door was broken for a couple days as well as one of two elevators. Then the elevators, there are only two elevators and that are shared between staff and guest which is unfortunate for all parties. The staff is delayed and the guys have to be in the elevator with leaking trash bags. The room seemed fine at first if a bit small but there was a corner of the room that smelled like urine the entire stay, the cleaning crew only does a very basic once over and the comforter and sheets are often dirty, I felt sick in the room and often had to go outside to feel better. The front of the hotel is a designated public area which I understand but at all hours there are teens, adults, and homeless people passed out, drinking, or vomiting on or around the benches. There was also apparently a leak downstairs so they had to come into our room on two different occasions to work on the shower and then we were told not to use it for some time. I'm sure there is a lot I am forgetting, but we rented here because my daughter had to come to NYC and this was close to where she had to go for her activity next time I'll book somewhere else even if it's further away. I would not recommend this place at all.

author: billyblaze
title: Great room. No issues
text: Very Nice Stay! I used my IHG cardmember free night award for this stay and was happy to find availability in the heart of NYC. Room was small but we don’t spend a lot of time in the room. It was clean and appeared to be recently renovated. Elevators are an issue in most NYC hotels so just be patient and not a big deal. Location is great for exploring NYC.

author: Anna F
title: A true Gem in Monti District
text: We had a wonderful stay at this hotel! The location was fantastic, so close to everything. The room was spotless, and the service was excellent. Even though they were fully booked, they kindly accommodated an early check-in, which really made our day easier. The breakfast was a highligh. We will definitely be back.

author: Anon092
title: Rome hotel of choice
text:
Stayed here for a long weekend in Rome.  Third visit in the past few years and hotel of choice when visiting this wonderful city. Small, quirky, boutique hotel within a converted traditional Roman apartment building.

Great location, 5 minute walk from Rome Termini train/ bus station. Very handy when getting train/ bus transfers from airport to the city. Next to the St Mary Major church and handy for the main attractions like The Colosseum and Forum (10-15 minute walk).

Hotel rooms are clean, modern and comfortable.  Staff are friendly and professional. Buffet breakfast is included, which is a nice touch.  Decent value given the location and quality of accommodation.

Recommended. Will return. Only has about twenty rooms, so book early!

author: Beverly T
title: Would stay again ‘When in Rome’
text: Beautiful room and location of hotel. The staff were helpful, friendly and professional. The free buffet breakfast was delicious. Cute elevator! No complaints would stay again. Good value for the money.

author: Magdalena M
title: Birthday holiday with friends and wife!
text: A fantastic hotel with beautiful design. The rooms are large and beautiful. Had a room with a view of the city. The staff were very nice and service-oriented, did everything for us and for our friend who had a birthday! The breakfast was very good, coffee available 24/7. Very clean and fresh hotel. If you have to find something negative, it is the rock-hard beds, but the pillows were very comfortable. Free drinks in the minibar upon arrival. We will be happy to return!

author: Tony F
title: Delightful Hotel
text: This quirky hotel was almost invisible from the street, but once inside you were pleasantly surprised.  Great location in Rome, but also quiet and homely.  Staff were friendly and helpful and breakfast was a further delight.  Wouldn't hesitate to stay here again.  Lovely establishment.

author: irenemood
title: Good choice
text:
A very conveniently located hotel, right in the heart of Manhattan, with easy access to all the major attractions and to the neighbourhoods that are best explored on foot if you really want to get a feel of New York.

The rooms were extremely small and somewhat basic in terms of amenities, although generally clean — as long as you don’t look too closely under the mattresses! The staff, however, were friendly and helpful throughout our stay.

The breakfast was perfectly decent, without being anything particularly special, but the service from the waiters was very good and welcoming.

Overall, I would say it is a very good option if you want to stay downtown, have breakfast included, and be within walking distance of many of the city’s main sights. A practical and pleasant choice, particularly for those who value location above spacious rooms and luxury amenities.
One point worth mentioning is the elevators. There are only two elevators serving all 32 floors, which can result in significant waiting times, particularly during peak hours. In the morning, especially, there can be quite a queue, making it difficult to get down to the lobby for breakfast. This is something to keep in mind, particularly if you are on one of the upper floors.

author: Alexe-Anne G
title: Great hotel!
text: Adrien was very helful. The room was very clean and came with complimentary snacks.

author: Robert S
title: Brilliant!
text: Claire and Adunni looked after us so well. Great stay. Lovely rooms.

author: Audrey S
title: Excellent hotel
text: Excellent hotel.Location ideal for subway to reach all areas. Rooms clean and comfortable with city view.Staff very professional and customer focused. Would definitely stay again.

author: Swellrdr247
title: Noisy Rooms, Poor Service, and Disappointing Amenities
text:
I requested a quiet room away from the elevators and even arrived early to confirm it. When I returned, a different front desk representative had assigned us a room directly next to the elevators. When I called to ask for a change, I was told the hotel was fully booked and, disappointingly, the staff blamed me for the issue instead of trying to help.

The room was extremely noisy. We could hear people talking loudly in the hallways at 1 a.m., as well as trucks and construction noise throughout the night. Sleep was nearly impossible.

The room itself was small and poorly designed, with a very narrow desk and virtually no comfortable seating. The only chair provided was uncomfortable, making it difficult to sit and relax in the room. The shampoo and other toiletries were also noticeably low quality.

The hotel has only three small, slow elevators, which were often crowded and resulted in long waits.

The breakfast and coffee were also disappointing, with limited options and poor quality.

Overall, between the poor customer service, excessive noise, uncomfortable room, low-quality amenities, and disappointing breakfast, this was a frustrating and unpleasant stay.

author: Mrs D
title: Non-Existent Housekeeping
text: We stayed for 5 nights leaving by 9.30am each morning to visit our daughter who lives nearby. Although we left the sign out requesting that the room be serviced this was only done on the first night and then bins were not emptied and no tea/coffee provided.  There are several hotels which are equally conveniently placed which will have our business when we return in just over a month.

author: D A

text: I didn’t book early check-in and arrived a bit early but Demz checked me in and the rest of the staff are friendly. The room needs some maintenance and cleaning. One of the bathroom spotlights wasn’t working, the soap dispenser in the shower didn’t work and had hand wash written on the side so no idea if it was soap or not, the shower curtain had stains on it as well. The location is very good apart from my room was next to some bars next door so can be a bit noisy which I know isn’t the hotels fault. Not the best Travelodge I have stayed at but the room was a decent price.

author: Oliver J

author: Sarah W

author: MOBAHD
title: This is a real scam !!
text:
My stay had already been fully paid through Booking.com, yet my card was charged a second time under the pretext of a “security deposit” or pre-authorization.
It has now been four weeks since my check-out, and I still have not received my money back.
What is even more concerning is the contradictory information I have received. First, I was told that a refund had been processed. Later, I was told it was only a released pre-authorization. My bank has confirmed that it has received neither a refund nor any released authorization.
I have filed a formal complaint with Booking.com and disputed the charge with my bank. Despite sending several emails and follow-ups, I still have not received any response from the manager, Shakira Luqman, nor any meaningful attempt to resolve this issue.
I strongly recommend that anyone staying here carefully checks their bank statements after check-out. Until this issue is resolved and my money is returned, I cannot recommend this hotel.

author: Yaumama
title: Don’t be cheated
text:
Beware of the hidden fees.

I booked two rooms at Soho 54 Hotel through Expedia for a 3-night family trip to New York because the advertised rates looked much cheaper than many other hotels in the area.

What I didn’t realise until after booking was that the hotel charges a mandatory “resort fee” of USD 40.16 per room, per night. For two rooms over three nights, that came to over USD 240 in additional charges.

The most frustrating part is that this fee was not prominently disclosed during the booking process. It only appeared afterwards in the confirmation email under “Additional Property Fees”. By the time you discover it, you’ve already paid.

To make matters worse, the so-called “resort fee” covers basic amenities that most travellers would reasonably expect to be included in the room rate anyway, such as Wi-Fi, bottled water, coffee and gym access. There is nothing remotely “resort-like” about this property.

The hotel itself was equally disappointing. The online photos create a much better impression than reality. The bathrooms were tired and outdated, the carpets looked worn, and the Wi-Fi was unreliable despite being one of the items supposedly covered by the resort fee. Other than the air conditioning working properly, very little justified the overall cost.

What appeared to be a bargain turned out to be anything but. Once all the mandatory fees were added, the value for money simply wasn’t there.

This hotel feels like a classic bait-and-switch: attract guests with a low headline price, then recover the difference through mandatory fees.

My advice: don’t be fooled by the headline room rate. Check every hidden charge carefully and compare the true total cost with other hotels before booking. There are far better options in New York for the same money.

author: Jess L
title: Total scam - beware of hidden fees!!!
text: Total scam. I booked through a portal and there were hefty hidden "facility fees" ON TOP of what I paid at checkout. I never would have booked this hotel if I had known the true cost. I'm actually embarrassed and disturbed at how much I ended up paying to spend 3 nights here. What a joke.

author: josef70115
title: Fine for the price
text:
Pros - very affable and competent staff.  fast elevators. comfortable beds

Cons - well worn hotel

author: P L
title: Nice hotel but loud.
text:
Hotel is ok. Staff is nice. TV is spotty. The only buttons on the remote that work are the power, the volume, and the down channel button. 
But the big thing is the traffic noise. This block of Watts street is at the holland tunnel. Traffic is very busy here and VERY loud. 
Horns honking until 11:00 pm every night. Hard to sleep even on our upper floor.

author: julien312026
title: Cardinal Hotel St. Peter
text:
Overall, a superb hotel with a pool.
Very appreciated in this hot weather!
A truly top-notch team, whether at the front desk, the restaurant, or housekeeping; they are all super friendly!
Hotel is a 2-minute walk from the bus and also a 10-minute walk from the subway,
Ideal for the sightseeing trips we were able to take, and there are many! 
Close to the Vatican, Colosseum, Pantheon, and others…
I recommend it.

author: LO75
title: Does not deserve 4 stars
text:
Don't deserve 4 stars!
The size of the pool is misleading compared to the photos. Once we arrive we are told the obligation to wear a swim cap to access it (without prior information although we had booked 4 months before) and the purchase of the cap is at our expense.

Staff not understanding and closed to discussion when we expressed disappointment with this obligation

Outdated room that requires a great refreshment, cleaning being very limited

author: Angelo G
title: Pleasant stay
text: Elegant and clean facility. Professional and efficient staff. Especially the dining room staff at the restaurant. Kind, polite, and well-groomed. Even the hour of relaxation in the pool was made pleasant by the staff

author: suerichardson2026
title: Clean, comfortable and friendly.

author: mamametkids2017
title: Enjoyed it!!!
text: Lovely hotel for good price. Slightly dated but makes one totally well with very friendly staff and pool. It was during our stay up to 38 degrees celcius, fantastic working e air conditioning in the room, ground floor. If you do not expect super luxury and needs absolute must.

author: Wendy V
title: Another fabulous stay
text:
This is my absolute favorite hotel!! I have stayed 3 times and this was my first time booking a balcony suite. Definitely worth the money. 
Kevin and Christina both went out of their way to be extremely kind. They both remembered what I had done the previous day and always asked how I was doing. This is the best hotel in NYC. I always feel like I am at home here.

author: SARAH G
title: New York
text: This hotel was a fantastic hotel. The bar area is lovely and the staff are so hard working. They help you whenever they can. Some tasty breakfasts with great company. The beds were really comfy and the location was excellent.

author: Thomas B
title: GREAT HOTEL!!
text:
The Westgate is a lovely hotel and a great choice for anyone visiting New York City. Having been to New York before, I knew how important a good location is, and being just a five-minute walk from Grand Central Terminal made getting around the city incredibly easy.
I took my girlfriend on her first trip to New York, and the hotel really helped make the experience special. Our room was cleaned every day, and all of the staff were friendly, welcoming, and helpful throughout our stay. I genuinely couldn’t fault the place.
As a bonus for Spider-Man fans, the hotel is right next to the building used as Norman Osborn’s (the Green Goblin’s) residence in the movies, which was a nice surprise.
I would happily stay here again and would highly recommend it to anyone planning a trip to NYC.

author: Tour645274
title: Not what we expected from Westgate
text: We were allowed to check in early but that's all that was good. Our rooms floor is dirty, our room has only one light by the bed so it's dark. Our view is of a alley or something, our shower has brown stains on the wall, our toilet paper dispenser is broken, we can hear everything our neighbors say, even just coughing, and our bed isn't very comfortable. Elevators are scary shaking and don't appear safe. Ice machine is 3 floor away and there's no restaurant as advertised. For the money this is not what I expected as an owner at Westgate. I have no chairs or night stand so my wife and I just sat on the bed. Finally got the front desk to send staff person to check light switch but it didn't work so he brought a lamp from another room.

author: PYL91
title: Hotel very well located, but a narrow, dark, and noisy room
text:
We spent four nights with three people in a room supposedly "Luxury Accommodation with 2 Queen-Size Beds." We have positive impressions from this stay and some negative ones.

On the positive side, the room was very clean and well-maintained every day. The staff was courteous and efficient. The location of the hotel is very good for visiting Manhattan. 

Unfortunately, the room was very narrow (difficult to store belongings) and dark (minimal lighting and windows that face directly onto the walls of the inner courtyard). 

Above all, the level of noise disturbances was very significant. The door does not reach the floor and allows sounds from the hallway to pass through (along with a stream of light that illuminates the room all night). Moreover, our room was separated from the neighboring room by a non-soundproofed locked door, which gives the impression of sharing the same room: one can follow the neighbors' conversations, hear them unpacking their suitcases, etc. This was particularly unpleasant. In addition, there was a noisy refrigerator placed right next to the headboards, as well as the loud clapping of the air conditioning that stops every 30 minutes (we therefore turned it off and got very hot, as opening the window would have exposed us to the noise of an air conditioning extractor located right next to it).

The value for money in Manhattan remains acceptable if one is willing to endure these inconveniences.

author: Carlos R. Martinez
title: Very well located.
text: Small rooms, beautiful terrace, it is one block from the subway.

author: Yolanda S
title: First Time in New York
text: The room was nice, we had are own bathroom which was nice, clean and comfortable the only thing didn’t have microwave or fridge to stored left overs are your drinks.

author: Explorer36355915805
title: Wonderful hotel-hostel in east midtown
text: Location was excellent in E Midtown.  Close to the E and 6 trains, which got us everywhere we wanted to go, otherwise very walkable.  Definitely a hotel/hostel hybrid, rooms are small with a bunk bed (full sized), shared bathrooms on each floor, but with housekeeping and a front desk staff (both very helpful and friendly).  Rooms and bathrooms were clean and comfortable.  Truly did not have any issues with noise.  And don't miss out on the Rooftop patio, is was perfect, great views, comfortable, great way to end the night.

author: Jordana L
title: Long and pleasant stay in room with private bathroom
text: Great location, clean room, comfortable and functional (pod queen). Careful employees. No inconvenience. Good cost benefit.

author: Johannes M
title: Very small but clean rooms good for spending the entire day out in NYC
text:
We originally booked a bunk bedroom with a shared hallway bathroom, which I was originally unaware of. We found this out when we arrived, but were able to upgrade to a queen bed and private bathroom for about $20. Also, whenever you check in, there is a roughly $30 charge that you have to pay. The rooms are very small, and the bathroom is even smaller and cramped. There's also, strangely, a window that looks into the bathroom from the bedroom. The bathroom door is also only a thin sliding door so make sure you are very comfortable with the person you are sharing the room with. 
The room is clean, and the check-in process was fairly smooth.

author: Venture51741493896
title: A good experience with this hotel
text: My family and I had a great experience at this hotel. We had heard that the Times Square area is very noisy, yet we didn't hear a thing from our room. The room was small but cozy and kept clean by the excellent housekeeping staff. We also had a positive experience with Maria at the front desk; she welcomed us to New York with open arms. If we ever return, we would stay here again.

author: Carlos L
title: Horror hotel! RUN
text: If I could give it minus 100 stars, I would 🤬. Upon arriving at the lobby, the seats were damaged, dirty, and torn; the bathroom had an unbearable smell of urine; the rooms were dirty with unpainted, scratched walls; the bathroom had mold; the curtains were torn; the walls had spiderwebs; the TV was stuck almost to your bed; the beds squeaked like in a horror movie. I went to cancel my reservation and they accepted it, only for me to receive an email 2 days later informing me that they will not refund me! They stole $278 from me. New York City should shut down this so-called hotel, if it could even be called that. DO NOT waste your money there; it is the worst in New York. Look at photos from former guests and you will realize what I am talking about. I left so scared that I did not manage to take photos.

author: Stay32187897042
title: AVOID IT AT ALL COSTS
text:
5/5 location, but not worth the money as it is clearly not a 4 star hotel. Extremely noisy room opposite the busiest road in Times Square due to a single-pane window. The loud sounds passed easily through the thin glass and tiny air gaps. I could not sleep at all even if the staff gave me free ear plugs. Filthy and very run down lift, corridor and room. Scuffs on the walls, torn blinds and gum on the couch. The AC worked the first 2 days of our stay but we had to turn it off because it was also noisy. Spacious shower but covered in mold. No tea, coffee or fridge. Worst of all, MARIA, the hotel staff at the front desk gave us the rudest welcome to New York. She should look for another job because it is obvious she is not happy working there. She should also learn how to treat customers from her colleagues Jaz, Rachel and Richy.
I would not recommend this hotel and suggest to avoid it at all costs. There is plenty of accommodation in this busy city.

author: Ana
text:
It is very frustrating to see that, two years after our terrible experience at this hotel, the same problems continue to occur with complete impunity.
In addition to the appalling standards of cleanliness and maintenance, the most serious issue is the fact that money is being charged to guests’ credit cards without their authorization / consent.
What is difficult to understand is how, despite the large number of complaints and reports from different guests, nothing seems to be done about it. It is shocking that such practices can apparently continue without any effective action being taken.

author: Reichiko
title: Lovely, clean, convenient, great Security
text: Our room was very clean, nice, and quiet. My son left his stuffed puppy and, currently, security staff (Irvin, Danny, JB, Alex and Erik) have found it and packed it to send back to us! Very grateful for their help and my son looks forward to receiving his long lost pup. We hope to return to this lovely place one day!

author: L C
title: Perfect Base for a Broadway Trip
text:
If you're headed to the Theater District, it's hard to beat the Edison. The location is unbeatable - we were steps from everything we needed, and the staff was genuinely helpful throughout our stay. Oh, and every time we walked through the lobby, Frank Sinatra was playing. Honestly, perfect.

Is it a grand luxury hotel? No. The hallway from the door to the bed has serious backrooms energy (we laughed every time), the bathroom is cozy to say the least, and the open shower concept means the entire bathroom becomes a splash zone. Housekeeping kept up admirably with the chaos and we were never short on towels.

A mini fridge would have been nice, but this is Manhattan - I get it. Every square inch counts.

For the price and location, the Edison delivers exactly what you need for a NYC trip. We'd absolutely stay again.

author: James F
title: Excellent stay !
text: The Staff and management at the hotel were fantastic ! Completly attentive and freindly. The bed was quite comfortable and the food at the restaurant was top draw ! This was my second trip in the past three months and i will be going back in the fall.

author: Dmitry K
title: Perfect place to stay when exploring New York with your family
text: Overall very nice hotel, very authentic and comfortable. Spacious clean rooms with stunning views. Perfect location in the heart of Manhattan. Plenty of breakfast options.

author: trishmsh

    Michael and I have just had the most magical stay at this Incredible Theater District/Time Square Historical Hotel!!

❤️❤️

author: graham052016
title: Great location. We enjoyed our stay.
text:
The location is great if you want to be near Times Square.
The staff are friendly.
We stayed 8 nights.
Our room was old (but we knew that from other reviews) but it was clean and very functional.
The daily service of the room was great.

2 lounge chairs, king bed, plenty of storage, large bathroom with a bath.
Safe. Desk and chair. Good WiFi

The odd siren, otherwise it was quiet.

Plenty of cafes and restaurants nearby. McDonald's is on the corner.
Various subway (train) options to get around town.
Easy walk to Bryant Park.

author: Danilo D
title: Disappointment
text: Excellent location right next to Times Square. Room on a high floor (48) with a nice view of the city, comfortable beds. Otherwise, the room is old, the bathroom is old with damaged tiles, the furniture is old and damaged, the TV shows one channel out of ten, and there is a lack of a refrigerator (the door that once housed it is now empty). When we asked to change to a better room, we were told that they are all like that. In short, a disappointment.

author: Amish A
title: Wonderful hospitality and genuinely caring staff
text: A very pleasant stay with a great location and welcoming atmosphere. When my flight was cancelled, Marlene was exceptionally kind and supportive, after I explained the situation, she personally spoke with her manager and helped arrange a considerable discount for an early check-in, which I truly appreciated. Christopher was also very courteous and took the time to assist me despite his busy schedule. Their genuine care and kindness made a stressful situation much easier. It was a memorable experience.

author: ddadams2021
title: Cannot fault this hotel 10/10
text:
My first stay at the Millennium hotel; was pre warned about the renovations going on, but to be honest, with the exception of the 44th street entrance being closed, it didn't make the slightest bit of difference. 
The check in process was  seamless and the customer service, excellent.
Location was amazing 
I was given a corner room with a Times Square view, which was completely unexpected, but it was just perfect. The air conditioning was fantastic, the room size was fabulous, especially for a room in the heart of Times Sqaure, the bed was super comfy, I honestly can't fault this place. 
If I had to pull things apart, I'd say it is quite tired looking but I assume the renovation will correct this, but for the price, it was EXCELLENT.
I managed to talk to George (Rooms Manager) who went above and beyond to answer my question and help me out.
I shan't hesitate to stay here the next time I'm in the city, it's a 10/10 for me.

author: L H
title: Great value and great people
text: Best place to stay in the city for price, value, view and their people. Thank you manager Lenny and Kyce for taking care of us and answering all of our questions. Your attention to detail and memory of us was appreciated. See you again soon!

author: Charlotte G
title: Amazing

author: Gabriel G
title: Clean, comfortable room, friendly staff, great central location
text:
The rooms are very large and airy, clean, and comfortably furnished. The back faces a courtyard, so it had an open view and was quiet even in our second-floor studio. The weekly housekeeping service and laundry room downstairs add to the convenience.
The desk, housekeeping, and maintenance staff are all very friendly and professional.
The location is also perfect. It’s on a quiet street in a charming, safe neighborhood with a great range of restaurants of all types and prices. You can walk to almost anywhere in Manhattan and there are buses, subways, and trains nearby.
Really enjoyed our stay and would highly recommend.

author: Excursion27491654293
title: A great place to stay in Manhattan

Near the Grand Central Station and many restaurants around. The area is safe. Their elevator is also very fast and efficient.  Checkout time is 12:00 noon. We requested if we can extend some time and they allowed us without charging us extra. We will definitely come back again.

author: Sightsee16425018054

Stan and all the doormen were extremely nice and helpful!
Location is amazing and the place is well kept and cleaned every week!

author: Gina H

author: Emma C

author: Travel40785504076

author: BecklarS
title: Not a 4 star hotel
text:
We stayed at The Park Central hotel at the end of July ‘26 for 8 nights. 

The good bits;
Location - The hotel is in a perfect location to explore the city. Close to everything and a subway station on the corner of the street. 

Fantastic bar man - John works in the hotel bar and deserves a special mention. He gave us some very helpful advice about the city, was always smiling and welcoming. 

The bad bits;
Not a 4 star hotel - Inside the lobby and bar, the hotel portrays a 4 star look. Once you get into the rooms, they are in need of decoration. The latch on the window in our room wasn’t secure (luckily we were 17 floors up) and came loose every time the main door closed. Windows were dirty too. Not what I would expect from a 4 star hotel.

Reception staff - Well they weren’t rude but I wouldn’t exactly call them welcoming! They told you the information you needed to know and any questions beyond that felt like an inconvenience. 

Room service - This is non existent. Coffee and tea making facilities are available in the room upon request. I asked for a kettle THREE TIMES before it was delivered to the room. Being British, it was lucky we had brought our own tea bags as nothing was offered. The cups provided were paper and I had to get my own plastic spoon from the shop in the lobby. 

The lifts - There were just 2 lifts serving all floors. To go from the 17th floor, you’d stop multiple times on the way down and people around the 5th floor were finding that by the time it reached them, they were too full. They were not adequate for the size of the hotel.
 
Security deposit - This was my BIGGEST bug bear. I had seen online that it was a $500 security deposit. I was told at check in it was $100 per night then charged $700. We checked out on the 1st of August. The security deposit was left pending on my credit card until the 24th of August despite being told it would be released upon checkout and then told within 14 days when I queried it after 7 days.

Conclusion - If you are looking for a roof over your head and a bed to sleep on in a good location whilst staying in the city, it fits the bill. If you are looking for a 4 star hotel, it does not.

author: Wendy H
title: Park Central. Why stay anywhere else?
text: Park Central is probobly my favorite place to stay on Manhattan . From the moment I step onto the lobby , I’m greeted with helpful , cheerful people.  Carolyn , at the front desk, always remembers me by name, and makes sure that I have all the accommodations that I need.. Carlolym is always quick to make sure  my special requests are met and has great suggestions of  pkaces to go and things to do . . that’s why I choose Park Central again and again, the Customer Service!

author: Alnesha Banks
title: Romantic Birthday Weekend
text: We truly enjoyed our stay at the Sanctuary Hotel in New York. We travelled there to see Bruno Mars at Metlife Stadium on August 22nd 2026. It was about ~20-25 minutes walk from Penn Station and was located right in the thick of Times Square. Upon arrival, check-in was smooth and pleasant. The staff was very friendly and welcoming. When we arrived, our room was beautifully decorated with a happy birthday sign and colorful balloons which was included in our prepaid birthday package. We also had a large piece of strawberry cheesecake and a chilled bottle of champagne waiting for us. I was very satisfied with this purchase. My boyfriend loved it and it really made him feel special on his birthday. We definitely took advantage of the $25 dollars a day food/beverage credit at the Haven rooftop and let me tell you the food was fabulous! We ate there on Friday and Saturday night and both times were amazing! The staff was super friendly and the manager stopped by several times to make sure we were enjoying our meal. I would definitely stay at Sanctuary again :)

author: NorthStar11253775574
title: Amazing Experience.
text:
I stayed here last week with my Mother, She yearly comes to visit me in New York and we always stay in different hotels. The Sanctuary Hotel was our favorite so far. The location is perfect, and the Hotel has a very Classy and clean look. 
All the staff is extremely friendly and helpful. 
Jhona is so so sweet, she checked us in and her warm genuine energy made us immediately feel super welcome.
I truly recommend this Hotel.

author: Kayla
title: Clean, great location, few hiccups
text:
Nice hotel I would stay at again. Great location close to Times Square and theaters, super easy walk from Penn Station. Room was clean and staff was very polite. Didn’t notice much noise (on the 5th floor). 

A few complaints: our one window was frosted over & facing an alley (? I think, it was hard to see through it!) so no sunlight whatsoever in the room. Pitch black in the morning!

Check in took a pretty long time. Partially because a few of the parties in front of us had issues with their reservations and partially because they only had one person checking people in at first, even though it was check in time. 

The $25 credit toward food is a little useless if you’re staying one night like I did. By the time we finally managed to check in, we didn’t want to linger around the hotel any longer, we wanted to get out there! And the places we could use it at the hotel didn’t stay open late, and we couldn’t use the money the next morning. I’m sure a lot of people don’t end up spending it. Not sure what the other $15 of the destination fee is meant to cover because they don’t provide any unique amenities or anything to make them stand out among the other hotels around. 

We got this hotel for a great deal and for that price, I’d definitely stay again - but I wouldn’t spend more on it.

author: Trina L
title: Will definitely be back
text: This is the second time that we have stayed at The Sanctuary Hotel New York. They are wonderful!! The hotel is beautiful, the staff are extremely friendly and accommodating. The housekeeping staff did a wonderful job keeping our room clean and tidy and keeping us stocked with fresh linens. We got the small room but it was perfect as we only needed it to sleep. This hotel is extremely nice for the price. We can go to New York without breaking the bank and stay in a beautiful hotel that is at the center of everything.

author: anjpanj55
title: Clean, comfortable, friendly, but very loud
text:
It was clean, the staff was friendly, the bed was comfortable, room was decorated nice, and the shower water was hot. 
The location could be good if you want to be basically right in Times Square. But if you want more quiet, this is not it. 
This was our first time in NYC so I didn't realize this about the location. 
The problem I had was the noise from our room. They put us on the 2nd floor street view and it was extremely loud. I know this is NYC, but it was so loud I couldn't sleep at all the first night. It felt like I was sleeping outside. I have a video taken by the closed window and it sounds like I'm outside on the street. 
We asked to be moved to a quieter room and the 2nd night they were able to accommodate. We were on the same side of the street, but on level 7. You could still hear street noise, but it was bearable. 
I would not stay here again mostly for this reason and I didn't love the location.

author: Renata G
title: Great weekend!
text:
Took my daughter to NYC for the weekend to celebrate her birthday, and we couldn’t have asked for a better welcome! 🎉🗽

As soon as we arrived, we were greeted and checked in by Raquel. She was so nice, welcoming, and incredibly helpful. She gave us some great tips on what to do, where to go, and the best way to hit some of the top spots around the city.

Her kindness and helpfulness really helped make our weekend extra special. Thank you, Raquel, for starting our NYC birthday adventure off on such a great note! ❤️

author: DaeSun C
title: DO NOT BOOK HERE! THEY PROMISED ME A REFUND AND ARE AVOIDING ME NOW!
text:
DO NOT STAY! Currently FIGHTING to get my money back that they TOLD ME I would get back during my early check out. My room was God awful and did not match the pictures. It has now been 14 days and they have ignored all communications from Air BnB in regard to my refund request. DO NOT STAY HERE! author: topharry123
title: DO NOT STAY, THIS HOTEL IS A HELL HOLE
text:
To put it mildly, this hotel might be the biggest hotel scam I have ever seen. Two reasons:

1. We booked through Priceline and spent roughly $3,000 for 6 nights. Every picture made the hotel look beautiful and newly renovated. When we checked in, we got a room looking something like it was out of a horror movie. I asked the front desk and they told us that only one out of the 18 floors or so was renovated and those were the highest price rooms. Nowhere in the booking did it reference that only 5% of the rooms looked like they did in the picture. Ours has old carpets, brown stains in the bathroom, peeling wallpaper etc. 
2. Our hotel came with free breakfast. It was noted in the booking confirmation that I got and when we checked in, the person that checked us in told us it came with breakfast included. Day one, no issues. Day two, we got told it was only for 2 people vs the 4 we had booked. We went to front desk, showed them our Priceline reservation and she gave us a card (which we still have) that says "breakfast for 4". Days 3-6 we asked for 4 and were told it was only for 2 again so we gave up and fed the kids at a coffee shop. When we checked out, we were told we were good to go. I noticed we were charged an extra $180 so I contacted the hotel. They told me we had been charged $30 per day for breakfast. I sent them proof it had been paid for and they "passed it onto accounting". In the last 6 weeks, they won't respond, they won't return calls after leaving a voicemail, and they won't pick up the phone. We have been forced to seek legal action against the hotel and have now made formal complaints to the DWP and DWCP to push for a resolution. 

DO NOT STAY HERE. They have the proof yet still do nothing about it. Their customer service is lousy, their hotel is disgusting and the staff are rude and nasty. I have stayed at maybe 2,500 hotels in my lifetime and this is 100% the worst experience I have ever had.

author: Meryem R
title: Great experience that made my heart happy

author: Dion I
title: Great Birthday Stay

author: NP London
title: Awful

author: StClare R
title: “Staff Assured Refund — Hotel Reversed Course After ATC Cancellation”
text: booked a Junior Suite at The Shoreham Hotel for August 7-10, 2026. My trip was cancelled due to an ATC power outage that grounded JetBlue flight B6 286 on August 7 — a federally documented event completely beyond my control. Gabriel at the front desk assured me a refund would be processed given the extraordinary circumstances. However, when my booking platform Hopper contacted the hotel for written authorization, the hotel reversed course and declined to authorize the refund. Over $900 lost for a stay that never happened due to a government-caused disruption. Hopper has confirmed they will process the refund immediately upon written authorization from the hotel. I have always believed that how a business handles adversity defines their character. Unfortunately The Shoreham’s handling of this situation does not reflect the standard expected of a luxury Midtown boutique hotel. I am still hopeful management will do the right thing and honor the commitment made by their staff.

Comfortable and clean room with self service bar at reception for drinks and snacks

author: Andre T

author: Heike B

author: Magalie B

Modern, clean, and quiet hotel, a very beautiful, friendly place.

Super welcoming staff, available for any request. 
Hearty breakfasts.

author: Silvia

We had a really great experience at this hotel, so much so that we chose to stay here twice in a row during our trips to Manhattan. The value for money is excellent, especially considering the location, which is very convenient for exploring the city and getting around easily.

The service was impeccable, with friendly and attentive staff who were always happy to help. We had a very positive experience on both occasions, and if we return to Manhattan in the future, I would definitely choose this hotel again without hesitation.

Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

author: Trip19612431586
title: Great Location, Poor Service
text: Will definitely be looking at other options when traveling to NYC.  We had to make multiple calls for repairs in the room, one being a leaking shower door than never got fixed.  Since we stayed for 7 days we ordered groceries.  When they were delivered we had to go down to meet the delivery person (he couldn't come up as we're accustomed to).  Plus, a lady working in the lobby said we couldn’t use the luggage cart to bring up the many bags and case of water.  Unacceptable!  They had several carts available for use.  The cleaning lady was persistent daily for wanting to clean the room.  We were on vacation and didn’t want the pressure to leave the room.  Putting out the door sign did not help.  The sleeper sofa in the 1 Bedroom was surprisingly comfortable.   I strongly recommend bringing a charging station.  We could not use the outlet in the living room while sleeping on sleeper sofa as the light switch at the entrance controlled this outlet.  Also, the bedroom lacks lighting.  There is no light anywhere near the closet so finding things in the closet/luggage was challenging.  Also, be prepared to pay a resort fee of 54.51 USD per night.

author: Laurie A
title: My best NYC hotel visit ever!
text: This place is fantastic! You can’t beat the location, Carnegie Hall, right across the street and a 10 minute walk to go see shows. We stayed in a room with one bedroom and two bathrooms and overall probably about 500 ft.². The only thing I wish the room had was a toaster!  I am 100% sure I will be staying there again on my next trip to New York City!!

author: MrsVV38
title: Great location, awful room & experience.
text:
The hotel needs to be updated. 
The reception area is nice and the seating area on floor 26 is nice. 
Other than that the hotel is majorly run down. 
For such a big hotel the elevator situation was terrible. 

The room we stayed in is not a suite and should not be sold as such. It is a small cramped, dark and dingy room. 

We stayed in room 226. It is the worst hotel room we have ever encountered. 
There is no proper window in the room.
There is no proper lighting in the room,  just 3 lamps. Without a window (it is half 3 quarter coated glass) this makes the room incredibly dark and dingy. 
No proper light in the bathroom so you can’t see in the mirror. 
When we arrived as a family of 4, we had expected 2 x double beds. This was probably a mistake on booking (through an agent). We had one bed and a sofa bed and the sofa bed that was not made up. 
We had to wait for it to be made and it was like a concrete block. So hard and uncomfortable. No proper duvet. The lady who made the bed was going to leave one pillow on the bed. After travelling for 12 hours this wasn’t a great start to our trip. 
We only had 2 big towels and 2 hand towels for 4 guests. 

We were only staying a few days before heading elsewhere so I didn’t have the energy to move rooms or hotels. I checked online and the hotel was full so no chance of a room move. 

The hotel should not be selling this room. The carpet was dirty, the blind didn’t fully come down, it wasn’t up to a cleanliness standard I would expect. 

The reception staff were all lovely and really helpful. Cannot fault the staff. It’s not their fault the owners / management have the hotel in the state it is in. 

We had to ask for clean towels, toilet rolls etc. 

The location is great but I wouldn’t book here. 

The images the hotel use seem to be from a long time ago. It is not like that now. 

We can only go off our room and experience. 

Avoid room 226 at all costs. Higher rooms you have the issue of getting up and down with one lift in operation or using the staff lift. It takes forever for lifts to come. 

At least we had the choice to use the staircase for our room. On saving grace. 

My daughter cried after being in the rock hard sofa bed so my husband slept on that instead. It is not OK to give that to guests.

author: Linda B
title: 4 star amazing hotel with balcony options!
text: Excellent hotel! Great staff, reasonably priced valet parking, breakfast and I upgraded to a junior suite with a Balcony! Great location for theater and concerts. Just stayed at a supposedly 4 star hotel that had ZERO of the advertised necessities like no food at all (not even coffee), no parking at all, a broken down version of its former self. The Manhatten Club is walking distance from theaters, concerts and museums. Can’t always afford that junior balcony suite but a regular room is well priced for this clear 4 star winner (Only a handful of hotels reach 5 stars in NYC and cost at least 2-3x as much). Will return and highly recommend.
