author: 1NicePerson
title: Friendly hotel in a good location
text:
This is a small hotel with a terrific staff and prime location.   The building is over 100 years old, but I believe it was converted to a hotel about 30 years ago and renovated more recently.   Unfortunately, when it was last renovated, they forgot to hire an electrician!

There were but a few electrical outlets poorly located around the room, including one inaccessible outlet behind the bed.  At the desk there was a lamp, cordless phone and coffee maker all competing for one well-worn outlet.  Even after disconnecting the cordless phone, I had to unplug the coffee maker to plug in my laptop, or unplug the lamp to make coffee, etc. etc.   Being able to plug in only two devices near the desk, may have worked years ago, but in 2026, it’s simply inadequate.

I mentioned this to the lovely young lady at Reception and she very politely offered to have an extension cord or power strip sent to my room.   That didn’t happen.   I mentioned it again the next morning and she again made the same offer, but again that didn’t happen.   I gave up at that point. 

There were two USB charging outlets in the desk lamp base.   The USB-A worked, but the USB-C didn’t.  None of the lamps had AC outlets, as you find in most hotels nowadays.  None.

So, if I stay here again, I’ll remember to pack an extension cord.

author: jpete02
title: Awesome stay in Midtown Manhattan
text:
Really good experience at this hotel.  You can’t beat the location.  One block from Grand Central Station, about a ten minute walk to Fifth Avenue and shopping, and a twenty minute walk to Times Square.  There is a market in Grand Central on the ground floor and many quick casual restaurants in the basement of the station.  Four subway lines converge on Grand Central Station and from there you easily explore Manhattan.

We paid extra for the junior suite and found it was worth the money.  Bathroom was recently renovated and extremely spacious with double sinks and a large shower.  Room also had a small sitting area.  

Hotel is only ten stories tall, so don’t expect a view from your room.  Our room was at the back of the hotel, so very quiet at night and minimal traffic noise.  They do have live music at the attached Wheeltapper pub patio but it was done by 9 or 10 pm and we slept well.

Staff was friendly and they do have a turn down service at night where they leave a few treats.

Overall, would happily stay here again.

author: Sonia P
title: 5 stars and the rest!
text: Can’t recommend this hotel enough.  Staff truly looked after us on our 6 night stay in  New York.  They are hardworking, always friendly and knowledgeable.  Everything from the moment we arrived to the minute we left was just perfect.  Baggage drops/storage for earlier check-ins/late departures; advice and support of how best to navigate the city and sights to visit.  Excellent location - round the corner from Grand Central Station and with excellent food and beverage shops within very short walking distances in all directions.  Delicious cocktails at the hotel bar.  Genuinely excellent service making our whole experience the absolute best.  Thank you team Fitzpatrick!

author: NorthFlorida
title: A Wonderful Stay
text:
We stayed at the Fitzpatrick Grand Central Hotel for a five-night stay and, after staying at many different NYC hotels over the years, we feel we have finally found the hotel we will return to for our visits to the city. The rooms and bathrooms are large and comfortable. Housekeeping came each day to clean our rooms and replace towels. The desk staff was helpful and personable. The on-site Wheeltapper Restaurant is a pub with an Irish American menu and served breakfast, lunch, and dinner in indoor and outdoor seating areas.  

There were a few issues we noted. The Wheeltapper does not open until 7:30 a.m. which was too late some mornings, but we found a French Pastry shop two blocks away that served breakfast. The hotel rooms are being remodeled starting with the ninth floor down. When I booked our rooms, I saw photos on the hotel website of walk-in showers in the junior suite. As older travelers, we prefer this option. Our room on the second floor has not been remodeled and had a tub with two steps up to climb in. This was a safety issue for us. Ironically, there was a grab bar, but it was on the left end of the tub where the faucets are. Adding a grab bar at the right end of the tub would have made our entries and exits feel safer. Rooms on the second floor are directly over the Wheeltapper Pub, so we could hear music. It did not go past 10:00 p.m. but we will request a higher floor in the future.

Our future plans will include stays at the Fitzpatrick. It is comfortable, clean, and conveniently located near Grand Central Station.

author: rowanNottingham
title: A great place to stay in New York
text:
I have honestly lost track of the amount of times we have stayed at this hotel and we honestly would not stay anywhere else in New York. 
The staff are all lovely and will always go above and beyond to talk to you or help you and they are a true credit to the management team. I can not name you all but Andrea, Jeff, Chrystal, Garfield, Sybil, Nicole and Bilau you are a true credit to this hotel. 
The hotel is in the perfect place to explore all of New York. Right near Grand Central Station. Hotel bar is amazing and was a great place to watch the World Cup and relax with a drink and a meal. 
We will be back in November to see you all for Thanksgiving.

author: Renee A
title: Love the staff above all
text:
The best experience was with the staff. Everyone was kind and helpful but 3 people stood out. One was the evening receptionist ( unfortunately I don’t remember her name), who went above and beyond to make me happy and has a fantastic personality. The other two people were Mohamed and Said  who greet you at the door and make an amazing team. These two guys are worth booking a room there again. 

The location is awesome too, in the theatre district, and you can pretty much walk everywhere. Everything I needed last minute was on that block. 2 minute walk to snacks, pharmacy, street cart right in front of the hotel if you need a midnight coffee or refreshment, lots of restaurants and bars and very diverse crowd. 

The bed was very comfortable, clean linens, fresh towels, complementary water and overall homey, relaxed atmosphere. 

I would come to this hotel again next time I’m in town.

author: Mariellen H
title: Very Nice!
text:
Location was great, hotel was very nice, room was compact but comfortable.
We did request ice & a few glasses/cups from front desk but they never arrived

author: Kelly B
title: Great 1 night stay
text:
Great 1 night stay. Check in was easy. The room was clean and the beds were really soft. Rooms are smaller but clean. The bathroom shower was excellent with fantastic hot water!  
A couple of opportunities were that there was no mini fridge to store cold drinks or leftovers.  Even though our room door was locked and secured with deadbolt it did not feel as secure as other hotel doors. The hotel is modern and renovated however I feel like newer room doors should have been part of what should have been replaced.
Jeff the doorman at the entrance was exceptional and super accommodating and friendly. 
Overall we enjoyed the experience

author: Korrawan K
title: Excellent Service and Great Location At Ameritania Times Square
text: I had a great stay at Ameritania at Times Square. The hotel is in a very convenient location, and the staff were incredibly helpful and friendly. A special thank you to Javal, Jeff, and Mohamed for helping us with our luggage and arranging a car to the airport. They made everything so much easier and stress-free, especially when we had a lot of bags. I really appreciate their kindness and excellent service. I would definitely recommend this hotel and would be happy to stay here again!

author: Shelly H
title: Fabulous stay in the heart of Times Square/Theater district
text: Staff were very attentive and housekeeping was excellent and room was very clean. Jeff at the front was very kind and helpful with our heavy bags too!!

author: Hovhannes
title: Great Location, Comfortable Room, and Helpful Staff
text:
We stayed at this hotel with our family in a double queen room with a sofa, and overall we had a very pleasant experience.

The room was quite spacious and comfortable. It was clear that the room had been recently renovated, with fresh, modern furniture and a nice overall feel. Having two queen beds and a sofa gave our family plenty of space.

The hotel also has a breakfast room with an à la carte menu. We had breakfast there a couple of times, and I especially appreciated being able to get Starbucks coffee every morning before heading out for a day of walking around New York. There is also a small market inside the hotel with a microwave, which is very convenient if you need to warm up some food.

The location is excellent. It’s about a 10–15 minute walk to Rockefeller Center, Times Square, and Central Park, and there are plenty of grocery stores, restaurants, and other places to eat nearby.

The staff were always polite and helpful, and the daily housekeeping service was very good and made our stay even more comfortable.

Overall, we were very happy with our stay and would definitely consider staying here again when visiting New York.

author: adamchen0129
title: Great Stay and great services
text:
We had a great living experience in this hotel! Very quiet neighborhood and good quality of services. 

Special thanks to Carlos and Claudia! They are very kind people who had provided great support and advice during our visit. 

It will definitely be a right decision if you choose to stay in Residence Inn Manhattan/Midtown East, NYC.

author: Ira
title: Great location, but vibe is not friendly.
text: Great location and rooms have 2 queen beds, which is hard to find in NYC. However, front desk staff are not friendly and the selection of books on display in the lounge area leans very right wing/conservative/religious ( Sarah Palin, Glenn Beck, Jerome Corsi, Billy Graham, etc). I’ve never seen this type of overt political statement in a large chain hotel. Seems like a weird thing to do in this polarized political climate.

author: jeff3545
title: A Best Bargain
text: Clean, efficient and basic.  Very large rooms with good beds, decent pillows, desk and a mini fridge.  Excellent price for the location and the quality of accommodation.  Breakfast offering was pretty poor, but you are in Manhattan with lots of options.  dedicated car service back to the airport was a very good deal.  Staff was friendly and helpful.  I wouldn't make this a romantic retreat, but for a quick business meeting in the area or a visit to MSK Rockefeller Outpatient Cancer Center you cannot beat it.

author: McLendon F
title: Amazing Experience + Staff
text: Oksana and Michael are absolutely amazing! It is always such a joy to book with them and they make the process as smooth as possible. Great location and room as well

author: ISABEL K
title: Odain and Odessa were the best!!
text: We had the most pleasant time at this hotel. It was close to everything we wanted to see and if it wasn't, then it was close to a subway stop that got us there. The rooms were clean and cozy and the staff had lots of great suggestions for us to visit. Odain, Kyle and Odessa were the stars of the show! They greeted us with a smile every time we came in and literally took care of us like we were family. I have never felt so comfortable in a place that wasn't my home! They were there literally all hours of the day and talking to them was a real highlight of our trip. Quiet, great atmosphere, great value, and location. all around 11/10 stay at this hotel!

author: Tom C
title: Convenient, clean hotel in the heart of midtown. Train stations nearby.
text: Convenient hotel location in heart of midtown. Clean, small room but very functional with a great view. Nice to stay on a higher floor. They make great use of the spaces. Near both Penn and Grand Central Stations. Great places to eat nearby.

author: Brendan M
title: Great business location
text: The Courtyard 5th Ave has been our organizations go-to for several years.  Staff has been very accommodating and the mid-town location is perfect.

author: addyvt
title: Great Midtown Location
text:
Got a great price for two nights so went with it. All staff we encountered were pleasant. The free coffee and water bottle filler on the Mezzanine floor are a nice touch. 
Rooms - room was clean and comfortable...also small which is to be expected in NYC.  Bathroom is in dire need of updating. 
Location was great - right in Midtown, across the street from the NY Public Library. Grand Central, Bryant Park, Times Sq. all an easy walk away. 
Would stay there again if the price is right.

author: WINEandTRAVEL
title: Great Location - Great for Solo No Frills Traveler
text:
I'm loyal to Marriott properties, unless there's a reason to look elsewhere... notable hotel, location, etc.  They have a great website that makes it easy to find what you are looking for.  Preferred a hotel in this area and noticed that they had a good price and didn't have an added nightly amenity fee (these added fees are becoming maddening... just charge what you need to charge, incorporate this "fee" in the room price).   They can't charge the fee as they don't have a restaurant.  This hotel has no amenities, other than a pretty good coffee/latte/etc. machine on the mezzanine that actually wasn't bad.  However, this is NYC, there are a ton of places within a couple of blocks. 

So, consider it a no frills place... just a room.  However, the location was great for me.  The rooms are small, but the bed, shower, fine.  As I was traveling solo,  it was perfect...  wouldn't recommend for a family.   I loved this pick!

author: Mirko Bianchi
title: Bad
text:
Let's start with the key point: this hotel cannot be a three-star. 
Dirty carpet in both the hallways and the rooms, very small bathrooms with toilets that clog every other minute, water that tastes like iron, minimal and basic breakfast service. 
These are just the general negative details.
In my specific case, one evening the shower knob came off in my hand… 
The only point in its favor is the strategic location near the park and near the metro 1 
I will not return.

author: matthew m
title: wonderful
text: Such a great hotel for couples who want a cozy place to stay at in Central Park. Jennifer at front desk was really helpful and great customer service. Definitely recommended. P/S: Thanks again, Jennifer for all your help!

author: tnypco
title: Fleabag - should be shut down at once.
text: Filthy and smelly room, with a huge indention in the bed, showing someone had been lying there and yet the room was sold to me as a new clean room. Not enough clean towels provided. No housekeeping provided unless requested - that was never disclosed, I overheard that in the elevator from another guest! Room lights went out when I was showering. TV failed due to rain - explained to me by the front desk as "TV fails in rain as it is a satellite dish as the manager is too cheap to provide cable"; the noisy through window air conditioner had a filter that had never been changed = I had to turn it off. Windows didn't open - the one that did slid shut on its own. Room phone to front desk not operational. The electricity shorted out unexpectedly, leaving me with no light, no power - nothing! And to charge me for one night with all of this, is a disgrace.  Finally, beg bug bites noted by physician the next day. This all will be reported to the City of New York's Dept of Health as well as the Dept of Consumer Affairs!

author: LLL2225
title: This property should be condemned
text: Terrible, horrible, shameful !  The great location doesn't compensate for the disgusting condition of the property.  The A/C window unit roared like a DC3,  the carpet in the hallway had bleach stains throughout , the carpet in the room was so bad I wore shoes the entire stay; would not dare put bare feet on the floor!  The excuse for pillows are lumps of compressed foam. The windows are filthy making the purple room seem even darker and smaller. The wait for the elevator exceeded 10 minutes most of the time since there is only one elevator to service 14 floors AND the housekeeping team (there is no daily housekeeping service and the mops and vacuums remain on the narrow halls all the time).  If you can ignore the subpar rooms, furniture and outlets that are broken and don't function, the rattle of the AC, awful breakfasts and wait time to exit the building then the surrounding neighborhood is pretty great.  Have fortitude and low standards to endure the hotel itself.

author: Michael M
title: Total mess of a hotel and way over priced
text:
Terrible messy hotel.
Arrived to find it was undergoing refurbishment. Mess in corridors and in the room. Bathroom had lumps of plaster falling off the walls onto the floor.
We left immediately and were told a refund would be given. Three weeks later no refund. They’re ignoring calls and emails.

author: KBD87
title: Ok just don’t over expect
text: We stayed at the hotel for a concert at Madison Square Garden. It is convenient for a two block walk to the arena. The hotel is old and hasn’t been renovated recently, the bathroom is primitive and rooms are small. But, it is clean and the beds are fine and the price is good for manhattan. The hotel is fine but just do not over expect. Not much of a lobby or staff but I rarely hang out in lobbies or need anything anyway.

author: SharonM371133
title: Great stay
text: Room was clean and quiet overnight. Staff were friendly upon check-in and check-out. Would definitely stay here again.

author: Lauren S
title: Decent value hotel
text: Went with 3 teenage girls and the size of the room was good for 5 people.  It was very clean.  Two complaints were that hot water frequently ran out and the elevator was extremely slow.  Staff were nice.

author: VFMEK
title: Perfect for what we wanted
text: We were delighted with this hotel. It is about one block away from the Empire State Building and close to the underground. It has a small rooftop terrace service food and drink and you could see the building lit up. It was beautiful. Every staff member we met was friendly and helpful. We would definitely choose it again.

author: NYC2VT
title: Decent Midtown Hotel
text: This hotel was perfectly adequate. Rooms were clean and staff were nice enough. Lobby is a bit lackluster, but we weren’t there to hang out in it! Very conveniently located to MSG and Penn Station.
